sections.text: The Angel Haven is a combat anomaly found in Angel infested regions. The site is moderately difficult, but may be done with a sniper Battleship or an advanced Cruiser (Faction, T2 or T3).

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Ungated normal space pocket. There are 2 variants of this anomaly, commonly referred to as "gas" or "rock" haven by players. The rock haven variant is readily identified by the warp-in popup received. Each also feature different structures within the site. Note: In Case of a Dreadnought spawn, note that if the only Ship left is the Dreadnought you must not leave the Site or the Dreadnought will despawn!

sections.heading: Rock Haven Variant (Pirate Gate)
sections.text: All hostile ships spawn within the Giant Snake-Shaped Asteroid structure making it easy to "speed tank" by orbiting that structure at optimal range.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Bounty of the site is around 30 Million ISK (2020).

sections.heading: Escalation

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Minmatar Republic or occupied by the Angel Cartel. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Domination faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Angel Repurposed Outpost complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Angel Hidden Hideaway, Angel Forsaken Hideaway and Angel Forlorn Hideaway.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Angel Repurposed Outpost Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Besieged Covert Research Facility is a Mordu's Legion combat anomaly. It can be found in any region of empire space, but only in Low Security systems. They are the only normal combat anomaly that can spawn in Faction warfare systems. You will need: * a ship that can sustain fire from up to five Battleships, a passive buffer Gila with Vespa and Kin/Therm resists can do this site in approx. 10-12 mins. * a Stealth Bomber with an oversized afterburner and missile precision enhancers. This method relies completely on speed tanking and cannot absorb more than one or two lucky hits from the battleships, and necessitates Tech II torpedo fits and high navigation skills to reliably complete the sites. Requires at least 500 DPS (Kinetic) to complete. Tips: * No faction standing penalty for killing Mordu's ships. * All ships fly up to 380m/s * All ships have active shield tank * Kinetic is the best damage to both deal and resist. * The Cruiser's missiles deal Kinetic damage * The Battleship's high accuracy and infinite range Thermal/Kinetic/EM turrets deal 350 damage per shot, while their cruise missiles deal 900 Kinetic damage per shot. * The Commander's turrets deal all damage types, but have poor tracking; and their 54 km range torpedoes deal Kinetic damage * On paper, the highest possible incoming DPS is 1040 (170 EM, 250 Thermal, 620 Kinetic) with 5 Battleships, before taking into account resists and relative signature radius. You should deal Kinetic damage because: * The Cruiser is weak to EM, but has low HP so high Kinetic volley damage can still kill it quickly * The Battl

sections.heading: Warp in
sections.text: Single deadspaced pocket. You cannot warp around. The site is empty at first and remains that way until a player enters within 50 km of the Guristas Research and Trade Hub, even if they are cloaked. Wave 1 spawns within a few seconds after the proximity trigger, indicated by a message in local. None of the NPCs drop any loot, though the Mordu’s Legion Commander has a bounty of 900k ISK. There is no trigger ship. The Second Wave will warp in seconds after you destroy the last ship in the wave. Tracking value of turrets is 7, in line with long-ranged cruiser turrets. Missile attacks have damage application of one size class lower (heavy missiles) The main value of the site comes from the Guristas Research and Trade Hub. The Thukker Component Assembly Facility only drops one or two Covert Research Tools, some minerals and possibly a rare Thukker Component Technical Data Chip that can contain Thukker Upwell structure rig blueprints. If the site isn't cleared within 20 minutes after Wave 1 spawns, the structures, along with any loot inside them, will explode (though the explosions don't deal damage to your ship), and the site is considered failed. Any remaining rats on grid will instantly despawn.

sections.heading: Loot table
sections.text: * Covert Research Tools * Any type of pirate faction ammo (regardless of region), includes commander ammo types (e.g. Dread Guristas) * 30-day pirate ship skins * Low and Mid-Grade implant drops of the following sets: Virtue, Nomad, Centurion, Talisman, Halo, Amulet, Harvest, Hydra, Crystal, Savior, Edge, Asklepian, Snake * Blueprint copies for Hyperspatial Accelerators, Jump Drive Economizers and any of the implants listed above * Minerals, in stacks of 10 (from the Thukker Component Assembly Facility) excluding Morphite * Thukker Capital Component Manufacturing Technical Data Chip, which can be opened to receive Thukker manufacturing rig blueprints for Upwell structures Loot will usually average between 15-40M ISK per site with some variance through implant and BPC drops, which can jack up the loot value to well over 300M. Lowest loot drop seen was around 6M, so it may be a good idea to warp in at long range to the site and cargo scan the Guristas Research and Trade Hub to see if the site is worth running, since the rewards are highly variable.

zh.title: 被围困的隐蔽研究设施

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 被围困的隐蔽研究设施是一个莫杜军团战斗异常。它可以在帝国空间的任何星系找到，但仅出现在低安全等级星系。它们是唯一可以在联邦战争星系中刷新的普通战斗异常。你需要：* 一艘能够承受最多五艘战列舰火力的舰船，一艘配备黄蜂无人机和动能/热能抗性的被动缓冲吉拉舰大约可以在10-12分钟内完成此地点。* 一艘装有超大加力燃烧器和导弹精度增强器的隐身轰炸舰。这种方式完全依赖速度抗性，无法承受战列舰超过一到两次幸运命中，并且需要T2鱼雷配置和高超的导航技能才能可靠地完成地点。至少需要500 DPS（动能）才能完成。提示：* 击杀莫杜舰船没有派系声望惩罚。* 所有舰船速度可达380m/s * 所有舰船使用主动护盾抗性问题 * 动能是对抗和抵抗的最佳伤害类型。* 巡洋舰的导弹造成动能伤害 * 战列舰的高精度和无限射程热能/动能/电磁炮塔每发造成350伤害，而其巡航导弹每发造成900动能伤害。* 指挥官的炮塔造成所有伤害类型，但跟踪速度较差；其54 km射程的鱼雷造成动能伤害 * 理论上，在5艘战列舰的情况下，最高可能的 incoming DPS 为1040（170电磁，250热能，620动能），尚未考虑抗性和相对信号半径。你应该使用动能伤害，因为：* 巡洋舰对电磁弱点，但HP较低，因此高动能齐射伤害仍然可以快速击杀它 * 战

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 单个死亡空间房间。无法环绕跃迁。地点一开始是空的，直到有玩家进入古斯塔斯研究与贸易中心50 km范围内才会触发，即使他们处于隐身状态。第一波在接近触发后几秒内刷新，本地频道会有消息提示。所有NPC都不掉落任何战利品，但莫杜军团指挥官有900k ISK的赏金。没有触发船。第二波将在你消灭该波最后一艘船后数秒内跃迁入场。炮塔跟踪值为7，与远程巡洋舰炮塔一致。导弹攻击的伤害应用低一个级别（重型导弹）该地点的主要价值来自古斯塔斯研究与贸易中心。图克尔组件组装设施仅掉落一到两个隐蔽研究工具、一些矿物，以及可能包含图克尔升级建筑装备蓝图的高价值图克尔组件技术数据芯片。如果在第一波刷新后20分钟内未清除地点，建筑及其内部的所有战利品将爆炸（尽管爆炸不会对你的舰船造成伤害），地点将被视为失败。场上所有剩余的怪将立即消失。

sections.heading: 战利品表
sections.text: * 隐蔽研究工具 * 任何类型的海盗派系弹药（不分区域），包括指挥官弹药类型（例如古斯塔斯指挥官）* 30天海盗舰船涂装 * 以下套组的低阶和中阶植入体掉落：Virtue、Nomad、Centurion、Talisman、Halo、Amulet、Harvest、Hydra、Crystal、Savior、Edge、Asklepian、Snake * 超空间加速器、跳跃驱动器节能器和上述任何植入体的蓝图副本 * 矿物，以10个为一组（来自图克尔组件组装设施），不包括Morphite * 图克尔旗舰组件制造技术数据芯片，可打开获得图克尔Upwell建筑制造装备蓝图 战利品通常平均每个地点在15-40M ISK之间，植入体和蓝图副本掉落会有所波动，可能将战利品价值推高到远超300M。已知最低战利品掉落约为6M，因此远距离跃迁到地点并对古斯塔斯研究与贸易中心进行货舱扫描以确认地点是否值得跑可能是个好主意，因为奖励差异很大。

Be advised, especially if attempting to complete the site inattentively, that in addition to being warp disrupted during the 3rd Reinforcement Spawn, you will often be double-webbed and occassionally triple-webbed, causing damage to spike if you are attempting to tank with angular velocity. Bounties of 24m as at 03-14-2025. They have since been nerfed.

sections.text: 血袭者遗弃枢纽是在血袭者出没区域发现的战斗异常。它是血袭者枢纽的3级变体。

sections.text: 单个无门普通空间区域。击杀最后一艘敌方舰船触发增援波次。请注意，特别是在尝试不注意地完成地点时，在第3增援波次期间你将被反跳，并且经常会被双重网子，偶尔三重网子，如果你尝试用角速度抗性，伤害会急剧上升。截至2025年3月14日赏金为24m。此后已被削弱。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Blood Forsaken Rally Point is a combat anomaly found in Blood Raiders infested regions. It is a level 3 variant of the Blood Rally Point.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Single ungated normal space pocket. This site has triggers, most notably 2 cruisers in the initial defending fleet. If these cruisers are killed, they will spawn the next wave(s) regardless of whether the battleships are killed. Note that one random cruiser in the initial fleet will trigger Wave #2, and another will trigger Wave #3. The site contains approximately 20 million in bounties on average, fluctuating mostly with the number of battleships that spawn. Faction spawns are possible.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The anomaly can escalate to Blood Raider Prison Camp. Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Deepflow Rifts are a Cosmic Anomaly which can be scanned down, appearing initially as a Level 1 Combat Site, but in reality is a fishing mini game involving Tractor Beams and Loot Crates.

sections.heading: Finding a Deepflow Rift
sections.text: Deepflow Rifts are Level 1 Combat signatures that appear in both K- and J- space as well as Pochven. Upon warping to the signature Aura will inform you that a Deepflow Abyssal rift has been detected. Target Lock the Deepflow Rift and manually activate your tractor beams to start "fishing". Be aware you will need to have 'Rifts' displayed on your overview. Using a Mobile Tractor Unit is helpful for collecting the crates but does not work on the Rift itself. thumb|The tracker for Deepflow Rifts includes the number of Canisters found, the time remaining, the current instability and the number of surges so far.

sections.heading: Getting loot
sections.text: Targeting the rift with a Tractor Beam has a chance to generate a Deepflow Cargo Container in space. These containers can have Blue Loot, Red Loot, and other rare items. While in the site, Tractor Beam auto-cycling is disabled, so they need to be manually activated each cycle. The site can generate up to 21 Canisters in High-sec, 27 in Null-sec and Wormholes, and 33 in Low-sec and Pochven, indicated by a tracker, and will expire after 18 minutes, also tracked on screen. Additionally, an indicator is present for stability, and if too many Tractor Beams are activated on the Rift in too short a period of time, a "surge" will happen and a force of roughly 10-15 Rogue Drone frigates and destroyers will appear. There is also a bonus payout for retrieving all containers from the Rift (3M ISK in High-sec, Low-sec and Null-sec), but you must be in a fleet (even with yourself) to be eligible for this reward. Cloaked ships will not receive a payout. If multiple fleets are competing in the same site, only the fleet that contributed the most (retrieved the most containers) gets the payout. Recommended to use no more than 2-3 Tractor beams for the site, since triggering a surge will cause a swarm of Rogue Drones to appear. They do about 250-300 DPS EM/Thermal damage which can quickly kill an undertanked ship. Thankfully, they have no EWAR aside from stasis webs so you can warp off at any time. Destroying them also gives small Rogue Drone standing hit if you intend on getting positive Triglavian and EDENCOM standings. Payout: Average of 25 mil per site, with chance of 'Glorified' crates t

sections.heading: Surges
sections.text: Destroying the spawned Surges will give a very minor faction standing boost for both EDENCOM (+0.004) and the Triglavian Collective (+0.009). The drone spawns behave very similarly to Homefront Operation rats. Corrupted prefix NPCs will frequently primary drones and generally orbit you at 20+ km. Alienator webbing frigates orbit within 10 km and will never shoot drones. Machinist orbits a random NPC and thus can be anywhere from point-blank range to 30 km out. If all containers are retrieved from the rift while the rats are still present on grid, they will continue shooting you for ~2 minutes before warping off.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.text: 2025-11-19 - Using 3 Tractor beams at once after 1 minute triggered ~15 frigate rogue drone response. 2025-01-30 - Deepflow Rifts returned: https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#Deepflow_Rifts 2025-02-05 - Number of canisters now scales with system security: https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#PVE_4 2025-03-19 - Rift timer increased from 15 to 18 minutes: https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#Drifter_Crisis 2025-05-15 - Spawn frequency updated and rewards and enemies updated: https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#Nexus_Reckoning Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 深流裂隙是一种可以扫描到的宇宙异常，初始显示为1级战斗地点，但实际上是一个涉及牵引光束和宝箱的钓鱼小游戏。

sections.heading: 寻找深流裂隙
sections.text: 深流裂隙是出现在K空间、J空间以及Pochven的1级战斗信号。跃迁到信号后，Aura会通知你检测到了深流深渊裂隙。锁定深流裂隙并手动激活牵引光束开始"钓鱼"。注意你需要在总览中显示'Rifts'。使用移动牵引单元有助于收集宝箱，但对裂隙本身无效。thumb|深流裂隙的追踪器包括已找到的容器数量、剩余时间、当前不稳定度和已触发的涌流次数。

sections.heading: 获取战利品
sections.text: 用牵引光束锁定裂隙有几率在空间中生成一个深流货柜。这些货柜可以包含蓝色战利品、红色战利品和其他稀有物品。在站点内，牵引光束的自动循环被禁用，因此每个周期都需要手动激活。该站点最多可生成21个容器（高安）、27个（0.0和虫洞）和33个（低安和Pochven），由追踪器指示，并将在18分钟后过期，同样在屏幕上追踪。此外，还有一个稳定性指示器，如果在太短的时间内对裂隙激活过多牵引光束，就会发生"涌流"，大约10-15艘自由无人机护卫舰和驱逐舰将会出现。从裂隙中回收所有容器还有额外赏金（高安、低安和0.0为3M ISK），但你必须加入舰队（即使只有自己也行）才有资格获得此奖励。隐身的舰船不会获得赏金。如果多个舰队在同一个站点竞争，只有贡献最多（回收最多容器）的舰队获得赏金。建议该站点使用不超过2-3条牵引光束，因为触发涌流会导致一群自由无人机出现。它们造成约250-300 DPS的电磁/热能伤害，可以快速击杀低防御的舰船。幸运的是，它们除了停滞网外没有其他电子战，所以你可以随时跃迁离开。摧毁它们还会轻微降低自由无人机声望，如果你打算获得正三角联合体和EDENCOM声望的话。赏金：每个站点平均2500万，有几率获得'强化'箱

sections.heading: 涌流
sections.text: 摧毁生成的涌流将为EDENCOM（+0.004）和三角联合体（+0.009）提供非常轻微的势力声望提升。无人机刷怪行为与前线行动怪非常相似。Corrupted前缀的NPC会优先攻击无人机，通常在20+公里外环绕。Alienator网子护卫舰在10公里内环绕，永远不会射击无人机。Machinist环绕一个随机NPC，因此可以从零距离到30公里不等。如果在怪仍在格点上时从裂隙中回收了所有容器，它们会继续射击你约2分钟，然后跃迁离开。

sections.heading: 变更
sections.text: 2025-11-19 - 1分钟后同时使用3条牵引光束触发了约15艘护卫舰级别的自由无人机响应。 2025-01-30 - 深流裂隙回归：https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#Deepflow_Rifts 2025-02-05 - 容器数量现在根据星系安全等级缩放：https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#PVE_4 2025-03-19 - 裂隙计时器从15分钟增加到18分钟：https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#Drifter_Crisis 2025-05-15 - 刷新频率更新，奖励和敌人更新：https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/UniWiki:Patch_Notes/Patch_Notes_-_Version_22.02#Nexus_Reckoning 分类：战斗异常

sections.text: Drone Herd is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in low-security and null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). This combat site has a chance to spawn a Sentient commander rogue drone, which drops rogue components and may drop faction drone modules and items. There are two minor variations with slightly different wave compositions.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Drone Horde is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). This site comes in two forms: One which cointains a turret ring and a cloud gas centering a structure, and other that has 4 bunkers in the middle and many scattered in the corners of a square pattern.

sections.heading: Walkthrough (4-Bunker Variant)
sections.text: This site contains four bunkers at 30km from landing and four other separated in a square pattern centering the bunker cluster. The initial wave spawns scattered at the "corners" of that square, all next waves spawn near the central bunker cluster. The site shows some major inconsistencies regarding the order and timing of wave spawning, resulting in some iterations spawning more than one wave at once, and in others skipping one entirely. There is incoming EM in this site (Alvus Queen, Exterminator Alvatis) Removing battleships from the initial wave will trigger two additional waves before the complete removal of the initial wave. One of those two waves will consist of frigates and some bigger ships, the other of cruisers and bigger ships. After the complete removal of the initial spawn and the two additional waves, the site will sequentially spawn these five additional waves (in a random order): With the last wave, there is a chance of a rare spawn

sections.heading: Walkthrough (Gas Ring Variant)
sections.text: Features a structure 30km app. from landing, 8x Lookout Tokers and a Battlecruiser as the initial spawn. Waves are spawned on different points of an horizontal ring with a 20km radius centering the middle structure. Each of these waves spawns a little deployable (not lootable) that diminishes incoming damage. This combat site has a chance to spawn a Sentient Commander Rogue Drone, which drops drone components and may drop faction drone modules and items.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Both sites may escalate to Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive (10/10)

sections.text: 无人机部落是一个属于自由无人机阵营的无评级战斗地点。可以通过探索在新伊甸的0.0星系中作为宇宙异常找到。作为一个无门槛的复合体，能完成该站点的舰船限制与异常所在星系的安全等级相关（高安星系为T2战列舰，低安和0.0星系最高可达泰坦）。该站点有两种形式：一种包含炮台环和以建筑为中心的气云，另一种在中间有4个地堡，并在方形图案的角落散布着许多其他地堡。

sections.heading: 流程（4地堡变体）
sections.text: 该站点在距登陆点30公里处有四个地堡，另有四个以方形图案分散排列，围绕中心地堡群。初始波次在该方形的"角落"处分散刷新，所有后续波次在中心地堡群附近刷新。该站点在波次刷新的顺序和时间上存在较大不一致，导致某些迭代同时刷出多个波次，而另一些则完全跳过一个波次。该站点存在电磁伤害 incoming（Alvus Queen、Exterminator Alvatis）。移除初始波次的战列舰将在初始波次被完全清除前触发两个额外波次。这两个波次之一由护卫舰和更大舰船组成，另一个由巡洋舰和更大舰船组成。在完全清除初始刷怪和两个额外波次后，站点将按顺序刷出以下五个额外波次（顺序随机）：最后一个波次有几率出现稀有刷怪

sections.heading: 流程（气环变体）
sections.text: 在距登陆点约30公里处有一座建筑，初始刷怪为8个Lookout Tokers和一艘战列巡洋舰。波次在以中间建筑为中心、半径20公里的水平环的不同点刷新。每个波次还会刷出一个小型可部署装置（不可拾取），会降低 incoming 伤害。该战斗地点有几率刷出有知觉指挥官自由无人机，掉落无人机组件，并可能掉落势力无人机装备和物品。

sections.text: 两个站点都可能升级为外生自由无人机巢穴（10/10）

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Drone Patrol is a combat anomaly found null-security systems across New Eden. Before hacking and slashing, beware that there are three versions of the site, and the spawns may vary considerably. sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Drone Surveillance is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in low-security and null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). There are two variations of this combat site. The first variation takes place in the ruins of a megastructure and includes Light Missile Batteries in the initial wave. The second variation takes place inside an asteroid-filled cloud and includes Defense Vampire (nosferatu) batteries instead. Both variations have a chance to spawn a Sentient commander rogue drone, which drops drogue components and may drop faction drone modules and items. This site has a chance to escalate to Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Emerging Conduit combat site appeared as an anomaly in all areas of high security space regardless of the presence of Triglavian Invasions between October 2019 and May 2020.

sections.heading: History
sections.text: Emerging Conduits were introduced in October 2019, during Chapter 1 of the Triglavian Invasion. The site uses an identical layout to Minor Conduits, with significantly weaker waves, and no scrams. Initially on a 1 minute respawn timer, people claimed that they could earn as much as 500M ISK/hr across three characters using smartbomb Praxii. The respawn time was later nerfed to 10 minutes in January 2020, lowering its farmability. This iteration of conduits were removed in May 2020, alongside the beginning of chapter 3 of the invasion. New versions of Emerging Conduits have replaced them, now exclusive to Invasion space. Emerging Conduits no longer exist.

sections.heading: Contents
sections.text: The site consists of single ungated normal space pocket. Three waves of increasing difficulty will spawn with next wave appearing after previous wave has been killed. The rats in the site will use various types of EWAR: Energy neutralizing, tracking disruptors, guidance disruptors, webs and target painters. The site does not have warp disrupting or warp scrambling enemies. Frigates are the most common enemy type in the site. Each wave will usually contain one or two destroyers with rest of the ships being frigates. Wave 1: 3-6 Frigates/destroyers (Kikimora/Damavik). Wave 2: 4-7 Frigates/destroyers (Kikimora/Damavik) and a chance of a named Kikimora (Zorya's Kikimora). Wave 3: 9 Frigates/destroyers (Kikimora/Damavik) and a named Vedmak (Zorya's Vedmak).

sections.heading: Tactics
sections.text: The rats will spawn on top of the rift at the center of the site. This is ~70 km from the warpin. The frigates and destroyers will orbit at ~6 km range making webs and grapplers highly effective once they are in range. Frigates have a speed of ~3 km/s and a range of ~20 km. Destroyers have a speed of ~1.5 km/s and a range of ~30 km. Zorya's Vedmak has a speed of 2.3 km/s and a range of 35 km. EWAR weapons have longer ranges. Incoming damage from the waves spike up to 1k to 1.5k per second during the final wave (earlier waves are easier/deal less damage). Kiting them is technically possible, but the fits required to maintain the speed and distance leave very little room for dps. The typical tactic is to stay where you warped in and let them come to you, which gives you time to target them and be ready for the next wave, or, as some are selecting the closest Talassonite asteroid and warping 70km from it allowing you to land directly on to the rift that they spawn from. The site can be completed solo with a heavily tanked passive shield tank battleship - Rattlesnake is the most obvious choice. Other known (successful) options include Leshak, Dominix, Dominix Navy Issue, Drekavac, Praxis and Vindicator. It can also be done with Dual Shield Rep Dominix or Praxis, but they require high drone skills for the proper dps and would require two or more pilots. The rats deal quite high damage but they also switch aggro quite often. This makes it possible to complete the site in a group of ships that can tank the incoming damage in bursts but not sustain the tank. The named rats (Zorya's

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Completing the site will pay 4.5 million isk and 300 DED LP to each pilot present on site. If more than three pilots are on site the payout will be reduced. The different payouts are as follows. No matter how many pilots are in the conduit after three pilots, the combined max payout is 13.5 million isk. 1 to 3 Players - 4.5 Million isk each * 1 Player - 4.5 Million isk Total * 2 Players - 9 Million isk Total * 3 Players - 13.5 Million isk Total 4 Players - 3.375 Million isk each * 13.5 Million isk Total 5 Player - 2.7 Million isk each * 13.5 Million isk Total The Triglavian wrecks will often contain stacks of Triglavian Survey Databases and rarely abyssal filaments or mutaplasmids. Loot from the wrecks can vary from 150,000 isk to upwards of 50 million isk. The Triglavian Survey Databases can be either sold in a station, typically in trade hubs, to buy orders, or you can go to any Concord Station and sell them to Concord for 100,000 isk before in game taxes. Salvage from the Triglavian wrecks will drop materials used for T2 Triglavian ships. Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 涌现导管战斗点于2019年10月至2020年5月期间作为异常出现在所有高安区域，不受特里格拉夫入侵是否存在的影响。

sections.heading: 历史
sections.text: 涌现导管于2019年10月引入，处于特里格拉夫入侵第一章期间。该站点使用与小型导管完全相同的布局，波次显著更弱，且没有短反。最初重生计时器为1分钟，有人声称使用智能炸弹Praxii跨三个角色可以赚取高达500M ISK/小时。重生时间在2020年1月被削弱至10分钟，降低了其刷场效率。此版本的导管在2020年5月与入侵第三章开始时一同被移除。新版本的涌现导管已替代它们，现在仅限于入侵空间。涌现导管已不再存在。

sections.heading: 内容
sections.text: 该站点由单个无门的普通空间房间组成。三波难度递增的怪物会依次刷新，前一波次被消灭后出现下一波次。站点中的怪物会使用多种类型的电子战：毁电、跟踪扰断器、制导扰断器、网子和目标标记器。该站点没有反跳或扰断的敌人。护卫舰是站点中最常见的敌人类型。每波通常包含一到两艘驱逐舰，其余为护卫舰。第1波：3-6艘护卫舰/驱逐舰（Kikimora/Damavik）。第2波：4-7艘护卫舰/驱逐舰（Kikimora/Damavik），有几率出现命名Kikimora（Zorya的Kikimora）。第3波：9艘护卫舰/驱逐舰（Kikimora/Damavik）和一艘命名Vedmak（Zorya的Vedmak）。

sections.heading: 战术
sections.text: 怪物会在站点中心的裂隙上方刷新。这里距跃迁入口约70公里。护卫舰和驱逐舰将在约6公里距离环绕，使得网子和抓钩在射程内非常有效。护卫舰速度约3公里/秒，射程约20公里。驱逐舰速度约1.5公里/秒，射程约30公里。Zorya的Vedmak速度为2.3公里/秒，射程为35公里。电子战武器射程更远。最终波次的来袭伤害峰值可达1k至1.5k每秒（前面的波次更简单/伤害更低）。风筝它们在技术上是可行的，但保持速度和距离所需的配船几乎留不出什么DPS空间。典型战术是停留在跃迁入口处让它们过来，这给你时间锁定目标并为下一波次做好准备，或者，有些人选择最近的Talassonite小行星并从其70公里处跃迁，使你直接落在它们刷新的裂隙上。该站点可以单独使用高抗被动盾抗战列舰完成——Rattlesnake是最显而易见的选择。其他已知（成功的）选择包括Leshak、Dominix、Dominix Navy Issue、Drekavac、Praxis和Vindicator。也可以使用双盾修Dominix或Praxis完成，但它们需要较高的无人机技能来达到足够的DPS，并且需要两名或更多飞行员。怪物的伤害相当高，但它们也经常切换仇恨。这使得一组能够承受爆发伤害但无法持续抗住的舰船也可以完成该站点。命名怪（Zorya的

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 完成该站点将向在场每位飞行员支付450万ISK和300 DED LP。如果在场飞行员超过三名，报酬将减少。不同的报酬如下。无论导管中有多少名飞行员（超过三名后），总报酬上限为1350万ISK。1至3名玩家 - 每人450万ISK * 1名玩家 - 总计450万ISK * 2名玩家 - 总计900万ISK * 3名玩家 - 总计1350万ISK 4名玩家 - 每人337.5万ISK * 总计1350万ISK 5名玩家 - 每人270万ISK * 总计1350万ISK 特里格拉夫残骸通常包含成堆的特里格拉夫调查数据库，稀有情况下会有深渊纤维或变异质粒。残骸战利品价值从150,000 ISK到超过5000万ISK不等。特里格拉夫调查数据库可以在空间站（通常是贸易中心）出售给收购订单，也可以前往任意统合部空间站以100,000 ISK的价格卖给统合部（扣除游戏内税前）。打捞特里格拉夫残骸将掉落用于T2特里格拉夫舰船的材料。分类:战斗异常

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Guri Malakim Survey Base is a Capsuleer Day XX combat event site and a variant of the SoCT Survey Expedition site. You will face 2 waves of Guristas and Angel NPCs that will need to be destroyed in order to spawn the boss wave (2 possible spawns). The site will appears as a beacon in the overview when warped to. The second wave appears to be timed, so it can spawn the boss if you take too much time to clear this wave. This site will provide you 6.5M in bounties if you kill the 2 waves plus the boss

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: NPCs do not drop any loot except the boss. Salvaging in this site is around 500K ISK. All remaining NPCs will warp away when the boss is destroyed so go immediately for him when he appears.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Guristas pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within high-security systems occupied by the Guristas Pirates. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to Titans in null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Dread Guristas faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Cruiser-sized enemy ships.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯洞穴是属于古斯塔斯海盗势力的无评级战斗点。它可以通过探索作为宇宙异常出现在古斯塔斯海盗占领的高安星系中。作为无门综合体，能够完成该站点的舰船限制与异常所在星系的安全等级相关（在0.0星系中最大允许泰坦）。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的恐惧古斯塔斯势力装备和弹药。该战斗点由一个无门空间房间组成，包含多种护卫舰到巡洋舰级别的敌对舰船。

sections.text: Guristas Forlorn Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Guristas Pirates pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Caldari State or occupied by the Guristas Pirates. As an ungated complex, there are no limitations so up to Titans are allowed. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Dread Guristas faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-, Cruiser-, Battlecruiser- and Battleship-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships does not trigger an escalation. Three other variations of this combat anomaly exist: Guristas Den, Guristas Hidden Den and Guristas Forsaken Den.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯凄凉洞穴是属于古斯塔斯海盗势力的无评级战斗点。它可以通过探索作为宇宙异常出现在加达里合众国拥有的或被古斯塔斯海盗占领的星系中。作为无门综合体，没有任何限制，最大允许泰坦级别的舰船。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的恐惧古斯塔斯势力装备和弹药。该战斗点由一个无门空间房间组成，包含多种护卫舰、巡洋舰、战列巡洋舰和战列舰级别的敌对舰船。击杀所有敌对舰船不会触发升级。该战斗异常还有三个其他变体：古斯塔斯洞穴、古斯塔斯隐秘洞穴和古斯塔斯遗弃洞穴。

sections.heading: 攻略

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Incipient Drone Swarm is a Rogue Drone combat anomaly that spawns in Pochven. The site is the easiest of the Pochven anomalies and is generally run only for the loot and standings. The site has three waves, each dealing around 200 DPS. The Rogue Drones (excluding Vexing and Punishing types) have a lot of EWAR, but it is very weak and can be easily ignored. All rats, except for the occasional "Overmind" ships, are drone-sized targets. None of the ships, including battleships, warp scramble. Rats can drop Interstellar Navigation Logs which can be traded to Triglavian stations for valuable items. The salvage is the same as with Rogue Drones in K-Space. The Overminds deal around 50-100 DPS each and are limited to a 58 km range, but have very high tracking within that range (100+, equivalent to frigate tracking speeds). They have a lot of EHP, often around or over 100K, but can be tanked fairly easily. Most of them have a large signature radius and can be hit relatively easily. They will orbit you at around 45-50 km. Recommended weapons to destroy them include torpedoes and cruise missiles due to their good application and high damage to battleships and above. (Use turrets for the Overmind Broodlord Omega since its signature radius is small (25m) meaning large missiles will not apply well to it and its shield tank is strong enough to shrug off what little missile damage can be dealt.) sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 初生无人机集群是一个在波赫文出现的自由无人机战斗异常点。该地点是波赫文异常点中最简单的，通常只为战利品和声望而刷。该地点有三波怪，每波大约200 DPS。自由无人机（不包括Vexing和Punishing类型）有大量电子战，但效果很弱，可以轻松忽略。除了偶尔出现的"Overmind"舰船外，所有怪都是无人机级别的目标。没有任何舰船，包括战列舰，会反跳。怪可以掉落星际导航日志，可在三角势力空间站兑换珍贵物品。打捞物与K空间中的自由无人机相同。Overmind每艘大约造成50-100 DPS，射程限制为58公里，但在此范围内追踪速度非常高（100+，相当于护卫舰追踪速度）。它们有大量有效生命值，通常在10万左右或更高，但可以比较容易地抗住。它们中大多数有较大的信号半径，可以相对容易地命中。它们会以约45-50公里的距离环绕你。推荐用来摧毁它们的武器包括鱼雷和巡航导弹，因为它们对 warship 及以上级别有良好的伤害应用和高伤害。（对于Overmind Broodlord Omega请使用炮，因为它的信号半径很小（25米），意味着大型导弹无法有效命中，且它的护盾防御足够强，可以无视能造成的少量导弹伤害。）Grazing Phase-0 Forager不造成伤害，没有电子战，但有很多结构生命值，可能需要一段时间才能摧毁。不过它的信号半径是战列舰级别的。每波可能有 u

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Observatory Flashpoint is a combat anomaly that can be found in Pochven, intended to be run with a fleet of up to 15 ships. It is functionally unchanged from the Observatory Flashpoints found during Chapter 2 and Chapter 3 of the Triglavian Invasion. Whenever a site is completed, a new site will spawn immediately in another part of Pochven, with a hard limit of three sites in the region at a time. The site comes pre locked, and will always be against EDENCOM.

sections.heading: Warpin
sections.text: A small number of EDENCOM and Triglavian ships fighting each other on the acceleration gate. Sometimes, Sleepers may also be seen fighting at the warpin point.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Near the warp-in, there is a large Stellar Observatory structure. On arrival, this structure is invulnerable, and guarded by one wave of EDENCOM ships. Attacking this wave will spawn a second wave of ships, and destroying enough ships from these two waves will spawn a single empire Dreadnought. After the Revelation spawns, two additional waves of EDENCOM ships will continue to spawn. The Dreadnought will warp in roughly 40-80km from the Observatory in a random direction. Every two minutes, the Dreadnought will enter Siege for three minutes, giving itself a massive +425% damage boost, and the standard EWAR resistance of a Siege Module. The Dreadnought has a slow 12-second fire rate, but extremely high alpha damage, and a tracking speed of 10 (in line with long-range Cruiser weapons), making evasion difficult and mandating heavy tank. Additionally, the Dreadnought and each wave of EDENCOM ships can and will choose targets independently, meaning that at any given time five different fleet members may be under attack - logis beware! The wreck of the Revelation contains a Dreadnought Systems Diagram, used to unlock the Triglavian cache at the end of the site. However, the wreck projects a large (30-50km) warp disruption field, so a fleet will either need to burn out of range of the disruption, bring a salvage ship to salvage the wreck, removing the field, or destroy the wreck by shooting it. Once the Dreadnought is destroyed, the Stellar Observatory will become vulnerable, two more waves of EDENCOM ships will spawn, along with two Overcharge Pylons, and a friendly Liminal Zirnit

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: The site pays a considerable sum of ISK that varies with fleet size, ranging from around 520 million ISK per pilot for a fleet of 5, to around 230 million ISK per pilot for a fleet of 15. Including more than 15 pilots in the payout will greatly reduce total site rewards. In order to be included in the payout, pilots must be in the site, not cloaked, and either apply damage to the Observatory structure or apply remote repairs to another ship which has damaged the structure. The loot cache can contain skillbooks for or . It can also contain a Zirnitra BPC, Supratidal Entropic Disintegrator BPC, XL Exotic Plasma Charge BPC, or capital component BPC. Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天文台闪点是一个可以在波赫文找到的战斗异常点，设计为最多15艘舰船的舰队进行。它与三角入侵第二章和第三章期间出现的天文台闪点在功能上没有变化。每当一个地点被完成时，一个新的地点会立即在波赫文的另一个区域生成，该区域同时最多存在三个地点的硬性上限。该地点预先锁定，始终对抗EDENCOM。

sections.heading: 入场
sections.text: 加速轨道上有少量EDENCOM和三角势力舰船在互相交战。有时在入场点也可以看到睡眠者在战斗。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 在跳跃入场点附近，有一个大型恒星天文台建筑。到达时，该建筑处于无敌状态，由一波EDENCOM舰船守卫。攻击这波舰船会生成第二波舰船，摧毁这两波中足够多的舰船后会生成一艘帝国无畏舰。在Revelation生成后，还会继续生成两波额外的EDENCOM舰船。无畏舰会在距离天文台约40-80公里的随机方向跳跃入场。每两分钟，无畏舰会进入攻城模式三分钟，获得巨大的+425%伤害加成，以及攻城模块的标准电子战抗性。该无畏舰射速缓慢，为12秒，但单次射击伤害极高，追踪速度为10（与远程巡洋舰武器相当），使得规避困难，必须配备重防御。此外，无畏舰和每波EDENCOM舰船可以且会独立选择目标，这意味着在任何时候可能有五名不同的舰队成员受到攻击——后勤舰注意！Revelation的残骸包含一个无畏舰系统图表，用于解锁地点末尾的三角势力宝箱。然而，残骸会投射一个大型（30-50公里）反跳力场，因此舰队需要要么烧出反跳范围，要么带一艘打捞船打捞残骸以移除力场，要么通过射击摧毁残骸。一旦无畏舰被摧毁，恒星天文台将变为可攻击状态，还会生成两波额外的EDENCOM舰船，以及两个超载能量塔和一个友方Liminal Zirnit

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 该地点支付可观的ISK金额，随舰队规模变化，5人舰队约为每名飞行员5.2亿ISK，15人舰队约为每名飞行员2.3亿ISK。超过15名飞行员参与分配会大幅降低总地点奖励。要参与分配，飞行员必须在地点内，未隐身，且对天文台建筑造成伤害或对已伤害建筑的舰船进行远程维修。战利品宝箱可能包含或的技能书。还可能包含Zirnitra BPC、超潮汐熵解离器BPC、XL异化等离子弹药BPC或旗舰组件BPC。分类：战斗异常

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Rogue Drone Outgrowth Colony is a Researching the Rogues combat site event where you can get valuable stuff. Enemy damage is split 50%/50% between 2 damage types, with the Colony Nest Overseer being somewhat omni with an 18%x3 + 45%x1 spread randomly. The frigates and destroyers have 0% resists in all categories while the Colony Nest Overseer has an omni tank of 33% structure and 40% Armour/Shields.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: The Colony Nest Overseer is very powerful and very dangerous. It will randomly warp-in when there is 1-4 enemies left (unconfirmed). It uses Web at 10km, Neut at 5km, and Disrupt at 25km. It will warp-in at 400-500km away. After that it will warp about 20km from you. There it instantly locks you, but does not instantly disrupt (2 second delay until it activates its disruptor). It will drop 3 Overseer Effects, but Rarely drops Random Kador, Semiotique, Valimor Legacy, and Wiyrkomi SKINs, Random Dose, Drone BPC.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 自由无人机衍生体殖民地是一个研究自由无人机战斗地点事件，可以获得珍贵物品。敌人伤害在两种伤害类型之间50%/50%分配，Colony Nest Overseer somewhat全能，伤害分布为18%x3 + 45%x1随机。护卫舰和驱逐舰在所有类别中抗性为0%，而Colony Nest Overseer有33%结构抗和40%装甲/护盾的全能防御。

sections.heading: 第3房间
sections.text: Colony Nest Overseer非常强大且非常危险。它会在剩余1-4个敌人时随机跳跃入场（未确认）。它在10公里使用网子，5公里使用毁电，25公里使用反跳。它会在400-500公里外跳跃入场。之后它会跳跃到距离你约20公里处。在那里它会立即锁定你，但不会立即反跳（激活反跳器前有2秒延迟）。它会掉落3个Overseer Effects，但稀有掉落随机Kador、Semiotique、Valimor Legacy和Wiyrkomi SKIN，随机Dose，无人机BPC。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Burrow is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships.

sections.text: 萨沙遗弃圣坛是一个在萨沙共和国感染的0.0安全等级区域发现的战斗异常点。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Haven is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within null-security systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to Titans in null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Battleship-sized enemy ships.

sections.heading: Chem Factory spawn
sections.text: Bounty: ~18.2m ISK Loot/Salvage: ~14.9m ISK

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙避难所是一个属于萨沙共和国海盗派系的未评级战斗地点。可以通过探索在萨沙共和国占领的0.0安全等级星系中发现为宇宙异常。作为无门禁的综合体，能完成该地点的舰船限制取决于异常生成星系的安全等级（0.0安全等级星系最高可达泰坦）。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的TRUE萨沙派系装备和弹药。该战斗地点由一个无门禁的空间房间组成，包含各种护卫舰到战列舰级别的敌方舰船。

sections.heading: 化学工厂刷怪
sections.text: 赏金：约1820万ISK 战利品/打捞：约1490万ISK

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Hidden Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Sansha Hideaway, Sansha Forsaken Hideaway and Sansha Forlorn Hideaway.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Ungated pocket with multiple waves of rats. Killing the last NPC in each class triggers a specific spawn. The structures "Habitation Module" may drop Trade Goods.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙隐蔽避难所是一个属于萨沙共和国海盗派系的未评级战斗地点。可以通过探索在阿玛帝国和阿玛塔曼达特拥有的星系中发现为宇宙异常。作为无门禁的综合体，能完成该地点的舰船限制取决于异常生成星系的安全等级（高安全星系为T2战列舰，低安全和0.0安全等级星系最高可达泰坦）。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的TRUE萨沙派系装备和弹药。该战斗地点由一个无门禁的空间房间组成，包含各种护卫舰级别的敌方舰船。该战斗异常点存在三个变体：萨沙避难所、萨沙遗弃避难所和萨沙悲伤避难所。

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 无门禁房间，有多波怪。击杀每个级别中最后一个NPC会触发特定增援。建筑"居住模块"可能掉落贸易商品。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Hidden Rally Point is a combat anomaly found in Sansha's Nation infested low and null security regions. There exists Sansha Rally Point, Sansha Forsaken Rally Point and Sansha Forlorn Rally Point variants of this site.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Ungated pocket with multiple waves of rats. The site can have quite high incoming damage. Players running this site are advised to bring ships with strong tanks. T3 Cruisers perform very well. Total bounties amount to around 15-20 million ISK.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Sansha Hidden Rally Point can escalate to True Sansha Fleet Staging Point. Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙隐藏集结点是在萨沙共和国泛滥的低安和无安区域发现的战斗异常。该站点存在萨沙隐藏集结点、萨沙被遗弃集结点和萨沙绝望集结点等变体。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 无门的房间，包含多波怪。该站点可能有极高的 incoming damage。建议玩家使用防御强劲的舰船来刷此站点。T3 巡洋舰表现非常出色。总赏金约为 1500-2000 万 ISK。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 萨沙隐藏集结点可以升级为真实萨沙舰队集结点。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). sections.text: Simple structure defended by Sansha pirates. Finishing each wave spawns the next one.

sections.heading: Scanner post
sections.text: Enemies spawn orbiting the scanner post about 30km away from warp-in.

sections.heading: Sansha bunker

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This anomaly can escalate to the 3/10 Sansha DED site Sansha's Command Relay Outpost.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙藏匿处是属于萨沙共和国海盗派系的无等级战斗站点。可以通过探索在艾玛帝国和阿玛塔联邦拥有的星系中以宇宙异常的形式发现。作为一个无门综合体，能够完成此站点的舰船限制取决于异常生成星系的安全等级（高安星系限于 T2 战列舰，低安和无安星系可使用包括泰坦在内的任何舰船）。完成此综合体可能会奖励玩家珍贵的真实萨沙派系装备和弹药。这个战斗站点由一个无门空间房间组成，包含各种护卫舰级别的敌舰。消灭所有敌对舰船可能会升级为 DED 等级的萨沙共和国指挥中继站综合体。该战斗异常存在三种变体：萨沙隐藏藏匿处、萨沙被遗弃藏匿处和萨沙绝望藏匿处。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 由萨沙海盗防守的简单结构。每完成一波敌人就会刷新下一波。

sections.heading: 扫描站
sections.text: 敌人在距离跳跃入口约 30km 的扫描站周围刷新。

sections.heading: 萨沙地堡
sections.text: 所有增援波次都来自距离跳跃入口 15km 的瞭望塔。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该异常可以升级为 3/10 萨沙 DED 站点萨沙共和国指挥中继站。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-, Destroyer- and Cruiser-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Sansha's Nation Neural Paralytic Facility complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Sansha Hidden Den, Sansha Forsaken Den and Sansha Forlorn Den. Two different site layouts can be encountered: The Light Missile Battery layout and the Heavy Missile Battery layout. Both layouts can spawn a True Sansha Cruiser and escalate.

sections.heading: Light Missile Battery layout
sections.text: Single pocket, the last ship kill triggers next spawn. Light missile batteries have limited aggro range, only about 30 km. ----

sections.heading: Heavy Missile Battery layout
sections.text: Single pocket, the last kill triggers next spawn.

sections.heading: Bounties
sections.text: * 275.000 ISK ===Loot=== Structures do not drop additional loot.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Sansha's Nation Neural Paralytic Facility.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Cruiser-sized enemy ships, as well as some batteries. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site complex.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇巢穴是属于天蛇集团海盗派系的无等级战斗站点。可以通过探索在加达里联邦拥有或被天蛇集团占领的星系中以宇宙异常的形式发现。作为一个无门综合体，能够完成此站点的舰船限制取决于异常生成星系的安全等级（高安星系限于 T2 战列舰，低安和无安星系可使用包括泰坦在内的任何舰船）。完成此综合体可能会奖励玩家珍贵的暗影天蛇派系装备和弹药。这个战斗站点由一个无门空间房间组成，包含各种护卫舰到巡洋舰级别的敌舰，以及一些炮台。消灭所有敌对舰船可能会升级为 DED 等级的天蛇集团水培站综合体。

sections.heading: 升级

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Forlorn Hub is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Battleship-sized enemy ships.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site can be done in any drone boat, such as the Vexor, Vexor Navy Issue or the Gila. A quick guide: When you enter the site, turn on your modules and drop drones. Then you want to move a bit away from the warp-in, drop down your Mobile Tractor Unit, start orbiting it while you attack the rats. You want to kill frigates first, then cruisers, battlecruiser then battleships, BUT keep an eye on what rat triggers the next wave, and leave 1 of those for last.

sections.heading: Bounty
sections.text: Around 22.500.000 ISK can be collected as bounty for the pirates, with more if the Shadow Serpentis spawn.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to the Shadow Serpentis Fleet Staging Point.

sections.text: 天蛇绝望枢纽是属于天蛇海盗派系的无等级战斗站点。可以通过探索以宇宙异常的形式发现。作为一个无门综合体，能够完成此站点的舰船限制取决于异常生成星系的安全等级（低安和无安星系可使用包括泰坦在内的任何舰船）。完成此综合体可能会奖励玩家珍贵的真实天蛇派系装备和弹药。这个战斗站点由一个无门空间房间组成，包含各种护卫舰到战列舰级别的敌舰。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点可以使用任何无人机舰船完成，例如 Vexor、Vexor Navy Issue 或 Gila。简要指南：进入站点后，开启装备并释放无人机。然后移动到距离跳跃入口稍远的位置，放下移动牵引单元，绕其轨道运行同时攻击怪。优先击杀护卫舰，然后是巡洋舰、战列巡洋舰，最后是战列舰，但要注意哪只怪触发下一波增援，最后留一只触发怪。

sections.heading: 赏金
sections.text: 赏金约为 22.500.000 ISK，如果刷出暗影天蛇则更多。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可以升级为暗影天蛇舰队集结点。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Haven is an combat anomaly found in Serpentis infested low and null security regions.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: There are two types of Havens: rock and gas. Gas havens have enemies pre-spawned, but the enemies are much more spread out. Rock havens have the enemies grouped together, but it takes a few seconds after warping in for them to spawn. The site can be done in any drone boat.

sections.heading: Type 1 - Rock Haven
sections.text: The site consists of one ungated pocket. There is a hollow rock with a stargate inside about 20 km from warp-in. The initial defenders will take a few second to arrive and new wave spawns once all ships from previous spawn are destroyed. A Shadow Serpentis commander, a Serpentis Dreadnought, or Shadow Serpentis Titan may spawn with Wave#5.

sections.heading: Type 2 - Gas Haven
sections.text: The site consists of one ungated pocket. A Shadow Serpentis commander, a Serpentis Dreadnought, or Shadow Serpentis Titan may spawn with Wave#5.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: about 40.000.000 ISK * Modules: Roughly 6.000.000-15.000.000 ISK * Salvage: about 15.000.000 ISK

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to the Serpentis Fleet Shipyard.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Serpentis Hidden Hideaway, Serpentis Forsaken Hideaway and Serpentis Forlorn Hideaway. Total cargo loot amount to around 20k ISK.

sections.heading: Escalation

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Port is a combat anomaly that can be found in low-security Gallente space.

sections.heading: Locating & Difficulty
sections.text: The site is an open pocket that can be warped to at any range. Two battlecruisers can run this site without too much difficulty.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Each new wave spawns when the previous one is destroyed. All enemy waves spawn around the cluster of structures. Waves can vary significantly in composition. Waves 2 and 3 can spawn simultaneously. There are multiple variations of this site with different spawns.

sections.heading: Variant 1 (asteroid port)
sections.text: ---- Sentries do not need to be destroyed to trigger Wave 2.

sections.heading: Variant 2
sections.text: ---- There is a small chance of a Shadow Serpentis faction spawn.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: You can get about 10-15 million ISK in bounties and a few million ISK in loot.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to Serpentis Paramilitary Complex.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇港口是可以在低安加达里空间发现的战斗异常空间。

sections.heading: 定位与难度
sections.text: 该地点是一个开放的房间，可以任意距离跃迁入场。两艘战列巡洋舰可以比较轻松地完成该地点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 每新一波在上一波被消灭后刷新。所有敌方波次在建筑群周围刷新。波次组成可能有较大差异。第2波和第3波可能同时刷新。该地点有多种变体，拥有不同的刷新。

sections.heading: 变体1（小行星港口）
sections.text: ---- 哨兵不需要被摧毁即可触发第2波。

sections.heading: 变体2
sections.text: ---- 有小概率刷新暗影天蛇势力怪。

sections.heading: 奖励

sections.heading: 升级

sections.text: 天蛇集结点是6级战斗异常空间，可以在低安和00安空间找到。总赏金约4,500,000 ISK。该地点有两种变体。

sections.heading: 流程（筒仓刷新）
sections.text: 该地点是一个开放的死亡空间房间，可以任意距离跃迁入场。塔楼哨兵天使虽然属于天使企业联合体，但会扣天蛇声望。哨兵在距跃迁入场点35-40公里处刷新。所有其他舰船在异常空间0米处刷新。地点内有两个存储筒仓，摧毁后掉落T1弹药。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可升级为天蛇后勤前哨。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Refuge is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can enter this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to T2 battleships for high-security systems, and titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of frigate- and destroyer-sized enemy ships, as well as two batteries. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses complex.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: The site is an open deadspace pocket that can be warped to at any range.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This anomaly can escalate to Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses. Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇避难所是属于天蛇公司海盗势力的无等级战斗地点。可通过探索在加达里联邦拥有或被天蛇公司占领的星系中作为宇宙异常空间发现。作为一个无门综合体，能够进入该地点的舰船限制与异常空间所在星系的安全等级挂钩（高安星系最高T2战列舰，低安和00安星系最高可达泰坦）。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的暗影天蛇势力装备和弹药。该战斗地点由一个无门空间房间组成，内含多种护卫舰和驱逐舰级别的敌方舰船，以及两座炮台。消灭所有敌对舰船可能升级为DED等级的天蛇麻醉品仓库综合体。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 该地点是一个开放的死亡空间房间，可以任意距离跃迁入场。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该异常可升级为天蛇麻醉品仓库。分类：战斗异常空间

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Sanctum is a combat anomaly found in Serpentis infested null security regions. Serpentis Sanctum comes in two types.

sections.heading: Type 1
sections.text: Type 1 consists of one ungated pocket. In the pocket, you will find 5 large structures called Magnetic Double-capped Bubble and the initial NPCs between them. If you have a mobil tractor unit, start orbiting it. If not, you can orbit one of the structures in the pocket. Start by killing the smallest size ships, and save the next wave trigger NPC for last.

sections.heading: Type 2
sections.text: Information on this site is not very accurate. Type 2 consists of one ungated pocket. In the pocket, you will a very large station (Pirate Complex), rock formations and scattered rocks. Initial Defenders spawn a few seconds after arriving into the site.

sections.heading: Bounty and drops
sections.text: * ~35.000.000 ISK bounty * ~19.000.000 ISK in salvage * Possibility for rare drop

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to a Serpentis Fleet Shipyard.

rows.name: Core Lord Admiral
rows.trigger: Last Lord Admiral triggers next wave

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇圣坛是出现在天蛇势力00安区域的战斗异常空间。天蛇圣坛分为两种类型。

sections.heading: 类型1
sections.text: 类型1由一个无门房间组成。在房间内，你会找到5座名为磁能双盖气泡的大型建筑和初始NPC。如果你有移动牵引光束单元，开始环绕它。如果没有，可以环绕房间内的一座建筑。先击杀最小级别的舰船，把触发下一波的NPC留到最后。

sections.heading: 类型2
sections.text: 关于该地点的信息不太准确。类型2由一个无门房间组成。在房间内，你会看到一座非常大的空间站（海盗综合体）、岩石编队和散落的岩石。初始防御者在进入地点后几秒刷新。

sections.heading: 赏金与掉落
sections.text: * 约35,000,000 ISK赏金 * 约19,000,000 ISK打捞物 * 有概率稀有掉落

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可升级为天蛇舰队船坞。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Forsaken Serpentis Sanctum is a combat anomaly found in Serpentis infested null security regions.

sections.heading: Site
sections.text: thumb|500px|Wave distribution Consists of one ungated pocket. Warping in from certain directions can cause you to decloak; even at 100km. Core Fleet Admiral will do Explosive damage in addition to Kin/Therm.

sections.heading: Bounty and drops
sections.text: * ~30mil ISK Bounty (before ESS payout) * ~15mil ISK in Salvage * ~10mil ISK in Loot * Possibility for rare drop

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to the Serpentis Fleet Shipyard.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇遗弃圣坛是出现在天蛇势力00安区域的战斗异常空间。

sections.heading: 地点
sections.text: thumb|500px|波次分布 由一个无门房间组成。从某些方向跃迁入场可能导致你在100公里处就反隐现形。核心舰队上将除了动/热伤害外还会造成爆伤害。

sections.heading: 赏金与掉落
sections.text: * 约3000万 ISK赏金（ESS分配前）* 约1500万 ISK打捞物 * 约1000万 ISK战利品 * 有概率稀有掉落

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可升级为天蛇舰队船坞。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Yard is a class 5 combat anomaly found in low security space.

sections.heading: Combat details
sections.text: All ships spawn at 0 on the site. Each successive wave is triggered by killing the last ship in the previous wave.

sections.heading: Type 1: Silos
sections.text: Also has 30x Veldspar Asteroids Attention: Number of NPCs and type needs updating

sections.heading: Type 2: Shipyard
sections.text: Attention: Type and number of NPCs needs updating

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Serpentis Logistical Outpost

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇船坞是出现在低安空间的5级战斗异常空间。

sections.heading: 战斗详情
sections.text: 所有舰船在地点0米处刷新。每一后续波次通过击杀上一波最后一艘舰船触发。

sections.heading: 类型1：筒仓
sections.text: 另有30个凡晶矿小行星 注意：NPC数量与类型需要更新

sections.heading: 类型2：船坞
sections.text: 注意：NPC类型与数量需要更新

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可升级为天蛇后勤前哨

sections.text: * Youtube video of the Smuggler Hideout in a Drekavac * Youtube video of the Smuggler Hideout in an Gila

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The SoCT Survey Expedition is a Capsuleer Day XX combat event site and a variant of the Guri Malakim Survey Base site. You will face 2 waves of Society of Conscious Thought, EDENCOM and CONCORD NPCs that will need to be destroyed in order to spawn the boss wave. The site will appears as a beacon in the overview when warped to. This site does not provide any bounties as you will fight non pirate NPCs. The second wave appears to be timed, so it can spawn the boss if you take too much time to clear this wave. This site features the new Soct frigate : Metamorphosis

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: NPCs do not drop any loot except the master. Salvaging in this site is around 500K ISK. All remaining NPCs will warp away when the master is destroyed so go immediately for him when he appears. All the NPCs orbit quite close, generally within 10km. All enemies have uniform resistance profile, so use the ammo type you prefer. Category:Combat Anomalies Category:Game events

groups.name: List of possible NPCs to face:

rows.name: SoCT Metamorphosis
rows.note: orbits very close (3km), can be difficult to hit

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: SoCT勘探远征是 capsuleer 日活动XX战斗事件地点，也是Guri Malakim勘探基地地点的变体。你将面对2波意识社会、EDENCOM和统合部NPC，需要将其消灭以刷新Boss波。跃迁入场后该地点在总览中显示为信标。该地点不提供任何赏金，因为你对战的是非海盗NPC。第二波似乎是定时的，如果你清理该波耗时过长可能会直接刷新Boss。该地点出现了新的Soct护卫舰：蜕变号

sections.heading: 备注
sections.text: NPC不掉落任何战利品，Boss除外。该地点打捞物约500K ISK。Boss被击杀后所有剩余NPC会跃迁离开，所以他出现后立即集火。所有NPC环绕距离很近，通常在10公里以内。所有敌人具有统一的抗性分布，因此使用你偏好的弹药类型即可。分类：战斗异常空间 分类：游戏事件

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Stellar Fleet Deployment Site appear every 5 hours and are centered around the Dazh Liminality Locus Structure. They spawn in Triglavian Minor Victory systems and in Pochven. The Dazh Liminality Locus projects a System-wide Effect. Kikimoras deploy powerful Structures and are high priority targets.

rows.name: Stellar Transfer Conduit
rows.note: Only open to the following ships: Frigate, Cruiser, Capsule, Shuttle, Corvette, Assault Frigate, Destroyer, Interdicter, Covert Ops, Intercepter, Stealth Bomber, Electronic Attack Ship, Compact Exploration Ship, Expedition Frigate, Tactical Destroyer, Logistics Frigate, Command Destroyer.

rows.name: Dazh Koliada
rows.note: The more Dazh Koliada there are the larger their escort Fleet

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 星际舰队部署地点每5小时出现一次，以达兹阈限核心建筑为中心。它们在三一维京胜利星系和波什文星系刷新。达兹阈限核心投射一个全星系效果。奇奇莫拉部署强力的建筑，是高优先级目标。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Stellar Observation Post is a combat anomaly found in EDENCOM-controlled systems. The site is centered around a destroyable structure, the Stellar Observatory. The Observatory projects a system-wide effect. Destroying it will temporarily remove this effect. The type of rats in the site and the type of effect it provides depends on the empire that holds the system.

sections.heading: Warp in
sections.text: Few EDENCOM ships of the local empire type.

sections.heading: 1st Room
sections.text: Moderate number of EDENCOM rats of the local empire type with supporting Heavy Gunstar sentries. Category:Combat Anomalies

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Only open to the following ships: Frigate, Cruiser, Capsule, Shuttle, Corvette, Assault Frigate, Destroyer, Interdicter, Covert Ops, Intercepter, Stealth Bomber, Electronic Attack Ship, Compact Exploration Ship, Expedition Frigate, Tactical Destroyer, Logistics Frigate, Command Destroyer.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 星际观测前哨是出现在EDENCOM控制星系中的战斗异常空间。该地点以一座可摧毁的建筑——星际天文台为中心。天文台投射一个全星系效果。摧毁它将暂时移除该效果。地点中怪的类型和提供的效果类型取决于控制该星系的帝国。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 少量当地帝国类型的EDENCOM舰船。

sections.heading: 第1房间
sections.text: 中等数量的当地帝国类型EDENCOM怪，配有重型炮艇哨兵支援。分类：战斗异常空间

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This is an overview of the combat anomaly sites found in the various phases of the 3rd chapter of the Triglavian Invasion. These combat anomalies can be found in the probe scanner window or in the Agency window in the systems undergoing a invasion by the Triglavian Collective. As the invaded systems escalate into later phases of the invasion, harder combat anomalies open up. For an overview of the NPCs to be found in these combat anomalies, look here. For a overview of the structures special to the invasion, look here. Although the combat sites in the 3rd chapter share many similarities to the found combat anomalies in earlier chapters of the Triglavian invasion, they aren't the same.

sections.heading: Triglavian Invasion Combat Anomalies
sections.text: The Cosmic Anomalies found in the systems invaded by the Triglavian Collective comes in three tiers or classes of difficulty. At first, in the Stellar Reconnaissance phase only class 1. of the combat sites are available, but as system progresses towards either Triglavian or EDENCOM victory higher classes will show up.

sections.heading: Emerging Conduit
sections.text: This combat site, together with the EDENCOM Forward Post, are the primary combat sites found in the Stellar Reconnaissance phase. They contain 3 waves of Triglavian NPCs containing 3-6 ships in each. These combat sites also spawn in minor victory systems Clearing this site helps the EDENCOM forces.

sections.heading: EDENCOM Forward Post
sections.text: This combat site, together with the Emerging Conduits, are the primary combat sites found in the Stellar Reconnaissance phase. These combat sites also spawn in minor victory systems. Clearing this site helps the Triglavian Collective.

sections.heading: Minor Conduit
sections.text: This combat anomaly is found when a system is either leaning towards the Triglavian Collective or the EDENCOM forces. It is a harder and more advanced version of the Emerging Conduit site. They contain 5 waves of Triglavian NPCs containing 12-15 ships in each. Clearing this site helps the EDENCOM forces.

sections.heading: EDENCOM Staging Area
sections.text: This combat anomaly is found when a system is either leaning towards the Triglavian Collective or the EDENCOM forces. It is a harder and more advanced version of the EDENCOM Forward Post. These combat sites now also spawn in minor victory systems after the 20/07/02 patch. Clearing this site helps the Triglavian Collective. == Major Conduit == This combat anomaly is found in either Bulwark or Second Liminality systems. It is a harder and more advanced version of the Minor Conduit site. They contain 6 waves of Triglavian NPCs containing 16-20 ships in each. Clearing this site helps the EDENCOM forces.

sections.heading: EDENCOM Field Base
sections.text: This combat anomaly is found in either Bulwark or Second Liminality systems. It is a harder and more advanced version of the EDENCOM Staging Area site. These combat sites now also spawn in minor victory systems after the 20/07/02 patch. Clearing this site helps the Triglavian Collective. == Stellar Fleet Deployment Site ==

sections.heading: World Ark Deployment Site
sections.text: The world ark deployment site appears during escalating liminality phases. The site contains the world ark and some Triglavian ships. Capsuleers on EDENCOM side can attack the site. Capsuleers on Triglavian side can mine Bezdnacine. Category:PvE

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 这是三一入侵第三章各阶段中出现的战斗异常空间地点总览。这些战斗异常空间可以在探针扫描器窗口或代理窗口中，在正遭受三一集合体入侵的星系中找到。随着被入侵星系进入入侵的后期阶段，更难的战斗异常空间会开放。有关这些战斗异常空间中出现的NPC总览，请参见此处。有关入侵特有的建筑总览，请参见此处。虽然第三章的战斗地点与三一入侵早期章节中的战斗异常空间有许多相似之处，但它们并不相同。

sections.heading: 三一入侵战斗异常空间
sections.text: 三一集合体入侵星系中的宇宙异常空间分为三个难度等级。最初，在恒星侦察阶段只有1级战斗地点可用，但随着星系向三一或EDENCOM胜利推进，更高等级的地点会出现。

sections.heading: 涌现通道
sections.text: 该战斗地点与EDENCOM前沿哨所是恒星侦察阶段的主要战斗地点。它们包含3波三一NPC，每波3-6艘舰船。这些战斗地点也会在次要胜利星系中刷新。清除该地点有助于EDENCOM部队。

sections.heading: EDENCOM前沿哨所
sections.text: 该战斗地点与涌现通道是恒星侦察阶段的主要战斗地点。这些战斗地点也会在次要胜利星系中刷新。清除该地点有助于三一集合体。

sections.heading: 次要通道
sections.text: 该战斗异常空间出现在星系偏向三一集合体或EDENCOM部队时。它是涌现通道地点的更难、更高级版本。它们包含5波三一NPC，每波12-15艘舰船。清除该地点有助于EDENCOM部队。

sections.heading: EDENCOM集结区域
sections.text: 该战斗异常空间出现在星系偏向三一集合体或EDENCOM部队时。它是EDENCOM前沿哨所地点的更难、更高级版本。在20/07/02补丁后，这些战斗地点现在也会在次要胜利星系中刷新。清除该地点有助于三一集合体。 == 主要通道 == 该战斗异常空间出现在堡垒或第二阈限星系中。它是次要通道地点的更难、更高级版本。它们包含6波三一NPC，每波16-20艘舰船。清除该地点有助于EDENCOM部队。

sections.heading: EDENCOM野战基地
sections.text: 该战斗异常空间出现在堡垒或第二阈限星系中。它是EDENCOM集结区域地点的更难、更高级版本。在20/07/02补丁后，这些战斗地点现在也会在次要胜利星系中刷新。清除该地点有助于三一集合体。 == 星际舰队部署地点 ==

sections.heading: 世界方舟部署地点
sections.text: 世界方舟部署地点出现在阈限升级阶段。该地点包含世界方舟和一些三一舰船。EDENCOM方的capsuleer可以攻击该地点。三一方的capsuleer可以开采贝兹达辛。分类：PvE

guides.title: Union Day Combat Challenge
guides.faction: Rogue Drones, Guristas, Triglavians, and Gallente Federation

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Union Day Combat Challenge is a limited-time combat site that spawns during the Caldari Union Day (2022). It contains 4 rooms with different faction enemies, being the Rogue Drones, Guristas Pirates, Triglavian Collective, and the Gallente Federation. Notes: *You will NOT get any faction standing losses from killing any opponents in this site. *You will receive a considerable amount of neut pressure while doing this site, especially on the third room. *Atleast for the first room, all enemies have no resists. Subseqent rats in the following rooms have similar natural resist holes to their usual variants.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Warp-in consists of an acceleration gate that permits access to T1 Destroyers (includes Kikimora and Sunesis), alongside T1 / T2 / Faction Frigates.

sections.heading: Third Pocket
sections.text: Notably high enemy DPS in this room, recommended to kill all enemies quickly.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 联合日战斗挑战是在加达里联合日（2022年）期间出现的限时战斗地点。它包含4个房间，分别有不同势力的敌人：自由无人机、古斯塔斯海盗、三一集合体和加达里联邦。注意：* 在该地点击杀任何对手不会导致势力声望损失。* 完成该地点你会承受大量毁电压力，尤其是第三个房间。* 至少第一个房间的所有敌人没有抗性。后续房间的怪与其通常变体有类似的天然抗性弱点。

sections.heading: 第1房间
sections.text: 跃迁入场由一个加速轨道组成，允许T1驱逐舰（包括奇奇莫拉和苏涅西斯）以及T1/T2/势力护卫舰进入。

sections.heading: 第3房间
sections.text: 该房间敌方DPS显著较高，建议快速击杀所有敌人。

guides.title: Union Day Elite Combat Challenge
guides.faction: Gallente Federation, Triglavians, Rogue Drones, and Guristas Pirates

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Union Day Elite Combat Challenge is a limited-time combat site that spawns during the Caldari Union Day (2022) in Caldari Lowsec space. It contains 4 rooms with different faction enemies, being the Gallente Federation, Triglavian Collective, Rogue Drones, and the Guristas Pirates, in order. Notes: *You will NOT get any faction standing losses from killing any opponents in this site. *You will receive a considerable amount of neut pressure while doing this site, especially on the second room. *There are no other differences with the highsec variant alongside the room shuffling, new boss, and the increased amount of rats on each pocket.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Warp-in consists of an acceleration gate that permits access to T1 Destroyers (includes Kikimora and Sunesis), alongside T1 / T2 / Faction Frigates.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 联合日精英战斗挑战是在加达里联合日（2022年）期间出现在加达里低安空间的限时战斗地点。它包含4个房间，分别有不同势力的敌人，依次为：加达里联邦、三一集合体、自由无人机和古斯塔斯海盗。注意：* 在该地点击杀任何对手不会导致势力声望损失。* 完成该地点你会承受大量毁电压力，尤其是第二个房间。* 与高安变体相比，除了房间顺序调整、新Boss和每个房间怪数量增加外，没有其他区别。

sections.heading: 第1房间
sections.text: 跃迁入场由一个加速轨道组成，允许T1驱逐舰（包括奇奇莫拉和苏涅西斯）以及T1/T2/势力护卫舰进入。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Vigilance Point is a combat anomaly located in the Pochven Region. This site will spawn 10 waves every 2 minutes, increasing in spawns with each wave. The rats themselves are random, but will be a mix of frigates, destroyers, cruisers, battlecruisers, and battleships. The structure's shields must be destroyed before each wave finishes or else the site will end. This site has extremely high DPS but typically low tracking, with no neut pressure and is usually done in self tanking AB fit kiting Eos fleets, as the site does not target drones. Due to the sites high damp pressure, signal boosters and info links are almost required. Category:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 警戒点是位于波什文区域的战斗异常空间。该地点每2分钟刷新10波，每波刷新数量递增。怪本身是随机的，但会是护卫舰、驱逐舰、巡洋舰、战列巡洋舰和战列舰的混合。建筑护盾必须在每波结束前被摧毁，否则地点将结束。该地点DPS极高但通常跟踪速度低，没有毁电压力，通常使用自抗加力速推风筝流埃俄斯舰队完成，因为该地点不锁定无人机。由于该地点的高阻尼压力，信号增强器和信息链接几乎是必需的。分类：战斗异常空间

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Wightstorm Anchorage is a Winter Nexus event that appears in the 2021 year. It contains 4 Diamond (♦) Dreadnaught and some other ships. Category:Game eventsCategory:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 幽灵风暴锚地是2021年出现的冬季枢纽活动。它包含4艘钻石（♦）无畏舰和一些其他舰船。分类：游戏事件 分类：战斗异常空间

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Wightstorm Forward Base is a highsec combat anomaly that appears inside Volatile Ice Storms during the Winter Nexus event in 2020, 2021, 2023 and 2025. thumb|View of a Wightstorm Forward Base. If a capsuleer is present at the Forward Base it will appear in the Overview of every capsuleer in the same System. Enemy ships can warp to tactical bookmarks and often target drones. They deal EM & Thermal damage with lasers, and Kinetic & Explosive damage with missiles, similar to their Incursion counterparts. Frigates have a 50k ISK bounty, Cruisers 125k, Battlecruisers 250K and the Battleship 2M. Only the Battleship drops loot. Similar to other event sites post-2019, the site is doable with a well fit Battlecruiser with application support. One of the event challenge texts recommends a T2-fit Battleship.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: (2025) The warp-in may feature a Sansha's Transit Modulator container, which you can use to deposit a Cryostorm Clarifier to replace the normal boss with a harder, tankier variant that deals more damage, has more HP and gives higher rewards. After the Acceleration Gate is used, the modulator will be disabled and the site unable to be modified.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The first wave spawns after 30 seconds. All types will frequently primary drones, so heavy droneboats are not recommended unless you can quickly remote repair your drones effectively. After the Wave 1 is defeated, the boss will warp in at about 20 km from the beacon after about 20 seconds. They do around 400 DPS. (Roughly 500 for the alternate spawn) Category:Game eventsCategory:Combat Anomalies

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 幽灵风暴前进基地是高安战斗异常，出现在2020年、2021年、2023年和2025年冬季枢纽活动期间的不稳定冰暴中。thumb|幽灵风暴前进基地一景。如果有胶囊飞行员位于前进基地，该站点将出现在同一星系中所有胶囊飞行器的概览中。敌方舰船可以跃迁至战术书签并经常锁定无人机为目标。它们使用激光造成电磁和热能伤害，使用导弹造成动能和爆炸伤害，与入侵中的同类敌人相似。护卫舰赏金为50k ISK，巡洋舰125k，战巡250K，战列舰2M。只有战列舰会掉落战利品。与2019年之后的其他活动站点类似，该站点可以使用装备良好的战巡在有效维修覆盖支持下完成。其中一项活动挑战文本推荐使用T2装备配置战列舰。

sections.heading: 跃入
sections.text: （2025）跃入时可能会出现一个萨沙跃迁调制器容器，你可以使用它来投放低温风暴净化器，将普通Boss替换为更难、更肉、伤害更高且奖励更丰厚的变种。使用加速轨道后，调制器将被禁用，站点无法再被修改。

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 第一波敌人在30秒后生成。所有类型的敌人都会频繁锁定无人机为目标，因此重无人机配置舰船不推荐，除非你能快速有效地远程维修你的无人机。击败第1波后，Boss将在约20秒后跃入，距离信标约20公里处。它们造成约400 DPS。（替代刷新约500）分类:游戏活动分类:战斗异常

They deal EM & Thermal damage with lasers, and Kinetic & Explosive damage with missiles, similar to their Incursion counterparts.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The first wave spawns after 30 seconds. After the Wave 3 is defeated, the boss will warp in at about 20 km from the beacon after about 10 seconds. They do around 600 DPS with a very heavy neut.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Wightstorm Transit Site is a Null Security Combat Anomaly that appears inside Volatile Ice Storms during the Winter Nexus event in 2020 till 2025. If a capsuleer is present at the Transit Site it will appear in the Overview of every capsuleer in the same System. The Sansha's Transit Modulator near the entry gate can be loaded wit a Cryostorm Mapper (Verity Cryo Tech), granting access to a more dangerous sector of the storm. Enemy ships can warp to tactical bookmarks and often target drones. They deal EM & Thermal damage with lasers, and Kinetic & Explosive damage with missiles, similar to their Incursion counterparts. A very well-tanked battleship is a must-have for the boss, which can and will shred you if you do not pilot well.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The first wave spawns after 30 seconds. After the Wave 2 is defeated, the boss will warp in at about 20 km from the beacon after about 10 seconds. They deal VERY high damage, totaling around 500 DPS @ 20km. You may need to overheat to tank them.

sections.text: 幽灵风暴中转站是零安战斗异常，出现在2020年至2025年冬季枢纽活动期间的不稳定冰暴中。如果有胶囊飞行员位于中转站，该站点将出现在同一星系中所有胶囊飞行器的概览中。入口加速轨道附近的萨沙跃迁调制器可以装入低温风暴映射器（真理低温科技），从而进入风暴中更危险的区域。敌方舰船可以跃迁至战术书签并经常锁定无人机为目标。它们使用激光造成电磁和热能伤害，使用导弹造成动能和爆炸伤害，与入侵中的同类敌人相似。Boss必须使用防御极强的战列舰，如果你操作不当，它能且会轻松撕碎你。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: World Ark Assault Flashpoint is a Triglavian Collective combat anomaly that can be found in Pochven. It was originally created during Invasion Chapter 1, and re-implemented in Chapter 3, which is the form it remains in. The World Ark Assault is an extremely long and difficult site, and little formal research is available on it due to its extremely limited availability during Chapter 3. Only four confirmed runs of it were completed during Chapter 3, and each run took roughly 45 minutes. As the site only exists in Pochven, fleets preparing to attempt it must account for the Dazh Liminality Locus effects (reduced target lock count but increased remote repair strength). The site is hidden behind an Acceleration Gate. Once a ship has attempted to warp to the site, a system-wide-visible Beacon will spawn at the acceleration gate. The site consists of a large ring containing numerous Triglavian structures, centered around a single, invulnerable and untargetable, Xordazh World Ark. Every ship which enters the site will sustain roughly 2000 damage from the 'Pozhlost Denial Zone' upon landing on grid with the Ark. This is enough damage to destroy small, untanked frigates, and thus discourage loot theft, however it will not significantly damage larger ships. The actual combat consists of roughly 10 waves of Triglavian ships. Most ships will be Hospodar-grade, with numerous Zorya-grade in each wave. Each wave consists of 20-50 ships of assorted sizes. sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 世界方舟突击闪点是特里格拉文集合体的战斗异常，可以在波赫文找到。它最初在入侵第1章期间创建，并在第3章中重新实现，也就是其目前保留的形式。世界方舟突击是一个极其漫长且困难的站点，由于在第3章期间可用时间极其有限，几乎没有正式的研究资料。在第3章期间仅完成了四次确认的攻略，每次攻略大约需要45分钟。由于该站点仅存在于波赫文，准备尝试的舰队必须考虑达兹阈限位点效果（减少锁定目标数量但增加远程维修强度）。该站点隐藏在加速轨道后面。一旦有舰船尝试跃迁至该站点，加速轨道处将生成一个全星系可见的信标。该站点由一个大型环形结构组成，包含众多特里格拉文建筑，以一座单一的、不可攻击且不可锁定的佐尔达日世界方舟为中心。每艘进入该站点的舰船在到达与方舟同一网格时将承受约2000点来自'腐朽拒绝区域'的伤害。这个伤害足以摧毁没有防御的小型护卫舰，从而阻止偷取战利品，但不会对大型舰船造成显著伤害。实际战斗包括大约10波特里格拉文舰船。大多数舰船为领主级，每波中有大量佐里亚级。每波由20-50艘不同尺寸的舰船组成。目前不清楚波次是基于触发还是基于时间。这些波次可能包含投放信标的基基莫拉。除了正常的

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony is a Cosmic Signature of the DED Complex (rated 4/10) type, occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battlecruiser class or smaller. This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site. (Note - Tech 3 cruisers are not supported by the entrance gate)

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: The entire pocket will auto-aggro in a few seconds, and the combined DPS is quite high. Well-tanked battlecruiser or pirate faction/heavy assault cruiser is advised. The Domination Excavator is marked with a battlecruiser icon but is an Overseer Cruiser. It has a fairly strong active tank which requires at least 250-300 Explosive DPS to safely break. Medium and heavy drones have no fun in this pocket as the rats tend to switch to attacking them in swarms and killing them quickly with high burst DPS.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Other Loot + Salvage 1.7M (16-March-2024) ~3.4M ISK in bounties

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 天使企业联合体占领的矿业殖民地是DED综合体（评级4/10）类型的宇宙信号，由天使企业联合体海盗派系占据。可以通过在高安和低安星系中使用探针探索找到。该站点由一个包含加速轨道的空间区域组成，内有各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用加速轨道可以进入站点内的其他区域。受到攻击时，防御者可能会派出多波增援。每组的出现由前一组成员的摧毁触发。列出的舰船名称和数量可能略有不同，但始终为战巡级或更小的舰船。该站点的加速轨道仅允许战巡级及以下的舰船及其T2等效舰船进入。（注意 - T3巡洋舰不被入口加速轨道支持）

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 整个死亡空间房间将在几秒内自动仇恨，综合DPS非常高。建议使用防御良好的战巡或海盗派系/重型突击巡洋舰。统治者采掘者标记为战巡图标但实际上是指挥官巡洋舰。它拥有相当强的主动防御，需要至少250-300爆炸DPS才能安全击破。中型和重型无人机在这个房间派不上用场，因为怪物倾向于成群切换目标攻击它们并以高爆发DPS快速击杀。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 其他战利品 + 打捞件 1.7M（16-March-2024） 赏金约3.4M ISK

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Creo-Corp Mining is a DED Complex (rated 2/10), occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec systems. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Cruiser class or smaller. This site's acceleration gate allows only destroyer class ships including tech 2 and tech 3 destroyers.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is doable in a beam-laser-fit Punisher with good piloting, but destroyers are recommended due to high number of ships. Pirate Frigates will have no problems with this site, and a Tactical Destroyer will make this site laughably easy. Avoid using Amarr ships as they deal EM and Thermal damage, the strongest resists of the Angel rats.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The acceleration gate is locked and requires key for operating it. The key is found in the wreck of Deadspace Synchronization HQ.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: The acceleration gate to next room is locked and requires key. The key is found in the wreck of CreoCorp Main Factory.

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 天使CreoCorp采矿场是DED综合体（评级2/10），由天使企业联合体海盗派系占据。可以通过在高安星系中使用探针探索找到。该站点由一个包含加速轨道的空间区域组成，内有各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用加速轨道可以进入站点内的其他区域。列出的舰船名称和数量可能略有不同，但始终为巡洋舰级或更小的舰船。该站点的加速轨道仅允许驱逐舰级舰船进入，包括T2和T3驱逐舰。

sections.heading: 攻略流程
sections.text: 该站点在光束激光配置的惩罚者中凭借良好的操作可以完成，但由于舰船数量众多，推荐使用驱逐舰。海盗护卫舰可以毫无困难地完成该站点，战术驱逐舰会让该站点变得轻而易举。避免使用艾玛舰船，因为它们造成电磁和热能伤害，这是天使怪物最强的抗性。

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 加速轨道被锁定，需要钥匙才能操作。钥匙可以在死亡空间同步总部的残骸中找到。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 通往下一个房间的加速轨道被锁定，需要钥匙。钥匙可以在CreoCorp主工厂的残骸中找到。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Military Operations Complex is a DED rated cosmic signature that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of Null Sec space. It may also be received as an escalation from an Angel Port anomaly.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: No hostiles at initial gate. The site offers a choice of 3 acceleration gates in the 2nd Pocket each leading to an alternate variant of the 3rd pocket and further leading to a common 4th pocket.

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: Dented Cipher from Container with Blast Marks alternative opens 1st gate, but is not required if you kill all enemies.

sections.heading: 5th Pocket
sections.text: The overseer battleship has strong structure hitpoints.

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 天使军事行动综合体是DED评级的宇宙信号，可以使用核心探针在零安天使出没区域扫描到。它也可能作为天使港口异常的升级出现。

sections.heading: 攻略流程
sections.text: 初始入口无敌对目标。该站点在第2间提供3个加速轨道的选择，每个通往第3间的不同变种，然后进一步通往共同的第4间。

sections.heading: 第1间
sections.text: 来自带爆炸痕迹的容器的凹陷密码器可以打开第1个加速轨道，但如果你杀死所有敌人则不需要。

sections.heading: 第5间
sections.text: 指挥官战列舰拥有很强的结构生命值。
