sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Mineral Acquisition Outpost is a DED complex that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of Low and Null Sec space. It may also be received as an escalation from an Angel Rally Point anomaly. It is considered as a 6/10 DED rated complex but this is not displayed in the warp in popup text.

sections.text: 3 pockets' initial groups and 5 spawns for a total of 63 ships.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: This site does not contain any noteworthy loot.

sections.heading: Escalation

sections.text: Angel Repurposed Outpost is a cosmic signature that can be found during exploration in high-security systems. thumb|Screenshot of max allowed ship sizes. The ships in the 4th and 5th pockets can be aggroed a couple of groups at a time, but in the earlier pockets they all seem to aggro together.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel's Red Light District is a DED Complex (rated 5/10), occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems, or as an escalation from Angel Refuge or Angel Den. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. This site's acceleration gate allows all subcapitals to enter. The location of this complex can be received as an escalation from Cosmic Anomalies, in particular the Angel Refuge and Angel Den. Upon such a discovery, the following message appears:

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: Warning: Initial incoming damage will be very high. Clear the triple Stasis Towers as fast as possible; they will web you to a standstill. Stasis towers spawn up to 50km from the beacon. Recommend over 85% resists to Explosive damage. Angel's Retirement Home (the structure with your loot) has 93k shield HP buffer. Unless you can permatank the rats, do not attempt to go after it first.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: unlocks when all defenders are dead.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Requires Garan's Private Key, and all defenders to be destroyed.

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 天使红灯区是DED综合体（评级5/10），由天使企业联合体海盗派系占据。可以通过在高安和低安星系中使用探针探索找到，或作为天使庇护所或天使巢穴的升级获得。该站点由一个包含加速轨道的空间区域组成，内有各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用加速轨道可以进入站点内的其他区域。该站点的加速轨道允许所有子旗舰级舰船进入。该综合体的位置可以作为宇宙异常的升级获得，特别是天使庇护所和天使巢穴。发现后，将出现以下消息：

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 警告：初始来袭伤害将非常高。尽快清除三座停滞塔；它们会用网子让你完全无法移动。停滞塔最远刷新在距离信标50km处。建议爆炸抗性超过85%。天使养老院（存放战利品的建筑）拥有93k护盾缓冲。除非你能永坦怪物，否则不要先尝试攻击它。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Coordination Center is a null security DED 7/10 site found through exploration.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Upon warping to the site you will arrive at an acceleration gate. It's possible to do this site in a ratting Ishtar but may take 3 hours to do in that manner.

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: You land ~60km from the tower and it webs you at that range. It has low health, but when you're webbed you're going to be taking a lot of damage. In an armour ratting Ishtar, I used warrior drones to kill the tower, due to their speed, and overheated tank and prop during this time, as well as aligning out. I had a DCU2 fitted rather than an ADC, though. I believe that the site despawns a certain amount of time after you kill the Dark Blood Hunter, but you may not have enough time to kill that guy if you leave the tower up.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Bounty for this site is about 65-70 million isk. Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 血袭者协调中心是通过探索发现的零安DED 7/10站点。

sections.heading: 攻略流程
sections.text: 跃迁至该站点后你将到达一个加速轨道。可以使用刷怪伊什塔完成该站点，但可能需要3小时。

sections.heading: 第5间
sections.text: 你在距离塔约60km处落地，它在这个距离用网子网你。它的生命值很低，但当你被网住时你会承受大量伤害。在装甲刷怪伊什塔中，我使用勇士无人机击杀塔，因为它们速度快，同时在此期间超载防御和推进装置，并对齐准备撤离。不过我装备的是DCU2而不是ADC。我相信在击杀暗血猎人后站点会在一定时间后消失，但如果你留着塔不拆，你可能没有足够的时间击杀他。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 该站点赏金约为65-70M ISK。分类:DED综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Human Farm is a DED rated complex that can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in high and low security space.

sections.text: 血袭者情报收集点是DED 3/10战斗站点，可以在有血袭者存在的艾玛区域的高安星系中找到。

sections.heading: 赏金

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Naval Shipyard is a null security DED rated site found through exploration.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The Complex consists of three rooms. All these rooms have serious numbers of battleships, cruisers and frigates inside them. The third room contains an overseer structure, which when destroyed has a chance of dropping Corpus X-Type or Dark Blood modules and a Bhaalgorn BPC. The structure also always drops 23rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. The complex contains many normal battleship NPCs Renamed as "Dark Corpus", however they are not faction and drop nothing of value.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Activating the acceleration gate to next room requires skill .

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Activating the acceleration gate to next room requires skill .

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: Rat info here is not exact. Only some of the frigates and battleships use EWAR. The final room deals incredible amounts of EM and Thermal damage and should not be taken lightly. Destroy the Blood Raider Fleet Stronghold for the loot, other NPCs can be ignored if you can tank them for long enough and then escape.

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 血袭者海军船坞是通过探索发现的零安DED评级站点。

sections.heading: 攻略流程
sections.text: 该综合体由三个房间组成。所有房间内部都有大量战列舰、巡洋舰和护卫舰。第三个房间包含一个指挥官建筑，摧毁后有几率掉落军团X型或暗血装备以及巴戈龙BPC。该建筑还会始终掉落23级指挥官私人物品。该综合体包含许多被重命名为“暗军团”的普通战列舰NPC，但它们不是派系舰船且不掉落任何有价值的物品。

sections.heading: 第1间
sections.text: 激活通往下一个房间的加速轨道需要技能 。

sections.heading: 第2间
sections.text: 激活通往下一个房间的加速轨道需要技能 。

sections.heading: 第3间
sections.text: 此处的怪物信息不完全准确。只有部分护卫舰和战列舰使用电子战。最终房间造成大量电磁和热能伤害，不可掉以轻心。摧毁血袭者舰队要塞获取战利品，如果你能抗住足够长时间然后撤离，其他NPC可以忽略。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood raider prison camp is a null security DED rated site found through exploration.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: Blood Raider Central Bastion has strong shield regen like other 8/10 structures and 400000 HP in structure.

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 血袭者战俘营是通过探索发现的零安DED评级站点。

sections.heading: 第4间
sections.text: 血袭者中央堡垒和其他8/10建筑一样拥有强大的护盾回充，结构生命值为400000 HP。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This site is usually found in low security space with Blood Raider presence, but it can be received as an escalation from the Blood Den.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: The Stasis Towers are located approximately 48 kilometers from the warp-in spot, and apply their webs immediately. The overseer spawns at 56 kilometers and approaches slowly.

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 该站点通常出现在有血袭者存在的低安区域，但也可以作为血袭者巢穴的升级获得。

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 停滞塔位于距离跃入点约48公里处，并立即施加网子效果。指挥官在56公里处刷新并缓慢靠近。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Cartel Prisoner Retention is a combat DED signature that can be scanned in Angel infested regions in Null Sec. It is also received as an escalation from an Angel Hub. Easy to difficult progression, best done with mate and MJD snipper fit.

sections.heading: Fourth room
sections.text: ---- Important: The main structure (Angel Retention Facility) will steadily repair its shields, and if anything (ships or drones) is within 35~38km of it, it will web you and repair all of its armor every few seconds. This dramatically increases the DPS needed to break it.

rows.name: Angel Retention Facility
rows.note: Has no EM Resists, instant armor repair stops if ship and drones attack from over 35km range

zh.title: 企业联合体囚犯拘留所

sections.heading: 概览
sections.text: 天使企业联合体囚犯拘留所是可以在零安天使出没区域扫描的战斗DED信号。它也作为天使枢纽的升级获得。难度从简单到困难递进，最好与队友配合并使用MJD狙击配置。

sections.heading: 第4间
sections.text: ---- 重要：主建筑（天使拘留设施）会持续回复护盾，如果任何物体（舰船或无人机）在其35~38km范围内，它会用网子网住你并每隔几秒修复全部装甲。这会显著增加击破它所需的DPS。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Centus Assembly T.P. Co. is a DED rated combat site found in null security space.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Anybody who want to use the gate and complete the site need himself, which excludes alpha characters.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: True Power' Assembly Security HQ has very strong tank and does not need to be killed. Should be within 30 KM in order to effectively kill it.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Again Centus Reprocessing Station has very strong tank and does not need to be killed. Should be within 30 KM in order to effectively kill it.

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: Again True Power Assembly Management HQ has very strong tank and does not need to be killed. Should be within 30 KM in order to effectively kill it.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: The Special Products container may contain faction modules. The defenders need to be killed before it can be opened.

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: Station Ultima fires EM citadel torpedoes that hit extremely hard but does not have very significant tank. 60k shield HP with 0 EM resist, 300 HP/s active shield reps. 10k armor and 50k structure. As long as you immediately begin moving quickly upon landing in the pocket its damage is survivable. Theoretically it deals upwards of 500,000 EM damage with each shot but the torpedoes have capital-ship sized damage application (10,000m), and they are fired extremely slowly (every 120 seconds).

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Centus Assembly T.P. Co. 是一个在低安空间发现的 DED 等级战斗地点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 任何想要使用加速轨道并完成地点的人都需要自己操作，这排除了 alpha 克隆体角色。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: True Power' Assembly Security HQ 拥有非常强的防御能力，不需要被击杀。应该在 30 KM 以内才能有效地击杀它。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 同样，Centus Reprocessing Station 拥有非常强的防御能力，不需要被击杀。应该在 30 KM 以内才能有效地击杀它。

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: 同样，True Power Assembly Management HQ 拥有非常强的防御能力，不需要被击杀。应该在 30 KM 以内才能有效地击杀它。

sections.heading: 第4个房间
sections.text: Special Products container 可能包含势力装备。防御者需要在打开容器之前被击杀。

sections.heading: 第5个房间
sections.text: Station Ultima 发射电磁 Citadel 鱼雷，伤害极高但防御能力不是很强。60k 护盾 HP，0 电磁抗性，300 HP/s 主动护盾回充。10k 装甲和 50k 结构。只要你在进入房间后立即开始快速移动，它的伤害是可以承受的。理论上每次射击造成超过 500,000 电磁伤害，但鱼雷的伤害应用范围是旗舰级别（10,000m），并且发射速度极慢（每 120 秒一次）。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Crimson Hand Supply Depot is a DED Complex that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in low security space in the Amarr regions. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate. This site is rated DED 6/10. 3 Battlecruisers and a Battleship ran this site easily.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Warping to the site lands on an acceleration gate at 0.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: Rats in this room can be from Serpentis and Angel factions along with Blood Raiders. The acceleration gate to second room is 70 km away. Sentries do not need to be destroyed to proceed. Acceleration Gate is 60km away. Blowing up the Gate Security structure gives you a key (Crimson Hand Level 1 Passcard) which is not needed for the gate.

sections.heading: Industrial Sector
sections.text: Acceleration gate 40 km from landing. Enemies spawn 25-60 km from landing. Red container may drop Blood Raider Cruiser Module, and contains an unnecessary key to the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Central Processing
sections.text: Crimson Sentinel has strong active shield tank (240 HP/s), high structure hitpoints (100k), and webs to 50 km. Save it for last, even with massive DPS it takes a long time to kill. It shoots battleship-grade Mjolnir torpedoes that deal 250 DPS EM with 1500 alpha - low enough to be able to speed tank. Rats spawn 50-60 km from landing. There are two acceleration gates 48 km from landing leading to the last two rooms of the complex. The Sentinel may drop Dark Blood faction modules as well as a key (Crimson Hand Level 3 Passcard) which is not required for both gates. BSs are all tier 1 battleships (300-400k bounty , not such a threat) they have a little hp and deal relatively low damage.

sections.heading: Supply Sector
sections.text: This room is optional. Enemies spawn between 30 and 110 km from landing in multiple groups that can be engaged mostly individually. An acceleration gate at landing will return you to the Central Processing room.

sections.heading: Command Sector
sections.text: Crimson Lord has 380 HP/sec active shield repair with 0 EM resist and additionally repairs 1500 armor HP every 25 seconds. You will need very high sustained damage output in excess of 700-800 DPS to volley through its shield and armor tank in a decent amount of time. Ships and cruise missile batteries spawn between 40-50 km from landing. Sentry guns are split in three groups, 30, 50, 65 km away from landing.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You can get about 24 million ISK in bounties and a similar amount of meta module loot. There are two opportunities to get Corpum Cruiser A-type Module drops, and you are guaranteed a 19th Tier Officer's Personal Effects (~51 million ISK). | class="wikitable complex sortable" |- ! sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Crimson Hand Supply Depot 是一个可以用探针扫描到的 DED 综合体，可以在 Amarr 区域的低安空间找到。该地点位于加速轨道后面。跃迁到侧面会将你送到加速轨道的 0 位置。该地点等级为 DED 6/10。3 艘战列巡洋舰和 1 艘战列舰可以轻松完成该地点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到地点会落在加速轨道的 0 位置。

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 这个房间的小怪可能来自天蛇和天使企业联合体势力，以及血袭者。通往第二个房间的加速轨道在 70 KM 外。哨兵不需要被摧毁即可继续。加速轨道在 60 KM 外。摧毁 Gate Security 结构会给你一个钥匙（Crimson Hand Level 1 Passcard），但加速轨道不需要这个钥匙。

sections.heading: 工业区域
sections.text: 加速轨道距离着陆点 40 KM。敌人在距离着陆点 25-60 KM 处刷新。红色容器可能掉落血袭者巡洋舰装备，并包含一个不需要的加速轨道钥匙。

sections.heading: 中央处理区
sections.text: Crimson Sentinel 拥有强大的主动护盾防御（240 HP/s），高结构生命值（100k），以及 50 KM 的网子。把它留到最后，即使有极高的 DPS 也需要很长时间才能击杀。它发射战列舰级别的 Mjolnir 鱼雷，造成 250 DPS 电磁伤害，单次伤害 1500——低到可以进行速度防御。小怪在距离着陆点 50-60 KM 处刷新。有两个加速轨道在距离着陆点 48 KM 处，通往综合体的最后两个房间。Sentinel 可能掉落 Dark Blood 势力装备以及一个钥匙（Crimson Hand Level 3 Passcard），但两个加速轨道都不需要这个钥匙。战列舰都是 T1 战列舰（300-400k 赏金，不是很大威胁），它们的血量较低，伤害相对较低。

sections.heading: 补给区域
sections.text: 这个房间是可选的。敌人在距离着陆点 30 到 110 KM 之间的多个小组中刷新，可以大部分单独交战。着陆点的加速轨道会将你送回中央处理区。

sections.heading: 指挥区域
sections.text: Crimson Lord 拥有 380 HP/s 的主动护盾回充，0 电磁抗性，并且每 25 秒额外回充 1500 装甲 HP。你需要非常高的持续伤害输出，超过 700-800 DPS，才能在合理的时间内穿透它的护盾和装甲防御。舰船和巡航导弹炮台在距离着陆点 40-50 KM 处刷新。哨兵炮分为三组，分别在距离着陆点 30、50、65 KM 处。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你可以获得大约 2400 万 ISK 的赏金和类似数量的 meta 装备战利品。有两次机会获得 Corpum Cruiser A-type Module 掉落，并且保证获得一个 19th Tier Officer's Personal Effects（约 5100 万 ISK）。| class="wikitable complex sortable" |- ! 物品名称 ! 预估价值 ! 掉落来源 ! 备注 |- | 19th Tier Overseer's Effects | 51M ISK | Crimson Lord | 100% 掉落率 |- | Corpum Cruiser A-type Module | | Crimson Lord | |- | Dark Blood Faction Module | | Crimson Lord | |- |Dark Blood Faction Module | |Crimson Sentinel |相当稀有 |- | Dark Blood Faction Module | | Crimson Hand Container | |- Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gurista Military Operations Complex is a null security DED rated site found through exploration.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: The defenders are split in two groups. Whole room will start attacking you.

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: The defenders are split in three groups. Dread Guristas Commanding Officer does EXTREMELY high Kinetic damage and has a strong EHP tank.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Gurista Military Operations Complex 是一个通过探索发现的低安 DED 等级地点。

sections.heading: 第4个房间
sections.text: 防御者分为两组。整个房间都会开始攻击你。

sections.heading: 第5个房间
sections.text: 防御者分为三组。Dread Guristas Commanding Officer 造成极高的动能伤害，并拥有强大的 EHP 防御。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Guerilla Grounds is a DED 3/10 complex that can be found in high and low security caldari systems.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: 3 groups of 5 frigates separated at long distances from each other.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: ---- 3 groups of 6 frigates separated at long distances from each other.

sections.heading: Third Room
sections.text: ---- 4 groups of 7 frigates separated at long distances from each other. All NPCs auto-aggro.

sections.heading: Fourth Room
sections.text: ---- 5 groups of 7 frigates separated at long distances from each other. All NPCs auto-aggro.

sections.heading: Fifth Room
sections.text: ---- Kill Dread Gurista, either loot it or bookmark the wreck and wait other NPCs to despawn. T2 salvage loot from Dread Gurista.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Guristas Guerilla Grounds 是一个 DED 3/10 综合体，可以在高安和低安的 Caldari 星系找到。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 3 组 5 艘护卫舰，彼此之间距离很远。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ---- 3 组 6 艘护卫舰，彼此之间距离很远。

sections.heading: 第三个房间
sections.text: ---- 4 组 7 艘护卫舰，彼此之间距离很远。所有 NPC 自动仇恨。

sections.heading: 第四个房间
sections.text: ---- 5 组 7 艘护卫舰，彼此之间距离很远。所有 NPC 自动仇恨。

sections.heading: 第五个房间
sections.text: ---- 击杀 Dread Gurista，要么拾取战利品，要么为残骸添加书签，等待其他 NPC 消失。从 Dread Gurista 获得 T2 打捞战利品。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Hallucinogen Supply Waypoint is a Cosmic Signature of the DED Complex (rated 5/10) type, occupied by the Guristas pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. This site's acceleration gate allows all subcapitals to enter. Warning: The DPS in the Second/third rooms becomes quite heavy. Do not attempt this site if you do not know what you are doing or you risk losing your ship quite easily.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Significant amount of (mostly) kinetic damage in this room. Prioritize battlecruisers and battleships first since their missiles make up most of the incoming damage and have long range.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: Kill Guristas Distributor then either loot his wreck or bookmark it, warp out, and come back a few minutes later to pick up the loot. Triple Stasis Tower spawn will reduce your speed to <10 m/s, making you take a LOT of damage, especially if you rely on speed-tanking.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Possible deadspace modules: Category:DED Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are dead.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are dead.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Guristas Hallucinogen Supply Waypoint 是一个 DED Complex（等级 5/10）类型的宇宙信号，由古斯塔斯海盗势力占据。可以通过在高安和低安星系中使用探针探索找到。该地点由一个包含加速轨道的空间区域组成，并包含各种结构及其防御海盗。该地点的加速轨道允许所有子旗舰进入。警告：第二/第三个房间的 DPS 变得相当重。如果你不知道自己在做什么，不要尝试该地点，否则你很容易失去舰船。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 这个房间有大量的（主要是）动能伤害。优先击杀战列巡洋舰和战列舰，因为它们的导弹构成了大部分 incoming 伤害，并且射程很远。

sections.heading: 房间 3
sections.text: 击杀 Guristas Distributor，然后要么拾取他的残骸，要么为其添加书签，跃迁出去，几分钟后回来拾取战利品。Triple Stasis Tower 刷新会将你的速度降低到 <10 m/s，使你承受大量伤害，特别是如果你依赖速度防御的话。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 可能的死亡空间装备：Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Scout Outpost is a DED rated complex which can be found in High-sec or Low-sec through exploration. Can be obtained through an escalation of Guristas Hideaway and Guristas Refuge.

sections.heading: Second pocket
sections.text: Do not underestimate the incoming damage; a T1 battlecruiser will implode under the DPS within a minute or two, although a buffer-fit Drake can clear it without dropping below 80% shields. Recommended to increase Kinetic resistance with two Kinetic Shield Hardeners and to also equip 10MN Afterburner for cruiser and battlecruiser fits. If you want to lower the damage output, it is highly recommended to destroy the cruisers, as they make up most of the incoming damage.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Possible deadspace modules: Category:DED Complexes

rows.name: Security Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed. 40 km from warp-in

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Guristas Scout Outpost 是一个 DED 等级综合体，可以通过探索在高安或低安找到。可以从 Guristas Hideaway 和 Guristas Refuge 的升级中获得。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 不要低估 incoming 伤害；T1 战列巡洋舰会在一两分钟内被 DPS 击毁，尽管 buffer 配置的 Drake 可以在护盾不低于 80% 的情况下清理它。建议使用两个 Kinetic Shield Hardener 增加动能抗性，并为巡洋舰和战列巡洋舰配置配备 10MN Afterburner。如果你想降低伤害输出，强烈建议摧毁巡洋舰，因为它们构成了大部分 incoming 伤害。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 可能的死亡空间装备：Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Troop Reinvigoration Camp is a DED rated site found through exploration. It can also be received as an escalation from the Guristas Rally Point and Guristas Hidden Den combat anomalies. 800 DPS T3 Cruiser is sufficient to clear the site in ~20-25 minutes.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: The acceleration gate is locked until all defenders are dead. All ships are ~15 km away and auto-aggro.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: The NPCs are spread out in 3 groups. The closest group (2 battleships, all frigates and 3-4 destroyers) will auto-aggro on landing, the other two groups will not attack unless approached within 25 km and will shoot drones. Combined damage output will be quite high if you aren't careful with pulling room aggro. The acceleration gate is locked until all defenders are dead.

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: Sentries have limited aggro range of ~20-25 km, you land 40 km away from them. Like the previous pocket, the NPCs are spread out in 3 groups and one group will auto-aggro on landing while the rest will shoot drones. The acceleration gate is locked until all defenders are dead.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: Total of 3 cruisers, which may or may not jam. No auto-aggro on warp-in. You land roughly 35-40 km away from the spawn. The good stuff drops from Captive Fighting Arena.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Clearing the entire site gives roughly 13 million ISK in bounties before risk modifiers. Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Guristas Troop Reinvigoration Camp 是一个通过探索发现的 DED 等级地点。它也可以作为 Guristas Rally Point 和 Guristas Hidden Den 战斗异常的升级获得。800 DPS 的 T3 巡洋舰足以在约 20-25 分钟内清理该地点。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 加速轨道被锁定，直到所有防御者被击杀。所有舰船都在约 15 KM 外，并自动仇恨。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: NPC 分为 3 组。最近的一组（2 艘战列舰、所有护卫舰和 3-4 艘驱逐舰）会在着陆时自动仇恨，其他两组不会攻击，除非接近到 25 KM 以内，并且会发射无人机。如果你不小心处理房间仇恨，组合伤害输出会相当高。加速轨道被锁定，直到所有防御者被击杀。

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: 哨兵的仇恨范围有限，约 20-25 KM，你在距离它们 40 KM 处着陆。与上一个房间一样，NPC 分为 3 组，一组会在着陆时自动仇恨，其余的会发射无人机。加速轨道被锁定，直到所有防御者被击杀。

sections.heading: 第4个房间
sections.text: 总共 3 艘巡洋舰，可能会也可能不会电子战。跃迁进入时没有自动仇恨。你在距离刷新点约 35-40 KM 处着陆。好东西从 Captive Fighting Arena 掉落。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 清理整个地点在风险修正前大约获得 1300 万 ISK 的赏金。Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm is a DED Rated Complex. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in Minmatar high security space. The entry to this site is limited to T2 and Faction frigates and below.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Upon warping to the beacon. This is a two room complex.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: Upon activating the acceleration gate to the room. The acceleration gate to the second room is locked and requires Thorak’s Private Key. The key is in Thorak's Biodome Garden.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Upon activating the acceleration gate to the room.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Example loot 2024-01-07 (excluding overseer effects): Gistii C-Type Small Remote Shield Booster Salvage: 759k Normal Modules/Ammunition: 68k Category:DED Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Requires Thorak's Private Key. It is consumed on use.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm 是一个 DED 等级综合体。可以通过扫描 Minmatar 高安空间的宇宙信号找到。该地点的入口限制为 T2 和势力护卫舰及以下。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到信标后。这是一个两个房间的综合体。

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 激活通往房间的加速轨道后。通往第二个房间的加速轨道被锁定，需要 Thorak's Private Key。钥匙在 Thorak's Biodome Garden 中。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 激活通往房间的加速轨道后。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 示例战利品 2024-01-07（不包括 overseer effects）：Gistii C-Type Small Remote Shield Booster 打捞：759k 普通装备/弹药：68k Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Mul-Zatah Monastery is a DED 4/10 combat site that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in high and low security space in the Amarr regions. Alternatively it can be received as an escalation from a Blood Refuge. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Battlecruiser hulls and below can access it. Strategic (T3) Cruisers can not enter the site.thumb|400px|Inner Sanctum

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The enemies in each room remain passive until the player takes aggressive action. Therefore, sniper-fit ships can easily and safely move to long range before starting combat, and can kill enemies well before the enemies get in range to do damage. Short-range combat ships will face a lot of enemy cap neutralizers, so a fit that requires low or no cap to operate is recommended.

sections.heading: Room #1
sections.text: Destroying all enemies unlocks the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Room #2
sections.text: No auto-aggro on warp-in. Cruiser group will primary medium and heavy drones frequently. Destroying the Inner Sanctum structure drops 8th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and potentially Dark Blood or Corpum C-Type modules. In rare cases, you can get an Ashimmu BPC.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You can get about 2 million ISK in bounties and about 2 million in Overseer's Effects. Faction loot values can vary significantly. Possible deadspace modules:

sections.heading: Blitz
sections.text: Destroy all enemies in the first room, and be able to tank/avoid enough damage in the second room to destroy the Inner Sanctum. It goes down pretty quickly under fire. Category:DED Complexes

rows.name: Inner Sanctum
rows.note: Doesn't DPS or EWAR, but it seems you already have enough in this pocket ¯\_(ツ)_/¯; immune to EWAR

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Mul-Zatah Monastery 是一个 DED 4/10 战斗地点，可以用探针扫描到，可以在 Amarr 区域的高安和低安空间找到。或者，它可以作为 Blood Refuge 的升级获得。该地点位于加速轨道后面。战列巡洋舰及以下船体可以进入。战略（T3）巡洋舰无法进入该地点。thumb|400px|Inner Sanctum

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 每个房间中的敌人在玩家采取攻击行动之前保持被动。因此，狙击配置的舰船可以轻松安全地移动到远距离，然后在开始战斗，并且可以在敌人进入伤害射程之前击杀敌人。近战战斗舰船将面临大量敌人毁电，因此建议使用需要低电容或不需要电容操作的配置。

sections.heading: 房间 #1
sections.text: 摧毁所有敌人解锁加速轨道。

sections.heading: 房间 #2
sections.text: 跃迁进入时没有自动仇恨。巡洋舰编队会经常优先攻击中型和重型无人机。摧毁 Inner Sanctum 结构掉落 8th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects，并可能掉落 Dark Blood 或 Corpum C-Type 装备。在罕见情况下，你可以获得 Ashimmu BPC。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你可以获得大约 200 万 ISK 的赏金和大约 200 万的 Overseer's Effects。势力装备价值可能有很大差异。可能的死亡空间装备：

sections.heading: 速刷
sections.text: 摧毁第一个房间中的所有敌人，并能够在第二个房间中防御/避免足够的伤害以摧毁 Inner Sanctum。它在火力下相当快地被摧毁。Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Old Meanie - Cultivation Center is a DED 1/10 rated combat site. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in high security space.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Old Meanie - Cultivation Center 是一个 DED 1/10 等级的战斗地点。可以通过扫描高安空间的宇宙信号找到。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive is a DED 5/10 rated combat site that is found in low and null security space. Note that the DED 10/10 Rogue Drone site found in null is also called Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive. See Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive (10/10) for details on that.

sections.heading: Seventh Pocket
sections.text: ---- The Lesser Strain Mother has very strong active shield repairers. 545 DPS takes nearly 10 minutes to kill it. Reps 120 shield/second, 500k Hull health with 0% hull resists. Recommend doing EM damage because of such high shield reps. Also note that it has very long range webs that reach to 50 km.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Like with all DED rated Rogue Drone sites the loot is not very good. You will get Overseer's Personal Effects, mineral alloys and some salvage but no deadspace modules or rogue drone parts.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive 是一个 DED 5/10 等级的战斗地点，可以在低安和低安空间找到。请注意，在低安发现的 DED 10/10 自由无人机地点也称为 Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive。有关该地点的详细信息，请参见 Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive (10/10)。

sections.heading: 第七个房间
sections.text: ---- Lesser Strain Mother 拥有非常强的主动护盾回充。545 DPS 需要近 10 分钟才能击杀它。回充 120 护盾/秒，500k 船体生命值，0% 船体抗性。建议造成电磁伤害，因为护盾回充如此之高。还要注意，它有非常远射程的网子，可以达到 50 KM。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 与所有 DED 等级的自由无人机地点一样，战利品不是很好。你会获得 Overseer's Personal Effects、矿物合金和一些打捞，但没有死亡空间装备或自由无人机部件。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive is a DED 10/10 rated combat site that is found in null security space. This site can be found by scanning cosmic signatures or as an escalation from Drone Squad, Drone Patrol, or Drone Horde. Note that the DED 5/10 Rogue Drone site found in low is also called Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive. See Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive (5/10) for details on that. The two sites are very similar.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: ---- The room contains two acceleration gates. Ancient acceleration gate will take you to the third room while the surging acceleration gate will take you straight to fourth room but requires to use. It also requires Zbikoki's Hacker Card (consumed on use) found in The Right Hand of Zazzmatazz. In a fleet only one member needs to have the hacker card. Once opened the gate will stay open for 10 seconds an allow passage to everyone with the required skill without requiring new hacker card. The Surging Acceleration Gate can be used to blitz the site by skipping the fourth and fifth pockets, but you will miss out on some of the site's loot. If you want the full loot from the site, take the Ancient Acceleration Gate.

sections.heading: Third Pocket (Surging Acceleration Gate)
sections.text: ---- The acceleration gate in this room leads to sixth room.

sections.heading: Seventh Pocket
sections.text: ---- The Kuari Strain Mother has very strong active shield repairers and large amount of hull HP. Also note that it has very long range webs that reach to 50 km.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You will get Overseer's Personal Effects, mineral alloys and T2 salvage. The loot value ranges from 280M to 450M ISK on average. However, the reward is always guaranteed.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive 是一个 DED 10/10 等级的战斗地点，可以在低安空间找到。该地点可以通过扫描宇宙信号或作为 Drone Squad、Drone Patrol 或 Drone Horde 的升级找到。请注意，在低安发现的 DED 5/10 自由无人机地点也称为 Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive。有关该地点的详细信息，请参见 Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive (5/10)。这两个地点非常相似。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ---- 这个房间包含两个加速轨道。Ancient acceleration gate 会将你带到第三个房间，而 surging acceleration gate 会直接带你到第四个房间，但需要使用。它还需要在 The Right Hand of Zazzmatazz 中找到的 Zbikoki's Hacker Card（使用时消耗）。在舰队中，只需要一个成员拥有黑客卡。一旦打开，加速轨道将保持打开 10 秒，并允许所有具有所需技能的人通过，而不需要新的黑客卡。Surging Acceleration Gate 可用于通过跳过第四个和第五个房间来速刷该地点，但你会错过该地点的一些战利品。如果你想要该地点的完整战利品，请走 Ancient Acceleration Gate。

sections.heading: 第三个房间（Surging Acceleration Gate）
sections.text: ---- 这个房间中的加速轨道通往第六个房间。

sections.heading: 第七个房间
sections.text: ---- Kuari Strain Mother 拥有非常强的主动护盾回充和大量船体 HP。还要注意，它有非常远射程的网子，可以达到 50 KM。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你会获得 Overseer's Personal Effects、矿物合金和 T2 打捞。战利品价值平均在 280M 到 450M ISK 之间。然而，奖励总是保证的。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Pith Merchant Depot is a DED Complex that can be found via exploration. Only Destroyers (including tech 2 and tech 3) and below can enter the complex.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The sentries can be ignored; they don't have to be destroyed to enter the second pocket.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: This room can be largely ignored. Destroy the overseer frigate, loot the key, and proceed into the third pocket.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: Most of the rats have special names but are just renamed Guristas deadspace rats.

rows.name: Ancient Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed. Requires Sade's Pass

rows.name: Storage Taxes
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Pith Merchant Depot 是一个可以通过探索找到的 DED 综合体。只有驱逐舰（包括 T2 和 T3）及以下可以进入综合体。

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 哨兵可以被忽略；它们不需要被摧毁即可进入第二个房间。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 这个房间可以大部分忽略。摧毁 overseer 护卫舰，拾取钥匙，然后进入第三个房间。

sections.heading: 房间 3
sections.text: 大部分小怪都有特殊名称，但只是重命名的古斯塔斯死亡空间小怪。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Pith-Robux Asteroid Mining Co. is a DED 1/10 Rated Complex. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in high security or low security space. This site's acceleration gate allows only Frigate class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site. The "Scratched and Dented Keycard" can also be found in the Leaking Caskets in the Haunted Yard.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The acceleration gate requires "scratched and dented keycard" to activate. The key is consumed on use. The container in the room contains the required key.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: The acceleration gate is again locked and requires a keycard. The keycard can be acquired from the Non-Secured Asteroid Colony.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: Note: The DPS in this room is very high Mineable Asteroids: * All clustered near main complex, ~50km from gate beacon * All ~ 200m size * 1 x Omber * 12 x Plagioclase * 12 x Veldspar Minable asteroids confirmed to still exist as of 2025-1-18. (CCP removed minable asteroids from a lot of missions during or before 2023.)

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Possible deadspace modules: (Incomplete) *Pithi C-Type Thermal Shield Amplifier *Pithi C-Type Small Shield Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Pith-Robux小行星采矿公司是一个DED 1/10等级综合体。可以通过在高安或低安扫描宇宙信号来找到它。该站点的加速轨道仅允许护卫舰级别及更低级别的舰船及其T2等效舰船进入。"磨损凹陷的钥匙卡"也可以在闹鬼场院的泄漏棺材中找到。

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 加速轨道需要"磨损凹陷的钥匙卡"来激活。钥匙使用后即消耗。房间中的容器包含所需的钥匙。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 加速轨道再次锁定,需要钥匙卡。钥匙卡可以从未设防的小行星殖民地获得。

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 注意:此房间DPS非常高 可开采小行星: * 全部集中在主综合体附近,距加速轨道信标约50km * 全部约200m大小 * 1 x 奥贝尔 * 12 x 斜长石 * 12 x 凡晶石 确认截至2025-1-18可开采小行星仍然存在。(CCP在2023年期间或之前从许多任务中移除了可开采小行星。)

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 可能的死亡空间模块:(不完整) *Pithi C型热能护盾增幅器 *Pithi C型小型护盾 分类:DED综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Pith's Penal Complex is a DED rated complex found in null security space. This site can be found by scanning cosmic signatures. The acceleration gates in this site let all subcapital ships in.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The First Gate Required CPU Management 5

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Enemies have special names. "Assistant Warden" battleships have ECM. Rats are simply renamed; they don't drop anything atypical from the usual loot.

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: Blitz: Kill Screaming Dewak Humfry, bookmark wreck, warp off and wait for site to despawn, warp back and loot.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: Pith的刑罚综合体是一个在00安领域发现的DED等级综合体。可以通过扫描宇宙信号找到该站点。该站点的加速轨道允许所有非旗舰舰船进入。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 第一道门 需要CPU管理5

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 敌人有特殊名称。"助理看守"战列舰具有ECM。怪船只是简单重命名;它们不会掉落不同于通常战利品的物品。

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: 速刷:击杀Screaming Dewak Humfry, bookmark残骸,跃迁离开等待站点消失,跃迁回来拾取战利品。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation is a DED rated combat site found in high and low security space. It is often regarded as a low value site as it contains no faction drones and has a very low chance to drop a single faction module. Interestingly, the site can have low amounts of Rogue Drone alloys in the cans in the last two pockets that can be reprocessed for minerals. There are minable asteroids of Omber and Veldspar, but the site will despawn shortly after the drones guarding the Scratched Cask in the last room are defeated, preventing them from being mined unless someone stays in the site, although you do have enough time to go to a nearby station to drop off. While mining the ore in the site, pirate rats (based on which empire space you're in) can randomly appear, their strength relative to the system's security rating.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: ---- thumb|First Pocket This pocket contains 1 Omber (about 18k units) and 11 Veldspar asteroids. A harvester fleet can spawn in this pocket. Maximum size of the fleet is unknown, but can contain at least two with Serpentis Harvesters and a Serpentis defense ship. The Harvester wrecks can drop an Elara Restrained Mining Laser Upgrade module, as well as minerals.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: ---- This pocket contains 2 Omber (only containing about 500 units total) and 28 Veldspar asteroids. The Black Drone Container is blocked from warp-in by a large, barren asteroid, requiring manual piloting to move around. The containers are locked until the rats by them are destroyed.

sections.heading: Third Pocket
sections.text: ---- thumb|Third Pocket This pocket contains 8 Omber (about 93k units) and 9 Veldspar asteroids.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Faction module drop is very rare. Total of ≈112k units (67,000m³) Omber site-wide.

sections.heading: Mining
sections.text: The site's signature will vanish once the last few rogue drones in the last pocket are defeated. Afterwards, leaving the site will result in the site despawning after a minute or so unless someone is present in the site. The site can very well despawn as you're warping back to it. The first pocket has a sizable amount of Omber in one asteroid, the second pocket has two asteroids with low amounts and the final pocket has a mixed amount of high and low amounts of Omber in each asteroid. If the site is present in Caldari space, it is recommended to use the Endurance or Venture to be able to defeat ECM rats with drones that can sporadically appear. The Endurance also boasts a larger mining hold to minimize ore drop-offs. In other empires, ECM is not a problem and the Prospect may be used as it can tank the rats through signature tanking and active tanking modules. The gate appears to accommodate Cruiser-sized ships, but mining barges and porpoises will not fit.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

zh.title: 自由无人机小行星侵扰

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 自由无人机小行星侵扰是一个在高安和低安发现的DED等级战斗站点。它通常被认为是低价值站点,因为它不包含派系无人机,且掉落单个派系模块的几率非常低。有趣的是,该站点在最后两个房间的箱子中可能有少量自由无人机合金,可以精炼为矿物。有奥贝尔和凡晶石的可开采小行星,但站点会在最后一个房间中守卫刮擦木桶的无人机被击败后不久消失,导致无法开采,除非有人留在站点中,不过你确实有时间前往附近的空间站卸货。在站点中采矿时,海盗怪(根据你所在的帝国空间)会随机出现,其强度与星系安全等级相关。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: ---- thumb|第1个房间 此房间包含1个奥贝尔(约18k单位)和11个凡晶石小行星。此房间可能生成收割舰队。舰队最大规模未知,但至少可包含两艘天蛇收割船和一艘天蛇防御舰。收割船残骸可掉落Elara限制型采矿激光升级模块以及矿物。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: ---- 此房间包含2个奥贝尔(总共仅约500单位)和28个凡晶石小行星。黑色无人机容器被一个大型贫瘠小行星阻挡无法直接跃入,需要手动驾驶绕过去。容器在旁边的怪被消灭前处于锁定状态。

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: ---- thumb|第3个房间 此房间包含8个奥贝尔(约93k单位)和9个凡晶石小行星。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 派系模块掉落非常稀有。整个站点共约≈112k单位(67,000m³)奥贝尔。

sections.heading: 采矿
sections.text: 站点的信号会在最后一个房间中最后几架自由无人机被击败后消失。之后,离开站点将导致站点在大约一分钟后消失,除非有人留在站点中。站点可能在你跃迁回来的过程中就消失。第1个房间有一个小行星含有大量奥贝尔,第2个房间有两个小行星含量较低,最后一个房间的每个小行星混合了高低不同含量的奥贝尔。如果站点位于加达力空间,建议使用Endurance或Venture,以便用无人机击败可能零星出现的ECM怪。Endurance还拥有更大的采矿舱以减少矿石卸货次数。在其他帝国中,ECM不是问题,可以使用Prospect,因为它可以通过信号坦克和主动坦克模块扛住怪。加速轨道似乎允许巡洋舰级别的舰船通过,但采矿驳船和Porpoise无法进入。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Rogue Drone Infestation Sprout is DED rated combat site. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in high and low security space.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: ---- Blitz: This pocket can be completely ignored. The acceleration gate is unlocked. The ships in this pocket spawn gradually. The Strain Operation Bunker may look like an overseer structure but drops nothing valuable. In the past destroying it might have given heavy standing hits from Rogue Drones, but this is no longer true (Verified lack of standings loss May 2025).

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: This combat site does not drop much of anything valuable. Most of the time the 5th tier overseer's personal effects are the only item of value. The faction module in final room is very rare. Bounties (full clear): 200k ISK

rows.name: Strain Operation Bunker
rows.note: Destruction causes standing loss towards Rogue Drones (No loot)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 自由无人机侵扰萌芽是一个DED等级战斗站点。可以通过在高安和低安扫描宇宙信号找到它。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: ---- 速刷:此房间可以完全跳过。加速轨道已解锁。此房间中的舰船逐渐生成。Strain行动地堡看起来像是一个督军建筑但不掉落任何有价值的东西。过去摧毁它可能会导致自由无人机声望大幅下降,但现在已经不是这样了(2025年5月验证无声望损失)。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 此战斗站点几乎不掉落任何有价值的东西。大多数时候第5级督军的私人物品是唯一的有价值物品。最终房间的派系模块非常稀有。赏金(全清):200k ISK

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Acclimatization Facility is a DED Rated Complex found via exploration. The site consists of four different pockets accessed by an acceleration gate. The gates allow Frigate, Destroyer, and their tech 2 and tech 3 versions.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The pirate ship classes encountered within this combat site are Frigate and Cruiser class. The Acceleration Gates are unlocked after all pirate ships are destroyed. The names and amount of ships may slightly vary from what is listed here. Note: Various NPCs in this site have tracking disruption modules.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: Note: The Sentry guns can be ignored. The gate to the second pocket will unlock even if they are left alive.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Note: the Sentry guns can be ignored. The gate to the third pocket will unlock even if they are left alive. (You still want to kill the stasis towers though.)

sections.heading: Room 4
sections.text: *Loot Blitz: Kill the Sansha Tenebrus, lure all NPCs about 40-50km away from the wreck, go sideways then if your 30-35km away from NPCs, approach then loot the Sansha Tenebrus wreck.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙适应设施是一个通过探索发现的DED等级综合体。该站点由四个不同的房间组成,通过加速轨道进入。加速轨道允许护卫舰、驱逐舰及其T2和T3版本进入。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该战斗站点中遇到的海盗舰船级别为护卫舰和巡洋舰。加速轨道在所有海盗舰船被消灭后解锁。舰船名称和数量可能与此处列出的略有不同。注意:该站点中的各种NPC具有追踪扰断模块。

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 注意:哨戒炮可以忽略。即使它们存活,通往第2个房间的加速轨道也会解锁。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 注意:哨戒炮可以忽略。即使它们存活,通往第3个房间的加速轨道也会解锁。(不过你还是需要摧毁停滞塔。)

sections.heading: 房间4
sections.text: *战利品 速刷:击杀萨沙Tenebrus,将所有NPC引到离残骸约40-50km处,横向移动,如果你距离NPC 30-35km,靠近然后拾取萨沙Tenebrus的残骸。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Military Operations Complex is a DED rated combat site found in null security space or as an escalation from Sansha Port anomalies.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: --NOTE-- Battleship class Centus Beast Lords, if they spawn, do have tracking disruption capabilities. No other ship based EWAR has been noted (as of Sep. 2020).

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: True Sansha Archduke does not have special tank, but it has a lot of Effective Health (42.5k hull HP). It will close in on you with MWD.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: About 54m in bounties Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙军事行动综合体是一个在00安领域发现的DED等级战斗站点,或作为萨沙港口异常点的升级站点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: --注意-- 战列舰级别的Centus Beast Lord如果生成,确实具有追踪扰断能力。未发现其他舰船级别的电子战(截至2020年9月)。

sections.heading: 第5个房间
sections.text: 真正的萨沙大公没有特殊坦克,但具有很高的有效生命值(42.5k结构HP)。它会使用微曲向你靠近。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 约54m赏金 分类:DED综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Military Outpost is a DED rated 1/10 complex found via exploration. Only T2 frigates and below may enter.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: The acceleration gate to next pocket is locked and requires a key to activate. The key is found in the wreck of the Outpost Security Officer wreck. The key is consumed on use.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: There are three structures named "Sansha Outpost Administration Building". Only the "Deadspace Overseer's Structure" will drop the good loot.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙军事前哨是一个通过探索发现的DED 1/10等级综合体。仅允许T2护卫舰及更低级别舰船进入。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 通往下一房间的加速轨道锁定,需要钥匙激活。钥匙在萨沙前哨安保官残骸中找到。钥匙使用后即消耗。

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 有三个名为"萨沙前哨行政大楼"的建筑。只有"死亡空间督军建筑"会掉落好的战利品。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Prison Camp is a DED rated combat site found in null security space. This site can be found by scanning cosmic signatures or as an escalation from Sansha Hub.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Of the battleships only Centus Beast Lords have tracking disruptors.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: The Sansha's Nation Central Bastion has 50 km web, and repairs its full 5,600 armor HP every 10 seconds. However, it has 50/35/25/20 armor resists, meaning it's best to not deal EM damage when trying to destroy it. The structure has 400k hull hitpoints.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙战俘营是一个在00安领域发现的DED等级战斗站点。可以通过扫描宇宙信号或作为萨沙枢纽的升级站点找到该站点。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 战列舰中只有Centus Beast Lord具有追踪扰断器。

sections.heading: 第4个房间
sections.text: 萨沙共和国中央堡垒具有50km网子,每10秒恢复其全部5,600装甲HP。然而,它的装甲抗性的为50/35/25/20,这意味着在尝试摧毁它时最好不要打电磁伤害。该建筑有400k结构HP。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha War Supply Complex is a DED Complex that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in low security space in some Amarr regions or in null security regions with Sansha presence. It can also be received as an escalation from the Sansha Rally Point. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate. This site is rated DED 6/10. 3 Battlecruisers and a Battleship ran this site easily. A well tanked T3 Cruiser is usually sufficient to clear the site in ~30-40 minutes.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Warping to the site lands on an acceleration gate at 0.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The overseer battleship does not contain any notable loot. Note: Room 2a (down gate) is optional and contains no particular loot. Room 2b has an overseer battleship and must be cleared in order to take the gate forward (updated June 2021). Both gates are locked until the pocket is cleared.

sections.heading: Room 2b (Product Park)
sections.text: The rats are spread out in 4 groups. Except for the group camping the warp-in, they will not auto-aggro on landing unless approached or attacked, and will shoot drones if they have not aggro'd any players already.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: Group 1 auto-aggros on landing. Group 2 will not aggro unless approached or attacked and will shoot drones if not aggressed first by a player.

sections.heading: Room 4
sections.text: The two sentries and the group camping the warp-in will auto-aggro on landing. Attacking Skomener Effotber will aggro the entire pocket. Skomener Effotber has strong armor tank that needs at least 600 DPS of pure EM damage (70% weakest resist) to break. He does ~450 dps EM/Thermal damage at 70km range. Combined with the full room aggro the total incoming damage in this pocket can well exceed 1000 dps. There are no webbing ships so speed tanking will reduce the room damage by a lot. Blitz: Kill Skomener Effotber, bookmark wreck, warp out, wait 3 minutes, warp back to loot wreck.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You can get about 24 million ISK in bounties and a similar amount of meta module loot. There is an opportunity to get Centum Cruiser A-type Module drop, and you are guaranteed a 19th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects (~51 million ISK). Category:DED Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Leads back to the first section

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙战争补给综合体是一个可以用探针扫描到的DED综合体,可以在低安的某些阿玛尔区域或有萨沙存在的00安区域找到。它也可以作为萨沙集合点的升级站点获得。该站点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到侧面会将你停在加速轨道0m处。该站点等级为DED 6/10。3艘战列巡洋舰和1艘战列舰轻松通过了该站点。一艘良好坦克的T3巡洋舰通常足以在约30-40分钟内清除该站点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到站点会停在加速轨道0m处。

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 督军战列舰不包含任何有价值的战利品。注意:房间2a(下方轨道)是可选的,不包含特殊战利品。房间2b有一艘督军战列舰,必须清除才能通过前方的加速轨道(2021年6月更新)。两个加速轨道在房间清除前都处于锁定状态。

sections.heading: 房间2b(产品园区)
sections.text: 怪分成4组。除了驻守跃入点的组外,其他组在落地时不会自动攻击,除非被靠近或攻击,如果尚未攻击任何玩家,它们会射击无人机。

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 第1组在落地时自动攻击。第2组除非被靠近或攻击否则不会攻击,如果未被玩家先攻击则会射击无人机。

sections.heading: 房间4
sections.text: 两个哨戒和驻守跃入点的组会在落地时自动攻击。攻击Skomener Effotber会激怒整个房间。Skomener Effotber具有强大的装甲坦克,需要至少600 DPS的纯电磁伤害(70%最弱抗性)才能击穿。他在70km距离造成约450 dps电磁/热能伤害。加上全房间仇恨,此房间的总 incoming 伤害很容易超过1000 dps。没有网子舰船,所以速度坦克可以大幅降低房间伤害。速刷:击杀Skomener Effotber, bookmark残骸,跃迁出去,等待3分钟,跃迁回来拾取残骸。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你可以获得约2400万ISK的赏金和类似价值的meta模块战利品。有机会获得Centum巡洋舰A型模块掉落,并且保证获得第19级督军的私人物品(约5100万ISK)。分类:DED综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha's Command Relay Outpost is a deadspace combat site that is occupied by the Pirate Faction known as Sansha's Nation. It can be found by Probing for exploration sites in high-security systems within Amarr and Ammatar space. It can also be triggered as an escalation from the Sansha Hideaway and Sansha Refuge sites. This combat site consists of 2 different areas accessed by an Acceleration gate. The gates will permit Frigates, Destroyers, Cruisers, and their Tech 2 counterparts. Pirate ship classes encountered within this combat site are Frigate and Destroyer classes. The names and amount of ships appearing may vary slightly from what is listed here.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The Squad Leader has much stronger resists and is immune to stasis webifiers, target painters, and possibly other EWAR. The Squad Leader drops a Command Relay Key which is needed to open the next gate and is reusable. All ships must be destroyed to unlock the next gate, in addition to the key. Note that the key is not used up by the gate.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: The damage in this room can exceed 600DPS if you are not careful; however, the room is mostly destroyers, and they only deal significant damage within 10km. The destroyers are also fairly squishy, so they die quickly, reducing room DPS. If you are in a well-fit (t2 or equivalent) cruiser, you can safely ignore everything except the Centus Black Ops Commander. Quickly kill him, burn to his wreck, loot, and warp off. Only one heavy missile battery will aggro on warp-in, so the sentries will not be a major concern as long as you keep your distance. As a T1 cruiser, you can launch a single light drone, make it shoot once in an overseer frigate, and scoop it back. This will trigger his aggro and lure him out of the group. The Centus Black Ops Commander has high omni resists in shield(90% to all damage types) but is weak in armor and structure.

zh.title: 萨沙共和国指挥中继前哨

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙共和国指挥中继前哨是一个死亡空间战斗站点,由萨沙共和国海盗派系占据。可以通过在高安的阿玛尔和阿玛塔空间扫描探索站点找到。它也可以作为萨沙藏匿点和萨沙避难所站点的升级站点触发。该战斗站点由2个不同的区域组成,通过加速轨道进入。加速轨道允许护卫舰、驱逐舰、巡洋舰及其T2等效舰船进入。该战斗站点中遇到的海盗舰船级别为护卫舰和驱逐舰级别。出现的舰船名称和数量可能与此处列出的略有不同。

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 小队队长具有更强的抗性,并且免疫停滞网子、目标标记,以及可能其他电子战。小队队长掉落一个指挥中继钥匙,需要它来打开下一道门,钥匙可重复使用。所有舰船必须被消灭才能解锁下一道门,此外还需要钥匙。注意钥匙不会被加速轨道消耗。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 如果你不小心的话,此房间的伤害可能超过600DPS;然而,房间中主要是驱逐舰,它们只在10km内造成显著伤害。驱逐舰也比较脆,所以它们死得很快,降低了房间DPS。如果你在一艘装备良好的(T2或等效)巡洋舰中,你可以安全地忽略除Centus黑 ops指挥官以外的所有目标。快速击杀他,冲向他的残骸,拾取,然后跃迁离开。只有重型导弹发射架会在跃入时攻击,所以只要你保持距离,哨戒就不会是主要威胁。作为T1巡洋舰,你可以释放一架轻型无人机,让它对着督军护卫舰开一次火,然后收回。这会触发他的仇恨并把他从群体中引出来。Centus黑 ops指挥官在护盾方面具有很高的全抗(90%所有伤害类型),但在装甲和结构方面很弱。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha's Nation Neural Paralytic Facility is a DED 5/10 combat site that can be scanned down in low or null-sec systems in Sansha rat territory. It can also be found as an escalation from Sansha Den anomalies. The site's initial acceleration gate permits up to battleships T1/T2/Faction

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: Full room aggro immediately after warp-in. You need to clear the entire pocket (minus the one sentry) to unlock the acceleration gate, which is ~45 km away.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: The majority of the incoming DPS in this pocket comes from the battlecruisers and battleships, destroying them significantly reduces incoming damage, which can exceed 700 DPS. Alternatively, you can keep the battleships at around 60-70 km and the battlecruisers at more than 40 km, the DPS is significantly reduced. Long-range weapons are recommended for this method. Smaller ships can simply destroy the cruiser and battlecruiser spawns, as the battleships' tracking is poor enough for a cruiser to speed-tank relatively easily. Unlike other DED sites of this rating, the gate in this pocket is unlocked from the beginning. If your ship is fast and can field a strong tank of upwards of ~700 DPS EM/Thermal, you can simply cross the 40 km distance to the gate and skip the pocket entirely. Note: rats info here is not exact. Only some battleships use EWAR.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: This pocket is the single most dangerous in the site. The triple stasis tower spawn will web you down to a standstill and make you an easy target for even the battleships to hit, even in fast moving cruisers. Additionally the weapons range of most of the battleships is very large and the smaller ships will close in quickly. Killing the stasis towers should be your highest priority, unless you can field at least 500 DPS/tank with over 80% EM/Thermal resists, in which then you can opt to immediately snipe the overseer. Once the towers die the rest of the fleet is significantly easier to speed-tank. Slave Ation09 is located around 40-45 km from the warp-in. Note: rats info here is not exact. Only some battleships use EWAR.

zh.title: 萨沙共和国神经麻痹设施

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙共和国神经麻痹设施是一个DED 5/10战斗站点,可以在萨沙势力范围内的低安或00安星系中扫描到。它也可以作为萨沙巢穴异常点的升级站点找到。站点的初始加速轨道允许直到战列舰T1/T2/派系的舰船进入

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 跃入后立即全房间仇恨。你需要清除整个房间(除了一个哨戒)才能解锁加速轨道,它大约在45km外。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 此房间中大部分incoming DPS来自战列巡洋舰和战列舰,摧毁它们可以显著降低incoming伤害,伤害可能超过700 DPS。或者,你可以将战列舰保持在约60-70km,将战列巡洋舰保持在40km以上,DPS会显著降低。此方法推荐使用远程武器。较小的舰船可以简单地摧毁巡洋舰和战列巡洋舰的刷新,因为战列舰的追踪差到巡洋舰可以相对容易地进行速度坦克。与其他同等级的DED站点不同,此房间的加速轨道从一开始就是解锁的。如果你的舰船速度快并且能维持约700 DPS以上的电磁/热能强坦克,你可以简单地穿过40km距离到达加速轨道,完全跳过此房间。注意:此处的怪信息不精确。只有部分战列舰使用电子战。

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 此房间是站点中最危险的。三个停滞塔刷新会将你网到完全停船,使你成为即使战列舰也能轻松命中的目标,即使在快速移动的巡洋舰中。此外,大部分战列舰的武器射程非常远,较小的舰船会快速靠近。摧毁停滞塔应该是你的最高优先级,除非你能维持至少500 DPS/坦克且具有80%以上的电磁/热能抗性,在这种情况下你可以选择立即狙击督军。一旦塔被摧毁,其余舰队用速度坦克就简单得多。Slave Ation09位于距跃入点约40-45km处。注意:此处的怪信息不精确。只有部分战列舰使用电子战。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha's Nation Occupied Mining Colony is a Rated DED Complex, occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battlecruiser class or smaller. This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Rats are split in two groups and auto-aggro very quickly. Combined pocket damage can well exceed 500 DPS, but it falls off very quickly past 40 km. The left group will primary medium and heavy drones en masse and can quickly kill them from the sheer burst damage. True Sansha Foreman requires 190 DPS EM to break its armor tank, but that will take time, so 200+dps EM is advised. Example times: A Jaguar with 180dps EM unheated will do the whole site (all opponents - loot Foreman) in about 25-27mn (11-12mn blitzing), whereas a Gila can do the whole site in less than 10mn (5-6 if blitzing).

zh.title: 萨沙共和国占领的采矿殖民地

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙共和国占领的采矿殖民地是一个DED等级综合体,由萨沙共和国海盗派系占据。可以通过在高安和低安星系中扫描探索找到。该站点由一个包含加速轨道的空间区域组成,包含各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用加速轨道可以进入站点内的其他区域。当受到攻击时,防御者可能会派出多波增援。每组的出现由前一组成员的死亡触发。列出的舰船名称和数量可能略有不同,但始终是战列巡洋舰级别或更低。该站点的加速轨道仅允许战列巡洋舰级别及更低级别的舰船及其T2等效舰船进入。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 怪分成两组,非常快自动攻击。组合房间伤害很容易超过500 DPS,但在40km以外会迅速衰减。左边的组会集中攻击中型和重型无人机,并凭借爆发伤害快速击杀它们。真正的萨沙工头需要190 DPS电磁伤害来击穿其装甲坦克,但那需要时间,所以建议200+dps电磁。示例时间:一艘180dps电磁不加热Jaguar可以完成整个站点(所有对手-拾取工头)大约25-27分钟(速刷11-12分钟),而Gila可以在不到10分钟内完成整个站点(速刷5-6分钟)。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site is a DED complex found in Serpentis infested regions. In addition to being found in low sec by scanning this complex may be received as an escalation from a Serpentis Den. Medium Difficulty using T3 Cruiser, Combat Battlecruiser, Battleship (MJD).

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The damage can be overwhelming. However, in a cruiser sized ship, with a 100mn afterburner, you should be able to avoid most damage by orbiting a stationary target at around ~25km at ~900m/sec. Just make sure you target the rats which can hit you first, there should only be about 3-5 per pocket which can. However, this method becomes a bit difficult to execute due to the webs in the last room, so be wary. The webs practically make you a stationary target for the rats to shoot. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly. If you want to blitz the last pocket, head-shot the Sarpati Family Enforcer, bookmark their wreck, and warp out. Then come back by warping to the bookmark, since the gates will already have despawned, as will have all the remaining rats in the final room, and you can scoop the loot.

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: Take extreme caution in this pocket, do not let the cruisers and battlecruisers get within 10 km; overall room damage can exceed 600 DPS and can kill even a battleship.

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket
sections.text: The initial damage is not high since most of the larger ships have limited damage projection, however due to the triple Stasis Tower webbing, they will close in quickly and apply extreme damage if the stasis towers aren't primaried. Alternatively, if you can project at least 500 DPS out to ~40-50 km, you can opt to immediately kill the Overseer, bookmark his wreck and come back to pick up the loot when the site despawns.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇公司水培站是一个DED综合体，出现在天蛇势力控制的区域。除了可以在低安通过扫描发现外，该综合体也可能作为天蛇巢穴的升级出现。使用T3巡洋舰、战斗巡洋舰或战列舰（配备MJD）难度适中。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 伤害可能非常猛烈。然而，驾驶巡洋舰级别的舰船，装备100MN加力推进器，你应该能够通过以约~900米/秒的速度环绕一个静止目标在约~25公里处来规避大部分伤害。只需确保优先锁定能打到你的怪，每个死亡空间房间大约只有3-5只怪能击中你。不过，由于最后一个房间存在网子，这种方法执行起来有些困难，需要留意。网子实际上会让你变成怪的固定靶子。舰船名称和数量可能略有不同。如果你想速刷最后一个房间，爆头击杀Sarpati家族执法者，将残骸做成书签，然后跃迁离开。再通过书签跃迁回来，因为加速轨道已经消失，最终房间里剩余的怪也都已消失，你可以拾取战利品。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 在这个房间要极度小心，不要让巡洋舰和战列巡洋舰靠近到10公里以内；整个房间的伤害可能超过600 DPS，甚至能击毁战列舰。

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: 初始伤害不高，因为大部分大型舰船的伤害投射能力有限，但由于三座停滞塔同时施加网子效果，如果不优先击杀停滞塔，敌人会迅速逼近并造成极高伤害。另一种方案是，如果你能在约~40-55公里外投射至少500 DPS，可以选择直接击杀督军，将残骸做成书签，等场地消失后再回来拾取战利品。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Drug Outlet is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems (confirmed in 0.1 security system). Frigates (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex frequently awards the player with valuable Coreli C-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as a possible Daredevil blueprint copy.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: Note: In the second room, kill the Serpentis Drugstore Overseer and loot his wreck, then kill all the rats and burn to and take the gate into the last room. The Drugdealer passcard is consumed on use. Left Group Gate Group Right Group Structures

sections.heading: Third Room
sections.text: Note: In the third room, kill only the Serpentis Financing office, loot the cargo container it drops, this drops your shiny loot, not the Overseer.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: thumb|none|alt=A|Example loot drop from a Drug Outlet Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇毒品销售点是属于天蛇公司海盗派系的DED等级战斗综合体。可以通过在高安和低安系统中扫描异常来发现（已在0.1安全等级系统中确认）。护卫舰（及其T2对应型号）是能进入该场地的最大舰船级别。完成该综合体通常会奖励玩家珍贵的Coreli C型和暗影天蛇派系装备，以及可能获得冒险家级蓝图副本。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 注意：在第二个房间，击杀天蛇毒品店督军并拾取其残骸，然后消灭所有怪，冲向并进入通往最后一个房间的加速轨道。毒品贩子通行证使用后会被消耗。左组 通道 右组 建筑

sections.heading: 第三个房间
sections.text: 注意：在第三个房间，只击杀天蛇财务办公室，拾取它掉落的货箱，这才是你的闪亮战利品的来源，而不是督军。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Fleet Shipyard is a combat site that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in null security space in the Serpentis regions. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate. This site is rated DED 10/10.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Warping to the site lands on an acceleration gate at 0.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: 0-60 km from warpin There are three acceleration gates from this room to the Alpha/Beta/Fleet Hangar rooms. (The site is considered complete if any of the final rooms are completed and will despawn if you warp out of the site)

sections.heading: Alpha Hangar
sections.text: 30-60 km from warpin There is an acceleration gate back to Room 2.

sections.heading: Beta Hangar
sections.text: Note: The Heavy Missile batteries are Amarr and do 100% EM damage. 0-50 km from warpin There is an acceleration gate back to Room 2.

sections.heading: Fleet HQ
sections.text: 0-45 km from warpin Serpentis Stronghold shoots Citadel Thermal Torpedos and webs within 50 km. If all player ships are greater than 50 km from the Serpentis Stronghold, it won't repair its armor damage. It still repairs full shields every few seconds, but it can be killed more easily this way. There is a glitch where Serpentis Stronghold will stop repair its armor damage if it switches target.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You can get about 60 million ISK in bounties from fully clearing the site. The Serpentis Stronghold is guaranteed to drop a 23rd Tier Officer's Personal Effects (~133 million ISK), and has a chance of dropping Core X-type and Shadow Serpentis modules.

rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed. Sentries can be ignored.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇舰队船厂是一个可以通过探针扫描定位的战斗地点，可以在天蛇势力的零安区域找到。该场地位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到侧面会将你送到轨道处0米位置。该场地等级为DED 10/10。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到场地后会落在加速轨道处0米位置。

sections.heading: 第2房间
sections.text: 距跃入点0-60公里 该房间有三条加速轨道分别通往Alpha/Beta/舰队机库房间。（完成任何一个最终房间即视为场地完成，如果你从场地跃迁出去则场地会消失）

sections.heading: Alpha机库
sections.text: 距跃入点30-60公里 有一条加速轨道返回第2房间。

sections.heading: Beta机库
sections.text: 注意：重型导弹电池为艾玛型号，造成100%电磁伤害。距跃入点0-50公里 有一条加速轨道返回第2房间。

sections.heading: 舰队总部
sections.text: 距跃入点0-45公里 天蛇要塞发射堡垒级热能鱼雷并在50公里内施加网子效果。如果所有玩家舰船与天蛇要塞的距离都大于50公里，它就不会修复装甲伤害。它仍然每隔几秒完全修复护盾，但这样可以更容易地击杀它。有一个漏洞：天蛇要塞在切换目标时会停止修复装甲伤害。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 完全清理该场地可获得约6000万ISK赏金。天蛇要塞保证掉落第23级军官个人物品（约1.33亿ISK），并有机会掉落Core X型和暗影天蛇装备模块。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Live Cargo Distribution Facilities is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. Destroyers (and their Tech 3 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Coreli B-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules.

sections.heading: Fourth room
sections.text: Due to the large number of ships and potentially high DPS, it is advised to destroy only the Shadow Serpentis Warden, bookmark the wreck, and warp out.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇活货分销设施是属于天蛇公司海盗派系的DED等级战斗综合体。可以通过在高安和低安系统中扫描异常来发现。驱逐舰（及其T3对应型号）是能进入该场地的最大舰船级别。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的Coreli B型和暗影天蛇派系装备。

sections.heading: 第四个房间
sections.text: 由于大量舰船和可能的高DPS，建议只击杀暗影天蛇看守者，将残骸做成书签，然后跃迁离开。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Serpentis Logistical Outpost is combat signature that can be found in low-sec or null-sec, or as an escalation from completing the anomaly Serpentis Yard or Serpentis Rally Point. Technically the site is an unrated complex, but behaves like a DED 6/10 and thus can be considered the Serpentis DED 6/10. The site is located behind an acceleration gate that allows T2 Battleships or lower to access and consists of two parts: Part 1 is found by probe scanning or as an escalation. Completing Part 1 will always cause an escalation to Part 2 at another location. Warning: The Serpentis Logistical Outpost and Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 are considered to be the hardest Serpentis Escalations. Use extreme caution when completing the sites due to the Scramming Frigs and T2 Neuting Towers

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: You land right on top of the frigates, which mean you land in web and point range. The rest of the NPCs spawn about 30km away from you.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: The Energy Neutralizing Sentries spawn by the Pressure Silo structure, so get ready to blow them up once they spawn, as they add a lot to the difficulty of this room.

sections.heading: Reward
sections.text: Clearing it all gives 23.000.000 ISK in bounties. This site has no notable loot drops.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site always escalates to Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 with the following message. Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇后勤前哨是一个可以在低安或零安找到的战斗信号，也可以作为完成天蛇船坞或天蛇集合点异常的升级出现。技术上该场地是一个未等级综合体，但行为类似DED 6/10，因此可以视为天蛇DED 6/10。场地位于加速轨道后方，允许T2战列舰或更低级别舰船进入，由两部分组成：第一部分可通过探针扫描或作为升级获得。完成第一部分总是会在另一个地点触发升级到第二部分。警告：天蛇后勤前哨和天蛇后勤前哨第二部分被认为是最困难的天蛇升级任务。由于存在反跳护卫舰和T2毁电塔，完成时请极度谨慎。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 你会直接降落在护卫舰上方，这意味着你落在网子和反跳范围内。其余NPC在距你约30公里处生成。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 毁电哨兵在压力筒仓结构附近生成，准备好在它们生成后立即击毁，因为它们会大幅增加这个房间的难度。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 全部清理可获得23,000,000 ISK赏金。该场地没有值得注意的战利品掉落。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该场地总是升级到天蛇后勤前哨第二部分，并显示以下信息。分类:DED综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning signatures in high-security and low-security systems or by getting escalation from Serpentis Hideaway and Serpentis Refuge. Cruisers (Tech 2 Cruisers can enter) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Coreli A-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as a Daredevil blueprint copy.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The Serpentis Narcotic warehouse consists of total of five deadspace pockets. Due to branched nature only four of them need to be entered to get the final reward.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: ---- 300px|thumb|First Pocket Fastest way through this room is to jump into security corridor ignoring all the rats in the room.

sections.heading: Second Pocket - Security Corridor
sections.text: ---- Gate to 3rd room is 55km from warp in. 300px|thumb|Second Pocket - Security Coridor

sections.heading: Third Pocket - Central Warehouses
sections.text: ---- 300px|thumb|Third Pocket Gate to 4th room 45km from warp in.

sections.heading: Fourth Pocket - Administration Sector
sections.text: ---- 300px|thumb|Fourth Pocket The Serpentis Supply Stronghold has a lot of hit points, so it is recommended to bring a high DPS ship. It does not, however, repair itself. Shooting it will aggro all ships.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: The main attraction of this site is the Coreli A-Type modules. The Small Armor Repairer and Small Remote Armor Repairer aren't as strong as corresponding deadspace modules from other factions due to widespread farming and cheaper prices. The Multispectrum Coating and prop mods are just as strong as corresponding deadspace modules from other factions. It is also possible to get faction modules from the overseers but this is very rare. Bounty: ± 1.1 Mil ISK (All five pockets) More loot data

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇毒品仓库是属于天蛇公司海盗派系的DED等级战斗综合体。可以通过在高安和低安系统中扫描信号发现，或作为天蛇藏匿处和天蛇避难所的升级出现。巡洋舰（T2巡洋舰可进入）是能进入该场地的最大舰船级别。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的Coreli A型和暗影天蛇派系装备，以及冒险家级蓝图副本。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 天蛇毒品仓库综合体总共包含五个死亡空间房间。由于分支结构，只需进入其中四个即可获得最终奖励。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: ---- 300px|thumb|第一个房间 通过这个房间最快的方式是跳入安全走廊，忽略房间内的所有怪。

sections.heading: 第二个房间 - 安全走廊
sections.text: ---- 通往第三个房间的门距跃入点55公里。300px|thumb|第二个房间 - 安全走廊

sections.heading: 第三个房间 - 中央仓库
sections.text: ---- 300px|thumb|第三个房间 通往第四个房间的门距跃入点45公里。

sections.heading: 第四个房间 - 行政区
sections.text: ---- 300px|thumb|第四个房间 天蛇供应要塞拥有大量生命值，建议驾驶高DPS舰船。但它不会自我修复。射击它会吸引所有舰船的仇恨。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 该场地的主要吸引力是Coreli A型装备。小型装甲修复器和小型远程装甲修复器由于被广泛刷取且价格更低，不如其他派系相应的死亡空间装备强力。全谱涂层和推进器改装件则与其他派系相应的死亡空间装备同样强力。也有可能从督军处获得派系装备，但这非常罕见。赏金：约110万ISK（全部五个房间） 更多战利品数据

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该综合体有机会升级到自身的另一个实例。据信这只会在通过宇宙信号扫描到的毒品仓库中发生。如果毒品仓库是作为升级获得的，则升级失败的信息为：分类:DED综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Paramilitary Complex is a Rated DED Complex (7/10) type, occupied by the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Nullsec systems. It can also appear as an escalation from Serpentis Forlorn Den and Serpentis Forsaken Den, in which case it may appear in lowsec. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battleship class or smaller. This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

sections.heading: Room 5
sections.text: The Shadow Serpentis Big Boss deals high damage at relatively short range, and has an armor tank that can withstand about 400-500 DPS.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Bounties approx 80M Category:DED Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇准军事综合体是一个等级为DED（7/10）的综合体，由天蛇海盗派系占领。可以通过在零安系统中使用探针扫描发现。也可能作为天蛇荒芜巢穴和天蛇被遗弃巢穴的升级出现，此时可能出现在低安。该场地由一片包含加速轨道的空间组成，内有各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用轨道可以进入场地内的其他区域。受到攻击时，防御者可能派出多波增援。每波增援的出现由前一波成员的毁灭触发。列出的舰船名称和数量可能略有不同，但级别始终不超过战列舰。该场地的加速轨道只允许战列舰级别或更低舰船及其T2对应型号进入。

sections.heading: 第5房间
sections.text: 暗影天蛇大头目在相对较近的距离造成高额伤害，拥有可承受约400-500 DPS的装甲抗性。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 赏金约8000万 分类:DED综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Phi-Outpost is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. Battlecruisers (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Corelum C-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: thumb|First Pocket The electronically sealed container is unlocked after certain ships have been destroyed. The acceleration gate requires the stolen passkey to get through. The key is found in the sealed container, which is located inside a Hollow Asteroid that will require a bit of manual piloting to maneuver through to reach the container. The above statement is not expressly true. When competing for this site I have seen my competitor take the gate to the second pocket without accessing the sealed cask. Either the key is reusable or the only requirement to jump is all enemies in the pocket being destroyed. (29 January 2026) Stolen Passkey was not consumed on use after clearing entire pocket and taking gate. It may ?? be possible to skip part of this pocket by killing the ships guarding the Electronically Sealed Container (unconfirmed). Note: The site has been known to despawn all NPCs except for the Phi-Operation Protector.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: ---- thumb|Second Pocket The Phi-Operation Protector battleship has a microwarpdrive, and will use it to close in on targets. On paper, its MWD can bring it up to 1000m/s, however in practice it usually will not exceed 850m/s. Its weapons are ineffective beyond around 30km, so if it can be outrun it should not be a major threat. Significantly, this battleship's armor has very high Kinetic resistance (80%) and it will actively repair itself. Its lowest resistance is Thermal (50%), which should be the damage used to kill it.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇Φ前哨是属于天蛇公司海盗派系的DED等级战斗综合体。可以通过在高安和低安系统中扫描异常来发现。战列巡洋舰（及其T2对应型号）是能进入该场地的最大舰船级别。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的Corelum C型和暗影天蛇派系装备。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: thumb|第一个房间 电子密封容器在某些舰船被摧毁后解锁。加速轨道需要被盗通行密钥才能通过。密钥位于密封容器内，容器在一个空心小行星中，需要一些手动驾驶技巧才能穿越到达容器。上述说法并不完全准确。在竞争该场地时，我见过对手在未打开密封容器的情况下就通过了通往第二个房间的轨道。要么密钥可重复使用，要么跃迁的唯一要求是消灭房间内的所有敌人。（2026年1月29日）清空整个房间并通过轨道后，被盗通行密钥并未被消耗。有可能通过击杀守卫电子密封容器的舰船来跳过该场地的部分（未确认）。注意：该场地已知会消失除天蛇Φ行动保护者外的所有NPC。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ---- thumb|第二个房间 天蛇Φ行动保护者战列舰装备有微型跃迁推进器，会使用它来追击目标。理论上，它的MWD可以使其达到1000米/秒，但实际上通常不会超过850米/秒。它的武器在约30公里以外无效，所以如果能跑得更快就不构成重大威胁。重要的是，这艘战列舰的装甲具有极高的动能抗性（80%），且会主动自我修复。最低抗性是热能（50%），应使用热能伤害来击杀它。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Prison Camp is a DED Rated Complex (rated 8/10) type, occupied by the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Nullsec systems. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battleship class or smaller. This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site. You may receive this site as an escalation from a Serpentis Hub or a Serpentis Forsaken Rally Point.

sections.heading: Room 4
sections.text: Note: The Serpentis Prisoner Isolation Facility (the structure that contains your loot) has a very strong web and will immediately target you upon warp in. Be prepared to not be able to speed tank or move closer to the structure. Also of note is that it shoots XL Inferno torpedoes that do approx 2000 thermal damage, though their explosion radius is appropriate to the signature radius of capital ships so they apply little damage to battleships or smaller ships. The outpost also repairs itself to the tune of about 1000 DPS and has lots of structure hit points. Incoming damage can be very high by reason of the Stasis Towers and the structure's web. Suggest refitting for maximum tank. Kill the webbing towers first, then the Elite Frigates, then move on to the rest. Profile is shown here: Database Entry There is a glitch Last verified by Ageon Targaryeon on 15 January 2024 on this structure whereby the structure will stop repairing armor if it switches aggro. The structure's armor repair can be turned off by forcing it to switch its primary target (the target it fires torpedoes at and webs). A drone ship does this by having its drones out and attacking the structure, then flying over 120km away from it. Players in ships without drones will have to have ensure another pilot is in space within application range of the structure.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Clearing it all gives 29.500.000 ISK in bounties.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇监狱营地是一个等级为DED（8/10）的综合体，由天蛇海盗派系占领。可以通过在零安系统中使用探针扫描发现。该场地由一片包含加速轨道的空间组成，内有各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用轨道可以进入场地内的其他区域。受到攻击时，防御者可能派出多波增援。每波增援的出现由前一波成员的毁灭触发。列出的舰船名称和数量可能略有不同，但级别始终不超过战列舰。该场地的加速轨道只允许战列舰级别或更低舰船及其T2对应型号进入。你可能作为天蛇枢纽或天蛇被遗弃集合点的升级获得该场地。

sections.heading: 第4房间
sections.text: 注意：天蛇囚犯隔离设施（包含你的战利品的建筑）拥有极强的网子效果，会在你跃迁进入时立即锁定你。准备好无法进行速度抗或靠近建筑。需要注意的是它发射超大型冥府鱼雷，造成约2000热能伤害，但其爆炸半径适配旗舰信号半径，因此对战列舰或更小舰船几乎不造成伤害。该前哨还会以约1000 DPS的速率自我修复，并拥有大量结构生命值。由于停滞塔和建筑的网子效果，受到的伤害可能非常高。建议改装为最大抗性。先击杀网子塔，然后是精英护卫舰，再处理其余目标。属性详见此处：数据库条目 有一个漏洞 最近由Ageon Targaryeon于2024年1月15日验证，该建筑在切换仇恨目标时会停止修复装甲。可以通过强制建筑切换主要目标（它发射鱼雷和施加网子的目标）来关闭其装甲修复。无人机舰船通过放出无人机攻击建筑，然后飞到距其120公里以外来实现。没有无人机的舰船需要确保空间中有另一名飞行员在建筑的生效范围内。
