sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Maze is a null security DED rated site found through exploration. It can also be received as an escalation from the Guristas Haven and Guristas Sanctum.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The maze contains a large number of acceleration gates. In each room one gate takes you deeper into the complex while the rest of them lead back to the first pocket.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: The gate is unlocked and the rats do not need to be killed. But you will most likely have to fly through this pocket many times so thinning out the rats is recommended. In the room there are twelve acceleration gates. One of them leads deeper into the complex while the rest loop back. Take the bottom gate. Experienced explorers will quickly establish a simple method to always choose the correct acceleration gate. Before taking any gate, drop a canister in front of it. If the gate returns you to the entrance, proceed to the next gate you wish to try and drop a canister in front of that one. Label each can and proceed to continue with this process until you find the right gate - make a note of which can is in front of the proper gate and either ignore or destroy all of the others. Each acceleration gate will first send you to an empty room and then back to the beginning of the complex. When you activate the second acceleration gate, you will instantly be able to tell whether or not you are being returned to the beginning - if you are, the intro window bearing the complex's description will pop up once again.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: After successfully navigating the correct acceleration gate you arrive in the second room of The Maze. Once again you will be confronted by a group defending the area. Once again you are faced with a choice of twelve acceleration gates, of which only one will lead further inside the complex. Take the fifth gate from the top

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: This time there are only four acceleration gates to choose from. Take the bottom gate.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: This room comprises the smallest amount of defending NPCs so far. There is a total of 14 NPCs in this room; a mixture of Cruisers and Frigates. You have to choose between two acceleration gates. Take the one on right side.

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: Warning: The Fleet Outpost fires Kinetic Citadel Torpedoes that can instantly destroy any craft not suitably equipped for it! https://zkillboard.com/ship/25528/ This room contains a mixture of frigates, cruisers, and battleships along with cruise missile batteries and the fleet outpost (firing Citadel Kinetic Torpedoes). Upon attacking the outpost 4 battleships spawn. The outpost will release more waves of defenders as it takes damage. Upon the outpost's destruction a jetcan will appear with a 23rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and possibly additional loot including Pith-X Type modules or a Rattlesnake BPC. There are 4 additional spawns that occur at damage intervals on the station. A spawn will occur at half-shield, half-armor. two-thirds structure and one third structure. Once you have reduced the station to one third structure you may as well finish it off before dealing with the spawn. Database Entry for structure stats.

rows.name: Guristas Fleet Stronghold
rows.trigger: Triggers extra waves at damage intervals.
rows.note: Shoots Citadel Torpedoes that hit hard.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 迷宫是一个通过探索发现的零安DED评级站点。它也可以作为古斯塔斯避难所和古斯塔斯圣坛的升级获得。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 迷宫包含大量加速轨道。每个房间中有一个轨道带你深入建筑群，其余轨道则回到第一个死亡空间房间。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 轨道已解锁，不需要击杀怪。但你很可能需要多次穿过这个房间，因此建议先清理一部分怪。房间内有十二个加速轨道。其中一个通往建筑群深处，其余则循环回到起点。选择底部的轨道。经验丰富的探索者会快速建立一套简单的方法，始终选对加速轨道。在选轨道之前，先在其前方扔一个货罐。如果轨道把你送回入口，就前往下一个想尝试的轨道，同样在它前方扔一个货罐。给每个货罐做标记，然后继续这个过程，直到找到正确的轨道——记下正确轨道前的货罐，忽略或摧毁其余货罐。每个加速轨道会先把你送到一个空房间，然后回到建筑群起点。当你激活第二个加速轨道时，你会立刻判断出自己是否被送回起点——如果是，显示建筑群描述的窗口会再次弹出。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 成功通过正确的加速轨道后，你到达迷宫的第二个房间。你再次会面对一群守卫区域的敌人。你再次面临十二个加速轨道的选择，其中只有一个能通往建筑群内部。选择从上往下数第五个轨道

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: 这次只有四个加速轨道可供选择。选择底部的轨道。

sections.heading: 第4个房间
sections.text: 这个房间的守卫NPC数量是目前最少的。房间内共有14个NPC，由巡洋舰和护卫舰混合组成。你需要在两个加速轨道之间选择。选择右侧的轨道。

sections.heading: 第5个房间
sections.text: 警告：舰队前哨站发射的动能城堡鱼雷可以瞬间摧毁任何未做好相应防护的舰船！https://zkillboard.com/ship/25528/ 这个房间包含护卫舰、巡洋舰和战列舰的混合编队，以及巡航导弹电池和舰队前哨站（发射城堡动能鱼雷）。攻击前哨站后会刷出4艘战列舰。前哨站在受到伤害时会释放更多波次的防御者。摧毁前哨站后会出现一个货罐，内含第23级监督官私人物品，还可能包含额外战利品，包括Pith-X Type装备或响尾蛇BPC。空间站在不同损伤阶段还有4次额外增援波次。增援分别在半护盾、半装甲、三分之二结构和三分之一结构时触发。当你将空间站削减至三分之一结构后，可以先处理完增援再将其摧毁。空间站属性的数据库条目。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: AEGIS Secure Capital Construction Forges is an expedition that can be received from successfully completing the AEGIS Secure Transfer Facility.

sections.heading: Site notes
sections.text: * Data Analyzer required to obtain the key to get into the main pocket with your loot. The hacks required for this site are the hardest difficulty tier (120 HP red core hack). * The site should not be attempted without several strongly-tanked Marauders or better. Allegedly the site was designed for Dreadnoughts but they are not allowed past the acceleration gate. You can expect upwards of 5k DPS in omni damage even at long range. Micro Jump Drives and other methods of kiting the incoming damage are strongly recommended. * NPC resists are mostly uniform with slight weakness to Kinetic and Thermal damage. * The site must be completed within 30 minutes of activation before it despawns.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: You land close to 0 on a large group of ~20 frigates, cruisers and battleships supported by Heavy GunStar sentries which aggress based on your EDENCOM standings. The acceleration gate requires an AEGIS Coded Security Key SCCF-FTS to use, which can presumably be obtained by hacking (one of) the containers. Picador neuts 36 GJ/s at extremely short range, Gendarme warp disrupts (no scram, can still MJD) with 56 km range.

sections.heading: Main Pocket
sections.text: Blitz: Kite the NPCs, destroy the AEGIS Capital Forging Tools Storage. Two large groups of NPCs 20 km from warp-in. Rat composition presently unknown but seems to be a total of at least 30-40 ships. Destroying the AEGIS Capital Forging Tools Storage will cause the NPCs to immediately stop attacking and warp off. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: EDENCOM Heavy GunStar
rows.note: 400 DPS omni. Aggresses based on your EDENCOM standings.

rows.note: Requires AEGIS Coded Security Key SCCF-FTS to use. Key is consumed on use.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: AEGIS安全旗舰建造锻造厂是一个远征任务，可通过成功完成AEGIS安全转移设施获得。

sections.heading: 站点备注
sections.text: * 需要数据分析仪获取钥匙才能进入有战利品的主房间。此站点需要的破解是最高难度等级（120 HP红核破解）。* 不应在没有多艘强抗性的掠夺者或更好舰船的情况下尝试此站点。据称该站点是为无畏舰设计的，但它们不允许通过加速轨道。即使远距离你也可以预期超过5000 DPS的全向伤害。强烈推荐使用微跃迁引擎和其他风筝伤害的手段。* NPC抗性基本均匀，对动能和热能伤害有轻微弱点。* 站点必须在激活后30分钟内完成，否则会消失。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 你降落在约20艘护卫舰、巡洋舰和战列舰组成的大型编队附近0米处，由重型炮星哨兵支援，它们根据你的EDENCOM声望主动攻击。加速轨道需要AEGIS编码安全密钥SCCF-FTS才能使用，推测可以通过破解容器获得。Picador在极近距离毁电36 GJ/s，Gendarme反跳（无扰扰，仍可微跃迁），射程56公里。

sections.heading: 主房间
sections.text: 速刷：风筝NPC，摧毁AEGIS旗舰锻造工具仓库。两大群NPC在跃迁点20公里处。当前怪组成未知，但似乎总计至少30-40艘。摧毁AEGIS旗舰锻造工具仓库后，NPC会立即停止攻击并跃迁离开。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Base is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of Null Sec space. Estimated payout 14-18.7 mil. The site is easy with Prop mod fitted Faction, T2 or T3 Cruiser; MJD sniper Battleship.

sections.heading: Warp-In
sections.text: No Hostiles at warpin. Activate the Acceleration Gate

sections.heading: Second pocket
sections.text: Go straight for the Drug Lab, destroy it and the command ship if it spawns.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the Drug Lab or the command spawn for a small chance to escalate to Toxic Waste Scandal! Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Clear all rats to access the gate

rows.name: Drug Lab
rows.trigger: On attack trigger Battleship and/or Commander spawn - Escalation trigger on destruction

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使企业联合体基地是一个未评级的宇宙信号战斗站点，可以在零安天使企业联合体活动区域使用核心探针扫描到。预计收益1400-1870万。使用装备推进模块的派系、T2或T3巡洋舰，或微跃迁狙击战列舰即可轻松完成。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 跃迁入场时无敌人。激活加速轨道

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 直奔毒品实验室，摧毁它以及可能刷出的指挥舰。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁毒品实验室或指挥刷怪有小概率升级为有毒废料丑闻！Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Capital Staging is an escalation site released on the 11th of June 2024 under the Equinox expansion and is designed to encourage the usage of capital class ships for running PVE within Nullsec. The site features three Angel Dreadnaughts as well as a large number of sub-capital ships and is designed to be run by a small fleet of players using both capital and sub-capital ships however this site can be easily cleared by a Supercarrier or Dreadnought pilot solo. Category:Expeditions

zh.title: 天使企业联合体旗舰集结点

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使企业联合体旗舰集结点是2024年6月11日Equinox资料片发布的升级站点，旨在鼓励在零安PVE中使用旗舰级舰船。该站点有三艘天使无畏舰以及大量次旗舰舰船，设计为由使用旗舰和次旗舰的小型玩家舰队完成，但超级航母或无畏舰飞行员也可以单独轻松清除该站点。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Cartel Naval Shipyard is a DED rated cosmic signature that can be scan The site is difficult, may be done with a small fleet of Faction, T2 or T3 Cruisers.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: On earned escalations only, the first gate is unlocked, allowing ships to bypass the first room completely via immediately aligning to the gate, activating micro jump drive, and taking the gate. This only applies to earned escalations, not sites that are scanned down.

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: Docked and Loaded Mammoth structure has 60,000 shield HP with 1700 DPS reps. Without a high DPS marauder or a few friends its better to skip its drop.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: Megathron Under Frantic Repair can rarely drop faction modules but has over 2000 DPS shield reps and 89500 HP.

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: Stasis Towers have limited engagement range and can be destroyed safely from around 50 km. Overseer’s turrets reach out to 100 km but are subject to the same tracking limits as regular battleships so speed tanking may be helpful. Its tank is also nothing special, 500 DPS Explosive is enough to crack its shield reps.

rows.name: The Antimatter Channeler
rows.note: This ship can deal extreme damage (EM:2500 EXP:5000 KIN:2500 TERM: 2500) every 60sec at ranges over 100 KM with pinpoint tracking). Has strong shield tank

zh.title: 天使企业联合体海军船坞

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使企业联合体海军船坞是一个DED评级的宇宙信号，可以扫描到。该站点难度较高，可以由派系、T2或T3巡洋舰组成的小型舰队完成。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 仅在获得的升级中，第一个轨道已解锁，允许舰船通过对齐轨道、激活微跃迁引擎并通过轨道来完全跳过第一个房间。这仅适用于获得的升级，不适用于扫描到的站点。

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: 装载完毕的Mammoth结构有60,000护盾HP和1700 DPS自修。没有高DPS掠夺者或几个朋友的话，最好跳过它的掉落。

sections.heading: 第4个房间
sections.text: 疯狂维修下的Megathron很少能掉落派系装备，但有超过2000 DPS的护盾自修和89500 HP。

sections.heading: 第5个房间
sections.text: 静止之塔的交战范围有限，可以从约50公里外安全摧毁。监督官的炮塔射程可达100公里，但受限于与常规战列舰相同的追踪限制，因此速度抗性可能有帮助。它的防御也没什么特别的，500 DPS爆炸伤害足以突破它的护盾自修。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point is an unrated cosmic signature site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of Null Sec space. It may also be received as an escalation from an Angel Forsaken Hub and Angel Forlorn Hub anomaly. The site is of medium difficulty, it can be done with a small fleet of Faction, T2 or T3 Cruisers or Battleships, but e.g. a single Ishtar can also do it.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point 2 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使统治舰队集结点是一个未评级的宇宙信号站点，可以在零安天使企业联合体活动区域使用核心探针扫描到。它也可以作为天使遗弃枢纽和天使孤寂枢纽异常的升级获得。该站点难度中等，可以由派系、T2或T3巡洋舰或战列舰组成的小型舰队完成，但例如单艘Ishtar也可以完成。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级为天使统治舰队集结点2 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point 2 is the 2nd part of an escalation chain received from the unrated cosmic signature site of the same name.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point 3 Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Gist Cherubim/Malakim/Seraphim
rows.trigger: First 2 Battleship killed trigger a spawn each

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使统治舰队集结点2是从同名未评级宇宙信号站点获得的升级链的第二部分。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级为天使统治舰队集结点3 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point 3 is the final part of the escalation chain received from the unrated cosmic signature site of the same name.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site consists of one open deadspace pocket. no ship restriction so supercarrier can beat this site very easy Do not try to Blitz with subcapital. it is impossible to active tank since there is neutralizing tower. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Angel Fleet Outpost
rows.trigger: 75% shield triggers 1st spawn, 25% shield triggers 2nd spawn, 50% armor triggers 3rd spawn

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使统治舰队集结点3是从同名未评级宇宙信号站点获得的升级链的最终部分。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点由一个开放的死亡空间房间组成。没有舰船限制，所以超级航母可以非常轻松地打过此站点。不要试图用次旗舰速刷。因为有毁电塔，无法进行主动防御。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Kickbacks is an expedition that escalates from Serpentis Lookout.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The three first locations are usually in high security space while the last location is usually in low security space but this can vary.

sections.heading: Part #1
sections.text: ---- On warp-in kill Shadow Serpentis Commander Frigate if present, then proceed into second pocket.

sections.heading: Pocket #2
sections.text: Simple warp-in to the pocket for possible escalation.

sections.heading: Part #2
sections.text: ---- On warp-in kill Shadow Serpentis Commander Frigate if present, then proceed into second pocket.

sections.heading: Pocket #2
sections.text: Probably simple warp-in to the pocket for possible escalation as in all previous locations.

sections.heading: Part #3
sections.text: ---- On warp-in kill Shadow Serpentis Commander Frigate if present, then proceed into second pocket.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使回扣是一个从天蛇哨所升级而来的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 前三个地点通常在高安区域，而最后一个地点通常在低安区域，但也可能有所不同。

sections.heading: 第一部分
sections.text: ---- 跃迁入场后，如果有暗影天蛇指挥官护卫舰则先击杀，然后进入第二个房间。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 简单的跃迁入场，可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二部分
sections.text: ---- 跃迁入场后，如果有暗影天蛇指挥官护卫舰则先击杀，然后进入第二个房间。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 可能与之前所有地点一样，简单的跃迁入场，可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第三部分
sections.text: ---- 跃迁入场后，如果有暗影天蛇指挥官护卫舰则先击杀，然后进入第二个房间。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Mineral Acquisition Outpost, 2nd Part is an escalation received from an Angel Mineral Acquisition Outpost found in Angel infested regions.

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: ---- It is possible to blitz this pocket by shooting the triggers, but expect high incoming damage. Hashi Keptzh deals very high damage at short to moderate range (495 DPS EM/Kin turrets w/ 20 km optimal, 450 DPS Explosive missiles w/ 34 km range) and needs at least 600 DPS in raw Explosive to effectively break his shield tank. He has -90% web within 15km and will approach you with microwarpdrive. Category:Expeditions

zh.title: 天使矿物采集前站，第二部分

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使矿物采集前站，第二部分是从天使活动区域的天使矿物采集前站获得的升级。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: ---- 可以通过射击触发器来速刷此房间，但预期会有高额 incoming 伤害。Hashi Keptzh在中近距离造成极高伤害（495 DPS电磁/动能炮，最佳射程20公里，450 DPS爆炸导弹，射程34公里），需要至少600 DPS的纯爆炸伤害才能有效突破他的护盾防御。他在15公里内有-90%网子，并会使用微曲引擎接近你。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Occupied Mine is an Escalation found in Angel-infested regions. The site is moderately difficult but may be done with a battlecruiser.

sections.heading: Escalation Journal
sections.text: ; Expeditions : You have traced a signal being broadcast from this location. It leads to an Angel occupied mining site. This site is likely to contain high-ranking members of the Cartel. ; Description : An abandoned mine occupied by the Angel Cartel and home to some high-ranking members. This is considered high-risk ; Operational Intel : Difficulty Level 4 : Hostiles Angel Cartel ; Escalation : Escalation Sites are sometimes revealed by your participation in other Deadspace sites. ; Waves : There is a total of 5 waves in this site.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The Angel Occupied Mine is obtainable as an escalation while doing Angel Havens; once you get it and warp on site there will be 5 waves of Angel NPCs that will come to get you. The site is feasible with anything you used to do the Angel Haven.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Bounty of the site is around 30 Million ISK. (Is this only the bounty or is the loot included?)

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Previously, it was believed this site can only be escalated from Angel Havens. Currently (February 2026) it can also escalate from Angel Forsaken Hub Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使占领的矿井是在天使活动区域发现的升级站点。该站点难度中等，但可以用战列巡洋舰完成。

sections.heading: 升级日志
sections.text: ; 远征任务：你追踪到了从这个位置广播的信号。它指向一个天使占领的采矿站点。该站点可能包含天使企业联合体的高级成员。; 描述：一个被天使企业联合体占据的废弃矿井，是一些高级成员的据点。这被认为是高风险区域。; 作战情报：难度等级4：敌对势力 天使企业联合体; 升级：升级站点有时会在你参与其他死亡空间站点时出现。; 波次：该站点共有5波敌人。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 天使占领的矿井可以在做天使避难所时作为升级获得；一旦获得并跃迁到站点，会有5波天使NPC前来攻击你。该站点可以使用你做天使避难所时的任何装备完成。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 站点赏金约为3000万ISK。（这仅是赏金还是包含战利品？）

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 以前认为该站点只能从天使避难所升级。目前（2026年2月）它也可以从天使遗弃枢纽升级 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Locating & Difficulty
sections.text: Angel Owned Station is a low/null-sec expedition that can be found by completing Minor Angel Annex unrated complexes, triggered by destroying the commander battlecruiser. This site's difficulty is on par with a DED 6/10, and multiple battlecruisers with logi support are recommended to complete it.

sections.heading: Initial wave
sections.text: Upon initial warp in you land 10 - 15 KM from the rats. Destroying the Stasis Webbing Tower triggers the next wave.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text: You land at an acceleration gate. Only take it if there is no commander or no escalation is triggered.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Ships have special names but are just renamed deadspace rats. Attacking any ship triggers reinforcements.

sections.heading: Part 4
sections.text: This part is usually in a null-sec system.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Completing all four parts of the escalation may yield Gistum A-type modules and/or a Cynabal BPC. Category:Expeditions

groups.name: Reinforcement wave (triggered by attacking the Starbase Control Tower)

sections.heading: 定位与难度
sections.text: 天使拥有的站点是一个低安/零安远征任务，可以通过完成小型天使附楼未评级综合体找到，触发条件是摧毁指挥官战列巡洋舰。该站点难度与DED 6/10相当，建议多艘战列巡洋舰配合后勤舰支援完成。

sections.heading: 初始波次
sections.text: 初次跃迁入场后你降落在距怪10-15公里处。摧毁停滞网子塔会触发下一波。

sections.heading: 第二部分
sections.text: 你降落在加速轨道处。只有在没有指挥官或未触发升级时才通过轨道。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 舰船有特殊名称，但只是改名的死亡空间怪。攻击任何舰船都会触发增援。

sections.heading: 第四部分
sections.text: 这部分通常在零安星系。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 完成升级的全部四个部分可能获得Gistum A型装备和/或Cynabal BPC。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Powergrid is an Expedition that can escalate from Angel Annex.

sections.heading: First Location ( Low sec )
sections.text: Ungated pocket. You land amongst a field of solar harvesters.

sections.heading: Third Location ( Low sec )
sections.text: You land at 0 on an acceleration gate. If commander battleship does not spawn or does not trigger escalation, take the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Fourth Location ( Null sec )
sections.text: You land at an acceleration gate on the warp-in.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You will get Domination ammo/tags, possible Domination faction modules, Gist C-Type deadspace modules or a rare Cynabal BPC. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使电网是一个可以从天使附楼升级而来的远征任务。

sections.heading: 第一个地点（低安）
sections.text: 无门禁房间。你降落在一片太阳能收割机区域中。

sections.heading: 第三个地点（低安）
sections.text: 你降落在加速轨道0米处。如果指挥官战列舰未刷出或未触发升级，通过加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第四个地点（零安）
sections.text: 跃迁入场时你降落在加速轨道处。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你会获得统治级弹药/标签，可能获得统治级派系装备、Gist C型死亡空间装备或罕见的Cynabal BPC。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Owned Station is an expedition that can be obtained by running Minor Blood Annex sites. It will take you to several new systems, each about 4 jumps from the previous one. Only the escalation trigger ship needs to be killed to continue the escalation.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: The Starbase Major Maintenance Facility can be destroyed, but it has a massive hull tank. It drops nothing.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Attacking the Blood Research Outpost causes it to emit blast waves, destroying drones and doing significant damage to any ships within 90-100 km (Damage is omni, hard for cruiser and deadly for destroyers and smaller). Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者拥有的站点是一个可以通过完成小型血袭者附楼站点获得的远征任务。它会带你前往多个新星系，每个星系距前一个约4跳。只需击杀升级触发舰船即可继续升级链。

sections.heading: 第三个地点
sections.text: 星基地大型维护设施可以被摧毁，但它有巨大的结构防御。它不掉落任何东西。

sections.heading: 第四个地点
sections.text: 攻击血袭者研究前哨会导致它释放冲击波，摧毁无人机并对90-100公里内的任何舰船造成大量伤害（伤害为全向属性，对巡洋舰困难，对驱逐舰及更小舰船致命）。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Powergrid is an Expedition that can escalate from Blood Annex.

sections.heading: Location One (Lowsec, Gateless)
sections.text: Group is located ~65 km from warp in. Site is ungated.

sections.heading: Location Two (Lowsec)
sections.text: Group is located 60-70 km from warp in. Site is ungated.

sections.heading: Location Three (Lowsec)
sections.text: Group is located ~15 km from warp in. Site is ungated. The Newly Constructed Acceleration Gate is usable, but leads to an empty room.

sections.heading: Location Four (Lowsec)
sections.text: Site is gated. Initial wave is ~20 (may be 5) km from entry beacon.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: A group of four frigates and three cruisers spawns 30km off, with the main spawn located at ~65 km.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: The commander rate can spawn special blood raiders themed items. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者电网是一个可以从不袭者附楼升级而来的远征任务。

sections.heading: 地点一（低安，无门禁）
sections.text: 编队位于跃迁点约65公里处。站点无门禁。

sections.heading: 地点二（低安）
sections.text: 编队位于跃迁点60-70公里处。站点无门禁。

sections.heading: 地点三（低安）
sections.text: 编队位于跃迁点约15公里处。站点无门禁。新建的加速轨道可以使用，但通向一个空房间。

sections.heading: 地点四（低安）
sections.text: 站点有门禁。初始波次距入口信标约20（可能5）公里。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 四艘护卫舰和三艘巡洋舰在30公里外刷出，主刷怪点在约65公里处。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 指挥官级别可以刷出特殊的血袭者主题物品。Category:Expeditions

guides.title: Blood Raider Temple Complex (The Inner Sanctum)

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Temple Complex (The Inner Sanctum) is an Expedition that has a nearly 100% chance to escalate from Blood Raider Temple Complex.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This expedition only has one part, but it is VERY hard compared to its Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point variant. Advise bringing a friend or two in ships with a very strong tank and remote capacitor transmitters. Alternatively, bring ships that require little to no cap to operate. The first section is ungated, so capitals can be brought in. Past the acceleration gate, though, only T2 Battleships and below are allowed to enter.

sections.heading: Warp-in point
sections.text: Due to heavy neuting, the energy neutralizer towers should be a very high priority. They have high armor and structure hitpoints, though, so your ship should be able to deal enough DPS to break them quickly. There are a lot of elite frigates in this room which like to target drones, so watch them and recall them if necessary. None of the structures drop loot. The acceleration gate is 60 km from warp-in.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Be EXTREMELY careful in this room; there are many trigger ships and triggering several waves at once can overwhelm you. 8x Sentry Tower Sentry Bloodraider III in the second room. Neut pressure is extreme. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Elder Corpii Collector/Seeker/Herald/Upholder
rows.trigger: Attacking any one triggers elite reinforcments
rows.note: Collectors/Seekers tracking disrupt; Heralds/Upholders web and warp disrupt

rows.name: Corpus Patriarch/Pope
rows.trigger: Triggers battleship reinforcements upon attacking any one and destroying any one

groups.name: Elite reinforcements (triggered by attacking elite frigates from initial spawn)
Battleship reinforcements (triggered by attacking battleships from initial spawn)
Battleship reinforcements (triggered by destroying any battleship from initial spawn)

source.title: Blood Raider Temple Complex (The Inner Sanctum)

zh.title: 血袭者神殿综合体（内殿）

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者神殿综合体（内殿）是一个有近乎100%概率从血袭者神殿综合体升级而来的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 此远征任务只有一个部分，但与黑暗血袭者舰队集结点变体相比非常困难。建议带上一两个朋友，使用防御极强并配备远程电容传输器的舰船。或者，使用几乎不需要电容操作的舰船。第一部分无门禁，因此可以带入旗舰。但通过加速轨道后，只允许T2战列舰及更小的舰船进入。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场点
sections.text: 由于严重的毁电压力，毁电塔应作为最高优先级目标。不过它们有很高的装甲和结构生命值，因此你的舰船应能输出足够的DPS快速击破它们。这个房间有很多喜欢攻击无人机的精英护卫舰，注意它们并在必要时召回无人机。所有建筑都不掉落战利品。加速轨道距跃迁入场点60公里。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 在这个房间要极其小心；有很多触发舰船，同时触发多波增援可能会压倒你。第二个房间有8个哨兵塔 哨兵 血袭者III。毁电压力极端。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Single pocket. Notable structures: The Moka will use smartbombs to destroy drones and to damage ships. As you deal damage to Moka more reinforcements will arrive. These include neuting, webs, points and tracking diruptors. Motoh himself has a very powerful MWD, making it possible to separate him from the group. Just overheat your guns to destroy Moka (the building) and warp out. Warp back in at 100 and let Motoh MWD himself out of his escort and take him out at medium range. Bookmark the wreck and come back in 5-10 minutes. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Colony Under Fire is an expedition found by completing the Serpentis Military Complex signatures. It contains four parts, each of which will be 4-8 jumps from the previous system, in null sec space.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The first 3 parts of this escalation are quite easy, but the 4th part can be somewhat challenging.

sections.heading: Part 1
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access In the first room you find a warp gate. Killing the NPCs allow usage of that gate to the second room. You might have a Shadow Serpentis spawn in the first room. Killing this triggers an escalation. If it is not there, going to the second room and killing the scout can trigger the escalation.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: If the second part of the escalation triggers, you get this message.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access This part is pretty straight forward. Clear the site of NPCs, aggress the station, kill the Shadow Serpentis and get out.

sections.heading: Part 3
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access Kill the Shadow Serpentis spawn in the first room to triggers the next part of the escalation. If it is not there, going to the second room and an approach the beacon for the escalation.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: If the second part of the escalation triggers, you get this message.

sections.heading: Part 4
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access This can be quite hard. The first 3 waves spawn on a 4 minutes timer. The third wave have a Relay Commander, killing this spawn the Relay Wave. Killing the second Relay Commander spawns Black Ceasar and his followers. You want to clear each wave before spawning the next wave. Attacking the Trucker Gate spawns a defensive wave. This offers nothing except the bounties - so there is no reason to attack the gate. They also hit A LOT harder than any other wave.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: The first part: *Can drop shadow serpentis modules, ammunition and tags. *Gives around 28.000.000 ISK in bounties. The second part: *Can drop shadow serpentis modules, ammunition and tags. *Gives around 36.000.000 ISK in bounties. The third part: *Can drop shadow serpentis modules, ammunition and tags. *Gives around 15.000.000 ISK in bounties. The fourth part: *Can drop Core A-Type Modules, shadow serpentis modules, ammunition and tags. *Gives around 50.000.000 ISK in bounties. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 殖民地遇袭是一个通过完成天蛇军事综合体信号发现的远征任务。包含四个部分，每个部分距离上一个星系 4-8 跳，位于零安空间。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 本次升级的前 3 个部分相当简单，但第 4 部分可能具有一定挑战性。

sections.heading: 第一部分
sections.text: 进入方式：无门控，开放进入。在第一个房间你会发现一个跃迁门。击杀 NPC 后可以使用该门进入第二个房间。你可能会在第一个房间遇到阴影天蛇生成。击杀它会触发升级。如果它不在，进入第二个房间击杀侦察兵可以触发升级。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 如果升级的第二部分触发，你会收到此消息。

sections.heading: 第二部分
sections.text: 进入方式：无门控，开放进入。这部分相当直接。清除站点中的 NPC，攻击空间站，击杀阴影天蛇然后离开。

sections.heading: 第三部分
sections.text: 进入方式：无门控，开放进入。击杀第一个房间中的阴影天蛇生成以触发升级的下一部分。如果它不在，进入第二个房间并接近信标以触发升级。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 如果升级的第二部分触发，你会收到此消息。

sections.heading: 第四部分
sections.text: 进入方式：无门控，开放进入。这部分可能相当困难。前 3 波以 4 分钟计时器生成。第三波有一个中继指挥官，击杀他会生成中继波。击杀第二个中继指挥官会生成 Black Ceasar 和他的追随者。你需要在生成下一波之前清除每一波。攻击运输门会生成防御波。这除了赏金之外没有任何收益——所以没有理由攻击门。他们的伤害也比任何其他波次高得多。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 第一部分：*可能掉落阴影天蛇装备、弹药和标签。*赏金约 28,000,000 ISK。第二部分：*可能掉落阴影天蛇装备、弹药和标签。*赏金约 36,000,000 ISK。第三部分：*可能掉落阴影天蛇装备、弹药和标签。*赏金约 15,000,000 ISK。第四部分：*可能掉落核心 A 型装备、阴影天蛇装备、弹药和标签。*赏金约 50,000,000 ISK。分类:远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Contract Killers is a expedition combat site that can be gotten from the Serpentis Base unrated complex. While the Serpentis Base only spawn in null-sec, this expedition can lead to both low-sec and null-sec. Contract Killers is considered a rare expedition with very low chance of happening. It consists of 2 parts.

sections.heading: Contract Killers - Part 1
sections.text: The room is ungated, meaning you can warp around in it, and people can warp directly to you. You should get the escalation upon landing. If so, you will see message below pop up:

sections.heading: Contract Killers - Part 2
sections.text: The room is ungated, meaning you can warp around in it, and people can warp directly to you. Take care of the NPCs but ignore the factory, as although it may look like an overseer structure it doesn't actually drop any deadspace items other than random contraband. The factory reps shield and armor so you will need around 1500dps just to break the tank. It fires Citadel torpedos which are relatively weak and can be tanked easily. The factory webs you up to 50km out. The next stage is to shoot the structure named "Serpentis Drug Lab". To clarify, this is not the structure that shoots you or repairs itself. This will trigger another wave of ships about 160-180k from the beacon. One battleship is named "Quertah Bleu", and is the overseer for the site. He moves very quickly and hits for a fair amount of damage and has exceptional tracking and damage application against fast moving targets. His tank, however, is nothing special. He is extremely fast and can be kited away from the rest of the wave easily, allowing you to kill and loot him. A message will be broadcast in local: Take him out and you'll get a message: Note: (The player who receives aggro from the Serpentis Drug Factory can keep it at range of at least 60km. In this instance the Drug Factory will still rep its shields but will cease to repair its armor and will be much easier to take down. All other players assisting can keep the Drug Factory at preferred range as long as the player who receives aggro from the factory keeps it at 60km. Factory does not switch targets.)

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: Quertah may drop Core C-types, and possibly a Vigilant BPC. Salvage from wreck is Tech 1. Quertah can also drop a 1-run Vindicator BPC. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 合约杀手是一个可以从无等级天蛇基地综合体获得的远征战斗站点。虽然天蛇基地只在零安生成，但此远征可以通往低安和零安。合约杀手被认为是一个稀有远征，触发几率非常低。它由 2 个部分组成。

sections.heading: 合约杀手 - 第一部分
sections.text: 房间无门控，意味着你可以在其中自由跃迁，其他人也可以直接跃迁到你身边。你应该在着陆时获得升级。如果是，你会看到以下消息弹出：

sections.heading: 合约杀手 - 第二部分
sections.text: 房间无门控，意味着你可以在其中自由跃迁，其他人也可以直接跃迁到你身边。处理 NPC 但忽略工厂，因为虽然它看起来像是一个 overseer 建筑，但它实际上不会掉落任何死亡空间物品，只会掉落随机违禁品。工厂会修复护盾和装甲，所以你需要大约 1500 DPS 才能打破它的防御。它发射 Citadel 鱼雷，伤害相对较弱，可以轻松抗住。工厂会在 50km 内对你使用网子。下一步是射击名为"天蛇毒品实验室"的建筑。需要澄清的是，这不是射击你或自我修复的建筑。这会在距离信标约 160-180km 处触发另一波舰船。一艘战列舰名为"Quertah Bleu"，是该站点的 overseer。他移动速度非常快，造成相当可观的伤害，并且对快速移动目标有出色的跟踪和伤害投射能力。然而，他的防御并不特别。他速度极快，可以轻松风筝脱离编队其余部分，让你能够击杀并拾取他。本地频道会广播一条消息：击杀他后你会收到一条消息：注意：（受到天蛇毒品工厂仇恨的玩家可以将其保持在至少 60km 的距离。在这种情况下，毒品工厂仍然会修复护盾，但不再修复装甲，会更容易被击毁。所有其他协助的玩家可以将毒品工厂保持在首选距离，只要受到工厂仇恨的玩家将其保持在 60km。工厂不会切换目标。）

sections.heading: 战利品表
sections.text: Quertah 可能掉落核心 C 型装备，可能还有 Vigilant 蓝图副本。残骸打捞为 T1。Quertah 还可以掉落 1 份 Vindicator 蓝图副本。分类:远征

sections.text: Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point 2 is an Expedition that can escalate from Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: As of 9-30-23 the site has been changed to deadspace. You cannot warp directly to objects in either room and will land around 30KM from rats in the second room. The site is difficult and should be taken with extreme caution due to heavy neuting.

sections.text: 暗血舰队集结点 2 是一个可以从暗血舰队集结点升级的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 截至 2023 年 9 月 30 日，该站点已改为死亡空间。你无法直接跃迁到两个房间中的任何物体，在第二个房间会降落在距离怪约 30KM 处。该站点难度较高，由于严重的毁电，应极其谨慎地应对。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point 3 is an Expedition that can escalate from Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point 2.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This section is very difficult to solo. Recommend bringing a friend for this escalation. The site is deadspace with no gates.

sections.heading: Single Room
sections.text: The Blood Raider Fleet Outpost has a strong active armor tank and 50 km web as well as substantial passive shield tank. This site although ungated is now DEADSPACE, meaning you cannot warp around freely while in the site. Any time you warp out and warp back in you will land at the same beacon every time. Recommend bookmarking an off grid location if you need to get out and get back in quickly. The fleet outpost fires Citadel EM torpedoes that deal heavy damage approx. 2000 EM damage. DO NOT STAND STILL or you risk getting alphaed. T3C or well tanked Battleship is advised.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 暗血舰队集结点 3 是一个可以从暗血舰队集结点 2 升级的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 此部分单人非常困难。建议带一个朋友来完成此升级。该站点为死亡空间，无门控。

sections.heading: 单个房间
sections.text: 血袭者舰队前哨站有很强的主动装甲防御和 50km 网子，以及相当可观的被动护盾防御。此站点虽然无门控，但现在是死亡空间，意味着你在站点内无法自由跃迁。每次你跃迁出去再跃迁回来，你都会降落在同一个信标处。建议做一个离线书签，如果你需要快速离开并返回。舰队前哨站发射 Citadel 电磁鱼雷，造成大量伤害，约 2000 电磁伤害。不要站在原地，否则有被齐射秒杀的风险。建议使用 T3C 或防御良好的战列舰。

sections.heading: 参见
sections.text: 舰队前哨站属性 分类:远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: David v Goliath is an expedition that escalates from Sansha Military Complex.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This expedition is in nullsec, with all four parts in Sansha infested nullsec. A high DPS ship is recommended to take out Naberius Marquis in the final location.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: If the True Sansha ship does not trigger escalation or does not spawn, take the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: The Sansha Military Outpost does not drop anything worthwhile, so it is not worth the time and ammunition to destroy it unless to trigger the escalation.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: If True Sansha ship does not trigger escalation or spawn, take the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: No rats are present here. Approach the beacon to trigger the escalation.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Single open pocket. No gate at warpin. This section can be easily mastered with a carrier. The haulers present will warp off when you warp in. Attacking the Trucker Gate spawns an optional defensive wave. This is only worth doing for the extra bounties/salvage.

rows.name: Sansha Military Outpost
rows.trigger: Triggers wave 2 when attacked, Escalation trigger

rows.name: Naberius Marquis
rows.note: Has a very strong passive armor tank and slight active tank, requires ~600 DPS to break

groups.name: Mercenary wave(triggered by attacking the Trucker Gate)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 大卫对战歌利亚是一个从萨沙军事综合体升级的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 此远征位于零安，所有四个部分都在萨沙出没的零安区域。建议使用高 DPS 舰船在最终位置击杀 Naberius Marquis。

sections.heading: 第一位置
sections.text: 如果萨沙真理舰船没有触发升级或未生成，走加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第二位置
sections.text: 萨沙军事前哨站不会掉落任何有价值的东西，因此不值得花费时间和弹药去摧毁它，除非是为了触发升级。

sections.heading: 第三位置
sections.text: 如果萨沙真理舰船没有触发升级或未生成，走加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 此处没有怪。接近信标以触发升级。

sections.heading: 第四位置
sections.text: 单个开放房间。跃迁进入处无门控。此部分使用航母可以轻松通关。在场的运输船会在你跃迁进入时跃迁离开。攻击运输门会生成一个可选的防御波次。这仅为了额外赏金/打捞而值得做。

sections.heading: Location and Difficulty
sections.text: This site is an escalation of data sites found in the Etherium Reach and Perrigen Falls and Insmother regions. *Abandoned Research Complex DG003 *Abandoned Research Complex DG018 Escalation message "Amongst the research material you managed to retrieve, you find the coordinates to a nearby high-security research center." The site follows many of the same mechanics as normal drone data sites, being impossible to fail hacks and spawning weak rats. This site cannot escalate further. The site has a total of 3 cans with increasing difficulty and higher chances of 'Augmented' BPC dropping.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: High chance for 30/60/120 run 'Augmented' BPC's Try to cargo scan the cans and pick only the valuable cans. Then return after downtime and hack the cans again. This will give you twice the loot as the site's loot respawns at downtime One of the High-Security Containment Facility has Firewall with 50 coherence, the other one with 40, the difference can be used to tell which is more likely to hold higher value. Both facility are fairly easy with few nodes and low difficulty. The Research and Development Laboratories can contain 'Augmented' BPC too, its Firewall has the stronger type of 90 coherence, difficulty is as same as other nullsec data sites containers with a similiar Firewall coherence. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 位置与难度
sections.text: 此站点是 Etherium Reach、Perrigen Falls 和 Insmother 地区数据站点的升级任务。*废弃研究综合体 DG003 *废弃研究综合体 DG018 升级消息"在你设法获取的研究材料中，你找到了附近一个高安全研究中心的坐标。"此站点遵循许多与普通无人机数据站点相同的机制，不可能破解失败，并生成弱怪。此站点无法进一步升级。该站点共有 3 个箱子，难度递增，掉落"增强"蓝图副本的几率更高。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 有很高几率掉落 30/60/120 次运行的"增强"蓝图副本。尝试用货舱扫描箱子，只选择有价值的箱子。然后在停机维护后回来再次破解箱子。这会给你双倍的战利品，因为站点的战利品会在停机时刷新。一个高安全收容设施的防火墙有 50 一致性，另一个有 40，这个差异可以用来判断哪个更可能包含更高价值的内容。两个设施都相当简单，节点少且难度低。研发实验室也可能包含"增强"蓝图副本，其防火墙为更强的 90 一致性类型，难度与其他零安数据站点容器相似，具有一致的防火墙一致性。分类:远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Domination Surveillance Squad is an Expedition that can escalate from Provisional Angel Outpost.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The first three locations are usually in low security space and the last in null security space, but this can vary. For locations #1-3, take the Newly Constructed Acceleration Gate into the first pocket if no escalation is given from destroying the commander or if the commander ship does not spawn. Gistum Breaker/Defeater cruisers rarely web.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: Kill Domination cruiser, loot wreck, possibly get escalation. Otherwise take the Newly Constructed Acceleration Gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: There are two groups of NPCs present at warp-in. One will warp off. Destroy the Angel Security Station to get escalation.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Like the first location, you land 60 km away from an Angel Security Station structure. Destroying this structure may trigger escalation. Rats do not aggro until you approach or attack. There are two groups, one of which will warp away after a few seconds.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Take acceleration gate if Domination cruiser does not spawn or trigger escalation.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Simple warp-in can trigger escalation. Unlike the first two locations, you have auto-aggro the moment you land in the pocket.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Ungated pocket, with debris, rocks, and an Elysian structure. No rats are initially present at warp-in. Attacking the Elysian structure also triggers multiple smartbomb waves. Note that warping off for too long may 'reset' the smartbomb trigger, causing another set of waves when your return. Nikmar Eitan has a strong passive shield tank compared to the other NPCs, and has a 2.5 million ISK bounty on him.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: The Domination commanders drop faction ammo and tags, and may also contain Domination cruiser modules. Nikmar Eitan may drop Gistum C-Type cruiser modules or a rare Cynabal BPC. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 统御监视小队是一个可以从临时天使前哨站升级的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 前三个位置通常在低安空间，最后一个在零安空间，但这可能会有变化。对于位置 #1-3，如果摧毁指挥官没有给出升级或指挥官舰船未生成，走新建加速轨道进入第一个房间。Gistum 破坏者/击败者巡洋舰很少使用网子。

sections.heading: 第一位置
sections.text: 击杀统御巡洋舰，拾取残骸，可能获得升级。否则走新建加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入处有两组 NPC。其中一组会跃迁离开。摧毁天使安全空间站以获得升级。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 与第一位置类似，你降落在距离天使安全空间站建筑 60km 处。摧毁此建筑可能触发升级。怪在你接近或攻击前不会主动仇恨。有两组怪，其中一组会在几秒后跃迁离开。

sections.heading: 第三位置
sections.text: 如果统御巡洋舰未生成或未触发升级，走加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 简单的跃迁进入即可触发升级。与前两个位置不同，你降落在房间的瞬间就会自动仇恨。

sections.heading: 第四位置
sections.text: 无门控房间，有碎片、岩石和一个 Elysian 建筑。跃迁进入处初始没有怪。攻击 Elysian 建筑会触发多波智能炸弹波次。注意跃迁离开太久可能会"重置"智能炸弹触发器，导致你返回时又触发一波。Nikmar Eitan 与其他 NPC 相比有很强的被动护盾防御，他的赏金为 250 万 ISK。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 统御指挥官掉落势力弹药和标签，也可能包含统御巡洋舰装备。Nikmar Eitan 可能掉落吉斯特姆 C 型巡洋舰装备或稀有的 Cynabal 蓝图副本。分类:远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point 2 is an Expedition that can escalate from Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site is considerably harder than the unrated complex due to heavy neuting and webbing, as well as high DPS. Again, a fleet of T2, T3 or Faction Cruisers or a small group of Battleships is recommended for this site.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: You land on a beacon. Wave 2 triggers when the penultimate battleship in initial spawn is attacked. Wave 3 triggers when the last battleship in initial spawn is attacked. The Guristas Scout Commander does not have significant tank, like a regular Overseer Cruiser. Its wreck may produce T2 salvage materials, though. Destroying the commander (and possibly, failing that, all ships) will trigger an escalation to Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point 3. To blitz, then, kill battleships until the elite frigates spawn, then kill the Overseer cruiser. The acceleration gate to the first pocket does not have to be used; the first pocket is optional, and only worth doing for extra bounties/salvage.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Only go in here if you want bounties/salvage. No escalation is triggered here. Highly recommend destroying the stasis tower and neuting sentry first; they add a lot of difficulty to this room.

rows.name: Guristas Energy Neutralizer Sentry III
rows.note: Has a strong passive tank and neuts 40 GJ/s

zh.title: 恐怖古斯塔斯舰队集结点 2

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 恐怖古斯塔斯舰队集结点 2 是一个从恐怖古斯塔斯舰队集结点升级而来的远征站点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点比未评级综合体要难得多，因为存在大量毁电和网子，以及高DPS。同样，建议使用T2、T3或势力巡洋舰舰队，或一小队战列舰来刷此站点。

sections.heading: 跃入
sections.text: 你降落在一个信标上。当初始刷怪中倒数第二艘战列舰被攻击时触发第二波。当初始刷怪中最后一艘战列舰被攻击时触发第三波。古斯塔斯侦察指挥官没有明显的抗性，和普通指挥官巡洋舰一样。它的残骸可能会产出T2打捞材料。摧毁指挥官（或者如果没做到的话，摧毁所有舰船）将触发升级至恐怖古斯塔斯舰队集结点 3。要速刷的话，击杀战列舰直到精英护卫舰刷出，然后击杀指挥官巡洋舰。通往第一个死亡空间房间的加速轨道不需要使用；第一个房间是可选的，只值得为了额外赏金和打捞而进入。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 只有在你想要赏金和打捞时才进入这里。此处不会触发升级。强烈建议先摧毁停滞塔和毁电哨兵；它们给这个房间增加了很大难度。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point is an Expedition that almost certainly escalates from Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point 2.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is the hardest of the three Fleet Staging Point parts, as heavy webbing, neuting and high incoming damage from spawns makes it fairly difficult to solo. Preferably use a well-tanked T3 Cruiser or fleet of battleships to handle the site, but it may also be blitzed with a well-fit Ishtar, killing only the frigates and the structure. If using a T3 Cruiser, make sure to keep moving as fast as possible to try and avoid as much damage as possible. The second reinforcement wave contains 3x Guristas Energy Neutralizer Sentry II so watch your cap. The Guristas Fleet Outpost (structure that contains your loot) has a strong -80% web that reaches out to 50 km. It fires Citadel Kinetic torpedoes that can instantly destroy an unprepared ship. High resists to Kinetic damage are strongly recommended. At around 75% Shield At around 50% Shield Once hitting Hull Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Guristas Fleet Outpost
rows.trigger: Triggers reinforcements at different damage intervals

zh.title: 恐怖古斯塔斯舰队集结点 3

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 恐怖古斯塔斯舰队集结点是一个几乎肯定从恐怖古斯塔斯舰队集结点 2 升级而来的远征站点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点是三个舰队集结点部分中最难的，因为重度网子、毁电以及刷怪的高 incoming damage 使得单人相当困难。建议使用装甲充足的T3巡洋舰或战列舰舰队来处理此站点，但也可以用配置良好的伊什塔速刷，只击杀护卫舰和建筑。如果使用T3巡洋舰，确保尽可能快地移动以尽量规避伤害。第二波增援包含 3x 古斯塔斯能量中和哨兵 II，注意你的电容。古斯塔斯舰队前哨站（包含你的战利品的建筑）拥有强力的 -80% 网子，射程达 50 km。它发射堡垒动能鱼雷，可以瞬间摧毁一艘没有准备的舰船。强烈建议高抗动能伤害。在护盾约 75% 时 在护盾约 50% 时 一旦进入装甲 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Drone Infested Starbase is a DED 4/10 rated combat site that is found in null security space. It consists of a starbase protected by a shield bubble, a large number of sentries with neutralizers, and several waves of drones. Despite being listed as a level 4/10 site in game, it requires capital scale damage to complete. It can be found as an escalation from Rogue Drone anomalies. It lasts 3 days once earned in the Opportunities journal. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Forcefield
rows.note: 400,000 hp Repairs for 8000 dps, must be destroyed to reach tower

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 无人机入侵星站是一个在低安空间发现的 DED 4/10 等级战斗站点。它由一个被护盾泡保护的星站、大量带有中和器的哨兵和数波无人机组成。尽管在游戏中被列为 4/10 等级站点，但它需要旗舰级别的伤害才能完成。它可以作为自由无人机异常的升级出现。在机会日志中获得后持续 3 天。 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Drop is an Expedition obtained through completion of the Sansha Hideout combat site.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: You land at an acceleration gate. Killing True Sansha's Minion can trigger a further escalation. If it is not there, just activate the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: No enemy ships except for named ship Gamat Hakoot and two frigate escorts which immediately warp off. The escalation might trigger when they warp off. "It seems like the weird sound once in a while coming from your left dashboard is not from the navigation computer after all, at least it seems to have calculated the whereabouts of these Sansha frigates pretty accurately. Not accurately enough though, as they warp out as soon as you enter space. Luckily your instruments manage to come up with a best approximation for their next destination." ==Second Location== Room 1: Room 2: "Again you warp in too far and the Sansha ships slip away into space. Luckily they leave a predictable path."

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Room 1: "While fighting the two ships you managed to catch up with, the third one got away. Your instruments give no clue as to where it was headed, but just before it vanished, you picked up a distress signal from it, containing this location... " Room 2:

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Initial Spawn Second Spawn Third Spawn "Obviously the distress signal made it through to the intended recipients, this was quite a reception. In any case, there are a bit less drug runners in space after this encounter..." Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 空投是一个通过完成萨沙共和国藏匿处战斗站点而获得的远征。

sections.heading: 跃入
sections.text: 你降落在一个加速轨道处。击杀真萨沙仆从可能触发进一步升级。如果它不在那里，直接激活加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 没有敌方舰船，只有命名舰船 Gamat Hakoot 和两艘护卫护航舰，它们会立即跃迁离开。升级可能在它们跃迁走时触发。"看起来你的左仪表盘时不时传来的奇怪声音并不是导航电脑发出的，至少它似乎相当准确地计算出了这些萨沙护卫舰的下落。不过还不够准确，因为它们在你进入空间后立刻就跃迁走了。幸运的是你的仪器设法给出了它们下一个目的地的最佳近似值。" ==第二位置== 房间 1：房间 2："你再次跃入得太远，萨沙舰船溜入了太空。幸运的是它们留下了可预测的路径。"

sections.heading: 第三位置
sections.text: 房间 1："在与你追上的两艘舰船交战时，第三艘逃走了。你的仪器没有给出它飞往何处的线索，但在它消失之前，你截获了它发出的求救信号，其中包含了这个位置……" 房间 2：

sections.heading: 第四位置
sections.text: 初始刷怪 第二刷怪 第三刷怪 "显然求救信号传达给了预期的接收者，这可真是一个盛大的迎接。无论如何，这次遭遇之后太空中的毒贩子少了一些……" Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Dubious Assignment is an escalation from the Blood Raider Fortress.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The expedition consists of four possible parts. Each part containing a single dark blood faction spawn with the final part having a chance at dropping Corpus A-type battleship modules, however the escalations and loot are not always guaranteed to trigger.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: This pocket appears to serve no purpose...

rows.name: Elder Corpum Arch Priest/Arch Sage/Dark Priest/Shadow Sage

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 可疑任务是从血袭者堡垒升级而来的远征。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该远征由四个可能的部分组成。每个部分包含一个单一的血袭者势力刷怪，最后一部分有机会掉落 Corpus A 型战列舰模块，但升级和战利品并不总是保证触发。

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 这个房间似乎没有任何用途……

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: EDENCOM Covert Research Headquarters is a limited time Expedition that can escalate from Upwell Covert Research Facilities.

sections.heading: NPCs
sections.text: Rogue drones are the same type as in the Upwell Covert Research Facilities. The fifth and final spawn contains Triglavian rats. The rats will sometimes warp in at 500 km then warp at 0 on you a few seconds later. Their behavior is very atypical compared to the normal rats in New Eden.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Ungated pocket. There are around 5-8 ships in each wave. Subsequent waves spawn several seconds after previous wave is destroyed. The site will become a warpable beacon when it is warped to so anyone can come into the site. Warning: The Voivode Jarognik Leshak has a strong armor tank and high structure hitpoints as well as EXTREME neuting. The Decloaked Infested Fluid Router Relay spawns when the Voivode Jarognik Leshak is destroyed. It is approx. 50 km away.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the overseer structure can escalate the site further to Signal Source. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Voivode Jarognik Leshak
rows.trigger: Destruction decloakes Decloaked Infested Fluid Router Relay

rows.name: Decloaked Infested Fluid Router Relay
rows.note: Spawns when the Voivode Jarognik Leshak is destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: EDENCOM 秘密研究总部是一个限时远征，可以从 Upwell 秘密研究设施升级而来。

sections.heading: NPC
sections.text: 自由无人机与 Upwell 秘密研究设施中的类型相同。第五也是最后一波刷怪包含特里格拉瓦老鼠。老鼠有时会跃迁至 500 km 处，然后在几秒后以 0 距离跃迁到你身上。与新伊甸中普通老鼠的行为相比，它们的行为非常异常。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 无门房间。每波大约有 5-8 艘舰船。后续波次在前一波被摧毁后数秒刷出。当有人跃迁到此站点时，它将变为可跃迁信标，任何人都可以进入站点。警告：Voivode Jarognik Leshak 拥有强大的装甲抗性和高结构生命值，以及极端的毁电。Decloaked Infested Fluid Router Relay 在 Voivode Jarognik Leshak 被摧毁时刷出。距离约 50 km。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁指挥官建筑可以将站点进一步升级至信号源。 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Second room
sections.text: One group, between 40 and 50 km off room beacon.

sections.heading: First room
sections.text: After taking the first acceleration gate:

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: NOTE: Mid-Grade Snake Omega (320 M ISK) looted in second location 14.08.17 Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Coreli Protector/Defender
rows.trigger: Escalation Trigger if no Shadow Serpentis Chief

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 一组怪，距离房间信标 40 到 50 km。

sections.heading: 第一个房间

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Following the Blood is an expedition that escalates from Blood Lookout combat site. The escalation has four locations. Generally three of the locations are in high security space while the last one is in low security space.

sections.heading: 1st location
sections.text: Ungated area. The rats are arranged in two groups which can be aggressed separately. Group 1 auto-aggros and has the commander among them. Group 2 does not aggro until attacked. Killing the commander frigate can trigger escalation. If no commander frigate is present then killing all ships may trigger escalation.

sections.heading: 2nd location
sections.text: Ungated area. Killing the commander frigate can trigger escalation. If no commander frigate is present then killing all ships may trigger escalation.

sections.heading: 3rd location
sections.text: Note: You will a need mining laser. A Civilian Miner won't work, but a Miner I will do just fine. Alternatively, mining drones also trigger the defender spawn. Ungated area. A Rock Formation is about 30km away. Close to the rock formation (in a blueish little cloud) there is a small Arkonor asteroid. Mine the asteroid (you have to complete one or two mining cycles) to spawn the defenders.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Use caution; the rats spawn at 0 on warp-in.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: One of the frigates is the overseer but has a generic frigate name. You will know it's destroyed when you see the completion message popping up.

sections.heading: Traveling
sections.text: Traveling may vary; the first three locations are normally in high sec and the last one in low sec. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 循血追踪是一个从血袭者哨站战斗站点升级而来的远征。该升级有四个位置。通常前三个位置在高安空间，最后一个在低安空间。

sections.heading: 第一位置
sections.text: 无门区域。老鼠分为两组，可以分别拉怪。第一组自动攻击，指挥官在其中。第二组在被攻击前不会主动攻击。击杀指挥官护卫舰可能触发升级。如果没有指挥官护卫舰，则击杀所有舰船可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二位置
sections.text: 无门区域。击杀指挥官护卫舰可能触发升级。如果没有指挥官护卫舰，则击杀所有舰船可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第三位置
sections.text: 注意：你需要一把采矿激光。民用采矿器不行，但采矿器 I 就可以了。或者，采矿无人机也可以触发防守波次刷出。无门区域。一个岩石构造在约 30 km 外。靠近岩石构造（在一个偏蓝色的小星云中）有一个小型艾克诺矿石小行星。开采小行星（你需要完成一到两个采矿周期）以触发防守波次。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 小心；老鼠在跃入时以 0 距离刷出。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 其中一艘护卫舰是指挥官但拥有通用护卫舰名称。当你看到完成消息弹出时就知道它已被摧毁。

sections.heading: 旅行
sections.text: 路线可能有所不同；前三个位置通常在高安，最后一个在低安。 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Fountain of Youth is an Expedition that can escalate from Blood Provincial HQ.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This expedition is a very hard one, and may require several people in strong ships (T3C, well-tanked Battleship or Marauder is advised). The first and second locations can be done solo, but the last two locations have very high incoming DPS that can overwhelm a ship running solo.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: You land at 0 on an acceleration gate. Take it if no commander spawns or if destroying it doesn't trigger escalation.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: Ungated pocket. Incoming damage is VERY high. Recommend using a sniper ship to pick of the enemies or activate an MJD away from the rats when you land. Alternatively use a strongly tanked ship that can tank the DPS (like a well-tanked T3 Cruiser). Attack the Blood Control Center or the Blood Raider Chapels to trigger escalation if none if received from the commander.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Warning: The two stasis towers web you very hard, so expect high incoming damage. The Blood Defense Outpost has very strong active shield and armor tank that requires about 1000 DPS to break (the equivalent of the firepower of 3 battleships). It only drops T1 ammo and meta modules, so don't bother wasting ammo to destroy it unless you need the escalation.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: This site is very hard, and will require multiple people in strongly tanked ships. Double Stasis towers will make you take a lot of damage. Recommend high resists against EM and Thermal damage. Avoid attacking the Blood Raider Military Outpost unless you can tank the incoming damage. The structure itself drops no loot. The site has 3 waves, and if you spawn 2 at once, the site is almost impossible. The final wave is the overseer wave. It spawns when the Blood Raider Military Outpost is at 55% structure. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 青春之泉是一个可以从血袭者省级总部升级而来的远征。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 这个远征非常困难，可能需要多人驾驶强力舰船（建议使用T3C、装甲充足的战列舰或掠夺者）。第一和第二位置可以单人完成，但最后两个位置有非常高的 incoming damage，可以压垮单人舰船。

sections.heading: 第一位置
sections.text: 你在加速轨道处以 0 距离降落。如果没有指挥官刷出或摧毁它没有触发升级，则通过它。

sections.heading: 第二位置
sections.text: 无门房间。Incoming damage 非常高。建议使用狙击舰船逐一击杀敌人，或者在降落时使用 MJD 跳离老鼠。或者使用一艘装甲充足能够扛住 DPS 的舰船（如装甲充足的T3巡洋舰）。如果没有从指挥官处获得升级，则攻击血液控制中心或血袭者教堂以触发升级。

sections.heading: 第三位置
sections.text: 警告：两座停滞塔会对你施加强力网子，所以预计会受到很高的 incoming damage。血袭者防御前哨拥有非常强大的主动护盾和装甲抗性，需要大约 1000 DPS 才能击破（相当于 3 艘战列舰的火力）。它只掉落T1弹药和元组模块，所以除非你需要升级，否则不要浪费弹药去摧毁它。

sections.heading: 第四位置
sections.text: 这个站点非常困难，需要多人驾驶装甲充足的舰船。双停滞塔会让你承受大量伤害。建议高抗电磁和热能伤害。避免攻击血袭者军事前哨，除非你能扛住 incoming damage。建筑本身不掉落战利品。站点有 3 波，如果你同时触发 2 波，站点几乎不可能完成。最后一波是指挥官波次。当血袭者军事前哨结构值降至 55% 时刷出。 Category:Expeditions

sections.text: 前线烽火是一个可以从血袭者军事综合体升级而来的远征。

sections.heading: 第一位置

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guardian Angels Surveillance Squad is an expedition that escalates from Provisional Serpentis Outpost.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The first three locations are usually in low security space while the last location is usually in null security space but this varies.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: ---- Warp in. If Shadow Serpentis is there: kill him, possibly get escalation. Else (or If didn't get escalation): Use acceleration gate, kill Serpentis Security Station (if present), possibly get escalation.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: When you warp in to the site there is additional group present. These ships will warp off and won't engage you.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: ---- Warp in. If Shadow Serpentis is there: kill him, possibly get escalation. Else (or If didn't get escalation): Use acceleration gate, kill Serpentis Security Station, possibly get escalation.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: ---- Warp in. If Shadow Serpentis is there: kill him, possibly get escalation. Else (or If didn't get escalation): Use acceleration gate, kill Serpentis Security Station, possibly get escalation.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: ---- First aggression on the Jeroon structure triggers multiple AoE smartbomb waves with 30+ km radius and 1k damage per wave. Return drones to dronebay before attacking the structure, warp out and back to stop the waves. After that, deploy drones normally.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 守护天使监视小队是一个从临时天蛇前哨升级而来的远征。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 前三个位置通常在低安空间，最后一个位置通常在低低安空间，但这会有变化。

sections.heading: 第一位置
sections.text: ---- 跃入。如果 Shadow Serpentis 在：击杀它，可能获得升级。否则（或如果没有获得升级）：使用加速轨道，击杀天蛇安全站（如果存在），可能获得升级。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 当你跃入站点时，有额外一组舰船存在。这些舰船会跃迁离开，不会与你交战。

sections.heading: 第二位置
sections.text: ---- 跃入。如果 Shadow Serpentis 在：击杀它，可能获得升级。否则（或如果没有获得升级）：使用加速轨道，击杀天蛇安全站，可能获得升级。

sections.heading: 第三位置
sections.text: ---- 跃入。如果 Shadow Serpentis 在：击杀它，可能获得升级。否则（或如果没有获得升级）：使用加速轨道，击杀天蛇安全站，可能获得升级。

sections.heading: 第四位置
sections.text: ---- 首次攻击 Jeroon 建筑会触发多波 AoE 智能炸弹，半径超过 30 km，每波 1k 伤害。攻击建筑前将无人机收回无人机舱，跃出再跃回以停止波次。之后正常部署无人机。

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯监视小队是一个可以从临时古斯塔斯前哨升级而来的远征。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 视频：第一位置，第二位置，第三位置，最终位置

sections.heading: 第一位置（低安）
sections.text: 如果恐怖古斯塔斯没有刷出，通过新建造的加速轨道进入第二个房间并摧毁古斯塔斯安全站。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 如果恐怖古斯塔斯没有刷出，通过新建造的加速轨道进入第二个房间并摧毁古斯塔斯安全前哨。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 舰船数量非常多。如果所有舰船都拉怪，DPS 可能非常高。

sections.heading: 第三位置（低安）
sections.text: ECM未确认。如果恐怖古斯塔斯巡洋舰没有刷出，通过轨道进入第二个房间。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Owned Station is an Expedition that can escalate from Minor Guristas Annex.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site has all four of its parts in low security space, and often leads up to 20 jumps away from the starting system.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: Mixture of Gurista and mercenary rats. The mercenary wave is optional, only worth doing for bounties and salvage.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: You land at an acceleration gate. If Dread Guristas commander doesn't spawn or doesn't trigger escalation, take the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Simple warp-in probably triggers escalation.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Typical loot from Dread Guristas commander battlecruisers includes faction ammo and Dread Gurista tags. The Guristas Research Outpost can drop Pithum A-Type cruiser modules and a rare Gila BPC. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯所属星站是一个可以从小型古斯塔斯分部升级而来的远征。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点的所有四个部分都在低安空间，并且经常导致从起始星系出发跳跃多达 20 跳。

sections.heading: 第一位置
sections.text: 古斯塔斯和雇佣兵老鼠混合。雇佣兵波次是可选的，只值得为了赏金和打捞而做。

sections.heading: 第二位置
sections.text: 你降落在一个加速轨道处。如果恐怖古斯塔斯指挥官没有刷出或没有触发升级，通过加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 简单跃入可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 恐怖古斯塔斯指挥官战列巡洋舰的典型战利品包括势力弹药和恐怖古斯塔斯标签。古斯塔斯研究前哨可以掉落 Pithum A 型巡洋舰模块和稀有的吉拉 BPC。 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gurista Productions Shipment is an Expedition that can escalate from Gurista Outpost.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: If there's no Faction cruiser in the pocket, jump through the Newly Constructed Acceleration Gate to get an escalation.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: You land on an acceleration gate. There is no reason to fly through it unless it is for the escalation.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: No enemies present, just a wrecked stargate in a brown cloud.

sections.heading: Fourth Location ( Null sec )
sections.text: This location can be in null security space but this can vary. You land on an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: The acceleration gate is 45 km from warp-in.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: The Dread Pithum Vindicator does not have significant tank, and can be taken out fairly easily. It does somewhat higher damage with its turrets and missiles, though.

Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯工业货运是一个可以从古斯塔斯前哨升级而来的远征。

sections.heading: 第一位置
sections.text: 如果房间里没有势力巡洋舰，通过新建造的加速轨道以获得升级。

sections.heading: 第三位置
sections.text: 你降落在一个加速轨道处。没有理由通过它，除非是为了升级。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 没有敌人，只有一个棕色星云中破损的星门。

sections.heading: 第四位置（低低安）
sections.text: 此位置可能在低安空间，但会有变化。你降落在一个加速轨道处。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 加速轨道距离跃入点 45 km。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 恐怖 Pithum Vindicator 没有明显的抗性，可以相当容易地击杀。不过它的炮台和导弹伤害略高一些。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: * 恐怖古斯塔斯停滞缠绕光束器 - 2014年11月6日。* 恐怖古斯塔斯反热能护盾增强器 - 2014年11月6日。* 恐怖古斯塔斯重型导弹发射器 - 2020年3月22日。* 恐怖古斯塔斯中型引力子智能炸弹，Pithum A 型中型护盾回充器 - 2021年8月25日。* Pithum A 型爆炸护盾增幅器，Pithum A 型电磁护盾增幅器，Pithum A 型中型护盾回充器 - 2026年2月25日。 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Hidden Riches is an Expedition that can escalate from Sansha Outpost.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: If True Sansha cruiser does not spawn take acceleration gate. The first three locations are usually in lowsec and the last one in nullsec but this can vary.

sections.heading: First Location( lowsec )
sections.text: You land at 0 on rats and an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: You land among some rocks and a ghost ship. There are no enemies present.

sections.heading: Second Location( lowsec )
sections.text: Again you land at an acceleration gate at 0 on rats.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: You land among the ruins of an Amarr station. No rats are present.

sections.heading: Third Location( lowsec )
sections.text: You land again at 0 on the rats and another acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Fourth Location( nullsec )
sections.text: Warping to the location lands you at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 隐藏财富是一项可以从萨沙共和国前哨站升级的探险任务。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 如果真正的萨沙共和国巡洋舰未出现，则通过加速轨道。前三个地点通常位于低安，最后一个位于零安，但具体情况可能有所不同。

sections.heading: 第一个地点（低安）
sections.text: 你在0米处跃迁入场，周围有怪物和一条加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 你在一些岩石和一艘幽灵船之间跃迁入场。现场没有敌人。

sections.heading: 第二个地点（低安）
sections.text: 你再次在0米处的加速轨道旁跃迁入场，周围有怪物。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 你在一个艾玛空间站的废墟之间跃迁入场。没有怪物。

sections.heading: 第三个地点（低安）
sections.text: 你再次在0米处跃迁入场，周围有怪物和另一条加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第四个地点（零安）
sections.text: 跃迁至该地点后你在一条加速轨道旁入场。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Hired Gun is an expedition that can escalate from Gurista Fortress

sections.heading: Hired Gun Part 1
sections.text: You will warp in to Area 1 close enough to deactivate any cloaks. Bookmarking the position will allow you to warp in at any range you choose. Blitz: Kill the Dread Guristas Battleship if it spawns. Otherwise ignore all ships and activate the acceleration gate. This strategy is applicable to all four parts of the escalation. Inside is nothing, but you will get either an escalation or DEAD END.

sections.heading: Hired Gun Part 2
sections.text: Warping to this stage places you in a cloud around 20-30km from the nearest enemy ships. Bookmarking the location will allow you to warp to any distance you choose. There is a chance the escalation will end after this site.

sections.heading: Hired Gun Part 3
sections.text: Warping to this area will place you in the middle of all of the hostiles and right next to the accleration gate, close enough to deactivate any cloak. Bookmarking will allow you to warp to any distance you choose.

sections.heading: Area 2
sections.text: The escalation will either end here, or continue.

sections.heading: Hired Gun Part 4
sections.text: Unlike the previous escalation sections, this one begins with a clear acceleration gate.

sections.heading: 2nd Room
sections.text: Blitz: (if you can take full room aggro) just kill the Pith Protagonist. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 雇佣枪手是一项可以从古斯塔斯要塞升级的探险任务。

sections.heading: 雇佣枪手第1部分
sections.text: 你会跃迁入场至区域1，距离足够近以解除任何隐身。标记该位置可以让你选择任意距离跃迁入场。速刷：如果恐惧古斯塔斯战列舰出现则击杀它。否则忽略所有舰船并激活加速轨道。此策略适用于升级任务的所有四个部分。里面什么都没有，但你会获得升级或死路。

sections.heading: 雇佣枪手第2部分
sections.text: 跃迁至此阶段会将你置于一片云团中，距最近的敌舰约20-30km。标记该位置可以让你选择任意距离跃迁入场。升级任务有可能在此站点后结束。

sections.heading: 雇佣枪手第3部分
sections.text: 跃迁至该区域会将你置于所有敌对目标的中间，紧挨着加速轨道，距离足够近以解除任何隐身。标记位置可以让你选择任意距离跃迁入场。

sections.heading: 区域2
sections.text: 升级任务要么在此结束，要么继续。

sections.heading: 雇佣枪手第4部分
sections.text: 与之前的升级部分不同，这一部分开始时加速轨道是清晰可见的。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 速刷：（如果你能拉住全房间的仇恨）直接击杀Pith Protagonist。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Hunting the Drudge Factory is an expedition that escalates from Chemical Yard.

sections.heading: Location #1 (ungated)
sections.text: Sansha ships have been confirmed to spawn as of 7 Sep YC124. They spawn after the Rogue Drone cruisers are destroyed (not on timer). * Note: Tackler frigates (WD) in this and next locations have lowest resistance EM of 60%+ so proceed with caution. They also attack drones. (as of Sept. YC124) Bounty: ± 681K ISK

sections.heading: Location #2 (ungated)
sections.text: *Simple warp-in triggers escalation. ---- Bounty: ± 1.1 Mil ISK

sections.heading: Location #3 (ungated)
sections.text: ---- Simple warp-in and moving a bit can trigger an escalation. The pocket is empty on warpin; the commander group must be manually spawned by approaching the Ruined Drone Post structures. Bounty: ± 970K ISK

sections.heading: Location #4 (lowsec, possibly highsec, observed 6/5/2018, ungated)
sections.text: ---- * Note: Hive Overseer drops ONLY T2 salvage parts as loot. Genius ! * Footnote: Without going into too much details, that whole expedition SUCKS ! Much travel (32+ jumps), small rewards, Empty containers, have fun. Read [possible reward] as [next to nothing]. Bounty: ± 1.4 Mil ISK Total Bounty for all four sites: ± 4.1 Mil ISK

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Hunting the Drudge Factory again. Category:Expeditions

groups.name: Commander spawn (20-25km, triggered by approaching Ruined Drone Post structures)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 猎杀苦役工厂是一项可以从化学船坞升级的探险任务。

sections.heading: 地点 #1（无门）
sections.text: 已确认自YC124年9月7日起萨沙共和国舰船会出现。它们在自由无人机巡洋舰被摧毁后出现（非计时刷新）。* 注意：此地点及后续地点中的反跳护卫舰（反跳）最低抗性为电磁60%+，请谨慎行事。它们还会攻击无人机。（截至YC124年9月）赏金：± 681K ISK

sections.heading: 地点 #2（无门）
sections.text: *简单的跃迁入场即可触发升级。---- 赏金：± 1.1 Mil ISK

sections.heading: 地点 #3（无门）
sections.text: ---- 简单的跃迁入场并稍微移动即可触发升级。跃迁入场时房间为空；指挥官编队必须通过接近废弃无人机哨站建筑来手动触发。赏金：± 970K ISK

sections.heading: 地点 #4（低安，可能高安，观测于6/5/2018，无门）
sections.text: ---- * 注意：Hive Overseer仅掉落T2打捞零件作为战利品。天才！* 脚注：不详细说了，整个探险任务烂透了！大量赶路（32+跳），奖励微薄，容器是空的，祝你愉快。把[可能的奖励]理解为[几乎什么都没有]。赏金：± 1.4 Mil ISK 四个站点总赏金：± 4.1 Mil ISK

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此站点可以再次升级为猎杀苦役工厂。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Single room
sections.text: Entering this room can trigger the escalation. Serpentis Madcat frigates are 225 km away. All of the Madcats will warp away, although they will attack you from a very long range for a couple of seconds. In previous patches the Escalation message was more colorful; stating:

sections.heading: Single room
sections.text: One of the Madcats will stay behind. Killing it can trigger escalation. Attacking it triggers first spawn. The Madcat is difficult to kill, uses MWD and has active shield and armor rep and small signature (~500 DPS HM Tengu was not able to kill it (possible if you manage to keep it at range (pressing E all the time) - the wreck was empty!)). If you are unable to kill the Madcat he will eventually warp away. A group of Serpentis ships (named Guardian Angels) spawn to defend the Madcat. Each pair of Guardian Angel ships will spawn a new reinforcement wave. Last ship killed will trigger Spawn 2. Scarcity Update: This site, like other cosmic signatures, contains ore. * As of 1st March 2021 the site contains large amounts of Hedbergite & Hemorphite, with smaller amounts of Omber, Kernite and ores found in high sec. The ore spans a crescent shape of 120km across and is therefore impossible to scan with a single survey. It was estimated on approximately a third of the belt scanned that ISK value at current prices would be 2.5-3b. Note that if the site is left by all players it may despawn, but leaving one player at all times within the site will retain it in space for mining. * As of 3rd March 2021 the only asteroids showing on overview at the site were Scordite and Veldspar. Very disappointing. * As of 15th of October 2021 the site, once again, contains only large amounts of Scordite and Veldspar. Each pair of first reinforcements will spawn a new pair of same type. Finishing reinforcement 2 spawns reinforcement 3. This group spawns around 100 km from warp-in. DO NOT KILL REINFOR

sections.heading: Single room
sections.text: As you enter the room three Madcat frigates are waiting. They will warp off after calling reinforcements. Their warp off is the escalation trigger. The guardian angel battlegroup will spawn if you kill enough ships from second reinforcements. The group spawns about 50 km from warp-in.

sections.heading: Fourth location
sections.text: Single normal space pocket. This last site is not time-sensitive, though it can be time-consuming if you do not bring something that can tank the high DPS or snipe the three Madcat Frigates from afar. Once the three Madcats are killed, the container unlocks. The loot can be anything from Metal Scraps to the usual array of faction modules. The Madcat Frigates are effectively a DPS check, as they boast high passive shield regeneration, strong 90% armor resistances, and strong armor repair. Fortunately, you do not need that much DPS (at least 180) to kill them if you pull them away from the site, though more is always better. While it is much faster to be able to overwhelm their armor repair, it is not strictly necessary. Recommend at least 450 DPS to break their active tank. Note - Apr 2025: It seems that there is some criteria under which they stop repairing their armor. I can't figure out what it is, and it doesn't seem to be consistent. It allowed me to kill 2/3 of the Madcat frigates, but not the third. August 2026: Madcats destroyed with HAMs and a Web. For clearing this site, there are three approaches: bookmark chaining to kite, sniping, or tanking. For the first two approaches (kiting/sniping), all you have to do is warp in, then warp out to the sun (or somewhere consistent) after creating a bookmark. Then, you warp to your bookmark at the site at 100km, and then create another bookmark so you are now 200km from the site. Depending on if you are kiting or sniping, you may be able to stop here and pick off the 5 Sentry Guns who can do a fair amount of damage up to 250k

rows.trigger: Killing spawns two more battlecruisers for both pairs
