sections.heading: 单个房间
sections.text: 进入此房间可能触发升级。天蛇Madcat护卫舰在225 km外。所有Madcat都会跃迁离开，尽管它们会在很短的时间内从极远距离攻击你。在之前的版本中升级提示信息更为丰富；内容为：

sections.heading: 单个房间
sections.text: 其中一艘Madcat会留下来。击杀它可以触发升级。攻击它会触发第一波刷新。Madcat很难击杀，使用微曲并拥有主动护盾和装甲修复以及小信号半径（约500 DPS的HM Tengu无法击杀它（如果你能保持距离或许可以（一直按E）——残骸是空的！）。如果你无法击杀Madcat，它最终会跃迁离开。一组天蛇舰船（名为Guardian Angels）会刷新来保护Madcat。每对Guardian Angels舰船会刷出新的增援波次。最后一艘被击杀的舰船将触发第二波刷新。稀缺性更新：此站点与其他宇宙信号一样包含矿石。* 截至2021年3月1日，站点含有大量Hedbergite和Hemorphite，以及少量Omber、Kernite和高安矿石。矿石呈新月形分布，跨度120km，因此无法通过单次扫描完成探测。据估计，在大约扫描了三分之一的小行星带后，按当前价格计算ISK价值约为2.5-3b。请注意，如果所有玩家都离开站点，它可能会消失，但只要始终有一名玩家留在站点内即可保留该站点以供采矿。* 截至2021年3月3日，站点概览中显示的唯一小行星是Scordite和Veldspar。非常令人失望。* 截至2021年10月15日，站点再次只含有大量Scordite和Veldspar。每对第一波增援会刷出新的一对同类型舰船。完成第二波增援后刷出第三波增援。该编队在距跃迁入场点约100 km处刷新。不要击杀增援

sections.heading: 单个房间
sections.text: 当你进入房间时，三艘Madcat护卫舰正在等待。它们会在呼叫增援后跃迁离开。它们的跃迁离开即为升级触发条件。Guardian Angels战斗编队会在你击杀了足够多的第二波增援舰船后刷新。该编队在距跃迁入场点约50 km处刷新。

sections.heading: 第四个地点
sections.text: 单个普通空间房间。最后一个站点没有时间压力，但如果你没有携带能够扛住高DPS的东西或从远处狙击三艘Madcat护卫舰的舰船，可能会很耗时。三艘Madcat被击杀后容器解锁。战利品从Metal Scraps到常规的阵营装备不等。Madcat护卫舰实际上是一个DPS检测，因为它们拥有高被动护盾回复、强力的90%装甲抗性和强力装甲修复。幸运的是，如果你把它们从站点拉出来，不需要太多DPS（至少180）就能击杀它们，不过越多越好。虽然能够压制它们的装甲修复会快得多，但并非严格要求。建议至少450 DPS来打破它们的主动防御。注意 - 2025年4月：似乎存在某些条件下它们会停止修复装甲。我无法确定具体条件，而且似乎不一致。这让我击杀了2/3的Madcat护卫舰，但第三艘不行。2026年8月：使用重型攻击导弹和网子摧毁了Madcat。清理此站点有三种方法：标记链风筝、狙击或硬抗。对于前两种方法（风筝/狙击），你只需要跃迁入场，然后在创建标记后跃迁到太阳（或其他固定位置）。然后，你在站点100km处跃迁到你的标记，再创建另一个标记，这样你就距离站点200km了。根据你是风筝还是狙击，你可能可以停在这里逐个消灭5门哨戒炮，它们可以造成高达250k的可观伤害

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Kidnapped! is an expedition that can escalate from Guristas Vigil.

sections.heading: First location
sections.text: At first, the site may appear empty. Be warned, several groups warp in within a few seconds.

sections.heading: Second location
sections.text: As before, the site may appear empty at first. Soon Guristas will warp in: Destroy the Commander Cruiser to roll for a chance to escalate further. Escalation text:

sections.heading: Third location
sections.text: Destroy the Commander Cruiser to roll for a chance to escalate further. Escalation text:

sections.heading: Fourth location
sections.text: Initially a small contingent of Guristas will await you at a station named Conquered Station 'Fatal Rabbit', complete with stationary heavy missile platforms. Make sure you bring serious firepower, as to complete the escalation you will need to seriously damage the station. The next wave will trigger when you start damaging the Station: When the Station reaches 20% Shields: When the Station reaches 20% Structure the commander Battlecruiser will spawn. Be advised that he may drop no loot at all. On completion this text box should appear: Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 绑架！是一项可以从古斯塔斯警戒升级的探险任务。

sections.heading: 第一个地点
sections.text: 起初，站点可能看起来是空的。请注意，多个编队会在几秒钟内跃迁入场。

sections.heading: 第二个地点
sections.text: 和之前一样，站点起初可能看起来是空的。很快古斯塔斯舰船会跃迁入场：摧毁指挥官巡洋舰以掷骰获得进一步升级的机会。升级提示文本：

sections.heading: 第三个地点
sections.text: 摧毁指挥官巡洋舰以掷骰获得进一步升级的机会。升级提示文本：

sections.heading: 第四个地点
sections.text: 起初，一小支古斯塔斯分队会在一座名为被占领空间站'Fatal Rabbit'的空间站等你，配有固定的重型导弹平台。确保你携带强大的火力，因为要完成升级你需要对空间站造成严重损伤。当你开始损伤空间站时下一波将触发：当空间站护盾降至20%时：当空间站结构降至20%时指挥官战列巡洋舰将会出现。请注意它可能完全不掉落战利品。完成后应出现此文本框：Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: In a limited mining expedition site, you need to mine 10,000 units of ore and deposit it in the friendly Orca, while under attack from enemy frigates.

sections.heading: Site details
sections.text: Rewards are based on total time taken to complete the site.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 在有限采矿探险站点中，你需要在敌方护卫舰的攻击下开采10,000单位矿石并存入友方Orca，同时遭受攻击。

sections.heading: 站点详情
sections.text: 奖励基于完成站点所用的总时间。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Loose Ends is an expedition that can escalate from Dirty Site.

sections.heading: First Location (Low Sec)
sections.text: ---- No gate. Single pocket. A sentient cruiser at close range on warpin, all auto-aggress. Killing the strain frigate spawns 3 new ones (no further spawns from these). Killing the sentient cruiser may give you the next chapter of the escalation.

sections.heading: Second Location ( Low sec )
sections.text: ---- Single pocket. A sentient cruiser on warpin, approx. 20k away.

sections.heading: Third Location ( Low sec )
sections.text: ---- No gate. The sentient cruiser is present on warpin, approx. 10k away. Second wave spawns if you destroy enough ships from initial wave. The trigger is unknown.

sections.heading: Fourth Location ( Null sec )
sections.text: ---- No gate. 1 Battleship and 1 frigate upon warpin. 6 Battleships and 2 strain cruisers spawned 1 minute in. 4 Battleships were 200km out and despawned after ~30 seconds. 4 Battlecruisers and 3 strain cruisers spawned after another minute. 6 Frigates spawned after one more minute, no further spawns. All drones auto-aggress upon spawning or warpin, except for the 4 battleships 200km away which never aggressed. Killing the frigate (Colony Captain Overseer) gives the end message. A commander cruiser spawned a minute afterward (not sure if related to the frigate kill or simply another time based spawn, please confirm), wreck contained ~27m worth of tech II salvage. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 蛛丝马迹是一项可以从污秽站点升级的探险任务。

sections.heading: 第一个地点（低安）
sections.text: ---- 无加速轨道。单个房间。跃迁入场时近距离有一艘感知巡洋舰，全部自动仇恨。击杀Strain护卫舰会刷出3艘新的（这些不会再继续刷新）。击杀感知巡洋舰可能给你升级的下一章。

sections.heading: 第二个地点（低安）
sections.text: ---- 单个房间。跃迁入场时有一艘感知巡洋舰，约20k距离。

sections.heading: 第三个地点（低安）
sections.text: ---- 无加速轨道。跃迁入场时感知巡洋舰在场，约10k距离。如果你摧毁了足够多的初始波次舰船，第二波将刷新。触发条件未知。

sections.heading: 第四个地点（零安）
sections.text: ---- 无加速轨道。跃迁入场时有1艘战列舰和1艘护卫舰。1分钟后刷出6艘战列舰和2艘Strain巡洋舰。4艘战列舰在200km外，约30秒后消失。又过1分钟后刷出4艘战列巡洋舰和3艘Strain巡洋舰。再过1分钟后刷出6艘护卫舰，不再继续刷新。所有无人机在刷新或跃迁入场时自动仇恨，除了200km外的4艘战列舰从未主动攻击。击杀护卫舰（Colony Captain Overseer）会显示结束信息。1分钟后刷出一艘指挥官巡洋舰（不确定是否与护卫舰击杀有关还是仅仅是另一个计时刷新，请确认），残骸包含约27m价值的T2打捞件。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Mare Sargassum is an expedition found by completing Desolate Site combat sites. It may contain up to four parts. The first three will be in high-sec space, while the fourth can be in low-sec or high-sec. The sites do not have gates, and can be easily completed in a cruiser.

sections.heading: Part 1
sections.text: ---- The initial defenders can vary wildly. The initial defenders consists of around 6 frigates and one sentient drone. * Note: Trash Construction is not vulnerable (despite warp-in message) - just approach it to trigger reinforcement wave. (On 26-Nov-YC124 destroying elite frigates didn't trigger reinforcement wave.) Reinforcement wave triggers when the elite frigates are destroyed. It is possible to have this wave included in initial defenders, possibly due to warping through the trash construct. Two additional spawns triggered by killing ships from initial spawn

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text: ---- There is at least one reinforcement wave. The escalation can be triggered by killing either the Sentient drone, or all enemies except the Sentient drone.

sections.heading: Part 3
sections.text: ---- Fewer rogue drones, and killing the sentient drone once again triggered the escalation. As a bonus, you get to see a great big red cube in space. The Borg turned more evil? 400px

sections.heading: Part 4
sections.text: ---- This part may be in a low-sec system (26 Feb 2017 ended in a .5 system / 26 Apr 2017 ended in .6 system / 26 Aug 2019 ended in a .3 system / 9 Dec 2019 ended in a .5 system / 3 Sep 2020 ended in a .2 system / 18 Mar 2024 ended in Ahbazon / 9 Nov 2024 ended in a .5 system). 5 small rogue drones waiting on warpin, and 5 "Drone Hold" cans. Completion popup happened after blowing up the first wave and starting to open cans. Strain Splinter drones can warp scram and web. Two reinforcement waves later appeared, one with a Rogue Mining Overseer dropping T2 salvage. One of the Drone Hold cans contained some drone goo (Dark Compound, Condensed Compound). All drone hold cans can be empty.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Each part has a commander rat which, when killed, will drop T2 salvage and Rogue Drone components. Lootable cans may contain drone alloys.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 马尾藻海是一项通过完成荒凉站点战斗站点发现的探险任务。它可能包含最多四个部分。前三个位于高安空间，第四个可能在低安或高安。站点没有加速轨道，可以轻松用巡洋舰完成。

sections.heading: 第1部分
sections.text: ---- 初始防御力量变化很大。初始防御力量由约6艘护卫舰和一艘感知无人机组成。* 注意：Trash Construction不可攻击（尽管跃迁入场提示信息如此）——只需接近它即可触发增援波次。（在YC124年11月26日，摧毁精英护卫舰未触发增援波次。）精英护卫舰被摧毁时触发增援波次。此波次有可能包含在初始防御力量中，可能是由于跃迁穿过了Trash Construction。击杀初始刷新舰船会触发两波额外刷新

sections.heading: 第2部分
sections.text: ---- 至少有一波增援。击杀感知无人机或除感知无人机外的所有敌人可以触发升级。

sections.heading: 第3部分
sections.text: ---- 较少的自由无人机，击杀感知无人机再次触发了升级。作为额外收获，你可以在太空中看到一个巨大的红色立方体。博格人变得更邪恶了？400px

sections.heading: 第4部分
sections.text: ---- 此部分可能位于低安星系（2017年2月26日结束于.5星系 / 2017年4月26日结束于.6星系 / 2019年8月26日结束于.3星系 / 2019年12月9日结束于.5星系 / 2020年9月3日结束于.2星系 / 2024年3月18日结束于Ahbazon / 2024年11月9日结束于.5星系）。跃迁入场时有5艘小型自由无人机等待，以及5个"Drone Hold"容器。炸毁第一波后开始开容器时弹出完成提示。Strain Splinter无人机可以使用反跳和网子。随后出现两波增援，其中一波包含一艘掉落T2打捞件的Rogue Mining Overseer。其中一个Drone Hold容器包含一些无人机化合物（Dark Compound, Condensed Compound）。所有Drone Hold容器可能为空。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 每个部分有一艘指挥官怪船，击杀后会掉落T2打捞件和自由无人机组件。可拾取容器可能包含无人机合金。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Medical Twilight is an expedition that can be obtained by running Blood Watch combat sites. It will take you to several new systems, each about 4 jumps from the previous one. Only the escalation trigger ship needs to be killed to continue the escalation.

sections.heading: First escalation
sections.text: The next wave will spawn upon attacking the Ritual Center. The final wave will spawn when the Ritual Center is at half shield. Do not underestimate the final wave. Being neuted, pointed and webbed can get you killed quickly! A suggested tactic is to fight at range and only go in to brawl when the elite frigates are off the field. To blitz this site, shoot the Ritual Center until all waves are spawned and then take out the elite frigates followed by the Dark Blood frigate. Be prepared to tank DPS under neut pressure.

sections.heading: Fourth escalation (Lowsec|Highsec)
sections.text: The warp in is within neut range of the Elite Cruisers. The DPS combined with the heavy neuting and webs is a serious problem for active tanked ships. Dropping a bookmark and warping in at range to the bookmark is recommended. Warping inside the site itself is possible and there are plenty of small asteroids to warp between. You can draw the Blood Factory Overseer and the Elite Frigates away from the rest by kiting (the Overseer BS has a top speed of 700+ m/s). [Jan 2025 (0.5 System)]

sections.heading: Escalation failure
sections.text: Another Blood hideout and more slaves. You find no clues as to where the medical facility is, nor can you find any information on other parts of this Blood operation. It looks like your expedition has come to an end.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Completing all four escalations gives the possibility of a Cruor BPC or Corpii (Frigate) A-Type module drops in the final escalation site. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 医疗暮光是一项通过完成血袭者监视战斗站点获得的探险任务。它会带你前往数个新星系，每个星系距前一个约4跳。只需击杀升级触发舰船即可继续升级。

sections.heading: 第一次升级
sections.text: 攻击仪式中心时下一波将会刷新。当仪式中心护盾降至一半时最终波次将会刷新。不要低估最终波次。被毁电、被反跳和被网子可以很快让你阵亡！建议的战术是在远距离作战，只在精英护卫舰离场后再进入近战。速刷此站点时，射击仪式中心直到所有波次刷新，然后消灭精英护卫舰，接着击杀暗血护卫舰。准备好在毁电压力下扛住DPS。

sections.heading: 第四次升级（低安|高安）
sections.text: 跃迁入场位置在精英巡洋舰的毁电范围内。DPS加上强烈的毁电和网子对主动防御舰船是严重问题。建议投放标记后远距离跃迁入场至标记处。可以直接跃迁进入站点内部，有许多小行星可以在其间跃迁。你可以通过风筝将Blood Factory Overseer和精英护卫舰从其余舰船中拉出来（Overseer BS最高速度超过700+ m/s）。[2025年1月（0.5星系）]

sections.heading: 升级失败
sections.text: 又一个血袭者藏匿点和更多奴隶。你没有找到关于医疗设施位置的任何线索，也找不到有关血袭者此行动其他部分的任何信息。看来你的探险任务到此结束了。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 完成全部四次升级有可能在最终升级站点掉落Cruor蓝图副本或Corpii（护卫舰）A型装备。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Unlike many escalations, rats from different pirate factions are present here.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: ---- Single pocket containing drone and Guristas ships. Second wave is triggered without killing anything. Either timed spawn or after agressing. Wave 3 is triggeres by killing the commander battlecruiser.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: ---- Single pocket. Wave 2 is triggered by killing all ships from initial defenders.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: ---- Single pocket with drone and mercenary ships. None of the destructible structures seem to trigger or drop anything. Initial defender information incomplete Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 与许多升级任务不同，这里存在来自不同海盗派系的怪物。

sections.heading: 第一个地点
sections.text: ---- 单个房间，包含无人机和古斯塔斯舰船。无需击杀任何东西即可触发第二波。要么是计时刷新，要么在仇恨后触发。第三波通过击杀指挥官战列巡洋舰触发。

sections.heading: 第三个地点
sections.text: ---- 单个房间。击杀所有初始防御舰船后触发第二波。

sections.heading: 第四个地点
sections.text: ---- 单个房间，包含无人机和雇佣军舰船。所有可摧毁建筑似乎都不会触发或掉落任何东西。初始防御力量信息不完整 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Mindflood is an expedition found by completing Serpentis Hideout signatures. It contains four parts, each of which will be 4-8 jumps from the previous system, in high sec space (though the route may include lowsec).

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Sites are not gated, and can be completed in a T1 frigate at range, though larger ships will be safer. The final named frigate requires around 50 DPS. In all sections, killing the Shadow Serpentis named frigate will trigger the next phase. If using a T1 frigate, a Tristan and proper range is highly recommended. In the second room in each phase there is usually Elgur Erinn escorted by two frigates and they will warp away immediately.

sections.heading: Part 4
sections.text: In this part there is no acceleration gate, and no Shadow spawn. Destroy the first wave to bring the commander. Erinn will repair armour at around 30-40 DPS.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Each part has a commander rat which, when killed, will drop faction ammunition and Shadow Serpentis tags. Typical module drop includes a Vortex Compact Magnetic Field Stabilizer. The commander may also drop implants, e.g. Mid-grade Snake Beta (and possibly Shadow Serpentis modules by comparison with other escalations, but not seen). Salvaging commander wrecks may generate T2 salvage. Elgur Erinn may drop Coreli C-Type modules. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 心灵洪流是一项通过完成天蛇藏匿点信号发现的探险任务。它包含四个部分，每个部分距前一个星系4-8跳，位于高安空间（尽管路线可能经过低安）。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 站点没有加速轨道，可以使用T1护卫舰在远距离完成，不过更大的舰船会更安全。最终命名护卫舰需要约50 DPS。在所有部分中，击杀Shadow Serpentis命名护卫舰将触发下一阶段。如果使用T1护卫舰，强烈建议使用Tristan并保持适当距离。在每个阶段的第二个房间中通常有Elgur Erinn由两艘护卫舰护送，它们会立即跃迁离开。

sections.heading: 第4部分
sections.text: 此部分没有加速轨道，也没有Shadow刷新。摧毁第一波以引出指挥官。Erinn会以约30-40 DPS的速率修复装甲。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 每个部分有一艘指挥官怪船，击杀后会掉落阵营弹药和Shadow Serpentis标签。典型装备掉落包括Vortex Compact Magnetic Field Stabilizer。指挥官还可能掉落植入体，例如Mid-grade Snake Beta（参照其他升级任务可能还有Shadow Serpentis装备，但未被观察到）。打捞指挥官残骸可能产出T2打捞件。Elgur Erinn可能掉落Coreli C型装备。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: In a minor mining expedition site, you need to mine 20,000 units of ore and deposit it in the friendly Orcas, while under attack from enemy frigates and cruisers.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 在小型采矿探险站点中，你需要在敌方护卫舰和巡洋舰的攻击下开采20,000单位矿石并存入友方Orca。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Moving Day is an expedition that can escalate from Rogue Trial Yard sites.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: ---- When you warp in only the cruisers are on site. Frigates will spawn in few seconds. If you warp out before killing the first triggers the second wave will spawn on warp in.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: ---- Attacking anything triggers wave #2. Attacking destroyers triggers wave 3. Subsequent spawns seem to be timed.

groups.name: Spawn 1, triggered by destroying commander from initial defenders

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 搬家日是一项远征任务，可能由自由无人机试验船坞遗址升级触发。

sections.heading: 第一地点
sections.text: ---- 当你跃迁进入时，现场只有巡洋舰。护卫舰将在几秒后刷新。如果你在第一波触发前跃迁离开，第二波将在你跃迁进入时刷新。

sections.heading: 第二地点
sections.text: ---- 攻击任何目标都会触发第2波。攻击驱逐舰触发第3波。后续刷新似乎是按时间触发的。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Nation on the Rise is an expedition obtained through completion of Sansha Watch combat sites. This expedition consists of 4 different open area locations (no Acceleration gate) starting in a high security system and ending in a low security system but it can suddenly end at any step in the chain. NPC ship class encountered is Frigate, Destroyer, Cruiser, Battlecruiser and Battleship hulls. Warning: Elite NPC's do medium lite EWAR - Tracking Disruption, Web and Warp Scram.

sections.heading: Location 1
sections.text: The initial ships will not auto-aggro on warp-in. You may have to fly some distance away from them to get within warp-in range of the Sansha ships. Warping into the site appears to sometimes prematurely trigger the second spawn, possibly due to proximity to the Sansha Control Outpost. Please note: No loot dropped from structures

sections.heading: Location 2
sections.text: Please note: Warping out may cause the site to disappear from your Expeditions list. Bookmark the beacon to allow you to return. Sansha Tower Sentry III can shoot up to 250km and can deal about 200~250 dps at max range. True Sansha commander is considerably faster than the other ships and will quickly approach you.

sections.heading: Location 3
sections.text: Hint: If you are only interested in the Faction npc, he is considerably faster then the other ships. It is possible to simply tank the Sentry Towers and wait for him to get close. Warp to site Message in local chat channel: "You have stumbled upon the enemy ship's scouting party. Prepare for a fight!" Please note: The Tachyon Towers have a very long range and do a decent amount of dps, even with 80%+ resists.

sections.heading: Location (Low Security)
sections.text: Warning: Your ship can be freely attacked by others - NO CONCORD INTERVENTION - in Low Security Systems (0.1 to 0.4) and Null Security Systems (0.0) Hint: Always check Star Map statistics (Active ships, Ship kills, Pod kills, etc) of Low Security and Null Security systems first before entering. Fitting a Cloaking Device module on your ship and making more than one Safe spot will provide more safety. The Repair Drone cruisers will periodically remote rep all hostile NPCs in this pocket for about 50-75 DPS worth while they are active. Centus Colony General will use MWD to catch up to you if you are over 40km away, so it can be kited away from the other rats with good piloting. Speed-tanking T1 cruiser with AB and 60+ km range weapons can comfortably snipe it. It does ~100 DPS EM/Th with its turrets at ranges under 20km. Please note: Centus Colony General has a 9,375,000.00 ISK Bounty and can drop True Sansha and Centii A-Type modules. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Sansha Heavy Missile Battery (Proximity Trigger 60 km)
Repair Drone
rows.note: Renamed Elite Repair Drone. Does no damage

rows.name: Centus Colony General
rows.trigger: Attacking triggers 3rd Wave. Destroy to end expedition

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 崛起的国度是一项远征任务，通过完成萨沙监视战斗站点获取。该远征由4个不同的开放区域组成（无加速轨道），起始于高安星系，最终到达低安星系，但可能在链条的任意一步突然结束。 encountered的NPC舰船级别包括护卫舰、驱逐舰、巡洋舰、战列巡洋舰和战列舰。警告：精英NPC会使用中等强度的电子战——追踪干扰、网子和反跳。

sections.heading: 地点 1
sections.text: 初始舰船不会在跳入时自动仇恨。你可能需要飞到距离它们一定距离外，才能进入萨沙舰船的跳入范围。跳入站点似乎有时会过早触发第二波增援，可能是因为靠近萨沙控制哨站。请注意：建筑不掉落战利品。

sections.heading: 地点 2
sections.text: 请注意：跃迁离开可能导致站点从你的远征列表中消失。请保存信标书签以便返回。萨沙塔哨兵III的射程可达250km，在最远距离可造成约200~250 dps。true萨沙指挥官的速度明显快于其他舰船，会迅速逼近你。

sections.heading: 地点 3
sections.text: 提示：如果你只对派系NPC感兴趣，他的速度明显快于其他舰船。你可以直接扛住哨兵塔的伤害，等他靠近。跃迁进入站点时本地频道消息："你偶然发现了敌方舰船的侦察队。准备战斗！"请注意：快子塔射程极远，即使你有80%+的抗性也能造成可观的dps。

sections.heading: 地点（低安）
sections.text: 警告：在低安星系（0.1至0.4）和0.0星系中，你的舰船可以被其他玩家自由攻击——没有联盟干预。提示：进入低安和0.0星系前，务必先查看星图统计数据（在线舰船数、击船数、击舱数等）。在舰船上装配隐形装置模块并设置多个安全点可以提高安全性。后勤巡洋舰的维修无人机在这个死亡空间房间中会周期性地远程修复所有敌对NPC，修复量约为50-75 DPS。如果你距离超过40km，Centus殖民地将军将使用MWD追赶你，因此技术好的话可以将其从其他怪堆中风筝出来。使用加力器的速抗T1巡洋舰搭配60+ km射程武器可以舒适地狙击它。它在20km以内用炮塔造成约100 DPS的电磁/热能伤害。请注意：Centus殖民地将军的赏金为9,375,000.00 ISK，可掉落true萨沙和Centii A型装备。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: No Quarter is an Expedition that can escalate from Gurista Provincial HQ.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The first two locations are doable solo, while the last two are much harder, with the final location requiring at least 1200 DPS minimum to break the overseer's tank. Even then it takes a long time due to the boss's strong active shield tank and high hitpoints, as well as high DPS that can tear apart a well-tanked T3 Cruiser with ease. Warning: The DED 10/10 The Maze combat site is comparatively easy to this escalation. Use extreme caution unless you want to risk losing your ship.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: You land on an acceleration gate. Take it if no escalation is triggered from the Dread Guristas commander.

sections.heading: First pocket
sections.text: No enemies in the pocket. Spy drones will warp away shortly after entry.

sections.heading: Second location
sections.text: Destroy the Guristas Control Tower if no escalation is received from the commander battleship.

sections.heading: Third location
sections.text: There is considerably higher damage in this pocket; the Guristas Annihilation Missile Battery does extreme EM damage and the Siege Railgun Sentries do high alpha Therm/Kin damage. Together they can destroy an improperly tanked T3C in as few as three volleys. Thus, mainly tank against EM and Kinetic damage. Attacking the Guristas Annihilation Missile Battery triggers a defensive wave. Destroying it or the commander battleship may trigger escalation and allows you to blitz through this location.

sections.heading: Fourth location
sections.text: This location is very hard, requiring around 3-4 people in high-DPS strong tank ships. The overseer battleship has extremely strong shield reps which require the damage to exceed 1200 DPS to thermal. Attacking the Guristas War Installation spawns two defensive waves, the second wave including the overseer. The Siege Sentries deal a high alpha damage of 1200 mostly therm/kin per turret but fire every 16 seconds. Since there are at least 8 turrets firing at warp in, they can destroy a single T3C in two volleys if improperly tanked. It is advised to make a bookmark on-grid as you land at the site to warp to in case of danger and to reset aggro. Terrorist Overlord Inzi Kika deals 500 DPS with turrets and nearly 1500 DPS with missiles. He has 89% EM resists, 79% Explosive and Kinetic resists, and 69% Thermal resists. It is strongly advised to keep your ship aligned to a bouncing bookmark 200 km off, warp to it as soon as the overseer wave spawns, and snipe the spider drones, the elite frigates and then the Terrorist Overlord. His turrets reach out to 200 km and his missiles to 130 km. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Guristas Annihilation Missile Battery
rows.note: Shoots high damaging EM Cruise missiles

rows.name: Guristas War Installation
rows.trigger: Triggers defensive waves at different damage intervals

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 毫不留情是一项可以从古斯塔斯省级总部升级的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 前两个地点可以单人完成，而最后两个地点难度大得多，最终地点需要至少1200 DPS才能打破监督官的防御。即便如此，由于Boss拥有强力的主动护盾回充、极高的生命值，以及能轻松撕碎配置良好的T3巡洋舰的高额伤害，战斗仍然会持续很长时间。警告：DED 10/10迷宫战斗站点相比之下反而比较简单。除非你愿意冒失去舰船的风险，否则请极度谨慎。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 你落在一个加速轨道上。如果没有被恐惧古斯塔斯指挥官触发增援，直接通过轨道离开。

sections.heading: 第一处空间
sections.text: 空间内没有敌人。侦察无人机会在入场后不久跃迁离开。

sections.heading: 第二处地点
sections.text: 如果没有从指挥官战列舰处触发增援，摧毁古斯塔斯控制塔。

sections.heading: 第三处地点
sections.text: 这个空间的伤害明显更高；古斯塔斯湮灭导弹阵列造成极高的电磁伤害，围攻磁轨炮哨戒造成高额的单轮热力/动能伤害。两者配合可以在短短三次齐射内摧毁配置不当的T3巡洋舰。因此，主要针对电磁和动能伤害进行配船。攻击古斯塔斯湮灭导弹阵列会触发一波防御波次。摧毁它或指挥官战列舰可能会触发增援，之后你可以速刷通过此地点。

sections.heading: 第四处地点
sections.text: 此地点非常困难，需要大约3-4人驾驶高输出、强防御的舰船。监督官战列舰拥有极强的护盾回复能力，需要热力伤害超过1200 DPS才能有效破防。攻击古斯塔斯战争设施会触发两波防御波次，第二波包含监督官。围攻炮台哨戒的单轮伤害很高，每门炮塔造成约1200点热力/动能伤害，但每16秒开火一次。由于跃迁入场时至少有8门炮塔同时开火，如果配船不当，可以在两次齐射内摧毁一艘T3巡洋舰。建议在落地时立即设置一个原位书签，以便在危险时跃迁至该书签脱离并重置仇恨。恐怖霸主因齐·卡的炮塔输出为500 DPS，导弹输出接近1500 DPS。他拥有89%的电磁抗性，79%的爆炸和动能抗性，以及69%的热力抗性。强烈建议保持舰船朝向200公里外的弹跳书签对齐，在监督官波次出现时立即跃迁至该书签，然后狙击蜘蛛无人机、精英护卫舰，最后击毁恐怖霸主。他的炮塔射程可达200公里，导弹射程可达130公里。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 400px Nuclear Small Arms Project is an expedition with 4 stages, and the final stage is located in a low-sec system. It has a chance to drop deadspace items. It is found by completing Angel Watch anomalies.

sections.heading: Stage 1
sections.text: 400px On warp in, there will be a stasis tower, some turrets and several mixed ships (frigs-BCs). Incoming damage is quite manageable. (Apparently) after a timer, you will either get the next location or a dead end. Shooting people seems to be optional, but there is almost always a faction ship. For me the escalation for this and the other stages in the expedition, happened immediately after destroying the "Domination" ship. Again a message in local, "Attacking the missile battery triggers an alarm, more ships are incoming!" There are 4 missiles batteries and each one adds more ships to the fray. Attacking each missile battery will cause 3 cruiser, 3 destroyers to spawn. Total: 4.6M (Bounties:2.0M, Loot: 1.0M, Salvage 1.6M) Dead end message: You find nothing interesting among the debris. As time passes by, you grow convinced that this is a dead end.

sections.heading: Stage 2
sections.text: 400px On warp in, there will be debris and a single damaged Mammoth (mini industrial, large collidable object). You're prompted to 'interact' with it in some way. Shoot it. Watch the Drone Carriers warp in then leave. After you've either got the escalation or a dead end, wait for a minute and several BCs and frigates, including a faction ship, will warp in and engage. Lots of Veldspar asteroids there.

sections.heading: Stage 3
sections.text: 400px On warp in, there are several ships and turrets located ~230k away. After a few seconds, you either get the escalation or a dead end. Engaging is optional, but you can warp to the asteroids near them and kill the faction ship for the loot.

sections.heading: Stage 4 LOW SEC
sections.text: This stage has heavy incoming damage, and webs, so a significant tank is recommended. Also, range may be up to 40k (I honestly can't remember), so a long-range weapon is preferable. On warp in, you will be greeted by a significant number of enemy BCs and smaller along with stasis towers and missile turrets. Although it's probably possible to kill them, my strong suggestion is to immediately target the Secret Angel Facility (tower) and destroy it. This will spawn more ships, and at this point the incoming damage can easily melt a drake's shields in 20 seconds or less. Once the tower is destroyed, the following appears (typo intentional): It looks like you have managed to destroy a facility developing one of the hottest new commodities in the galactic underworld, the Nuclear Small Arms. As far as you know, none of these new weapons have hit the market yet, but from the look of this place, it is not long until common criminals will go nuclear. You cant help wondering what is wrong with the good old sawed off shotgun. Bookmark the cargo container that the lab dropped, warp out, and warp back to the container. Loot, then leave. This minimizes your time in low-sec, and makes it very hard for anyone to get enough time to scan you down. Loot consists of 130 Compact Nuclear Small Arms, worth approximately 20m ISK on contract. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 400px 核小型武器计划是一项包含4个阶段的远征，最终阶段位于低安星系。有几率掉落死亡空间物品。通过完成天使监视异常可以发现此远征。

sections.heading: 第一阶段
sections.text: 400px 跃迁进入后，会有一座停滞塔、一些炮台和数艘混合舰船（护卫舰至战巡舰）。来袭伤害相当可控。（似乎）经过一段时间后，你要么会获得下一阶段的位置，要么走到死胡同。射击敌人似乎是可选的，但几乎总是有一艘势力舰船。对我来说，这次远征以及后续阶段的推进，都是在摧毁“统治”级舰船后立即触发的。本地频道再次出现消息：“攻击导弹发射台会触发警报，更多舰船正在赶来！”共有4座导弹发射台，每攻击一座都会增加更多舰船参战。攻击每座导弹发射台会触发3艘巡洋舰、3艘驱逐舰增援。总计：4.6M（赏金：2.0M，战利品：1.0M，打捞：1.6M）死胡同消息：你在残骸中没有发现任何有趣的东西。随着时间的推移，你确信这是一个死胡同。

sections.heading: 第二阶段
sections.text: 400px 跃迁进入后，会有残骸和一艘受损的长毛象级（迷你工业舰，大型可碰撞物体）。系统提示你以某种方式与之互动。开火打它。然后你会看到无人机运载舰跃迁进入再离开。在你获得下一阶段推进或走到死胡同后，等待一分钟，数艘战巡舰和护卫舰（包括一艘势力舰船）将跃迁进入并发起攻击。那里有大量凡晶石小行星。

sections.heading: 第三阶段
sections.text: 400px 跃迁进入后，数艘舰船和炮台位于约230k外。几秒钟后，你要么获得下一阶段推进，要么走到死胡同。交战是可选的，但你可以跃迁到它们附近的小行星并击杀势力舰船获取战利品。

sections.heading: 第四阶段 低安
sections.text: 此阶段来袭伤害很高，还有网子，因此建议配备较强的防御能力。另外，距离可能达到40k（老实说我记不清了），因此远程武器更为合适。跃迁进入后，你会面对大量敌方战巡舰及更小的舰船，以及停滞塔和导弹炮台。虽然理论上可以全部击杀，但我强烈建议立即锁定秘密天使设施（塔）并将其摧毁。这会刷出更多舰船，而此时来袭伤害可以在20秒或更短时间内轻松融化幼龙级的护盾。摧毁塔后，出现以下文字（故意保留的拼写错误）：看起来你成功摧毁了一座正在研发银河黑市中最火热的新商品——核小型武器的设施。据你所知，这些新武器尚未流入市场，但从这个地方的情况来看，普通犯罪分子用上核武器只是时间问题。你不禁想，老式短管霰弹枪到底哪里不好了。收藏实验室掉落的货物集装箱坐标，跃迁出去，再跃迁回集装箱。拾取战利品，然后离开。这样可以最大限度减少你在低安的时间，使其他人很难有足够时间扫描到你。战利品包含130件紧凑型核小型武器，合同价值约20m ISK。分类:远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Operation Spring Cleaning is an expedition that escalates from Angel Fortress and consists of 4 parts.

sections.heading: First Part
sections.text: Warp in. If the Domination commander is there: kill him, possibly get escalation. Else (or If didn't get escalation): Use go to the next room to possibly get the escalation.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Loot may contain: High-grade Savior Epsilon Blueprint Domination MWD module

sections.heading: First room
sections.text: ---- Approach either the station or the wreck for a possibility for the escalation to trigger.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: Ungated pocket. The second wave is passive until attacked or approached.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Again, another ungated pocket. Group 3 warps off after a short time and can be ignored.

sections.heading: Fourth and Last Location
sections.text: You land at an acceleration gate at warp-in. No enemies are present.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Enemies are approximately 40 km from the warp-in point. Gist Domination Murderer has a short turret optimal of 21 km, but fires Nova cruise missiles that reach out to 120 km and deal approx. 450 points of damage. It deals Thermal and Kinetic damage with its turrets (with a slant towards thermal) and pure Explosive damage with its missiles. It also recharges shield at around 500 DPS.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: The Domination battleships drop faction ammo and dog tags, and may also drop Domination faction modules or even implants. The Gist Domination Murderer in the final location may drop Gist A-Type battleship modules and possibly a rare Machariel BPC. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 春季大扫除行动是一项从天使企业联合体要塞升级而来的远征任务，共分为4个部分。

sections.heading: 第一部分
sections.text: 跃迁入场。如果统御指挥官在场：击杀他，有可能触发升级。否则（或如果没有触发升级）：使用前往下一房间来有可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 战利品可能包含：高阶救世主ε 蓝图 统御微型跃迁引擎模块

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: ---- 靠近空间站或残骸，有可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二个地点
sections.text: 无加速轨道的死亡空间房间。第二波敌人在被攻击或靠近前为被动状态。

sections.heading: 第三个地点
sections.text: 同样是另一个无加速轨道的死亡空间房间。第三组敌人在短暂时间后跃迁离开，可以忽略。

sections.heading: 第四个也是最后一个地点
sections.text: 跃迁入场时你降落在一加速轨道处。没有敌人存在。

sections.heading: 第二个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 敌人距离跃迁入场点约40公里。古斯塔斯统域杀手炮台最佳射程为21公里，但发射的新月巡航导弹射程可达120公里，造成约450点伤害。其炮台造成热能和动能伤害（偏重热能），导弹造成纯爆炸伤害。它还能以约500 DPS的速率恢复护盾。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 统域战列舰掉落阵营弹药和狗牌，还可能掉落统域阵营装备甚至植入体。最终地点的古斯塔斯统域杀手可能掉落古斯塔斯A型战列舰装备，并有可能掉落稀有的马查里尔蓝图。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Pioneers Peril is an Expedition that can escalate from Angel Military Complex.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Single enemy 140 km away in this pocket. Simple warp-in may trigger escalation.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: No acceleration gate. Enemies are approx. 50 km away, though the Stasis Towers are 140 km off. Destroy Angel Outpost station if no escalation is triggered from the Domination commander.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Ungated non-deadspace pocket. No rats initially present. Jorun 'Red Legs' Greaves deals significantly high Explosive and Kinetic damage at a fairly short range. Try to outpace her if you can. She has fairly high resists, the weakest being 66% Explosive resists, plus a strong shield tank. She has an MWD and will try to chase you at around 1700 m/s. Attack the Space Truckers Pit Stop to spawn an optional defensive wave. This is only worth doing for extra bounties/salvage.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You will possibly get Domination faction modules, Gist A-Type modules or a rare Machariel BPC. Category:Expeditions

groups.name: Reinforcements (triggered by destroying all ships from initial defenders)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 先驱危机是一项远征任务，可由天使军事综合体升级触发。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 此房间中仅有一个敌人，距离140公里。简单跃入即可触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二个地点
sections.text: 无加速轨道。敌人约在50公里外，但停滞塔在140公里外。若未从统御指挥官触发升级，则摧毁天使前哨站。

sections.heading: 第四个地点
sections.text: 无门的非死亡空间房间。初始无怪。Jorun 'Red Legs' Greaves 在相当近的距离造成极高的爆炸伤害和动能伤害。如果可以的话，尝试拉开与她的距离。她的抗性相当高，最弱的也是66%爆炸抗性，加上强力的护盾防御。她装备了加力燃烧炉，会以约1700米/秒的速度追击你。攻击太空运输站停靠点可触发一个可选的防御波次。此举仅对额外赏金和打捞有价值。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你可能获得统御势力装备、古斯塔A型装备或稀有的马查瑞尔蓝图。分类：远征任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Pirate's Path is an escalation of Guristas Military Complex.

sections.heading: Room 1 (ungated)
sections.text: The escalation may end after killing the Dread Guristas Exterminator. Language: (did not capture this)

sections.heading: Pirate’s Path, Part 4
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access Spawns 1-5 arrive in waves over a few minutes. Category: Expeditions

groups.name: Mercenary Wave (Triggered by attacking the Stargate)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 海盗之路是古斯塔军事综合体的升级任务。

sections.heading: 房间1（无门）
sections.text: 击杀恐惧古斯塔灭绝者后升级可能结束。语言：（未记录）

sections.heading: 海盗之路，第四部分
sections.text: 进入方式：无门，开放进入。敌人1-5会在数分钟内分波次抵达。分类：远征任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Pulverize the Pioneers is an expedition escalated from Haunted Yard.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The first three locations are generally in high security space and last in low security space but this can vary. The first three locations can be done in a T1 frigate at range, though for the last location a high DPS destroyer or a cruiser is advised.

sections.heading: Location #1
sections.text: ---- thumb|Example drop from Sentient drone Destroying the Abandoned Drones or the Sentient Decimator from initial defenders triggers the reinforcement.

sections.heading: Location #4
sections.text: ---- thumb|Final location initial spawn The Logistic Overseer has a stronger tank than the usual cruiser NPCs and deals more damage.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: The commander drones in sites drop drone components and can also drop Rogue Drone 46-X Nexus Chip (Astero) or a faction module. The container in last location contains T2 salvage. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Abandoned Drone
rows.note: Abandoned Drone is a flavor name. Ship type: Render Alvi

rows.name: Research Drone
rows.note: Research Drone is a flavor name. Ship types: Infester/Splinter Alvi

rows.name: Researcher
rows.note: Researcher is a flavor name. Ship type Strain Raider Alvi

rows.name: Researcher
rows.note: Researcher is a flavor name. Ship type: Annihilator Alvum

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 粉碎先驱者是从闹鬼庭院升级而来的探险任务。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 前三个地点通常在高安区域，最后一个在低安区域，但这可能会有变化。前三个地点可以驾驶T1护卫舰在远距离完成，但最后一个地点建议使用高DPS的驱逐舰或巡洋舰。

sections.heading: 地点 #1
sections.text: ---- thumb|感知无人机示例掉落 击杀初始防御者中的废弃无人机或感知裁决者会触发增援波次。

sections.heading: 地点 #4
sections.text: ---- thumb|最终地点初始刷新 后勤主管拥有比普通巡洋舰NPC更强的抗性和更高的伤害输出。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 站点中的指挥官无人机会掉落无人机组件，还可能掉落自由无人机46-X联结芯片（阿斯特罗）或势力装备。最后一个地点的容器包含T2打捞物。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Religious Fury is an Expedition that can escalate from Blood Raider Base. It is a rare expedition compared to similar ones in nullsec.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: Ungated pocket. You land among four Blood Raider Chapels. Shoot them to trigger escalation if none is gotten from the Dark Blood commander.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: There are two possible scenarios for this second part: one which is fairly easy, and a harder one with the overseer spawn.

sections.heading: Easier scenario
sections.text: The Blood High Priest repairs other enemy ships until it is destroyed. Advise destroying it first if you want to take out the other rats. There is no overseer spawn for this scenario; you will only get Dark Blood faction ammo and dog tags, as well as a chance for a Dark Blood faction module.

sections.heading: Harder scenario
sections.text: Dark Templar Uthius hits for about 760 EM and Thermal damage at a long range, although his tank isn't anything special. He orbits you at 38 km.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Typical loot from the Dark Blood battleship and the Blood High Priest includes dog tags and faction ammunition. Dark Templar Uthius can drop Corpus C-Type modules and in rare cases a Bhaalgorn BPC. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 宗教狂怒是从血袭者基地升级而来的探险任务。与0.0区域中的类似任务相比，这是一个罕见的探险任务。

sections.heading: 第一个地点
sections.text: 无加速轨道房间。你会出现在四座血袭者礼拜堂之间。如果没有从暗血指挥官处获得升级，则击杀它们以触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二个地点
sections.text: 第二部分有两种可能的情况：一种相当简单，另一种则有主管增援波次，较为困难。

sections.heading: 较简单的情况
sections.text: 血袭高级祭司会持续修复其他敌方舰船，直到其被击杀。如果想清除其他怪，建议优先击杀它。这种情况不会有主管增援波次；你只会获得暗血势力弹药和狗牌，并有几率获得暗血势力装备。

sections.heading: 较困难的情况
sections.text: 黑暗圣堂武士乌西乌斯在远距离造成约760的电磁和热能伤害，不过他的抗性并不特别出色。他会在38公里处环绕你飞行。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 暗血战列舰和血袭高级祭司的典型掉落包括狗牌和势力弹药。黑暗圣堂武士乌西乌斯可以掉落社团C型装备，稀有情况下可以掉落巴戈恩蓝图副本。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Salvation Angel's Shipment is an expedition found by completing Angel Outpost combat sites. It may contain up to four parts, each of which will be about 4 jumps from the previous system. The first three will be in high-sec space, while the fourth will be in low-sec.

sections.heading: Part 1
sections.text: As soon as you warped in to the last room, your instruments registered a large group of ships escaping the fight in the last second. Further analysis of the data indicates this was a convoy of six to eight transport ships from the Salvation Angels, accompanied by an unknown number of combat ships. Your navigational systems have already come up with a likely location for you to get to, in case you feel you have any business with them. 500px Taking out the Domination cruiser triggers the escalation. Assuming you always get a low bounty (and therefore short range) BS in the spawn, you can minimize DPS and fit for more gank by simply moving away from the BS after warpin. Even moving slowly you'll buy yourself enough time to take out all the BCs. The drake that had to warp in and out above had no trouble here.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text: Even though most of the convoy left before you even got there, you still have a good indication of where to follow them. 500px

sections.heading: Part 3
sections.text: Despite their heavy ships, the Angels seem to be outmaneuvering you, getting away without a scratch. Your scanners have a new destination ready in few seconds... 500px

sections.heading: Part 4
sections.text: After this fierce fight you are relieved to see your instruments still have track on the main convoy which seems to still contain all of the original transport ships. 500px First Pocket: *2x Frigates (Impaler/Hunter) *3x Elite Frigates (Arch Impaler/Arch Ambusher) Web/Scram(?) *3x Destoryers (Seizer) *3x Battleships (Saint/Nephilim) Second Pocket: *1x Frigates (Impaler) *4x Elite Frigates (Arch Impaler/Ambusher/Raider) Web/Scram(?) *3x Battlecruiser (Legionnaire/Primus) *1x Battleships (Saint) *1x Cruiser (Gistum Domination Racer, doesn't appear to be actual Domination) Upon clearing Gistum Domination Racer I got a completion message but no loot and Racer wreck yielded T1 salvage. In a recent instance, the Gistum Domination Racer dropped a single Gistum A-Type 50mn MWD, with no other modules or tags in the wreck.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 救赎天使的货运是一条通过完成天使前哨战斗遗址触发的远征任务。它最多包含四个部分，每部分距离上一个约4跳。前三个部分位于高安，第四个位于低安。

sections.heading: 第一部分
sections.text: 当你跃迁进入最后一个房间时，你的仪器记录到一大群船只在最后一刻逃离了战斗。对数据的进一步分析表明，这是由六到八艘救赎天使运输船组成的船队，并有数量不明的战斗舰船护航。你的导航系统已经为你推算出了一个可能的目的地，如果你觉得有必要追查他们。500px 击毁统治级战列巡洋舰会触发升级。假设刷出的战列舰始终是低保值（因此射程较短）的型号，你可以通过跃迁后 simply 远离战列舰来降低对DPS的需求并装配更多爆发伤害。即使是缓慢移动，你也有足够的时间清理掉所有战列巡洋舰。之前需要反复跃迁进出的德拉克级在这里没有任何问题。

sections.heading: 第二部分
sections.text: 尽管大部分船队在你到达之前就离开了，你仍然有很好的线索可以追踪他们。500px

sections.heading: 第三部分
sections.text: 尽管他们拥有重型舰船，天使们似乎仍然在机动性上胜过你，毫发无损地逃脱了。你的扫描仪几秒钟内就准备好了新的目的地……500px

sections.heading: 第四部分
sections.text: 经过这场激烈的战斗，你欣慰地发现仪器仍然追踪到了主力船队，似乎所有原始运输船都还在其中。500px 第一个房间：*2x 护卫舰（Impaler/Hunter）*3x 精英护卫舰（Arch Impaler/Arch Ambusher）网子/反跳(?) *3x 驱逐舰（Seizer）*3x 战列舰（Saint/Nephilim）第二个房间：*1x 护卫舰（Impaler）*4x 精英护卫舰（Arch Impaler/Ambusher/Raider）网子/反跳(?) *3x 战列巡洋舰（Legionnaire/Primus）*1x 战列舰（Saint）*1x 巡洋舰（Gistum Dominance 竞速型，似乎并非真正的支配装备）清理掉 Gistum Dominance 竞速型后，我收到了完成消息但没有战利品，残骸只产出了T1打捞物。在近期的一次实例中，Gistum Dominance 竞速型掉落了一个 Gistum A型 50mn 微曲，残骸中没有其他装备或标记。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Owned Station is an Expedition that can escalate from Minor Sansha Annex.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: Ungated pocket. None of the structures drop loot. Destroying all ships or the True Sansha commander can trigger escalation.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: There are no escalation triggers; only go in if you want bounties/salvage.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: The Sansha Research Outpost has a smartbomb that triggers when it is attacked. It does not have that many hitpoints (4000 in shield, 4000 in armor and 400 in structure), so taking it out is actually fairly easy.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Typical loot from the True Sansha commanders include criminal dog tags, faction ammunition and meta modules. They also have a chance to drop True Sansha faction modules. The Sansha Research Outpost can drop Centum A-Type cruiser modules, True Sansha modules and possibly a rare 1-run Phantasm BPC. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Starbase Tower Sentry (Tower Sentry Sansha II)
Starbase Drone Guardian (Alvus Controller/Swarm Preserver Alvus)

groups.name: Tower wave (triggered by attacking the Starbase Control Tower)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙占领站是一个远征任务，可从次要萨沙附属站升级触发。

sections.heading: 第一处位置
sections.text: 无门死亡空间房间。所有建筑均不掉落战利品。摧毁全部舰船或萨沙真神指挥官可触发升级。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 没有升级触发条件；仅在你想要赏金或打捞品时进入。

sections.heading: 第四处位置
sections.text: 萨沙研究前哨拥有一个智能炸弹，在受到攻击时触发。它的生命值并不高（护盾4000、装甲4000、结构400），因此摧毁它其实相当容易。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 萨沙真神指挥官的典型战利品包括犯罪狗牌、势力弹药和 meta 模块。他们也有几率掉落萨沙真神势力模块。萨沙研究前哨可掉落 Centum A 型巡洋舰模块、萨沙真神模块，以及可能的稀有 1 跑 Phantasm BPC。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Surveillance Squad is an Expedition that can escalate from Provisional Sansha Outpost.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: If the True Sansha ship does not spawn, take the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: There are two large groups of rats at initial warp-in 50 km away. The larger right group will warp off after ~30 seconds. Destroy the Sansha Security Station to trigger escalation.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: Once again, take the acceleration gate if commander cruiser does not spawn.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Two groups of rats are initially present 50 km away. One will warp away when you warp in.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Similar number of rats. Warp disrupting rats should be killed first so you can initiate a safe warp-out if the need arises.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Simple warp-in may trigger escalation. There are no notable structures in this room.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Ungated pocket. You land on a colorful mixture of ruins, structures, and rocks. No rats initially present. The Jeroon structure itself triggers a smartbomb wave when initially attacked which reaches out to 30 km. The structure itself is fairly easy to destroy with only 16k HP. The Sansha's Berserkers/Demons should be destroyed first, they deal high damage compared to normal rats and have more tank, though not as much as normal elite frigates. Kazah Durn hits hard also, out to 100 km.

sections.heading: See also
sections.text: * Stats of the Jeroon structure * Stats of the overseer cruiser Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙监视小队是一个远征任务，可从萨沙临时前哨升级触发。

sections.heading: 第一处位置
sections.text: 如果萨沙真神舰船未刷新，走加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 初始跃迁入口处 50 公里外有两大型敌对编队。右侧较大的编队将在约 30 秒后跃迁离开。摧毁萨沙安全哨站以触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二处位置
sections.text: 同样，如果指挥官巡洋舰未刷新，走加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 初始时 50 公里外有两组敌对编队。其中一组在你跃迁进入时会跃迁离开。

sections.heading: 第三处位置
sections.text: 敌对数量相似。应优先击杀反跳敌对，以便在需要时安全跃迁脱离。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 简单跃迁进入可能触发升级。此房间没有显著建筑。

sections.heading: 第四处位置
sections.text: 无门房间。你降落在废墟、建筑和岩石的混合区域。初始无敌对。Jeroon 建筑本身在首次受到攻击时会触发智能炸弹波次，范围延伸至 30 公里。该建筑本身相当容易摧毁，仅有 16k HP。应优先击杀萨沙狂战士/恶魔，与常规敌对相比它们造成更高伤害且更耐打，不过不如常规精英护卫舰那么硬。Kazah Durn 射程可达 100 公里，伤害也很高。

sections.heading: 参见
sections.text: * Jeroon 建筑属性 * 监督者巡洋舰属性 Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Save the Slaves is an expedition found by completing Blood Raider Outpost combat sites. It may contain up to four parts, each of which will be about 4 jumps from the previous system. The first three will be in low-sec space, while the fourth will usually be in null-sec.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: The first pocket is optional. Killing the Faction Cruiser has the possibility of triggering the next mission on the escalation. If not, take the gate. Simple warp-in may trigger escalation.

sections.heading: Second Escalation
sections.text: Again you land at another acceleration gate. Take it if no escalation triggers from the Dark Blood commander.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: No enemies present, only the abandoned ruins of an Amarr station. Escalation may trigger upon warp-in.

sections.heading: First Room (Gateless Entry)
sections.text: Kill all rats to activate the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Getting all four escalations gives the possibility of an Ashimmu BPC or Corpum A-Type module drops in the final escalation site. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 拯救奴隶是一个通过完成血袭者前哨战斗点发现的远征任务。它最多包含四个部分，每部分距上一个星系约 4 跳。前三个位于低安，第四个通常位于 null 安。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 第一间房间为可选。击杀势力巡洋舰有可能在升级时触发下一个任务。如果没有，走加速轨道。简单跃迁进入可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二升级
sections.text: 你再次降落在另一个加速轨道旁。如果暗血指挥官未触发升级，走加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 无敌对，仅有艾玛空间站的废弃废墟。跃迁进入时可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第一间房间（无门进入）
sections.text: 击杀全部敌对以激活加速轨道。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 完成全部四个升级有可能在最终升级点获得 Ashimmu BPC 或 Corpum A 型模块掉落。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 is escalation from the Serpentis Logistical Outpost. Warning: The Serpentis Logistical Outpost and Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 are considered to be the hardest Serpentis Escalations. Use extreme caution when completing the sites due to the Scramming Frigs and T2 Neuting Towers

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site consists of a warpin area and one normal space pocket. The site is not in deadspace so you can warp around freely. Take advantage of this by making bounce bookmark ~300 km off the site as you land in. You can then use this bookmark to bounce on asteroid/wreck to get in good position. This also means that a potential hunter can warp directly to you in second room with combat probes.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: The rats are in 3 groups and you land in the middle of them. The initial two neut towers are close to two other towers. The two other groups have three towers each and after two minutes an additional neuting tower spawns at them. As this isn't dedspace you can warp freely. (The groups are close to some asteroids and structures so you have warpin points.) Carefully consider how you want to run the site and adapt it to your ship(s) because if you warp to the towers you'll face a good bit of DPS, be pointed, and webbed.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: ---- As in the first pocket you can warp around, so use bookmarks if needed. In the room is a Serpentis Stronghold in the shape of a Gallente station. When warping in you face four groups of rats. One group in front of the structure is close to you when you warp in and consists of battlecruisers and frigates which web and point. One group is in the center of the structure and consists of battleships and frigates. The other two groups are on the left and right of the structure and consist of battleships and (battle-)cruisers. After a short while in the center of the structure also towers spawn (one of them is neuting). For more details see the table below. The four groups independently trigger respawns. In theory you could only kill the center group and it's following spawns to trigger the commander wave. But in practice you'll want to at least kill all pointing frigates and the neuting tower. For the center group a new wave is triggered if it is completely cleared. For the other groups the last ship of it's biggest shipclass is the trigger. (If the spawn contained battleships the last battleship killed in this spawn will trigger a new one and so on.) Uehiro Katsen will approach you with microwarpdrive and projects 1050 DPS out to 21 km, with -90% web within 15 km. If you can't safely project at least 600 DPS of pure Kinetic damage beyond his weapons range, you will find killing him extremely hard. Great little advice is to form a solo fleet and assign marks to the center group and its following waves for easy overview of who to kill.

sections.heading: Loot and bounties
sections.text: The boss might drop Corelum A-type modules, shadow serpentis modules, and Vigilant BPC. He always drops 19th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. Clearing all rats gave around 50m isk bounty. Never checked salvage and so on. I usually expect salvage to be half of the bounty. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Serpentis Energy Neutralizer II
rows.note: They spawn at the asteroids surrounded by the sentries

rows.name: Uehiro Katsen
rows.note: He has an active tank that can tank 500 dps

groups.name: Towers spawn (middle of the Stronghold, shortly after warpin)

zh.title: 天蛇后勤前哨 第二部分

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇后勤前哨第二部分是从天蛇后勤前哨升级而来的任务。警告：天蛇后勤前哨和天蛇后勤前哨第二部分被认为是最难的天蛇升级任务。由于反跳护卫和 T2 毁电塔的存在，完成这些点时请极度小心。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该点由一个跃迁入口区域和一个常规空间房间组成。该点不在死亡空间中，因此你可以自由跃迁。利用这一点，在降落地约 300 公里外设置弹跳书签。然后你可以用这个书签在小行星/残骸上弹跳以获得有利位置。这也意味着潜在的猎手可以用扫描探针在第二个房间直接跃迁到你身边。

sections.heading: 跃迁入口
sections.text: 敌对分为 3 组，你降落在它们中间。初始的两座毁电塔靠近另外两座塔。另外两组各有三座塔，两分钟后每组会额外刷新一座毁电塔。由于这不是死亡空间，你可以自由跃迁。（各组靠近一些小行星和建筑，因此你有跃迁入口点。）仔细考虑你打算如何攻略此点，并根据你的舰船调整策略，因为如果你直接跃迁到塔附近，你将面对大量 DPS，并被反跳和网子。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: ---- 与第一间房间一样你可以自由跃迁，因此根据需要利用书签。房间中有一个盖伦特空间站形状的天蛇要塞。跃迁进入时你面对四组敌对。正前方的一组在你跃迁进入时距离你很近，由战列巡洋舰和网子/反跳护卫舰组成。一组在建筑中央，由战列舰和护卫舰组成。另外两组分别在建筑左右两侧，由战列舰和（战列）巡洋舰组成。过一小会儿建筑中央也会刷新塔（其中一座为毁电）。更多细节见下表。四组敌对独立触发增援。理论上你可以只击杀中央组及其后续增援来触发指挥官波次。但实际上你至少要击杀全部反跳护卫舰和毁电塔。中央组被完全清空后会触发新一波。其他组的最后一艘最大舰船级别的舰船是触发条件。（如果刷新中有战列舰，则该刷新中最后被击杀的战列舰将触发新一波，依此类推。）Uehiro Katsen 会以微曲接近你，在 21 公里内投射 1050 DPS，并在 15 公里内施加 -90% 网子。如果你无法在他的武器射程外安全投射至少 600 DPS 的纯动能伤害，你会发现击杀他极其困难。一个小建议是组建单人舰队，为中央组及其后续波次设置标记，以便清晰了解该击杀谁。

sections.heading: 战利品与赏金
sections.text: Boss 可能掉落 Corelum A 型模块、暗影天蛇模块和 Vigilant BPC。他固定掉落 19 级监督者的私人物品。清空全部敌对给予约 5000 万赏金。未检查打捞品等。我通常预期打捞品约为赏金的一半。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Single pocket. The battleships have short range weapons and the shadow serpentis is in a very fast ship. With a warpin bookmark it is possible to draw the commander away from battleships to noticeably reduce damage. Reinforcements will spawn 65-140 km from the tower.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Single pocket. The Serpentis research outpost will smartbomb all nearby ships and drones once attacked. It deals approximately 1000 dps but won't attack far (30 km is already safe). Cloaked Metamorphosis blown up by the Serpentis research outpost smartbomb at 60 km. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: trigger = Attacking triggers reinforcements and escalation

sections.heading: 第三处位置
sections.text: 单个房间。战列舰使用短程武器，暗影天蛇驾驶一艘非常快速的舰船。利用跃迁入口书签，可以将指挥官从战列舰处拉走以显著降低伤害。增援将在距塔 65-140 公里处刷新。

sections.heading: 第四处位置
sections.text: 单个房间。天蛇研究前哨在受到攻击后会对附近所有舰船和无人机释放智能炸弹。它造成约 1000 dps，但不会攻击远距离目标（30 公里已经安全）。隐身的 Metamorphosis 在 60 公里处被天蛇研究前哨的智能炸弹摧毁。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: You land on an acceleration gate. Take it if there is no Shadow Serpentis spawn or if killing the commander does not trigger escalation.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Simple warp-in can trigger escalation. There are no enemy ships at warp-in, only 8 passive batteries.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: No enemy ships at initial warp-in. You land on an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Large amount of sensor damping in this room. The acceleration gate is 40 km from the warp-in point.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: The Shadow Serpentis commanders drop faction ammo and tags, and may drop Shadow Serpentis or meta modules. The Shadow Serpentis Colonel in final location can drop Core C-Type battleship modules and possibly a rare Vigilant BPC.

sections.heading: References
sections.text: https://www.fuzzwork.co.uk/evelopedia/index.php/Serpentis_Powergrid https://sistersprobe.fandom.com/de/wiki/Serpentis_Powergrid Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 第三处位置
sections.text: 你降落在加速轨道旁。如果没有暗影天蛇刷新，或者击杀指挥官未触发升级，走加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 简单跃迁进入可触发升级。跃迁入口无敌对舰船，仅有 8 座被动炮台。

sections.heading: 第四处位置
sections.text: 初始跃迁入口无敌对舰船。你降落在加速轨道旁。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 此房间有大量感应抑阻。加速轨道距跃迁入口点 40 公里。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 暗影天蛇指挥官掉落势力弹药和狗牌，可能掉落暗影天蛇或 meta 模块。最终位置的暗影天蛇上校可掉落 Core C 型战列舰模块以及可能的稀有 Vigilant BPC。

sections.heading: 参考
sections.text: https://www.fuzzwork.co.uk/evelopedia/index.php/Serpentis_Powergrid https://sistersprobe.fandom.com/de/wiki/Serpentis_Powergrid Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Secrets is an expedition that escalates from Serpentis Provincial HQ and can lead into both low-sec and null-sec regions.

sections.heading: First Part
sections.text: The first room is ungated, meaning you can warp around in it, and people can warp directly to you. If Shadow Serpentis is there: kill him, possibly get escalation. Else (or If didn't get escalation): Use acceleration gate, possibly get escalation.

sections.heading: First room
sections.text: Entering this room can trigger the escalation. In the room you find a lot of Siloes and a structure/ship called "Ours De Soin".

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: This site consists of one ungated room. The enemies are grouped in in four separate groups. You spawn in the middle of them. The two statis towers webs you to a halt, making you take A LOT of damage, and the damping makes them hard to hit. This can make the site hard to survive.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: This site is yet another ungated pocket. You spawn 100km from the NPCs and the two web-towers makes the travel to the station very slow, while the damp makes hitting anything hard. If you get the Shadow Serpentis Battleship to spawn, kill it for the escalation. If not, destroy the station. The Siege Sentries does a lot of damage, but they are only two. Clear the area of rats before you engage the station.

sections.heading: Fourth and Last Location
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access This site is extremely difficult, and can require 3-4 people in very tough ships. The site contains 4 waves, and if you manage to spawn 2 at once, the site is near impossible. The four waves trigger when you attack the Serpentis Privateer Stronghold (wave 1), when it reaches 50% shields (wave 2), at 25% shield (wave 3), and when it goes into armor (wave 4). You spawn 200 km from the station. Kill the frigates, then the web-towers, then the siege blasters and then the rest. This wave spawn about 250km from the station, close to the warp-in location. They are spread in 4 groups. An easy and fast wave that spawns about 200km from the station. The fourth and last wave is the commander wave. It spawn at 0 on station. The drones web and the frigates points, while Heysus deals approx. 1800 dps from about 125km away. The drones are VERY fast, so the best strategy seems to damage the station while aligned to a bookmark 200+ km off, and warp to it as soon as they spawn. Then kill the drones while they come to you, then the frigates after.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis High Admiral
rows.note: He comes to you, so you don't have to travel 100km webbed.

rows.name: Serpentis Defense Sentinel
rows.trigger: Damaging it triggers a reinforcement wave

groups.name: Reinforcement wave - Triggers upon station damage

rows.name: Privateer Admiral Heysus Sarpati
rows.note: Does approx 1800 dps from 125km, can tank 700 dps, orbits at long range.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇秘密是一个从天蛇省级总部升级而来的远征任务，可通往低安和 null 安区域。

sections.heading: 第一部分
sections.text: 第一个房间无门，意味着你可以在其中自由跃迁，其他人也可以直接跃迁到你身边。如果暗影天蛇在场：击杀他，可能获得升级。否则（或未获得升级）：走加速轨道，可能获得升级。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 进入此房间可触发升级。房间中有大量筒仓和一个名为"Ours De Soin"的建筑/舰船。

sections.heading: 第二处位置
sections.text: 此点由一个无门房间组成。敌对分为四个独立编队。你在它们中央刷新。两座停滞塔会将你网子至停止，使你承受大量伤害，加上感应抑阻使它们难以命中。这可能导致此点难以生存。

sections.heading: 第三处位置
sections.text: 此点是又一个无门房间。你在距 NPC 100 公里处刷新，两座网子塔使前往空间站的行程非常缓慢，加上感应抑阻使命中任何目标都很困难。如果暗影天蛇战列舰刷新，击杀它以获得升级。如果没有，摧毁空间站。攻城哨兵造成大量伤害，但仅有两艘。在攻击空间站前先清空区域内的敌对。

sections.heading: 第四也是最后的位置
sections.text: 进入方式：无门，开放进入。此点极其困难，可能需要 3-4 人驾驶非常硬的舰船。此点包含 4 波敌对，如果你同时触发 2 波，此点几乎不可能完成。四波敌对分别在你攻击天蛇私掠者要塞时（第 1 波）、护盾降至 50% 时（第 2 波）、护盾降至 25% 时（第 3 波）以及进入装甲时（第 4 波）触发。你在距空间站 200 公里处刷新。先杀护卫舰，然后网子塔，然后攻城脉冲炮，最后其余敌对。此波在距空间站约 250 公里处刷新，靠近跃迁入口位置。它们分为 4 组。一波简单快速的敌对在距空间站约 200 公里处刷新。第四也是最后一波是指挥官波次。它在空间站 0 米处刷新。无人机施放网子，护卫舰反跳，而 Heysus 从约 125 公里外造成约 1800 dps。无人机速度非常快，因此最佳策略似乎是在对准 200 多公里外书签的同时攻击空间站，一旦无人机刷新就跃迁至书签。然后在无人机飞来时击杀它们，之后再杀护卫舰。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Shadow Serpentis Fleet Staging Point is a expedition and the second and third part of Shadow Serpentis Fleet Staging Point.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access This site is rather easy. Mind the wave trigger and destroy the Energy Neutralizers fast and you should have no problems. There are no warp disrupters on any of the NPCs, so you can come and leave as you see fit. Remember that since the site is gateless, you can make bookmarks you can warp to. Note: December 29th 2018 - Sentry wave never spawned Note: February 9th, 2020 - Sentry wave does in fact spawn, about 4-5 minutes after warp-in. They neutralize 61 GJ per cycle each. Note: May 2020/2022 - The sentries never spawned. Note: May 5th, 2023 - Sentry wave did spawn, Neutralizing 75 GJ per cycle each.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: This pocket offers no loot nor gives the escalation, only additional bounties and wrecks for salvage.

sections.heading: Escalation: Shadow Serpentis Fleet Staging Point, Part 3
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access This site can be hard or easy, depending on how you approach it. It is very easy to accidentally trigger all 3 reinforcement waves. They are triggered at 70% station shield, at 30% shield and at 50% armor. You should first clear out any NPCs. Then do minimal damage to get the stations shield to 70%, clear out that wave and repeat for the next wave and the last wave. Consider de-grouping launchers or/and only using some of the drones. If you do it in groups, coordinate with the others. Station tanks ~1,000 dps. Avoid using Sentry drones as they may auto aggress the structure

sections.heading: See also
sections.text: Stats of the Serpentis Fleet Outpost Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all NPCs are destroyed

rows.name: Serpentis Fleet Outpost
rows.trigger: Wave 1 at 70% shield, Wave 2 at 30% shield and Wave 3 at 50% armor
rows.note: Stasis Webifier 50km - Shoots Thermal Citadel Torpedos deailing 7200 dmg - 900dps armor/shield tank

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 暗影天蛇舰队集结点是一个远征任务，是暗影天蛇舰队集结点的第二和第三部分。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 进入方式：无门，开放进入。此点相当简单。注意波次触发并快速摧毁毁电塔，你应该不会有问题。所有 NPC 都没有反跳，因此你可以自由进出。记住由于此点无门，你可以设置弹跳书签。注意：2018 年 12 月 29 日 - 哨兵波次从未刷新。注意：2020 年 2 月 9 日 - 哨兵波次确实会刷新，约在跃迁进入后 4-5 分钟。每座每周期毁电 61 GJ。注意：2020 年/2022 年 5 月 - 哨兵未刷新。注意：2023 年 5 月 5 日 - 哨兵波次确实刷新，每座每周期毁电 75 GJ。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 此房间不提供战利品也不触发升级，仅有额外赏金和可打捞残骸。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Special Forces is an Expedition that can escalate from Angel Provincial HQ.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The second, third and fourth locations are ungated, and either strongly tanked T3C, Battleships, Marauders or a carrier are recommended due to the VERY high DPS in the third and fourth locations.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: You land on an acceleration gate. Take it if no Domination battleship spawns or if destroying it triggers no escalation.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: No enemies in this pocket. Simple warp-in can trigger escalation.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: The site is NOT in deadspace, so you can grid warp in this location. Destroy the Amarr Control Center if no escalation is triggered from the Domination battleship. Warning: Destroying each cruise missile battery triggers a smartbomb wave that deals around 8000 Explosive damage. Recommend bringing a ship with a strong tank and over 80% resists to Explosive damage if you are going to destroy the cruise missile batteries.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Warning: The DPS in this room can become quite heavy if all ships get in range. Make sure you know what you're doing or risk losing your ship. Clear all rats before engaging the Military Outpost. The Domination Commander battleship will approach you with MWD, so it can be kited away from the other rats.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: The rats are spread out in 5 groups. Avoid triggering 2 waves at once; if that happens, the site is practically impossible. Try to eliminate the Siege Autocannon sentries as soon as possible, there are 10 of them and they deal VERY high DPS. The third and final wave is the commander wave. It is triggered by bringing the Angel Military Outpost into structure. This is a hard wave, as the large number of elite frigates can keep you halted in one spot, while the overseer battleship (Einhas Malak) deals a LOT of damage. Recommend keeping over 15 km from the elite frigates so you won't get webbed and pointed while Einhas Malak puts your tank to the acid test. Einhas Malak does about 3000 points of Explosive damage and 700-900 points of Kinetic damage. He also repairs both shield and armor, with strong passive shield and armor tanks with his shield recharging at about 300 DPS and his armor at about 250. Recommend over 85% resists to Explosive and Kinetic damage and at least 550 DPS to break Einhas. He has 76% EM and Kinetic resists and 66% Explosive and Thermal resists.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 特种部队是一项可以从天使省级总部升级的远征任务。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 第二、第三和第四个地点没有加速轨道，由于第三和第四个地点的DPS非常高，强烈建议使用装备完善的T3C、战列舰、掠夺者舰或航母。

sections.heading: 第一地点
sections.text: 你会出现在加速轨道上。如果没有统御战列舰刷新，或者摧毁它没有触发升级，就通过轨道。

sections.heading: 第一个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 这个房间没有敌人。简单的跃迁入场就可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二地点
sections.text: 该地点不在死亡空间内，因此你可以网格跃迁到这个地点。如果统御战列舰没有触发升级，摧毁阿玛尔控制中心。警告：摧毁每个巡航导弹发射台会触发一发智能炸弹波次，造成约8000爆炸伤害。如果你打算摧毁巡航导弹发射台，建议携带一艘具有强大抗性和超过80%爆炸抗性的舰船。

sections.heading: 第三地点
sections.text: 警告：如果所有舰船都进入射程，这个房间的伤害会变得非常重。确保你知道自己在做什么，否则有失去舰船的风险。在攻击军事前哨站之前清除所有怪。统御指挥官战列舰会用微曲接近你，所以可以风筝它远离其他怪。

sections.heading: 第四地点
sections.text: 怪分散成5组。避免同时触发2波；如果发生这种情况，这个地点几乎不可能完成。尽量尽快消灭围城自动炮哨兵，共有10个，它们造成非常高的DPS。第三波也是最后一波是指挥官波次。它通过攻击天使军事前哨站触发。这是一个困难的波次，因为大量精英护卫舰可以让你停滞在一个位置，而监督者战列舰（Einhas Malak）会造成大量伤害。建议与精英护卫舰保持15公里以上的距离，这样你就不会被网子和反跳，同时Einhas Malak会考验你的抗性。Einhas Malak造成约3000点爆炸伤害和700-900点动能伤害。他还会同时修复护盾和装甲，具有强大的被动护盾和装甲抗性，护盾回复约300 DPS，装甲约250。建议超过85%的爆炸和动能抗性，以及至少550 DPS来击败Einhas。他具有76%的电磁和动能抗性，以及66%的爆炸和热能抗性。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Ancient City is an extremely difficult escalation from the Sansha Provincial HQ and possibly other Sansha sites.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This escalation has 4 locations, typically each location is 6-10 jumps between each other and can cross regional boundaries. Locations 1-3 are easier to blitz, but Location 4 is one of the hardest sites that exists in Eve. It is not guaranteed for each location to escalate. After each location, killing the True Sansha Battleship will either trigger the escalation to the next location or not. If not, your time with the site is over. Full details for this expedition are not currently available, the below is provided as best effort because this is a rare escalation. No rats warp disrupt/scram in this entire escalation as of writing.

sections.heading: Location 1
sections.text: Blitz: Warp in, kill the True Sansha battleship, bookmark the wreck, warp out. Wait 2 minutes for site to despawn, warp to bookmark and loot. No gate, you will warp in and the rats will be on the outside of an acceleration gate that does not work. No ewar reported in this room

sections.heading: Location 2
sections.text: Blitz: Warp in, kill the True Sansha battleship, bookmark the wreck, warp out. Wait 2 minutes for site to despawn, warp to bookmark and loot. Tip: True Sansha spawn is off to the right, away from the other groups. You can warp to the site cloaked (be careful not to be decloaked by the beacon), bookmark the center and then look for a good celestial behind the true sansha spawn. Warp out to that celestial, then warp to your bookmark at 30km. You'll land right on the TS spawn for a quick kill. Bookmark wreck and warp out, loot in 2 minutes after the site despawns. Rats are in 2 main groups with 2 tiny groups on the side. Full site aggros on land. This site has a lot of DPS that will easily break a T3 Cruiser.

sections.heading: Location 3
sections.text: Blitz: Warp in, kill the True Sansha battleship, bookmark the wreck, warp out. Wait 2 minutes for site to despawn, warp to bookmark and loot. No need to get Wave 1 unless you want the bounties.

sections.heading: Location 4
sections.text: This site is ungated and therefore can be run with capitals. When you warp in, you will be 200km from the structure you need to shoot. This site is NOT deadspace so you can actually warp around on grid. The various waves will spawn in different spots around the site, so you will need to either warp around or MJD as needed. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古城是一项从萨沙省级总部以及可能的其他萨沙地点升级的极其困难的升级任务。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 这个升级有4个地点，通常每个地点之间相隔6-10跳，并且可能跨越区域边界。地点1-3更容易速刷，但地点4是EVE中存在的最困难地点之一。每个地点不保证会升级。在每个地点之后，击杀真萨沙战列舰会触发或不触发到下一个地点的升级。如果没有，你在这个地点的时间就结束了。这个远征的完整细节目前不可用，以下内容作为最佳努力提供，因为这是一个罕见的升级。截至撰写时，整个升级中没有怪会反跳/扰频。

sections.heading: 地点1
sections.text: 速刷：跃迁入场，击杀真萨沙战列舰，保存残骸书签，跃迁出场。等待2分钟让地点消失，跃迁到书签并拾取。没有加速轨道，你会跃迁入场，怪会在一个不起作用的加速轨道外侧。这个房间没有报告电子战

sections.heading: 地点2
sections.text: 速刷：跃迁入场，击杀真萨沙战列舰，保存残骸书签，跃迁出场。等待2分钟让地点消失，跃迁到书签并拾取。提示：真萨沙刷新点在右侧，远离其他群体。你可以隐形跃迁到地点（小心不要被信标解隐），保存中心书签，然后在真萨沙刷新点后方寻找一个好的天体。跃迁到那个天体，然后跃迁到你的30公里书签。你会直接落在真萨沙刷新点进行快速击杀。保存残骸书签并跃迁出场，在地点消失后2分钟内拾取。怪分为2个主要群体和2个侧边小群体。入场时整个地点会仇恨。这个地点有很多DPS，可以轻松击穿T3巡洋舰。

sections.heading: 地点3
sections.text: 速刷：跃迁入场，击杀真萨沙战列舰，保存残骸书签，跃迁出场。等待2分钟让地点消失，跃迁到书签并拾取。除非你想要赏金，否则不需要打第一波。

sections.heading: 地点4
sections.text: 这个地点没有加速轨道，因此可以用旗舰运行。当你跃迁入场时，你会距离你需要攻击的建筑200公里。这个地点不是死亡空间，所以你实际上可以在网格上跃迁。各种波次会在地点周围的不同位置刷新，所以你需要根据需要跃迁或使用微曲。分类：远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Big Blue is an expedition which can be earned by destroying Pat Wead in Angel Vigil combat sites. The completion of each segment has a random chance of giving the next segment in the chain. The initial escalation from Angel Vigil is thought to be around 10%, but each stage escalating higher is thought to be around 75%. High level angel drops are possible at each stage.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 大蓝是一项可以通过在天使警戒战斗地点摧毁Pat Wead获得的远征。完成每个阶段有随机机会给予链条中的下一个阶段。从天使警戒的初始升级被认为约为10%，但每个后续阶段升级被认为约为75%。每个阶段都可能掉落高级天使战利品。

sections.heading: 大蓝（阶段1）
sections.text: 派系：天使企业联合体 任务类型：探索 - 升级 空间类型：普通 造成伤害：爆炸/动能 网子/反跳：Arch Gistii Outlaws 额外：统御粉碎者 - 目标标记 推荐伤害类型：爆炸/动能 推荐舰船：具有强大T2抗性的战斗巡洋舰，动能/爆炸抗性超过60% 战利品：*总计：约3.0M *赏金1.6M *战利品538K *打捞约1.0M *指挥官掉落战利品（初始作者）植入体Low-Grade Halo Alpha，1000派系弹药 *建筑不掉落战利品。

sections.heading: 大蓝（阶段2）
sections.text: 派系：天使企业联合体和无人机 任务类型：探索 - 升级 空间类型：普通 造成伤害：爆炸/动能 网子/反跳：无 推荐伤害类型：爆炸/动能 注意：新刷新的怪会锁定你的无人机，建筑不掉落战利品 战利品：总计：约3.8M 赏金：1.3M 战利品约1.2M（包括无人机的矿物） 打捞：根据指挥官打捞变化很大 记录的指挥官掉落：Low-Grade Halo Delta，（第2次运行 - Low-grade Halo Omega） 记录的指挥官掉落（25.07.2011）：Cynabal BPC（约1.8亿），Arch Angel Nuclear M x1000，统御停滞网子发射器（约1亿）和一些T1物品 摧毁第二艘战斗巡洋舰会结束远征（如果不幸运）或给你弹出到下一个升级的提示。 升级弹出："另一个救赎天使信标，这次完全可用，可能是由勘测船放置的。它给出了到不远处另一个地点的方向。"

sections.heading: 大蓝（阶段3）

sections.heading: 大蓝（阶段4）低安（可能高安）
sections.text: *总计：2.25M *赏金1.5M *战利品750k *打捞 - 我没有打捞，因为这是低安 派系：天使企业联合体 任务类型：探索 - 升级 空间类型：普通？（没有跃迁入场门） 造成伤害：爆炸/动能 网子/反跳：Arch Gistii Hijacker 额外：Arch Gistii Ruffians目标标记 推荐伤害类型：爆炸/动能 推荐舰船：龙骑兵（PVP配置） 注意：这发生在低安，所以建议你使用一艘愿意失去的舰船并进行PVP配置。一个干净的跳跃克隆体可能是明智的。在低安系统中快速摧毁网子/反跳舰船可能更为重要（但这可能是触发下一个刷新的条件）。新刷新的怪会锁定你的无人机。为毒品工厂带大量弹药。 跃迁入场时，只能看到'毒品工厂 - 天使天堂'和其他几个建筑。 刷新5（在运输船刷新后约10秒） 约6-8艘舰船，包括一艘货船。它们会快速跃迁离开。（在我能锁定一艘之前。） 分类：远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This expedition can escalate from Independence. This escalation can also re-escalate to another drone roulette. The last part of this escalation may be received randomly after any stage.

sections.heading: Fourth location
sections.text: Large number of drones. The dozen-plus elite frigates have points and webs and their destruction triggers additional spawns, recommend sniping the frigates from range. A "drone hive mother" may also spawn. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 这个远征可以从独立升级。这个升级也可以重新升级到另一个无人机轮盘赌。这个升级的最后一部分可能在任何阶段后随机获得。

sections.heading: 第四地点
sections.text: 大量无人机。十多个精英护卫舰有反跳和网子，摧毁它们会触发额外刷新，建议从远处狙击护卫舰。也可能刷新一个"无人机蜂巢母舰"。分类：远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Nuclear Small Arms Project is an expedition that escalates from Angel Watch combat site. The escalation has four locations. Generally three of the locations are in high security space while the last one is in low security space. Usually the first three locations are in high sec and the final one in low sec but there are exceptions.

sections.heading: 1st location
sections.text: The are has four missile batteries. Attacking each of them will trigger one battery wave. Killing the commander frigate may trigger the escalation.

sections.heading: 2nd location
sections.text: After warping in you receive a message about interacting with a disabled mammoth (large collidable object). You need to shoot it with a turret/launcher. Drones won't do anything. EWAR modules will work, though. Wave 2 spawns shortly after the initial wave warps off.

sections.heading: 3rd location
sections.text: Note: Angel Sentries deal high combined DPS and can reach out all the way to 250 km.

sections.heading: 4th location
sections.text: Warning: Incoming DPS can be very high due to close proximity of spawns. The facility webs have 20 km range and -75% speed reduction. Attacking the station will trigger reinforcement wave. The valuable drops are in the Secret Angel Facility. These include Gistii A-Type modules and Dramiel BPC. It is possible to blitz this section by dropping a bookmark at the warp-in, warping off, warping at range to the bookmark and sniping the Secret Angel Facility to greatly reduce incoming damage. This expedition end message will also appear in local.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Typical commander loot includes Domination copper and silver dog tags and some faction ammo, as well as possible Domination faction modules or a Mid-Grade Halo implant. The Secret Angel Facility in final location can drop Gistii A-Type modules or a rare Dramiel BPC. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Gistum Heavy Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Attacking each triggers a battery wave

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 核小型武器项目是一项从天使哨所战斗地点升级的远征。这个升级有四个地点。通常三个地点在高安空间，而最后一个在低安空间。通常前三个地点在高安，最后一个在低安，但也有例外。

sections.heading: 第一地点
sections.text: 该区域有四个导弹发射台。攻击每个发射台会触发一波发射台怪。击杀指挥官护卫舰可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 第二地点
sections.text: 跃迁入场后，你会收到一条关于与受损的长毛象（大型可碰撞物体）互动的消息。你需要用炮塔/发射器射击它。无人机不会起作用。不过电子战模块会起作用。第二波在初始波次跃迁离开后不久刷新。

sections.heading: 第三地点
sections.text: 注意：天使哨兵造成很高的综合DPS，可以 reach 到250公里。

sections.heading: 第四地点
sections.text: 警告：由于刷新点距离很近， incoming DPS可能非常高。设施的网子有20公里射程和-75%速度降低。攻击空间站会触发增援波次。有价值的掉落物在秘密天使设施中。这些包括Gistii A型组件和Dramiel BPC。可以通过在跃迁入场点保存书签，跃迁离开，远距离跃迁到书签并狙击秘密天使设施来速刷这个部分，大大减少 incoming 伤害。这个远征结束消息也会出现在本地频道。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 典型的指挥官战利品包括统御铜和狗标签以及一些派系弹药，以及可能的统御派系组件或Mid-Grade Halo植入体。最后地点的秘密天使设施可以掉落Gistii A型组件或稀有的Dramiel BPC。分类：远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Rewards of Devotion is an expedition from the Blood Vigil Unrated Complex, which can be found at a Cosmic Signature via exploration. The expedition has a chance to trigger upon the destruction of the Corpus Station Manager, a Dark Blood Cruiser Commander found in the Blood Vigil.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Initially only the elite frigates and destroyers are present. Frigates and cruisers spawn within about 10 seconds or so. The elite cruisers and battlecruisers are on a ~1 minute timer.

sections.heading: Location 4 (Lowsec/Rarely Highsec, Gateless)
sections.text: Triggered by attacking a Missile Battery, of after 1 minute. Wave will contain 5-7 total elite frigates. Triggered by attacking the last Missile Battery, or after 2-3 minutes. Station Wave contains 9 total elite frigates. Category:Expeditions

groups.name: Additional defenders on very short timer

rows.name: Blood Vessel Resort
rows.trigger: Attacking triggers Station Wave, destroying is alternate trigger for possible escalation

rows.name: Blood Paradise
rows.trigger: Triggers Station Wave when attacked, Commander Wave at 5% structure

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 虔诚的回报是一项来自血液警戒未评级综合体的远征，可以通过探索在宇宙信号中发现。当摧毁血液警戒中的Corpus Station Manager（一个黑暗血液巡洋舰指挥官）时，这个远征有机会触发。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 最初只有精英护卫舰和驱逐舰存在。护卫舰和巡洋舰在大约10秒左右刷新。精英巡洋舰和战斗巡洋舰在约1分钟的计时器上。

sections.heading: 地点4（低安/罕见高安，无门）
sections.text: 通过攻击导弹发射台触发，或在1分钟后。波次将包含5-7艘精英护卫舰总数。通过攻击最后一个导弹发射台触发，或在2-3分钟后。空间站波次包含9艘精英护卫舰总数。分类：远征

sections.text: Trap? is an expedition that escalates from Gurista Lookout combat site. The escalation has four locations. Generally three of the locations are in high security space while the last one is in low security space.

sections.heading: pocket

sections.text: 陷阱？是一项从古里斯塔瞭望战斗地点升级的远征。这个升级有四个地点。通常三个地点在高安空间，而最后一个在低安空间。

sections.heading: 口袋
sections.text: 进入口袋是第二个可能的升级触发点。口袋中没有值得注意的东西。
