sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Trouble in Paradise is a four part expedition that can escalate from the Hierarchy combat site. The four parts are each about 5-8 jumps apart, and can take you far from the starting point. The rewards can be worth it though. The rogue drones in these combat sites do mostly explosive damage, with kinetic a close second. They are weak to EM damage.

sections.heading: First Location
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access The Sentient is the trigger for the escalation and contains loot. It is spawned from the beginning. This part can be blitzed by destroying the Sentient fast.

sections.heading: Second Location
sections.text: Access: Gateless, Open Access Same as before, the Sentient is the trigger for the escalation and contains loot. It is spawned from the beginning. Can also be blitzed.

sections.heading: Third Location
sections.text: Rats are at warp-in. The Sentient is the trigger for the escalation and contains loot. It is spawned from the beginning. Additional rats seem to spawn after a timer. A 3rd wave spawned as I was warping off. -- Kelon Darklight 3 May 2021.

sections.heading: Fourth Location
sections.text: Unable to finish site in ship I was in -- Kelon Darklight 2 May 2021. - initial spawn A 2nd wave spawned when attacking a frigate, which forced me off in a Vexor Navy Issue -- User:Kelon Darklight 3 May 2021. Rats at warp-in. 2nd spawns right after you spawn. Attack once 2nd spawn, attack once 3rd spawn. Hive Mother Appears. 04-2026: Just did one with a Proteus. Headshotted previous sites but had to full clear but the final wave on the last site. Got around 190mil in loot. Took a while to do, so not sure if this is worth it, especially if you need to go through enemy lands. Hierarchy Queen 88kk ISK and 15 kk head bounty Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天堂有难是一项四部分远征，可以从等级制度战斗地点升级。这四个部分每个相隔约5-8跳，可能带你远离起点。不过奖励可能是值得的。这些战斗地点中的自由无人机主要造成爆炸伤害，动能伤害紧随其后。它们对电磁伤害较弱。

sections.heading: 第一地点
sections.text: 进入：无门，开放进入 感知体是升级的触发点并包含战利品。它从一开始就刷新。这部分可以通过快速摧毁感知体来速刷。

sections.heading: 第二地点
sections.text: 进入：无门，开放进入 与之前相同，感知体是升级的触发点并包含战利品。它从一开始就刷新。也可以速刷。

sections.heading: 第三地点
sections.text: 怪在跃迁入场点。感知体是升级的触发点并包含战利品。它从一开始就刷新。额外的怪似乎在计时器后刷新。当我跃迁离开时，第三波刷新了。-- Kelon Darklight 2021年5月3日。

sections.heading: 第四地点
sections.text: 无法用我当时的舰船完成地点 -- Kelon Darklight 2021年5月2日。 - 初始刷新 当攻击护卫舰时，第二波刷新，这迫使我在Vexor Navy Issue中离开 -- User:Kelon Darklight 2021年5月3日。 跃迁入场点的怪。第二波在你刷新后立即刷新。攻击一次第二波刷新，攻击一次第三波刷新。蜂巢母舰出现。 04-2026：刚用Proteus完成了一个。之前的地点都爆头了，但最后一个地点的最后一波必须完全清除。获得了约1.9亿战利品。花了很长时间，所以不确定这是否值得，特别是如果你需要经过敌对领地。 等级制度女王 8800万ISK和1500万头部赏金 分类：远征

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: True Power HQ is a combat site that is an escalation from Sansha Base. It consists of 2 parts, where the first one is the initial escalation, and Part 2 is a further escalation. NOTE: This is an initial description - feel free to edit and correct.

sections.heading: True Power HQ Part 1
sections.text: After killing the True Sansha BS or Isiura Tuurento, the escalation to True Power HQ Part 2 may trigger.

rows.name: Major Assembly Array
rows.trigger: Attacking spawns Major Assembly Array wave

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 真实权力总部是一个战斗地点，是从萨沙基地升级的。它由2部分组成，第一部分是初始升级，第二部分是进一步升级。注意：这是一个初始描述 - 欢迎编辑和更正。

sections.heading: 真实权力总部第一部分
sections.text: 击杀真萨沙战列舰或Isiura Tuurento后，可能触发升级到真实权力总部第二部分。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: True Power Shipyards is an expedition that can be obtained by completing Sansha Vigil combat sites. This expedition consists of 4 different open area locations (no Acceleration gate) starting in a High Security System and ending in a Low Security System but it can suddenly end at any step in the chain. NPC class encountered are (Elite) Frigate, Destroyer, (Elite) Cruiser, Battlecruiser and Battleship hulls.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text: A large fleet spawns 15 minutes after destroying the Sansha Yard.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text: A large fleet spawns 20 minutes after you warped into the site.

sections.heading: Expedition Site Four (Low Security System and sometimes High Sec)
sections.text: Sentries have proximity aggro of <55 km. The Foreman spawns at 0 on the battletower when it reaches structure.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text: Warning: Your ship can be freely attacked by others - NO CONCORD INTERVENTION - in Low Security Systems (0.1 to 0.4) and Null Security Systems (0.0). Always check Star Map statistics (Active ships, Ship kills, Pod kills, etc) of Low Security and Null Security systems first before entering. Fitting a Cloaking Device module on your ship and making more than one Safe spot will provide more safety. The Sansha's Battletower has a lot of HP (50.000 HP Shield + 150.000 HP Armor), make sure to clear the site first or be able to tank the site for 5-10 minutes. Put the Sansha Battletower to structure to spawn the Foreman.

sections.heading: Tactics and Hints
sections.text: * The Sites have no gates, so there are no ship restrictions * You can warp freely inside the site * make a bookmark on warp-in to bounce * Site 1 and 2 have no spawn at warp in * Site 3 has high incoming DPS at warp in, but you can get out of range fairly easy * You can warp in cloaked at Site 4 and bounce back to stay out of range (45km) of the towers * Site 1-3 can be done in good tanked Tactical Destroyers * Site 3 has faction loot only in the reinforcement spawn. The faction cruiser can be sniped as there is no initial aggro at 50km away after the group spawn. * Site 4 can be done in an Stratios Category:Expeditions

Reinforcements after Deadspace Outpost taking structure damage

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 真实力量造船厂是一项探险任务，可通过完成萨沙警戒战斗地点获得。该探险由4个不同的开放区域组成（无加速轨道），从高安全星系开始，到低安全星系结束，但可能在链中任何步骤突然终止。遇到的NPC船型包括（精英）护卫舰、驱逐舰、（精英）巡洋舰、战列巡洋舰和战列舰。

sections.heading: 注意
sections.text: 摧毁萨沙船坞后15分钟会刷新一支大型舰队。

sections.heading: 注意
sections.text: 跃迁进入地点后20分钟会刷新一支大型舰队。

sections.heading: 探险点四（低安全星系，有时为高安）
sections.text: 哨兵在小于55公里范围内接近触发仇恨。当战斗塔进入结构状态时，工头在0米处刷新。

sections.heading: 注意
sections.text: 警告：在低安全星系（0.1至0.4）和零安全星系（0.0）中，其他玩家可以自由攻击你的舰船——没有CONCORD干预——进入前务必先查看星图中低安全和零安全星系的统计数据（活跃舰船、舰船击杀、舱击杀等）。在舰船上装配隐形装置模块并设置多个安全点可以提供更多安全保障。萨沙战斗塔拥有大量HP（50.000 HP护盾 + 150.000 HP装甲），确保先清理地点或能够扛住该地点5-10分钟。将萨沙战斗塔打入结构状态以刷出工头。

sections.heading: 战术与提示
sections.text: * 该地点无星门，因此无舰船限制 * 你可以在地点内自由跃迁 * 在跃迁进入点做书签以便弹跳 * 地点1和2在跃迁进入时无刷新 * 地点3在跃迁进入时敌方DPS较高，但你可以较容易地脱离射程 * 你可以在地点4隐形跃迁进入并弹跳回来，保持在塔（45公里）射程之外 * 地点1-3可以使用抗性良好的战术驱逐舰完成 * 地点3仅在增援波次中有势力战利品。势力巡洋舰可以被狙击，因为在编队刷新后50公里外没有初始仇恨。 * 地点4可以使用Stratios完成 分类:探险

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 2 is an Expedition that may escalate from True Sansha Fleet Staging Point.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site is NOT deadspace. You can warp around the site, and any potential hunter can warp directly to you with combat probes. The site can be difficult due to the presence of Energy Neutralizer sentries.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Cruise missile batteries deal a fair amount of EM damage. Blow them up if you can't tank the incoming DPS.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying all enemies gives a fairly high chance of escalating the site to True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 3. Unlike normal escalations, the system in which the escalation appears in may be up to 12 jumps away from the current system. Category:Expeditions

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 真正萨沙舰队集结点2是一项可从真正萨沙舰队集结点升级而来的探险任务。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该地点不在死亡空间中。你可以在地点周围跃迁，任何潜在的猎人都可以用战斗扫描探针直接跃迁到你身边。由于存在毁电哨兵，该地点可能很困难。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 巡航导弹炮台造成大量电磁伤害。如果你扛不住受到的DPS，就摧毁它们。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 消灭所有敌人有较高几率将地点升级为真正萨沙舰队集结点3。与普通升级不同，升级出现的星系可能距离当前星系最多12跳。 分类:探险

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 3 is an Expedition that can escalate from True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 2.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site can be very hard, though the loot may be very rewarding. The site is not in deadspace, and it is ungated. Any aspiring hunter can warp directly to you with combat probes, so be careful if running the site. Unlike the True Sansha Fleet Staging Point and True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 2, the site has no gates. The Sansha's Battletower has a fairly strong web that reaches out to 50 km. It deals a 0-2250-4500-2250 damage hit (in total 9000 dph) per 20000 seconds, and will fire the instant it locks your ship. It fires Citadel Mjolnir torpedoes every 120 seconds that deal high EM damage. It recharges shields to the tune of about 300 DPS. It is recommended to keep moving as fast as you can to mitigate as much damage from the battletower as possible. Destroy the Energy Neutralizer sentries as quickly as possible; they add much difficulty to the site.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 真正萨沙舰队集结点3是一项可从真正萨沙舰队集结点2升级而来的探险任务。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该地点可能非常困难，但战利品可能非常丰厚。该地点不在死亡空间中，且无星门。任何有心的猎人都可以用战斗扫描探针直接跃迁到你身边，所以执行该地点时要小心。与真正萨沙舰队集结点和真正萨沙舰队集结点2不同，该地点没有星门。萨沙战斗塔拥有一个相当强的网子，射程可达50公里。它每20000秒造成0-2250-4500-2250的伤害（总计9000 dph），并在锁定你的舰船的瞬间开火。它每120秒发射堡垒级雷锤鱼雷，造成高额电磁伤害。它以约300 DPS的速率恢复护盾。建议尽可能保持高速移动，以最大限度减少战斗塔造成的伤害。尽快摧毁毁电哨兵；它们大大增加了该地点的难度。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: After the Seven is a multi-part mission involving combat against both Serpentis and factionless pirates.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 七人之后是一个多部分任务，涉及与天蛇和无势力海盗的战斗。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Air Show! is a five-part mission involving both courier objectives and combat against Rogue Drones.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text: The pilot will be directed to a deadspace pocket with collidable objects, but no hostiles. There are 8 beacons in total. Beacons 1, 4, and 7 may require some amount of manual piloting to get to, as they are located in and around a hollow asteroid. It can also be helpful to ensure that beacons are visible in the overview.

sections.heading: Part 3
sections.text: The pilot will be directed to a deadspace pocket with no hostiles. Warp in, move to the damaged pod, pick up the stranded pilot, and return.

sections.heading: Part 4
sections.text: No aggro on warp-in. All ships in a given group will attack will aggro when any member of that group is attacked, but each group aggros separately. Group 5 will auto-aggro on spawn. Mission is completed upon killing Group 5. Ships are restricted to: Frigate, Shuttle, Corvette, Assault Frigate, Destroyer, Covert Ops, Interceptor, Stealth Bomber, Expedition Frigate, Logistics Frigate

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 飞行表演！是一个五部分任务，涉及快递目标和与自由无人机的战斗。

sections.heading: 第二部分
sections.text: 飞行员将被引导至一个有可碰撞物体但没有敌人的死亡空间房间。共有8个信标。信标1、4和7可能需要一定程度的手动驾驶才能到达，因为它们位于一颗空心小行星内部和周围。确保信标在概览中可见也会有所帮助。

sections.heading: 第三部分
sections.text: 飞行员将被引导至一个没有敌人的死亡空间房间。跃迁进入，移动到受损逃生舱，接上被困的飞行员，然后返回。

sections.heading: 第四部分
sections.text: 跃迁进入时无仇恨。给定编队中的所有舰船在该编队任何成员被攻击时会触发仇恨并攻击，但每个编队分别触发仇恨。编队5将在刷新时自动触发仇恨。击杀编队5后任务完成。舰船限制为：护卫舰、穿梭机、轻护卫舰、突击护卫舰、驱逐舰、隐秘行动舰、拦截舰、隐形轰炸舰、探险护卫舰、后勤护卫舰

guides.title: Alluring Emanations (Level 1)
guides.objective: Investigate the asteroid belt. Retreat if you encounter overwhelming force.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Alluring Emanations is a mission involving combat against Rogue Drones. There are multiple level variants. After killing the first Rogue Drone, a huge number of reinforcements show up. Killing them is not required to complete the mission. Doing so anyway, such as for the 25 non-capsuleer kills daily, is quite manageable due to their low small hitpoints pool and their arriving in smaller clumps that can be picked off well before they become a problem simply from strength in numbers. Bounties: ~254,000 ISK Salvage: ~1,250,000-1,500,000 ISK, (at 80 % salvage access difficulty, ~50 % wrecks successfully salvaged, value estimation of April 2025, Rens, Amarr) Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 诱人辐射是一个涉及与自由无人机战斗的任务。该任务有多个等级变体。击杀第一架自由无人机后，大量增援会出现。不需要击杀它们即可完成任务。尽管如此击杀它们（例如为了每日25次非克隆飞行员击杀）是相当容易的，因为它们的血量池较低，而且它们以小群方式到达，可以在它们凭借数量优势构成威胁之前被逐个清除。赏金：约254,000 ISK 打捞：约1,250,000-1,500,000 ISK，（在80%打捞难度下，约50%残骸成功打捞，2025年4月价值估算，伦斯，艾玛） 分类:安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: An Ancient Roster is a mission to retrieve an item from the Angel Cartel. Video: [Rifter September 2017] There are two variants of the mission.

sections.heading: Variant A
sections.text: Initially there is only the acceleration gate. When approaching the gate at about 30 km the enemy shows up.

sections.heading: Deadspace Pocket
sections.text: Mission objective item (Brutor Tribe Roster) is in the container. Blitz: Approach the container, get the Roster and warp out.

sections.heading: Mining
sections.text: The asteroids are identical in both variants. Note that the only mining-specialized ships that the Acceleration Gate admits are the Venture, Venture Consortium Issue, Pioneer, Pioneer Consortium Issue, and Perseverance. Category:Security missions Category:Missions with refinable asteroids

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古老名册是一个从天使企业联合体取回物品的任务。视频：[Rifter 2017年9月] 该任务有两个变体。

sections.heading: 变体A
sections.text: 初始只有加速轨道。当接近加速轨道约30公里时敌人出现。

sections.heading: 死亡空间房间
sections.text: 任务目标物品（布鲁特部落名册）在容器中。速刷：接近容器，拿取名册，然后跃迁离开。

sections.heading: 采矿
sections.text: 两个变体中的小行星相同。注意，加速轨道允许进入的唯一专用采矿舰为Venture、Venture联合体改进型、Pioneer、Pioneer联合体改进型和Perseverance。 分类:安全任务 分类:含可精炼小行星的任务

guides.title: Athran Exigency
guides.objective: Approach Abandoned Mining Station

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Athran Exigency is a five part mission chain. Involving combat with the Minmatar Republic.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: * Single pocket without gate. * Approach the mission objective (Abandoned Mining Station). Make it visible in the overview by enabling 'Types - Celestial - Large Collidable Object'. * The Station is 40km away from warp-in. The mission is flagged as complete when within 5km of the station.

sections.heading: Second pocket
sections.text: * A Battleship, the Republic Tribal Ymir, is exploding when you arrive in the second pocket, leaving behind no wreckage. * Group 2 appears after the explosion of the above mentioned battleship.

sections.heading: Part 3 of 5
sections.text: Blitz: Destroy the Amarr Starbase Control Tower, leaving the ships alone.

sections.heading: Single pocket
sections.text: * The mission objective is the Amarr Starbase Control Tower. Show it on your overview with "Entity - Large Collidable Structure". * Despite the wording of the mission briefing, you do not need to destroy the Stationary Bestower to complete the mission.

sections.heading: First pocket
sections.text: Blitz: Go directly to the acceleration gate. Destruction of the "Repair Crew" is not necessary. On activating the acceleration gate the following message appears: "Something just isn't right here. Several Minmatar ships circle the outpost, and your scanners clearly indicate artillery being fired off in the vicinity. Best be careful here."

sections.heading: Second pocket
sections.text: * Five 'Minmatar kamikaze pilot' frigates destroy themselves upon warp-in to the second pocket. * Group 1 spawns after the explosion of the above mentioned kamikaze frigates explode

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Tips: * Part 5 of 5 is a good mission to mine with large amounts of Veldspar and Scordite very near warp-in point. * Several Athran Proximity Mines are scattered throughout the asteroids. Be careful as they do explode and do a decent amount of damage. Structures: * No loot Category:Security missions

groups.name: 20-30km, spawn when you are within 10km of the station

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 阿特兰紧急事态是一个五部分任务链。涉及与米玛塔尔共和国的战斗。

sections.heading: 跃迁进入
sections.text: * 无星门的单房间。 * 接近任务目标（废弃采矿站）。通过启用'类型 - 天体 - 大型可碰撞物体'使其在概览中可见。 * 站点距离跃迁进入点40公里。在站点5公里范围内时任务标记为完成。

sections.heading: 第二房间
sections.text: * 当你到达第二房间时，一艘战列舰——共和国部落Ymir——正在爆炸，不留残骸。 * 编队2在上述战列舰爆炸后出现。

sections.heading: 第3部分（共5部分）
sections.text: 速刷：摧毁艾玛星基控制塔，不用管舰船。

sections.heading: 单房间
sections.text: * 任务目标是艾玛星基控制塔。用"实体 - 大型可碰撞建筑"在概览中显示它。 * 尽管任务简报的措辞如此，你不需要摧毁固定的Bestower即可完成任务。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 速刷：直接前往加速轨道。不需要摧毁"维修队"。激活加速轨道后出现以下信息："这里有些不对劲。几艘米玛塔尔舰船环绕着前哨站，你的扫描仪清楚地显示附近有火炮开火。最好小心行事。"

sections.heading: 第二房间
sections.text: * 五艘'米玛塔尔自杀式飞行员'护卫舰在跃迁进入第二房间时自毁。 * 编队1在上述自杀式护卫舰爆炸后刷新

sections.heading: 跃迁进入
sections.text: 提示：* 第5部分（共5部分）是一个适合采矿的好任务，跃迁进入点附近有大量的凡晶石和赛奥矿。 * 小行星中散布着多个阿特兰感应地雷。小心它们会爆炸并造成可观的伤害。 建筑：* 无战利品 分类:安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Single gated(locked) pocket with defenders at the gate. Walkthrough: * When you warp in there are no pirates but a whole lot of debris and an acceleration gate. * Attempting to activate the acceleration gate prompts a message to say that it is locked and you must destroy all nearby enemies. * Approaching the gate at approximately 5 km the first wave of Environmental Terrorists (Serpentis ships) then spawn. * Killing all the Environmental Terrorists unlocks the acceleration gate so you can then pass through. * On arrival in the second pocket, there are no enemies but three hollow asteroids, one of which contains the Infested Laboratory which you need to destroy. * Attacking the Infested Laboratory spawns the first wave of Environmental Terrorists. * Kill all the Environmental Terrorists and destroy the Infested Laboratory to complete the mission. Blitz: * Kill the Environmental Terrorists in the first pocket to unlock the gate. * Destroy the Infested Laboratory in the second pocket and warp away. Standing: * No empire standing lost. Notes: * The Infested Laboratory is inside the Hollow Asteroid. Kill all of the Environmental Terrorists before attempting to navigate to retrieve the drop, because you do not want to be fighting them while bouncing around inside the asteroid. Mineable Asteroids: * None. Structures: * The Infested Laboratory drops some Trade Goods and Scrap Metal (It drops 10 x Water which is a reagent for boosters production) Category:Security missions

sections.text: 单个带门（锁定）的房间，门口有防御者。攻略：* 跃迁进入时没有海盗，但有大量残骸和一个加速轨道。* 尝试激活加速轨道会提示它已被锁定，必须消灭附近所有敌人。* 接近轨道约5公里时，第一波环境恐怖分子（天蛇舰船）刷新。* 消灭所有环境恐怖分子后加速轨道解锁，可以通过。* 进入第二个房间后没有敌人，但有三个空心小行星，其中一个包含需要摧毁的感染实验室。* 攻击感染实验室会刷新第一波环境恐怖分子。* 消灭所有环境恐怖分子并摧毁感染实验室以完成任务。速刷：* 消灭第一个房间的环境恐怖分子以解锁轨道。* 摧毁第二个房间的感染实验室后跃迁离开。声望：* 无帝国声望损失。备注：* 感染实验室位于空心小行星内部。在尝试导航拾取掉落物之前消灭所有环境恐怖分子，因为你不想在小行星内部弹来弹去时与他们战斗。可开采小行星：* 无。建筑：* 感染实验室掉落一些贸易品和废金属（掉落10个水，是增效剂生产的催化剂）类别：安全任务

sections.text: Lost That Bet is a 5 part mission chain issued by Distribution division Agents. It consists of a Courier and 4 Encounter missions

sections.heading: Lost That Bet (4 of 5)
sections.text: "Don't you hear them? The dolls? They're all laughing at me." Single Pocket: Removal of all asteroids triggers container spawn and mission completion. Bring a ship with lots of max targets. LOTS. Or in a pinch, board a free corvette with two civilian mining lasers will work. (Board a corvette, unfit a mining laser, trash corvette and board another one to fit two miners.) 1 m3 of mining is about 2 seconds each rock. (End cycles early.) It only takes a few minutes with great piloting skills. Rats may appear so a weapon might be needed.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Single pocket without gate. Video: Punisher Walkthrough: * Pick up the 4x scientists (4m³) at the Survey Post container (10km) then place them in the Mining Outpost container (30km). * Kill all the drones that spawn * Killing the last Drone flags the mission complete. Note: The dust cloud here causes area damage to any player-owned entities nearby, including drones. Triggered by the first rogue drone spawn, the damage inflicted seems to continue until the last rogue drone is killed. After that, the area is safe for mining. Overall damage seems to be around 400-500 HP total, so it's quite manageable even in a frigate. You can also use an afterburner or Microwarpdrive to move approximately 35 to 40 km 'above' or below' the dust cloud and wait for the drones to come to you. This is useful if using a ship armed only with drones. Whilst fighting drones are unaffected by the dust cloud, do not try to use salavage drones to salvage the frigate wrecks as these will be destroyed by the damaging effects. If you want to salvage, fly just outside the dust cloud (approximately 57kms from the mining outpost) and then pull the wrecks towards you using a Mobile Tractor Unit. and Mineable Asteroids: * From 10km to 30km * 45x Veldspar (1.5M units) * 30x Plagioclase (814k units) * 16x Pyroxeres (480k units) Minable asteroids confirmed to still exist as of 2025-07-23. (CCP removed minable asteroids from a lot of missions during or before 2023.) Structures: * No loot. Category:Security missions Category:Missions with refinable asteroids

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Shaman Secrets is a multi part level 1 mission for Minmatar Republic. The structure of the mission chain suggests that it was supposed to be started in any of the three Minmatar Republic data centers, but this pre-requisite is not implemented in game. Instead, you can talk to Pinala Adala without having completed any of the data center missions to initiate the chain. The mission chain will reward the player with one random +1 attribute implant and Minmatar Republic faction standings. The mission chain can be completed only once. A failed mission can not be attempted again. But the missions themselves are fairly easy - as long as you pay attention and don't let the offered or accepted timers expire, they can be done without too much of a hassle. The missions are easy enough for a brand new player in their first frigate to complete them without problems.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨满秘密是米玛塔尔共和国的一个多部分1级任务链。任务链的结构表明它本应在米玛塔尔共和国的三个数据中心之一开始，但这一前置条件在游戏中并未实现。相反，你可以直接找到 Pinala Adala 对话，无需完成任何数据中心任务即可启动任务链。任务链将奖励玩家一个随机+1属性植入体和米玛塔尔共和国阵营声望。任务链只能完成一次。失败的任务无法重新尝试。不过任务本身相当简单——只要你注意不让提供或接受计时器过期，就可以轻松完成。即使是驾驶第一艘护卫舰的全新玩家也能毫无困难地完成这些任务。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This mission seems pretty alright for the first four parts, until the fifth part that will make you destroy the Drone Control Tower which will decrease your standings with other factions like Gallente Federation by a massive -2.621 (in my case) So AVOID THIS KIND OF MISSION!

sections.heading: Agents that offer this mission
sections.text: Khanid Trasport Storage Corporation: Eqi Arataragh ( Level 1 Distribution Agent ) located in Khanid Kingdom > Arniri Constellation > Danera System

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: Drone Habitat (10x) - drops nothing Infestated Station Ruins (1x) - drops nothing

sections.heading: Part 3 of 5
sections.text: Mine Scordite at location given (YOU MUST MINE the ORE here) - this flags it complete, but you still need to build the item 2x Asteroids - 1,000 units (150 m3) 3x Structures - no drops Construct the Basic Robotics (I had to go 4 jumps to find a station I could build at) Job takes about a little over 6 minuets. If you get this mission early in your career this might help: # Mine the Scordite. # Find a station having the Science & Industry service. (Right-click stations in the overview list > Show info > Services tab). # Bring the Scordite and the blueprint to that station and unload it into the hangar. # Right-click the Scordite and have it refined. (In the unlikely event that the station doesn't have a refinery you'll have to go to one to have Scordite refined.) # Open Science & Industry. From the available installations select the one on the station you are on. # Select a vacant assembly line. # Click "Install job". Select the blueprint. Click Ok. Click Accept Quote. # Select to Jobs tag > Get jobs. There you see that the job is in progress. Wait for it to finish. Click the job to see at which time it will be finished. When the job is ready click Deliver. It is now available in the hangar. # Pick up your stuff and return to the mission giver.

sections.heading: Part 5 of 5
sections.text: Space type: Deadspace without gates Blitz: Destroy the Drone Control Tower (it belongs to Gallente Federation) and warp out, there is no need to destroy any ships or drones.

sections.heading: 第3部分，共5部分
sections.text: 在指定位置开采灰岩（你必须在此处开采矿石）- 这会标记任务完成，但你仍需制造物品 2x 小行星 - 1000单位（150立方米） 3x 建筑 - 不掉落 建造基础机器人（我不得不跳4次找到一个可以制造的站点） 制造大约需要6分多钟。如果你在游戏早期接到这个任务，这可能会有帮助：# 开采灰岩。# 找到一个有科学与工业服务的空间站。（右键总览列表中的空间站 > 显示信息 > 服务标签）。# 将灰岩和蓝图带到该空间站并卸入机库。# 右键灰岩并精炼。（在空间站没有精炼设施的罕见情况下，你必须去一个有精炼设施的站点精炼灰岩。）# 打开科学与工业。从可用设施中选择你所在空间站的设施。# 选择一个空闲装配线。# 点击"安装任务"。选择蓝图。点击确定。点击接受报价。# 选择任务标签 > 获取任务。你可以在那里看到任务正在进行中。等待完成。点击任务查看完成时间。任务就绪后点击交付。现在物品已在机库中可用。# 拿上你的东西返回任务给予者。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Alluring Emanations is a mission involving combat against Rogue Drones. There are multiple level variants.

sections.heading: Details
sections.text: Upon warp-in, there will be one rogue drone at approximately 50km. Destroying this drone completes the mission and spawns an ambush group of 42 additional rogue drones. The ambush group does not need to be destroyed, and because drones do not drop loot, it may be more time-efficient to blitz the mission by simply destroying the initial single drone and warping away. Pilots who wish to engage the ambush group should ensure that they remain outside of the ambush group's optimal range, as getting too close can result in massive amounts of damage due to the number of hostiles. Category:Security missions

sections.text: 诱人辐射是一个涉及与自由无人机战斗的任务。有多个等级变体。

sections.text: 跃入后，约50公里处有一架自由无人机。摧毁该无人机即完成任务，并刷出42架额外的自由无人机伏击群。伏击群无需消灭，且无人机不掉落战利品，因此速刷该任务——仅摧毁初始单架无人机然后跃走——可能更省时间。想要与伏击群交战的飞行员应确保保持在伏击群的最佳射程之外，因为靠得太近会因敌对数量过多而承受大量伤害。Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Human Cattle is a 5 part mission chain. It consists of 4 encounter and a courier mission.

sections.heading: Human Cattle (1 of 5)
sections.text: Blitz: Destroy the Rogue drone ships, pick-up the data chip and get out.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: You have to dispatch the drones to open the cargo can (disguised as a habitation module) and pick up the data chip needed for the mission. The bulk of the incoming damage is from the missile batteries, using Scourge Light missiles. They do roughly 10x as much damage as the ships. 2022-05-29 While the EVE-Survival import reports 2.4% standing loss with Caldari State no loss was seen.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: The residence in the middle drop some trade goods.

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: Possible Blitz: Take care of group A and go trough the gate. When enough distance is maintained the other groups will not aggro.

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: The mission completes on warp in, with both a pop-up and a message in local. Blitz: Immediately warp out on mission complete. No combat required. WARNING: ALL of the Imperial Navy Gamma II Support Frigates have warp scramblers. In the third room of this mission, there are six groups of enemy ships in a 2x3 grid, about 160 km away from warp-in. Each group has two battleships, five frigates, and the bottom left group has the three Mallers. In addition, one of the five Gamma II frigates starts 20km away from warp in and will attempt to scram immediately. The Jakars attack with cruise missiles, while the rest of the battleships attack with beam lasers. The DPS in this room is extremely high - enough to destroy a heavily tanked Raven in roughly 30 seconds. If you insist on completing this room, it is strongly advised to bring at the very least a marauder with logi support. Drops about 2500 m3 of loot in total, including Large Tachyon Beam Lasers and a chance of some Caldari Navy Fulmination Heavy Assault missiles. Category:Security missions

sections.text: 人类牲畜是一个5部分任务链。包含4场战斗和1个运输任务。

sections.heading: 跃入
sections.text: 你必须消灭无人机以打开货柜（伪装成居住模块）并拾取任务所需的数据芯片。主要 incoming 伤害来自导弹炮台，使用扰频轻型导弹。它们造成的伤害大约是舰船的10倍。2022-05-29 虽然EVE-Survival导入报告显示加达里共和国声望损失2.4%，但实际未观察到损失。

sections.heading: 跃入
sections.text: 中间的居住建筑会掉落一些贸易品。

sections.heading: 第1房间
sections.text: 可能的速刷：处理掉A组然后通过星门。保持足够距离后其他组不会仇恨。

sections.heading: 第3房间
sections.text: 跃入时任务即完成，会同时弹出提示和本地消息。速刷：任务完成后立即跃走。无需战斗。警告：所有帝国海军伽马II支援护卫舰都装备有反跳器。在该任务的第三个房间中，有6组敌对舰船呈2x3网格排列，距跃入点约160公里。每组有2艘战列舰、5艘护卫舰，左下组有3艘统治者级。此外，5艘伽马II护卫舰中有1艘起始于距跃入点20公里处，会立即尝试反跳。猎鲛级使用巡航导弹攻击，其余战列舰使用光束激光攻击。该房间的DPS极高——足以在约30秒内摧毁一艘重防的乌鸦级。如果你坚持要完成这个房间，强烈建议至少带一艘掠夺者级并配备后勤舰支援。总共掉落约2500立方米战利品，包括大型快子光束激光和一定几率的加达里海军暴风雨重型突击导弹。Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Mining
sections.text: Every cycle completion OR deactivation of a mining laser has a 50% chance to cause the warp-in Beacon to fire a 500 EM damage smartbomb with a radius of 250 kilometers. That is not a typo: the warp-in beacon, itself, fires the smartbomb. All players and player-owned drones in range take damage. Damage to NPCs is untested. Wrecks and the loot structure (the "Starbase Ship Maintenance Array" mentioned above) do NOT take damage. CAUTION: This testing only applies to this specific variant of "The Blockade". Other variants may have a beacon-smartbomb that deals a different damage type or amount. Plagioclase - 23 asteroids with a total of 677,404 units (237,091.4 m^3) Pyroxeres - 13 asteroids with a total of 404,510 units (121,353 m^3) Veldspar - 39 asteroids with a total of 1,592,457 units (159,245.7 m^3) Category:Security missions Category:Missions with refinable asteroids

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Alluring Emanations is a mission involving combat against Rogue Drones. There are multiple level variants.

sections.heading: Details
sections.text: Upon warp-in, there will be one rogue drone at approximately 50km that does not aggro. Destroying this drone completes the mission and spawns an ambush of 43 additional rogue drones in 5 groups, 60-120 km away. The ambush group does not need to be destroyed, and because drones do not drop loot, it may be more time-efficient to blitz the mission by simply destroying the initial single drone and warping away. Pilots who wish to engage the ambush groups should ensure that they remain outside of the ambush groups' optimal range, as getting too close can result in massive amounts of damage due to the number of hostiles. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 诱惑辐射是一个涉及与自由无人机战斗的任务。有多个等级变体。

sections.heading: 详情
sections.text: 跃迁入场后，约50km处会有一架不主动仇恨的自由无人机。摧毁这架无人机完成任务，并在60-120 km外刷新5组共43架额外自由无人机的伏击。伏击组无需被摧毁，并且由于无人机不掉战利品，速刷任务可能更省时间——只需摧毁初始单架无人机然后跃迁离开。想要交战伏击组的飞行员应确保保持在伏击组的最佳射程之外，因为靠太近可能会因敌对数量过多而承受大量伤害。 分类：安全任务

guides.title: Angel Extravaganza (Level 3)
guides.objective: Destroy Terzam Tazzon

sections.heading: Details
sections.text: Except where noted otherwise, all hostile NPCs will auto-aggro on spawn or warp-in. Drones will receive aggro from newly-spawned waves. The ship that triggers the next wave on destruction is usually the ship with the highest bounty. All Sentries can be ignored and gates will still unlock. The majority of the explosive damage noted in the mission details is found in the bonus pocket.

sections.heading: Blitz
sections.text: * Pocket 1: Destroy Angel Cartel Structure and Small Refinery so that Wave 1 and Wave 2 won't spawn. * Pocket 2: Destroy Shipyard so Wave 2 will not spawn. * Pocket 3: Destroy Storage Silo so Wave 1 won't spawn. * Pocket 4: Destroy Cruiser, no need to destroy Turrets. * Pocket 5: Trigger all triggers leading to spawn of Terzam Tazzon, and destroy his/her ship and both drones.

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: If the casino is destroyed before the trigger, Wave 2 will not spawn. Ryker III - "It's not the Casino. It's the Shipyard that has all the ships inside it." 2026.03.16 00:55 EVE-Time

sections.heading: Pocket 4
sections.text: Group 3 (the single cruiser) does not aggro unless it or the sentry towers are attacked, but it may aggro drones. If drones are targeted, it will follow the drones and attack them, but will head back to its initial position if the drones are returned to the drone bay, even if it is very close to a player ship. Ryker III - "You may not need to blow up the turrets, but if you have drones you may as well sic 'em on one or two of 'em while you're heading over to stomp the Cruiser for the added bounties." 2026.03.16 01:05 EVE-Time

sections.heading: Pocket 5
sections.text: The mission is marked complete upon destruction of Wave 4.

sections.heading: Bonus Pocket
sections.text: It is not necessary to clear the bonus pocket to complete the mission. To activate the acceleration gate, the player ship must have an Angel Palladium Tag in its cargo hold. The tag is not consumed. The Angel Battlestation has 700K HP and generally doesn't drop any good loot, you want to ignore this. Terzam's Stash may contain Domination faction modules, though.

sections.heading: 详情
sections.text: 除非另有说明，所有敌对NPC将在刷新或跃迁入场时自动仇恨。无人机将吸引新刷新波次的仇恨。击杀后触发下一波次的舰船通常是赏金最高的那艘。所有哨兵炮台可以忽略，加速轨道仍会解锁。任务详情中提到的大部分爆炸伤害来自奖励房间。

sections.heading: 速刷
sections.text: * 第1房间：摧毁天使企业联合体建筑和小型精炼厂，这样第1波和第2波不会刷新。 * 第2房间：摧毁船坞以阻止第2波刷新。 * 第3房间：摧毁储存筒仓以阻止第1波刷新。 * 第4房间：摧毁巡洋舰，无需摧毁炮台。 * 第5房间：触发所有触发怪以刷出Terzam Tazzon，并摧毁其舰船和两架无人机。

sections.heading: 第2房间
sections.text: 如果在触发前摧毁赌场，第2波不会刷新。 Ryker III - "不是赌场。是船坞里面才有所有舰船。" 2026.03.16 00:55 EVE时间

sections.heading: 第4房间
sections.text: 第3组（单艘巡洋舰）不会主动仇恨，除非它或哨兵炮台被攻击，但它可能会仇恨无人机。如果无人机被锁定，它会跟随并攻击无人机，但如果无人机返回无人机舱，即使它非常接近玩家舰船，它也会返回初始位置。 Ryker III - "你可能不需要炸掉炮台，但如果你有无人机，不妨在前往摧毁巡洋舰拿额外赏金的路上，放无人机去咬一两座炮台。" 2026.03.16 01:05 EVE时间

sections.heading: 第5房间
sections.text: 摧毁第4波后任务标记为完成。

sections.heading: 奖励房间
sections.text: 无需清理奖励房间即可完成任务。要激活加速轨道，玩家舰船货舱中必须有一个天使钯金标签。标签不会被消耗。天使战斗空间站有700K HP，通常不掉好战利品，建议忽略。不过Terzam的藏匿处可能包含主宰势力装备。

sections.text: Angel Strike is a Level 3 mission with ten parts. Parts 1 through 4, as well as part 6, are always the same, but part 5, and parts 7 through 10 have variants for each pirate faction.

sections.text: Blitz: Destroy the Radio Telescope and warp-out. That will finish the mission quickly; however, even if you kill all the ships, there is no standings loss incurred (and the tags have a significant amount of value)

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Initial spawn is 20-30km away from warp-in. Upon destruction of the last ship in a group, a new reinforcement wave will spawn. The Radio Telescope is 29km from warp-in. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：摧毁Radio Telescope并跃出。这样可以快速完成任务；不过，即使你击杀所有舰船，也不会损失声望（而且标签具有相当高的价值）

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: 初始刷新在距跃入点20-30km处。每组最后一艘舰船被摧毁后，新一波增援将出现。Radio Telescope距跃入点29km。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gallente Detective Spotted is a level 3 mission involving combat against Gallente Federation. Acceleration gate, no hostiles on warp in

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 发现盖伦特侦探是一个涉及对抗盖伦特联邦的等级3任务。加速轨道，跃入时无敌人

guides.title: Gate Blitz
guides.ewar: Sensor damps from Elite Federation Arx and Federation Praktor Hippeus/Nauclarius

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: Groups 1 and 2 initially present in the pocket and will auto-aggro. Reinforcement wave appears after the first Industrial is destroyed and will auto-aggro. Blitz: Destroy the three Federation Industrials. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: 第一组和第二组初始在房间内，会自动仇恨。摧毁第一艘工业舰后增援波次出现并自动仇恨。速刷：摧毁三艘联邦工业舰。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Gone Berserk (Level 3)
guides.objective: Destroy all enemy ships

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Kill right spawn, then all Cruisers and "Demon" Frigates reinforcements in that chain. It is recommended to target one EoM Prophet from each group and kill them first. Then kill the remaining ships one at a time and eliminate the chain of spawns after it. This means you get a total of three of each of the Reinforcement Spawns! An easy way to tackle this is to approach from either the left or right hand side and just pick off the ships as they approach.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Like the level 4 variant, the spawns appear in chains. All spawns appear 45-55km from warp-in point and automatically aggro. For each initial spawn group you kill, you'll get an additional reinforcement spawn consisting of 4 waves. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：击杀右侧刷新，然后击杀该链中所有巡洋舰和"Demon"护卫舰增援。建议从每组中优先锁定一艘EoM Prophet并先击杀。然后逐个击杀剩余舰船，并清除后续的刷新链。这意味着每种增援刷新你总共会打三波！一个简单的处理方式是从左侧或右侧接近，在敌舰接近时逐个击杀。

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: 与等级4版本类似，刷新以链的形式出现。所有刷新出现在距跃入点45-55km处并自动仇恨。每击杀一组初始刷新，你会获得一组额外的增援刷新，共4波。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Guristas Extravaganza (Level 3)
guides.ewar: Webs from Guristas Kyoukan/Webifier and Spider Drone I

sections.heading: Blitz
sections.text: * Pocket 1: Not Possible * Pocket 2: Kill the Cruiser, no need to destroy Sentries. * Pocket 3: Destroy all ships, no need to destroy the missile battery, then destroy the EM ForceField. * Pocket 4: Not possible. * Pocket 5: Kill Satori Kardun, and the Spider Drone.

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket
sections.text: Tip: To kill the forcefield, you will need to shoot it directly. (Requires adding Collidable Structures to your overview.)

sections.heading: 6th Pocket (Bonus Room)
sections.text: Requires Guristas Palladium Tag (not consumed). Difficulty: Hard (Requires full tanking abilities) Note: Guristas War Installation loot may not be valuable and not worth the time. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Blitz
sections.text: * 房间1：无法速刷 * 房间2：击杀巡洋舰，无需摧毁Sentries。* 房间3：摧毁所有舰船，无需摧毁导弹炮台，然后摧毁EM力场。* 房间4：无法速刷。* 房间5：击杀Satori Kardun和Spider Drone。

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket
sections.text: 提示：要摧毁力场，你需要直接射击它。（需要在总览中添加可碰撞建筑。）

sections.heading: 6th Pocket (Bonus Room)
sections.text: 需要Guristas Palladium Tag（不消耗）。难度：困难（需要完整的抗性功能）注意：Guristas War Installation的战利品可能价值不高，不值得花时间。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Strike is a 10 part storyline mission mission chain. It consists of 3 courier and 7 encounter missions. Like all storyline missions there is no loyalty points reward for any of the missions. However the faction standings, normally received for storyline missions, are only rewarded to the final mission. The other missions in the chain only increase corporation standings and, unusual for storyline missions, agent standings.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 古斯塔斯打击是一个10部分的故事线任务链。包含3个运输任务和7个遭遇任务。与所有故事线任务一样，所有任务均无忠诚度点数奖励。然而，通常从故事线任务获得的阵营声望仅在最终任务奖励。链中的其他任务仅增加军团声望，以及不寻常地，增加代理人声望。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This is actually a level 1 mission that points towards to the The Blood-Stained Stars. Read the pop ups and the item in can that drops. Single gated pocket. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 这实际上是一个指向血染星辰的等级1任务。阅读弹窗和货罐中掉落的物品。单个门控房间。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Illegal Activity is a 3 part mission chain, consisting of 3 encounter missions involving combat with Gallente Federation

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 非法活动是一个3部分的任务链，包含3个涉及与盖伦特联邦战斗的遭遇任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Space type: Deadspace Recommended generic setup: All Ranges, Active Tank All ships come at you as soon as you initiate combat. They will orbit you at varying distances, from 2500m to 20km, and the battleship will try to stay at 30km. They fire a variety of hybrid weapons and all sizes of tracking kinetic missiles. Overall damage taken is high. Tips: * Get close to the Battleship and orbit it so it can't hit you. * If your ship is fast enough to avoid the hybrid turrets, you only need kinetic resistance to survive the missiles.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 空间类型：死亡空间 推荐通用配置：全射程，主动抗 所有舰船在你发起战斗后立即冲向你。它们会在不同距离环绕你，从2500m到20km，战列舰会试图保持在30km。它们使用各种混合武器和所有尺寸的追踪动能导弹。总体承伤较高。提示：* 靠近战列舰并环绕它使其无法命中你。* 如果你的舰船足够快以躲避混合炮塔，你只需要动能抗性来抵御导弹。

guides.title: Intercept The Pirate Smugglers (Blood Raiders)
guides.shipSuggestion: Battlecruiser, Recon, Faction Cruiser, Cruiser, Assault Frigate.
guides.objective: Fly to the Space-Port, ambush the convoy when it arrives, and then report back to your agent.

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: There is a short delay after killing the first wave before the second wave spawns. Just wait for about 30 seconds to three minutes or so and they will appear. Warp-in message:

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: *Bounty: ~426k ISK *Loot: ~380k ISK *Salvage: ~450k ISK Category:Security missions

zh.title: 拦截海盗走私者（血袭者）

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: 击杀第一波后第二波刷新前有短暂延迟。等待约30秒到三分钟左右它们就会出现。跃入信息：

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: *赏金：约42.6万ISK *战利品：约38万ISK *打捞：约45万ISK 分类：安全任务

guides.title: Intercept The Pirate Smugglers (Serpentis)
guides.objective: Fly to the Space-Port, ambush the convoy when it arrives, and then report back to your agent.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Not possible. Notes: Space-Port is destructible, has an incredible amounts of EHP, and drops nothing.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：不可能。注意：Space-Port可摧毁，拥有极高的有效血量，且不掉落任何物品。

guides.title: Intercept The Saboteurs (Amarr) (Level 3)
guides.ewar: NOS Imperial Tamir. Tracking disruption., Divine Imperials

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: Blitz: * Kill group 4, loot the can which is dropped from the last ship in group 4 * Make sure you can tank group 3, 4 and 5 at the same time The mission objective drops from the last ship destroyed in group 4. On attacking group 1, group 2 aggros. On attacking group 3, group 4 aggros. On attacking group 4, group 3 and 5 aggro. On attacking group 5, group 4 aggros.

sections.heading: Asteroids
sections.text: Veldspar - 51 asteroids Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: 速刷：* 击杀第四组，拾取第四组最后舰船掉落的货罐 * 确保你能同时抗住第三、四、五组 任务目标从第四组最后击杀的舰船掉落。攻击第一组，第二组仇恨。攻击第三组，第四组仇恨。攻击第四组，第三组和第五组仇恨。攻击第五组，第四组仇恨。

sections.heading: Asteroids
sections.text: 凡晶石 - 51颗小行星 分类：安全任务

guides.title: Intercept The Saboteurs (Caldari)
guides.ewar: State Fudai/Ashigaru/Buke/Chugen (Target jamming), Taibu State Shinai/Shirasaya/Nagasa (Web, Scram)

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Kill Initial Group in Pocket 1, Group 4 in Pocket 2, and loot objective.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * Objective drops from last kill in Group 4. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：击杀房间1的初始组，房间2的第四组，拾取目标。

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * 目标从第四组最后击杀掉落。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Intercept The Saboteurs (Sansha's Nation)
guides.ewar: Weapon Disrupton(Centii Slave Hunter/Savage/Beast), Centii Loyal Minion
guides.objective: Confiscated viral Agent (20.0 m3)

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Mission completed once last Group 4 ship is killed (drops the needed item in a cargo container), you do not have to kill other groups. See note above for aggressing Group 4 individually without triggering Group 3.

sections.heading: Pocket
sections.text: Notes: Attacking group 3 or 4 gets aggro from 3 and 4 (**except** when pulling aggro at the range; this way you can easily do it in a much smaller ship). Drones don't cause any aggro but may aggro further ship themselves when out. Taking them back in drone bay doesn't lead the aggro on you, NPC ships just head back to their initial location even if very close to you, as long as you don't fire.

sections.heading: Loot & Salvage
sections.text: Loot: 1.1 Mil ISK (2024-09-03) Salvage: 2.09 Mil ISK (2024-09-03) Category:Security missions

zh.title: 拦截破坏者（萨沙共和国）

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：击杀第四组最后一艘舰船后任务完成（在货柜中掉落所需物品），无需击杀其他组。参见上方关于单独触发第四组而不触发第三组的说明。

sections.heading: Pocket
sections.text: 注意：攻击第三组或第四组会同时引来第三和第四组的仇恨（**除非**在远距离拉仇恨；这样你可以用更小的舰船轻松完成）。无人机不会引起仇恨，但放出后可能自行仇恨其他舰船。将它们收回无人机舱不会导致对你仇恨，NPC舰船会返回初始位置，即使非常靠近你，只要你不开火。

guides.title: Lasers Softly Beaming (Level 3)
guides.objective: Destroy Geebel Tash-Murkon's ship and capture him.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Kill Geebel Tash-Murkon, loot the the wreck, and warp out.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * Sensor dampening may be present. * Tank primarily against Gallente, as Geebel Tash-Murkon is the only Amarr ship. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：击杀Geebel Tash-Murkon，拾取残骸，跃出。

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * 可能存在感应抑阻。* 主要针对盖伦特配置抗性，因为Geebel Tash-Murkon是唯一的艾玛舰船。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Lights Out (Level 3)
guides.objective: Kill the Gallente Lieutenant

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Kill the Gallente Lieutenant, then warp-out.

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: * No rats on warp-in. Agent will tell you to attack the outpost, which will spawn a group. * Additional groups are time-based spawns, ranging from 30 seconds after previous to several minutes. * Group 5 will spawn after destruction of groups 1-4.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * Destroying the Starbase Control Tower is difficult, but results in the entire outpost exploding. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：击杀盖伦特中尉，然后跃出。

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: * 跃入时无怪。代理人会指示你攻击空间站，这会刷新一组怪。* 额外组为定时刷新，间隔从30秒到数分钟不等。* 第五组会在第一至四组被摧毁后刷新。

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * 摧毁Starbase Control Tower很困难，但会导致整个空间站爆炸。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Mannar Mining Colony
guides.objective: Pick up the broken mining equipment from the mining colony.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Take the Broken Mining Equipment from the Parts Container (~16km away), warp out. Note: You may take up to 8,000 damage on a Blitz run with low resistances. Done with 219 DPS tank (Rogue Drones specific).

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 速刷：从Parts Container（约16km外）取走Broken Mining Equipment，跃出。注意：低抗性速刷可能承受高达8,000伤害。使用219 DPS坦克完成（针对自由无人机）。

guides.title: Massive Attack (Sansha's Nation) (Level 3)
guides.ewar: Web by Stasis Tower in pocket 2

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 4 pockets + a bonus pocket. Requires a Sansha's silver tag for the bonus.

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: Asteroid belt with one or more Omber asteroids

sections.heading: Pocket 5
sections.text: Bonus Pocket (Needs a Sansha silver tag) The stash might drop a +3 implant. Utopia gardens dropped drugs. Category:Security missions

zh.title: 大规模进攻（萨沙共和国）（等级3）

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 4个房间加一个奖励房间。奖励房间需要萨沙银标签。

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: 小行星带，有一个或多个奥贝尔小行星

sections.heading: Pocket 5
sections.text: 奖励房间（需要萨沙银标签）储藏可能掉落+3植入体。Utopia gardens掉落毒品。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Million Little Pieces
guides.objective: Destroy the Ore Processing Plant

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gate restriction to Command Ships and down. Spawns are all time based. No hostiles at initial gate. Blitz: * Destroy Ore Processing Plant and warp out. * Via this method no Gallente Federation standing loss is incurred.

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: Destroying the Communications Relay prevents the timed waves. Auto-aggro after one minute. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 仅允许指挥舰及更小型的舰船通过。所有增援波次均为定时刷新。初始门处无敌对目标。速刷：* 摧毁矿石加工厂并跃迁离开。* 通过此方式不会造成盖伦特联邦声望损失。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 摧毁通信中继器可阻止定时增援波次。一分钟后自动触发仇恨。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Tank the room and destroy the four industrials. Space type: Normal space with one gate Overview: Single pocket with 2 groups, one spawn. Mission is complete once group 2 is destroyed. Spawn triggered by last ship in group 1.

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: This group spawns once last ship in group 1 is destroyed. It appears at the same location as the industrials. Tip: Mission is complete once four industrials are destroyed. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 速刷：抗住整个房间并摧毁四艘工业舰。空间类型：含一个门的普通空间 概述：单个房间，2组敌人，1个增援波次。第2组被击毁后任务完成。增援由第1组最后一艘船被击毁触发。

sections.heading: 单个房间
sections.text: 第1组最后一艘船被击毁后此组刷新。出现位置与工业舰相同。提示：四艘工业舰被摧毁后任务即完成。分类：安全任务

guides.title: My Sweet Privateer
guides.faction: Gallente (privateers drop Gallente tags and shooting them hurts Gallente standing)
guides.ewar: Damp Privateer Specialist and Damp/NOS Privateer Commander, Privateer Specialist
guides.objective: kill Privateer Commander and scoop the Privateer Commander's Head.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Clear first room and activate gate. Kill scrambling frigates, then kill Privateer Commander, scoop the Privateer Commander's Head and warp out. Tips * Kill the Privateer Specialists first just in case you have to warp out * Destruction of any Sentry will result in -0.3 standing loss * And last but not least don't die

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 速刷：清理第一个房间并激活门。击杀反跳护卫舰，然后击杀私掠指挥官，拾取私掠指挥官的头颅并跃迁离开。提示 * 优先击杀私掠专家，以防需要紧急跃迁离开 * 摧毁任何哨兵舰将导致-0.3声望损失 * 最后但同样重要的是，别死

guides.title: New Frontiers 1-7
guides.objective: Mine 235 of Green Aristite

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: New Frontiers is a level 3 mission series (Mission chain) consisting of 7 missions (4 encounter, 1 mining and 2 courier). Summary: * All gates in the missions are unlocked. * Several missions have pairs of Energy Neutralizer Towers that do 5gj/s each. * Damage can get quite high for a level 3 in later stages, especially if blitzing.

sections.heading: Raw Materials (1 of 7)
sections.text: alt=Screenshot of the grid of the Raw Materials mission, showing the group of mercenaries|thumb|left You must mine the Green Arisite yourself, buying it will not complete the mission. No initial aggro from enemies on grid. After some time 3 Cruisers (Mercenary Miners) depart. You are able to mine the Green Arisite from a distanse without being attacked, but may aggro if you get within about 15km. As with any time you mine (even in missions or sites), it is possible for belt rats to spawn. A Pioneer can mine the required ore in seconds without moving from the warpin and without aggroing any enemies. Blitz: * Mine the Green Arisite

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: There are two reinforcement chains. The Mercenary Miners will warp out after a bit if not killed. Triggers are last kill of specified ship type.

sections.heading: Mad Scientist (2 of 7)
sections.text: A passive tanked battlecruiser is a good choice for this mission due to energy neutralizers. Blitz: * Go straight through gate, blow up Professor Delainen's Lab, and loot the cargo container spawned. * Destroy Stasis/Energy Neutralizer towers as needed.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: All enemies will aggro immediately. Destroying the two drone bunkers can stop additional reinforcements. Waves 2 and 3 are likely timed. WARNING There is a chance that an Alvus Controller battleship will spawn after the initial frigate spawn. Frigate Strain Sunder Alvi, which warp disrupt, might spawn as well.

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: Warning: You will be webbed and neuted immediately after warp-in. Make sure you have weapons/drones capable of hitting the towers at about 50 kilometers or you will be stuck while being neuted and fired upon. Neutralizer towers will be capping you for -10GJ/s each, -20GJ/s total. Reinforcements do not always spawn and may be prevented by destroying bunkers at warp-in.

sections.heading: The Unveiling (4 of 7)
sections.text: Damage is primarily thermal. Blitz: * Kill Delainen-ROM Symbiote, loot Elite Drone AI, and warp out.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Mission objective is contained in the cargo container created on destruction of Delainen-ROM Symbiote. Destroying the Drone Bunker can cause multiple waves to spawn. Triggers are last kill of specified ship type.

sections.heading: An Unexpected Twist (5 of 7)
sections.text: Energy Neutralizers combine for -15gj/s and have a range in excess of 120Km. Web towers have a range of about 30km. If you are active tanked focus down the neutralizers first. Blitz: * Kill Group 2 to trigger Wave 1. Kill the battleship, loot the can, warp out.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Mission objective is contained in the cargo container created on destruction of Wave 1 Drone Battleship.

sections.heading: Ascendance (7 of 7)
sections.text: Blitz: * Jump through first gate, kill Delainen-Solar Cinder Entity, warp out.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Gate is not locked. Delainen-Solar Cinder Entity will make a short appearance before using the acceleration gate. Enemy ships spawn in over the first 20 seconds.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 新边疆是一个3级任务系列（任务链），共包含7个任务（4个遭遇战、1个采矿和2个快递）。概述：* 任务中所有门均已解锁。* 多个任务中有成对的毁电塔，每座输出5GJ/s。* 在后期阶段，对于3级任务来说伤害可能相当高，尤其是速刷时。

sections.heading: 原材料（1/7）
sections.text: alt=原材料任务网格截图，显示雇佣兵编队|thumb|left 你必须亲自开采绿色阿晶石，购买无法完成任务。网格上的敌人初始不会触发仇恨。一段时间后3艘巡洋舰（雇佣兵矿工）将离开。你可以在安全距离外开采绿色阿晶石而不被攻击，但进入约15km范围内可能会触发仇恨。与任何采矿时一样（即使在任务或遗址中），都有可能刷新矿带老鼠。开拓者级可以在数秒内从跃迁入场点开采所需矿石，无需移动且不会触发任何敌人仇恨。速刷：* 开采绿色阿晶石

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 共有两条增援链。雇佣兵矿工若未被击杀，一段时间后将会跃迁离开。触发条件为指定类型最后一艘船被击毁。

sections.heading: 疯狂科学家（2/7）
sections.text: 由于存在毁电设施，被动抗战巡是此任务的不错选择。速刷：* 直接通过门，炸毁德莱南教授实验室，并拾取刷新的货物集装箱。* 根据需要摧毁停滞/毁电塔。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 警告：跃迁入场后你将立即被网子和毁电。确保你的武器/无人机能在约50公里距离打击毁电塔，否则你将在被毁电和攻击的同时动弹不得。毁电塔每座消耗你-10GJ/s，共计-20GJ/s。增援不一定刷新，可通过在跃迁入场点摧毁掩体来阻止。

sections.heading: 揭幕（4/7）

guides.title: Pick Your Poison
guides.objective: Rescue the diplomats and other station personnel from the damaged emissary, and then return them to the Sisters of EVE Rescue Vessel.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: There are 2 parts to this mission, the first part is in the first pocket and restricts the size of ship that can be used to a cruiser or smaller, but there are no hostiles. You need only grab the cargo using a MWD frig or shuttle. Once you have the diplomat in cargo, you must warp back to the entrance and deposit it in a can. This can be accomplished in the fast ship, but if desired this part may be completed in any combat ship as no gate is required. This allows you to engage the navy ships present. Warp-in: Initially at the warp-in there is an acceleration gate and a stationary SOE Rescue Vessel. There are no hostiles.

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: Pocket One consists of no hostiles two cans: one labeled Minmatar Embassy Housing, one labeled Amarr Embassy Housing and an Acceleration Gate to Pocket 2. Shortly after warping in you are given a message that you can only save one. Pick up the embassy staff from one of the housing cans, and the other blows up. Contrary to the mission advice, you do not seem to lose faction standing for the faction that you leave behind, or receive any improvements if you rescue one or both. Note: It is possible to rescue both diplomats at once, but it will require a fleet and proper timing. Once you rescue one, you will have only a few seconds to rescue the second before the embassy building explodes, so you'll need a second pilot at the other embassy to grab the other diplomat at the same time you do. Either way, an opposing fleet will be present at the destination of the second gate (ie, the mission entrance) following your rescue. A third pilot with a well-tanked battleship can withstand the enemy fleet while other pilots complete the drop-off. There is an acceleration gate here that returns to the warp-in/mission entrance and it will place you at 50km from the container, but if you prefer it is possible to warp out and then warp back to the mission.

sections.heading: Second Gate (Mission Entrance)
sections.text: In addition to the SOE Rescue Vessel present when you first warped-in, you now have faction ships of the faction you didn't save out for your blood (See list below), but you do not have to kill them to complete the mission. Ships will vary depending on which empire space you are in. There is no reason to take the gate as it will simply return you to P1. The mission is complete once the diplomatic staff are placed inside the SoE ship. Method: Blitz:Use a fast frigate or interceptor. Pick up the diplomat in P1. Return to the warp in, drop them off, and warp away. Mission is complete. Eliminating the Navy Ships: Instead of returning to the entrance start point immediately, you can go get your ship of choice to kill all enemies at the warp-in point. Simply ensure you transfer the rescued diplomat into your combat ship's cargohold. Upon returning to the warp-in/mission entrance you can kill everything with your large ship and deposit the diplomat. If you wish to fight the NPCs fight the Minmatar ones; they are significantly easier to destroy and tank against. Isk: Amarr Bounty: Loot: 7.7M Isk in Insignias and other drops, 1.4M Isk in salvage Minmatar Bounty: Loot: 12.7M Isk in Insignias and other drops, 920k Isk in salvage Standing: No standing loss from killing ships in pocket 2. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 此任务分为两部分，第一部分在第一个房间中，限制可用舰船大小为巡洋舰或更小，但没有敌对目标。你只需使用装微型跃迁推进器的护卫舰或穿梭机抓取货物。将外交官装入货舱后，你必须跃迁返回入口并将其放入箱子中。这可以用快速舰船完成，但如果愿意，这部分也可以在任何战斗舰船中完成，因为不需要通过门。这允许你与在场的海军舰船交战。跃迁入场：初始跃迁入场点有一道加速轨道和一艘静止的伊芙姐妹会救援舰。没有敌对目标。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 第一个房间无敌对目标，有两个箱子：一个标注为米玛塔尔大使馆住所，一个标注为艾玛大使馆住所，以及一道通往第二个房间的加速轨道。跃迁入场后不久你会收到消息说你只能拯救一个。从其中一个住所箱子中接上外交人员，另一个将会爆炸。与任务提示相反，你似乎不会因为留下的一方而损失阵营声望，拯救一个或两个也不会获得任何声望提升。注意：可以同时拯救两名外交官，但这需要舰队配合和精确的时机。拯救一个后，你只有几秒钟在大使馆建筑爆炸前拯救第二个，因此你需要第二名飞行员在另一个大使馆同时接上另一名外交官。无论如何，在你完成拯救后，第二道门的目的地（即任务入口）将会出现一支敌方舰队。第三名驾驶高抗战列舰的飞行员可以在其他飞行员完成投放时抵御敌方舰队。这里有一道加速轨道返回跃迁入场点/任务入口，会将你放置在距箱子50km处，但如果你愿意，也可以跃迁离开再跃迁回任务。

sections.heading: 第二道门（任务入口）
sections.text: 除了你首次跃迁入场时存在的伊芙姐妹会救援舰外，现在还有你未拯救的阵营派出的阵营舰船来取你的性命（见下方列表），但你不必击杀它们来完成任务。舰船类型取决于你所在的帝国空间。没有理由通过门，因为它只会将你送回第1个房间。外交人员被送入伊芙姐妹会舰船后任务即完成。方法：速刷：使用快速护卫舰或拦截舰。在第1个房间接上外交官。返回跃迁入场点，将其放下，然后跃迁离开。任务完成。消灭海军舰船：你可以不立即返回入口起点，而是去驾驶你选择的舰船来击杀跃迁入场点的所有敌人。只需确保将获救的外交官转移到你的战斗舰船货舱中。返回跃迁入场点/任务入口后，你可以用大型舰船击杀所有敌人并放下外交官。如果你想与NPC交战，选择米玛塔尔的；它们明显更容易摧毁和抗怪。ISK：艾玛赏金：战利品：7.7M ISK的徽章及其他掉落，1.4M ISK的打捞件 米玛塔尔赏金：战利品：12.7M ISK的徽章及其他掉落，920k ISK的打捞件 声望：在第2个房间击杀舰船不会损失声望。分类：安全任务

A Gnosis can clear the mission before they spawn. The following were obtained from a full sweep: Republic Fleet Captain Insignia I x2 Republic Fleet Commander Insignia I x2 Republic Fleet High Captain Insignia I x15 Republic Fleet Private Insignia II x4 In addition, various other loot is dropped in the form of meta modules and assorted Minmatar ammo. Salvage is also decent. Total loot value comes up to about 29,300,000 ISK. Most of this value, 27 million of it, comes from the tags, with salvage of 1.3 million, and 1 million of modules. https://evepraisal.com/a/11pide (no salvage) Category:Storyline missions

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: This mission does not have acceleration gates. Distances and directions of enemies are relative to the warp-in point of the mission. Being part of a fleet (even if it's only a fleet of just yourself) and warping the squad/wing/fleet to the mission "to within 30 km" from the southeast will put you at close range to all waves. Warping the squad/wing/fleet to the mission "to within" some distance from the north, northwest, or west will increase your initial distance from all waves. The most recent editor of this page forgot to check if the mission is in deadspace; warping to zero on a fleetmate in the mission might instead warp you to zero on the mission warp-in point. The elite cruisers, renamed Divine Imperial Justicar and Divine Imperial Ambrose, have a noticeable amount of armor repair. If running this mission as part of a fleet, then tagging targets and focusing fire is recommended. Category:Security missions

guides.objective: Take the preacher called Tolmak (Preacher 1 ) from the Yunshin Z refining complex to your agent.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The damage output is significant. Good tank recommended. No faction standings penalty for destroying the enemies. No bounties for destroying ships. Blitz: Kill all enemies of wave 1 in the first pocket. Ignore NPCs in the second pocket, grab the preacher from the Preacher's Quarters (container), and warp out.

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: The pocket starts off empty. After a few seconds, 8 enemy cruisers spawn, but two of them are scripted to blow up when the friendly cruisers arrive. The friendly cruisers simply stay in the pocket and do not engage the enemies. About 20 seconds after out of warp. After disposing of the last enemy in the initial wave, five additional enemy cruisers spawn. The gate will be unlocked at this point, and thus engaging the second wave is optional. About 30 seconds after hostiles wave 1

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: The objective is in the Preacher's Quarters, which you can loot without engaging the enemies. Note for blitzing, you have to wait a bit (until a message popup? ). "Bring Preacher to Agent Name " from the mission tracker indicates the completion of the quest, after this you can warp out and complete the quest. Category:Security missions

rows.name: Scions of the Superior Gene
rows.trigger: Last one destroyed triggers hostiles wave 2

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 伤害输出很高。建议良好的抗性。摧毁敌人不会导致派系声望惩罚。摧毁舰船没有赏金。速刷：在第一房间消灭第一波所有敌人。忽略第二房间的NPC，从传道所（容器）中拿到传道者，然后跳走。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 房间开始时是空的。几秒后，8艘敌方巡洋舰刷新，但其中两艘被脚本设定为在友方巡洋舰到达时自动爆炸。友方巡洋舰只是留在房间中，不与敌人交战。跃迁退出后约20秒。处理完初始波次的最后一个敌人后，额外刷新5艘敌方巡洋舰。此时星门将被解锁，因此是否交战第二波是可选的。敌对第一波后约30秒

sections.heading: 第二房间
sections.text: 目标在传道所中，你可以不与敌人交战直接搜刮。速刷注意，你需要等待一会儿（直到弹出消息？）。任务追踪器中的"将传道者带给代理人姓名"表示任务完成，之后你可以跳走并完成任务。类别：安全任务

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * Group 2 may aggro drones that have attacked Group 1. * No structures drop loot. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 备注
sections.text: * 第二编队可能对攻击过第一编队的无人机产生仇恨。 * 没有建筑掉落战利品。 类别：安全任务

guides.title: The Left Hook

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Destroy the Gallente Tactical Support Center and ignore all rats.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text: * Mission may be run in a sniper fit Manticore (stealth bomber). Orbit at max range, shoot the Tactical Support Center and speed tank all NPCs. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 速刷：摧毁加来战术支援中心，忽略所有敌人。

sections.heading: 注意
sections.text: * 任务可以使用狙击配置的Manticore（隐形轰炸机）完成。在最大距离环绕，射击战术支援中心，用速度抗性扛住所有NPC。 类别：安全任务

guides.title: The Missing Convoy
guides.objective: Destroy the Lesser Drone Hive, loot the special delivery package (0.1 ), and then report back to your agent.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Destroy the lesser drone hive (85km away), pick up contents (from cargo container). No hostiles at the initial gate

sections.heading: Single pocket
sections.text: * After warp-in, only three towers, groups spawn every few seconds * No aggro on warp-in * Aggro on any group except towers does not trigger others 714px|border|alt=Positions of NPC groups in pocket Other structures have no loot * Attacking the towers aggros entire pocket Choice of aggro: shoot the shield before the last group spawns, and you will only have aggro from group 2 until the shield dies (then groups 6+7 join in); alternatively, wait until after the last group spawned before shooting the shield for full stage aggro and safe drone usage. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 速刷：摧毁小型无人机蜂巢（85公里外），拾取内容物（从货物容器中）。初始星门处无敌对目标

sections.heading: 单一房间
sections.text: * 跃迁进入后，只有三座塔，编队每隔几秒刷新一次 * 跃迁进入时无仇恨 * 对除塔以外的任何编队产生仇恨不会触发其他编队 714px|border|alt=房间中NPC编队的位置 其他建筑没有战利品 * 攻击塔会引起整个房间的仇恨 仇恨选择：在最后一组编队刷新前射击护盾，你只会有第二编队的仇恨直到护盾被摧毁（然后第六和第七编队加入）；或者等到最后一组编队刷新后再射击护盾以获得全阶段仇恨并安全使用无人机。类别：安全任务

guides.title: The Missing Reporters
guides.objective: Acquire these goods: 5x Gallente Corpse

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: All enemies are designated as "Escort" ships, scanning or showing info reveals their type. Objective is ship wreckage 60-70km Warning: -0.48 Standing Loss with Caldari State; 2 x -0.24 for Ship Kill. Note : You can not access ship wreckage while it is guarded - no way to avoid Caldari ship destruction (and standing loss). Frigates may not do webbing (sometimes).

sections.heading: The Missing Reporters - Bad Timing (2 of 3)
sections.text: Blitz: Do not attack any ships! Just Destroy the "Local Prison" structure as quickly as possible then warp away. During your assault on the prison, everything will start shooting at you. For this reason it is safest to pre-align then insta-warp when it detonates. Wait a minute then warp back to the mission. This time there should be zero aggro so you can go and pick up the contents of the dropped storage containers at your leisure, then turn in the mission. If you're in a well-tanked ship, like a battlecruiser, you can safely approach it to 0m and then attack it. You should have way enough tank to loot the can and warp out in time, on my attempt I warped out with 85% shield left. Shooting all ships leads to a total Standing Loss of -0.6 with the Angel Cartel (2 x -0.3 for Ship Kills). Incurred a further -0.3 Standing Loss with the Angel Cartel from destroying Prison.

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: * 6 groups, each guarding a structure, one of the structures is the target (Designated as "Local Prison") * Shooting Local Prison will aggro everything. Maneuvering and shooting one group will aggro only that group * Drones should not cause aggro

sections.heading: The Missing Reporters - Slavers Beware (3 of 3)
sections.text: Blitz: Just kill the slave traders and take the can.

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: Mining: Veldspar - 23 asteroids Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 单一房间
sections.text: 所有敌人被标记为"护航"舰船，扫描或显示信息可揭示其类型。目标是舰船残骸，60-70公里外 警告：与加达里共和国声望下降-0.48；2次-0.24的舰船击杀。注意：舰船残骸在被守卫时无法访问——无法避免摧毁加达里舰船（及声望损失）。护卫舰可能不会进行网子攻击（有时）。

sections.heading: 失踪的记者 - 时机不对（3之2）
sections.text: 速刷：不要攻击任何舰船！尽快摧毁"当地监狱"建筑然后跳走。在你攻击监狱期间，所有东西都会开始射击你。因此最安全的做法是预先对准方向，然后在监狱爆炸时立即跳走。等待一分钟后跳回任务。这次应该没有仇恨，你可以从容地拾取掉落的储存容器中的内容物，然后交付任务。如果你驾驶抗性充足的舰船，如战列巡洋舰，你可以安全地接近到0米然后攻击它。你应该有足够的抗性来搜刮罐子并及时跳走，在我的尝试中我跳走时护盾还剩85%。击毁所有舰船会导致与天使企业联合体声望总共下降-0.6（2次-0.3的舰船击杀）。摧毁监狱还导致与天使企业联合体声望进一步下降-0.3。

sections.heading: 单一房间
sections.text: * 6个编队，每个守护一个建筑，其中一个建筑是目标（标记为"当地监狱"） * 射击当地监狱会引起所有敌人仇恨。移动和射击一个编队只会引起该编队的仇恨 * 无人机不会引起仇恨

sections.heading: 失踪的记者 - 奴隶贩子小心了（3之3）
sections.text: 速刷：直接杀死奴隶贩子，拿走罐子。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: An Advantageous Catastrophe is a Level 4 mission involving combat against the Gallente Federation. Video: Sentry Dominix

sections.heading: Details
sections.text: No aggro on warp-in. The mission objective is marked as complete once the last battleship in Wave 3 has been destroyed. Killing a random battleship will trigger Wave 2, and killing the last battleship in Wave 1 will trigger Wave 3. The orbits at 50-55km, and has an optimal range of 45km. The and should be dealt with first, as their sensor dampening and web/scram capabilities can greatly reduce both a ship's combat effectiveness and ability to escape.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Extravaganza is a mission involving combat against the Angel Cartel. Example clear videos can be found featuring a Sentry Dominix, Paladin and Gila, 07-03-2021]

sections.heading: Blitz
sections.text: * Pocket 1: Kill the Scanner Post, then kill the initial ships and wave 1. * Pocket 2: Kill all ships. * Pocket 3: Kill the Battleship, ignore everything else. * Pocket 4: Kill the Silo (bookmark the can) and the Radio Telescope, then kill all ships. * Pocket 5: Kill the Battleships, starting with the highest bounty of each group to trigger spawns, kill Tiogo Kargaz you're done.

sections.heading: Details
sections.text: Notes: * Bring an Angel Diamond Tag to unlock the Bonus pocket gate. * Auto aggro from initial groups in every room. The spawns may target your drones. * No Hostiles at initial gate. * Identifying the spawn trigger may be tricky, it is usually the highest bounty Battleship yet not always or could be one that flies differently. * Fit for DPS, tanking doesn't require much, with the exception of bonus room.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Acceleration gate to next pocket is at 13km. The acceleration gate is locked until all ships are dead. Tip: Killing the Scanner Post will remove the 2nd wave.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Acceleration gate to next pocket is at 5km. The gate is locked until all ships are destroyed.

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket
sections.text: Acceleration gate to next pocket is at 5km. One battleship with multiple sentries. Killing the battleship unlocks the gate so the sentries do not need to be killed. The towers are spread out between 15-70km from the gate.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: Multiple waves. Every one of the battleships triggers the next wave. Tips: * Blow up the Storage Silo and the Radio Telescope and the spawns won't appear. * Storage Silo will drop a random Hardwiring Implant (3% bonus) and T1 modules.

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: Multiple waves. Every time the last battleship of a wave triggers next wave. Mission is completed once Tiogo Kargaz is killed. Bonus pocket: * The acceleration gate leads to the Bonus Pocket. * Fleet members may use the acceleration gate without the tag if they do it within 10 seconds after activation.

sections.heading: Bonus Pocket
sections.text: Bring an Angel Diamond Tag to unlock the Bonus pocket gate! Fit with either very high DPS to take out most of the aggro, or with a massive tank to not worry about that. Move away from the Angel Bunker to buy you a bit of time to kill the sentries as the enemy ships try to close in. Eliminating all the Angel Cruise Missile Batteries and Tower Sentry Angel III first will negate a significant portion of the incoming damage. Do not kill the Gist Seraphim trigger, wait until you have cleared the pocket from all other hostile targets. The Single Spawn isn't triggered if you destroy the Angel Bunker before Killing the Gist Seraphim. Depending on the spawns, damage is Explosive (49- 55%)/ Kinetic (22- 28%)/ EM (7- 14%)/ Thermal (9- 15%). The Sentry Towers deal equal EM/ Thermal. Angel Cruise Batteries, Arch Gistii Ruffian, and Gistatis Tribunis deal lots of Thermal. Angel Viper, Gistatis Legatus, Gist Malakim, and Gist Throne deal EM. Removing these may help your tank, depending on how you decide to set up. Tips: * Angel Cruise Missile Batteries spam Cataclysm Cruise Missiles every 25 secs. Each missile deals 900 Thermal damage at 0% resist. * Angel Light Missile Battery fire Piranha Light Missiles. * Tower Sentry Angel III fires every 2- 3 sec, each hit deals 80- 250 Explosive damage at 0% resist. Angel Battle Station & Angel Bunker drop T1 modules and ammo. The Angel Battle Station has over 400k hp and has not been observed to drop anything of significant value so it may not be worth destroying. Loot (with Bonus Pocket): ± 17.4M ISK (2025-04-21) By Verum Peto Salvage (With Bonus

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使盛筵是一个涉及与天使企业联合体战斗的任务。可参考哨兵多米尼克斯、圣骑士和吉拉的清理视频示例，2021-07-03]

sections.heading: 速刷
sections.text: * 房间 1：摧毁扫描站，然后击杀初始船只和第 1 波次。* 房间 2：击杀所有船只。* 房间 3：击杀战列舰，忽略其他所有目标。* 房间 4：摧毁储存筒仓（对罐子做书签）和射电望远镜，然后击杀所有船只。* 房间 5：击杀战列舰，从每组最高赏金开始触发波次，击杀 Tiogo Kargaz 即完成。

sections.heading: 详情
sections.text: 注意事项：* 携带天使钻石标签以解锁奖励房间大门。* 每个房间的初始编组会自动吸引仇恨。增援波次可能会锁定你的无人机。* 初始大门处无敌对目标。* 识别增援触发目标可能较困难，通常是赏金最高的战列舰，但并非总是如此，也可能是飞行方式不同的那艘。* 装配以输出为主，除奖励房间外防御压力不大。

sections.heading: 第 1 房间
sections.text: 通往下一个房间的加速轨道在 13km 处。加速轨道在所有船只被消灭前处于锁定状态。提示：摧毁扫描站可移除第 2 波次。

sections.heading: 第 2 房间
sections.text: 通往下一个房间的加速轨道在 5km 处。大门在所有船只被摧毁前处于锁定状态。

sections.heading: 第 3 房间
sections.text: 通往下一个房间的加速轨道在 5km 处。一艘战列舰配合多个哨兵。击杀战列舰即可解锁大门，无需击杀哨兵。炮塔分布在距大门 15-70km 范围内。

sections.heading: 第 4 房间
sections.text: 多个波次。每艘战列舰触发下一波次。提示：* 摧毁储存筒仓和射电望远镜后增援不会出现。* 储存筒仓会掉落随机硬件植入体（3% 加成）和 T1 模块。

sections.heading: 第 5 房间
sections.text: 多个波次。每波次最后一艘战列舰触发下一波次。击杀 Tiogo Kargaz 后任务完成。奖励房间：* 加速轨道通往奖励房间。* 舰队成员可在激活后 10 秒内无需标签使用加速轨道。

sections.heading: 奖励房间
sections.text: 携带天使钻石标签以解锁奖励房间大门！装配极高输出以快速消灭大部分仇恨目标，或装配超强防御以无惧仇恨。远离天使地堡以争取时间击杀哨兵，同时敌舰会试图靠近。优先消灭所有天使巡航导弹炮台和天使 III 型塔哨兵可大幅降低 incoming 伤害。不要击杀吉斯特炽天使触发目标，等到清除房间内所有其他敌对目标后再处理。如果在击杀吉斯特炽天使之前摧毁天使地堡，则单一生成不会出现。根据生成情况，伤害类型为爆炸（49-55%）/ 动能（22-28%）/ 电磁（7-14%）/ 热能（9-15%）。哨兵塔造成等量电磁/热能伤害。天使巡航导弹炮台、吉斯蒂暴徒和吉斯塔蒂斯执法官造成大量热能伤害。天使毒刺、吉斯塔蒂斯使者、吉斯特马拉金和吉斯特王座造成电磁伤害。根据你的装配方案，消灭这些目标可能有助于维持防御。提示：* 天使巡航导弹炮台每 25 秒发射大灾变巡航导弹。每枚导弹在 0% 抗性下造成 900 热能伤害。* 天使轻型导弹炮台发射食人鱼轻型导弹。* 天使 III 型塔哨兵每 2-3 秒发射一次，每次命中在 0% 抗性下造成 80-250 爆炸伤害。天使战斗站和天使地堡掉落 T1 模块和弹药。天使战斗站拥有超过 40 万生命值，据观察未掉落过有价值的物品，可能不值得摧毁。战利品（含奖励房间）：约 1740 万 ISK（2025-04-21）由 Verum Peto 提供 打捞（含奖励

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Are You Receiving? is a Level 4 combat consisting of three sub-missions. It involves combat against the Angel Cartel and Amarr Empire.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 你在接收吗？是一个包含三个子任务的 4 级战斗任务。涉及与天使企业联合体和阿玛尔帝国的战斗。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Gila 2021-06-09, Maelstrom (Arty), Ishtar (Blitz), Raven Navy Issue, Sentry Dominix, Paladin Single ungated pocket. When you warp in it turns out the convoy you were supposed to escort is no more. Your task is to destroy the rogue drones that killed the convoy. No blitzing, you must kill all drones to complete the mission. Tips: * To manage aggro, do not kill the trigger ships all at once. Eliminate the incoming reinforcement spawn first, before you trigger the next spawn. * You can snipe or out run the Supreme Alvus Battleships. Their max attack distance is around 35 km, and they move very slowly. * You may [Fleet] warp at a preferred range and snipe. Spawns and rats: * Initial group appears and auto aggro after a delay. * Each ship killed from the initial group triggers one of the spawns. * All spawns auto aggro and may aggro Drones and Fleet Members, keep an eye on your drones. * The order, ship amount and names of the spawns will vary. In total you will be facing 10 battleships. All at once if you so trigger. It is very much recommended to not trigger all at once.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：吉拉 2021-06-09，飓风级（火炮），伊什塔（速刷），乌鸦级海军型，哨兵多米尼克斯，圣骑士 单一无门控房间。跃入后发现你本应护航的舰队已全军覆没。你的任务是消灭摧毁舰队的自由无人机。无法速刷，必须击杀所有无人机才能完成任务。提示：* 为管理仇恨，不要同时击杀所有触发船只。先消灭 incoming 增援波次，再触发下一波次。* 你可以远程狙击或风筝 Supreme Alvus 级战列舰。其最大攻击距离约 35km，且移动速度极慢。* 你可以[舰队]跃迁至偏好距离后远程狙击。生成和敌人：* 初始编组在延迟后出现并自动吸引仇恨。* 击杀初始编组中的每艘船会触发一个增援波次。* 所有增援自动吸引仇恨，可能吸引无人机和舰队成员的仇恨，注意你的无人机。* 增援的顺序、数量和名称会有变化。总共你将面对 10 艘战列舰。如果全部触发则同时出现。强烈建议不要同时触发所有波次。

sections.text: 无。所有可开采小行星已于 2023 年或之前从此任务中移除。

guides.objective: Destroy all enemy ships and Blood Farm

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Ishtar blitz, Cerberus, Dominix, Gila 2021-04-23] Single ungated pocket. Important Note: All rats in this mission have 60%+ (often 70%+) lowest resistance (explosive) and resistance is same for shield and armor! Tips: * Snipers can warp [fleet] at range. All groups and spawns will auto-aggro. * Set your drones to passive to keep them from taking out trigger ships that could cause swarming, and watch them for frequent aggro. * The last Hostile killed of a ship class triggers the next spawn unless marked otherwise. * Following the trigger sequence is advisable for a sniper too, since even the Battleships move in fast. * The Frigate spawn may not show up. * Mission is flagged completed after you have killed the last Battleship. * As usual divert Drone aggro by pulling them in for a second. Remote Shield Booster is an option for Sentries. * The naming convention under the Overview for Type and Name are swapped. This results in Angel Destroyer being seen as the default name, instead of Gistior Seizer. Optional Approach: * Use Micro Jump Drive as it's much easier to take everything out from a distance. Blitz: * Kill the initial group, ignore the elite frigates, and focus on the reinforcement wave (triggered by the frigate). * You may want to kill some or all of the elite cruisers and battlecruisers to reduce incoming damage. * Kill the disruptor frigates and all the battleships, done. Confirm trigger accuracy?? 5 December 2025: Destroying elite cruisers triggered destroyer wave.

sections.heading: Loot, Salvage and Bounty
sections.text: Loot: 1-14 million Note: Loot for this mission is highly luck dependent. You can get several Clutch Restrained/ Pitfall Compact Warp Field Disruption Generators, worth around 2.7-2.8 million each. On one run I got 4 of these in total and ended up with 13.9 million ISK in loot as a result. Salvage: ~1.4 mil Bounty: ~10 mil Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：伊什塔速刷，塞纳波斯，多米尼克斯，吉拉 2021-04-23] 单一无门控房间。重要提示：此任务中所有敌人的最低抗性（爆炸）均为 60%+（通常 70%+），且护盾和装甲抗性相同！提示：* 狙击手可[舰队]跃迁至远距离。所有编组和增援会自动吸引仇恨。* 将无人机设为被动模式，避免击杀可能导致蜂群的触发船只，并频繁关注其仇恨。* 每种舰船类别的最后一个被击杀的敌对目标触发下一波次增援，除非另有说明。* 即使对战列舰而言也建议按触发顺序推进，因为它们移动速度很快。* 护卫舰增援可能不会出现。* 击杀最后一艘战列舰后任务标记为完成。* 与往常一样，通过短暂拉仇恨来转移无人机仇恨。哨兵可使用远程护盾助推器。* 概述中类型和名称的命名惯例是颠倒的。这导致天使驱逐舰被显示为默认名称，而非 Gistior Seizer。可选方案：* 使用微型跳跃引擎，从远处逐个消灭敌人更为轻松。速刷：* 击杀初始编组，忽略精英护卫舰，集中攻击增援波次（由护卫舰触发）。* 你可能需要击杀部分或全部精英巡洋舰和战列巡洋舰以降低 incoming 伤害。* 击杀扰断护卫舰和所有战列舰，完成。确认触发准确性？？2025 年 12 月 5 日：摧毁精英巡洋舰触发了驱逐舰波次。

sections.heading: 战利品、打捞和赏金
sections.text: 战利品：100-1400 万 注意：此任务的战利品高度依赖运气。你可能获得多个 Clutch Restrained/Pitfall Compact 跃迁场干扰发生器，每个价值约 270-280 万。有一次我总共获得了 4 个，最终战利品达到 1390 万 ISK。打捞：约 140 万 赏金：约 1000 万 分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Gila 2021-04-18] Blitz: * Warp to the mission in a shuttle or fast frigate with a MWD. * Approach and open the Warehouse container, align, loot and warp out.

sections.heading: Single ungated Pocket
sections.text: Looting the Quafe Ultra from the Warehouse (40km) triggers the spawn, potentially scrambling you. A second [optional] spawn is triggered by killing the Destroyer (Corpior Friar). Beware that this spawn has up to 6 Battleships with Nosferatus on top of the container, so if you intend to fight be prepared to warp out before you get capped out (beware of warp disruptors). The battleships are also of the more stronger variants. Combined with neuts they pose a serious threath. Optional Approach: Loot the Warehouse with a shuttle, come back with a Battleship, Micro Jump and snipe if needed. Done with a T2 fit Dominix from warp in (~646 DPS, 112.9 ehp/s rep, 16 min cap). If you can get outside their effective gun range (about 40 km) you can easily snipe them safely.

sections.heading: Mining
sections.text: 60 Veldspar asteroids (18- 65km). Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
