guides.title: Dread Pirate Scarlet
guides.ewar: ECM (Guristas), dampening (Serpentis), Target painting (Angel), Elite frigates (last pocket)
guides.objective: Kill Anire Scarlet

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: [Ishtar (Blitz) July 2014], [Raven Navy Issue April 2016], [Sentry Dominix June 2018], [Gila May 2021], [Manticore (Blitz) April 2024] Every pocket in this mission has ships from one randomly selected faction. Your fit should be able to fight with all of them. You can bring an extra Gate Key to skip warpin area or to give to fleet members. The mission pockets are semi deadspace. This means that you can warp within a pocket grid but any warps from outside the pocket will land on the warpin area. Blitz: * Bring your own gate key and skip first room. * Rush to acceleration gates and make your way to last room. All gates are open. * Kill Scarlet and return to agent.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: The gate deeper into the mission requires one Gate Key. The key is dropped by last battleship. The key is not consumed on use so you can keep it and skip fighting at warpin next time you get this mission. you can warp in at distance to snipe. At first some merchants are on the gate. The hostiles arrive soon. The hostiles are either Serpentis ships or Angel ships.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: You will see Anire Scarlet when you warp in but she will warp to the next pocket once a hostile module of any kind is activated on her. However, you can kill her here if you can do so with one volley from grouped turrets. She will leave a normal wreck, but not the additional jet can with the +3 Charisma implant. Despite this, she will be present in the next pocket. This room contains either Guristas ships or Blood Raider ships. Gate to next room is not locked so you can skip combat. The gate is 29 km away.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: You can see Anire again when you warp in. This time you will have enough time to get one or two shots at her. If you have enough DPS you can kill her here and complete the mission prematurely. If you manage to kill her here you will be able to loot an +3 charisma implant from her wreck. Anire Scarlet is most vulnerable to EM/Thermal damage; it is advisable to preload EMP ammo or Mjolnir missiles before warping into the pocket. Any fit that can deal at least 1000 DPS EM or can do at least 7-8k alpha in EM damage should be able to accomplish this. This room contains initially either Serpentis ships or Serpentis and Guristas ships. Regardless of which are present first more Guristas battleships will spawn as reinforcement. The gate to next room is again unlocked. The gate is 19 km away.

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: Last pocket. This time Anire Scarlet has nowhere to run to so you can finish her. The initial defenders are from a random faction. The spawn's faction is based on the initial defender's faction, if Guristas, then the spawn will be Blood Raider, if Angels then Serpentis. Anire Scarlet deals about 2-3x the damage of a normal NPC battlecruiser at 28km range. Note: Scarlet's Station does not drop loot. The Angel/Guristas spawns will be roughly 50-75 km away from you. Blood Raiders/Serpentis spawns will be further, at ~100 km. Duration, Loot, Salvage (Sept 2020) Ship Fit Used: Praxis Duration: 85mins (2 jumps away, salvaging of 10 minutes included) Loot: 10mil Salvage: 5mil Bounty: 29mil Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：[Ishtar（速刷）July 2014]、[Raven Navy Issue April 2016]、[Sentry Dominix June 2018]、[Gila May 2021]、[Manticore（速刷）April 2024] 此任务的每个房间都有来自随机选择一个派系的舰船。你的装配应该能与所有派系作战。你可以携带额外的门禁钥匙来跳过跃迁入口区域或给舰队成员。任务房间为半死亡空间。这意味着你可以在房间网格内跃迁，但从房间外部的任何跃迁都会落在跃迁入口区域。速刷：* 自带门禁钥匙并跳过第一个房间。* 冲向加速轨道并前进到最后一个房间。所有加速轨道都是开放的。* 击杀Scarlet并返回代理人。

sections.heading: 跃迁入口
sections.text: 深入任务的加速轨道需要一把门禁钥匙。钥匙由最后一艘战列舰掉落。钥匙使用后不消耗，因此你可以保留它，下次接到此任务时跳过跃迁入口区域的战斗。你可以跃迁到远距离进行远程狙击。最初有一些商人在加速轨道处。敌对很快就会到达。敌对为天蛇舰船或天使舰船。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入时你会看到Anire Scarlet，但一旦对她激活任何类型的攻击性模块，她就会跃迁到下一个房间。不过，如果你能通过炮组的一次齐射击杀她，你可以在这里杀死她。她会留下一个普通残骸，但不会留下装有+3魅力植入体的额外喷射集装箱。尽管如此，她会出现在下一个房间。这个房间包含古斯塔斯舰船或血袭者舰船。通往下一个房间的加速轨道未锁定，因此你可以跳过战斗。加速轨道在29 km外。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入时你可以再次看到Anire。这次你有足够的时间对她进行一到两次射击。如果你有足够DPS，可以在这里击杀她并提前完成任务。如果你成功在这里击杀她，你将能从她的残骸中拾取+3魅力植入体。Anire Scarlet最弱于电磁/热能伤害；建议在跃迁进入房间前预装EMP弹药或妙尔尼尔导弹。任何能造成至少1000 DPS电磁伤害或至少7-8k电磁齐射伤害的装配都应该能完成这个操作。这个房间初始包含天蛇舰船或天蛇和古斯塔斯舰船。无论初始出现的是哪种，更多古斯塔斯战列舰将作为增援刷新。通往下一个房间的加速轨道同样未锁定。加速轨道在19 km外。

sections.heading: 第3个房间
sections.text: 最后一个房间。这次Anire Scarlet无处可逃，你可以击杀她。初始防御者来自随机派系。增援的派系基于初始防御者的派系，如果是古斯塔斯，则增援为血袭者；如果是天使，则增援为天蛇。Anire Scarlet在28km射程造成约2-3倍于普通NPC战列巡洋舰的伤害。注意：斯卡蕾特的空间站不掉落战利品。天使/古斯塔斯增援将在距你约50-75 km处刷新。血袭者/天蛇增援将在更远约100 km处刷新。耗时、战利品、打捞（2020年9月） 使用装配：Praxis 耗时：85分钟（2跳距离，包含10分钟打捞） 战利品：10mil 打捞：5mil 赏金：29mil 分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Sentry Dominix, Gila, 31-03-2021] Single ungated pocket. You can [Fleet] warp to preferred distance. Auto aggro from Initial Group and spawns. * The initial formation is composed of three groups with a Cruiser and a Battleship in each. * Each Cruiser killed will trigger a spawn wave. * Each wave is composed of four spawns for a total of 12 spawns. * Reminder: set your drones to passive to avoid triggering a swarm. AI of this mission seems to be different from most missions, as scooping sentry drone to bay and re-releasing them will not move aggro from drone to ship. An active hostile module is necessary to keep aggro at ship. * Spawn composition and distance may vary with each wave. * To manage aggro, work on a single chain of 4 waves/spawns, then kill the next Crusader from Initial defenders to cause spawn of subsequent chain. Flag the Cruisers at the beginning to make it easier to keep an eye on the triggers. * The mission is flagged complete once you have killed ALL hostile ships, so you have to destroy the EoM Death Lord from all chains. * Deathlord (last wave) uses missile over 100km range

sections.text: 视频：Sentry Dominix, Gila, 31-03-2021] 单一无门房间。你可以[舰队]跃迁到理想距离。初始编队和刷新的自动仇恨。* 初始编队由三组组成，每组有一艘巡洋舰和一艘战列舰。* 每击杀一艘巡洋舰会触发一波刷新。* 每波由四个刷新组成，共计12个刷新。* 提示：将无人机设置为被动模式以避免触发蜂群。此任务的AI似乎与大多数任务不同，因为将哨兵无人机收回无人机舱再重新释放不会将仇恨从无人机转移到舰船。需要保持激活攻击性模块以使仇恨持续锁定在舰船上。* 刷新的编成和距离可能随每波变化。* 为管理仇恨，先处理一条链中的4波/刷新，然后击杀初始防御者中的下一个十字军以触发后续链的刷新。在开始时标记巡洋舰，以便更容易关注触发者。* 击杀所有敌对舰船后任务即标记为完成，因此你需要消灭所有链中的EoM死亡领主。* 死亡领主（最后一波）使用超过100km射程的导弹

sections.text: Videos: [Gila 26-08-2021], [Ishtar 4 August 2014], [Navy Raven 20 March 2014], [Vargur Full Clear 26 August 2012] Blitz: * Pocket 1 - Destroy all ships. * Pocket 2 - Destroy the Ion Field Projection Battery and Moon Harvester, then kill all ships. * Pocket 3 - Destroy the Guristas Medium Refinery, Subspace Frequency Generator, and Asteroid Mining Post. Then kill all ships. * Pocket 4 - Destroy the Starbase Storage Facility, Starbase Reactor, and Guristas Starbase Control Tower. Then kill all ships. * Pocket 5 - Kill all Battleships and Battlecruisers from the first spawn. Notes: * Structures drop no loot, with the exception of those in Pocket 5 and the Ion projections and Moon harvester. * Asteroid Factory has a lot of armor and there's no point in shooting it. * As of the Trinity 1.2 Update the Guristas Storage Facility no longer drops faction loot. * Many of the frigates (Kyoukan/Webifier) in the earlier waves of each pockets only do little damages and doesn't web (Jan 5th 2025).

Blitz: * Eliminate all ships in the 1st pocket to unlock the warp gate. * Eliminate all ships in the 2nd group and destroy the Bunker, done. * You do not have to kill the third and furthest group in the second pocket.

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: Auto aggro from the 1st group, 2nd group remains neutral. The warp gate to the next pocket is ~33km away and locked until all hostiles are cleared. If you get stuck colliding with the structures when you try to use the acceleration gate, just blow up the structure that is stopping the warp. The large structure has less HP than you may assume.

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: Destroy group 2 and the bunker next to them to complete the mission. The battleships on the side belong to group 2. * Attacking the 2nd Group (or its bunker) will aggro the entire pocket. * Attacking either the 1st or 3rd group will aggro the other group (3rd or 1st). * Drones that get too close to any remaining neutral group will be attacked.

sections.heading: 第一个区域
sections.text: 第一组自动仇恨，第二组保持中立。通往下一区域的跃迁门约33公里外，在所有敌对目标被清除前处于锁定状态。如果你在尝试使用加速轨道时因与结构体碰撞而卡住，直接摧毁阻挡跃迁的结构体。大型结构体的生命值可能比你想的要少。

sections.heading: 第二个区域
sections.text: 消灭第二组和旁边的掩体以完成任务。侧边的战列舰属于第二组。* 攻击第二组（或其掩体）将仇恨整个区域。* 攻击第一组或第三组将仇恨另一组（第三组或第一组）。* 无人机过于接近任何剩余中立编队时将遭到攻击。

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: * Attacking group 2 aggros entire pocket. * Group 2 is actually two groups so the whole group doesn't need to be killed. sections.text: Space type: Deadspace Video: [Nightmare 2013-03-24], [Machariel 2011-11-04] Note: The mission is reported to be against Amarr, but the Tracking Disruptor ships given are Sansha's Nation They do not appear in the details.. The majority of hostile ships are frigate/destroyer/cruiser class with only a handful of battlecruisers and only a few battleships.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: The warp gate into the pocket is guarded by a small group of ships. They will aggro immediately after you have warped in.

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: Warp in is very near the Acceleration Gate (3500m) Deploying drones to attack Group 1 will aggro Group 2. Group 1 does not always aggro, if it doesn't shooting group 1 will also aggro group 2. Group 2 has a proximity aggro of 25km. Note: No loot from structures

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: Warp in is very near the Acceleration Gate (3500m) Deploying drones to attack Group 1 will aggro the entire pocket.

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: Auto aggro from Group 1. Group 3 will aggro after several seconds. Group 2 (located in the middle) remains neutral. Any drones attacking Group 3 will be targeted and attacked by Group 2. Blitz: Eliminate all ships from Group 3 in pocket 3. Warp out. Tip: Mission is flagged completed after you have eliminated all ships from Group 3.

sections.heading: 跃迁进入
sections.text: 通往区域的跃迁门由一小群舰船守卫。它们会在你跃迁进入后立即仇恨。

sections.heading: 第一个区域
sections.text: 跃迁入口非常靠近加速轨道（3500米）部署无人机攻击第一组将仇恨第二组。第一组不总是主动仇恨，如果不仇恨，射击第一组也会仇恨第二组。第二组有25公里的接近仇恨范围。注意：结构体没有战利品

sections.heading: 第二个区域
sections.text: 跃迁入口非常靠近加速轨道（3500米）部署无人机攻击第一组将仇恨整个区域。

sections.heading: 第三个区域
sections.text: 第一组自动仇恨。第三组将在几秒后仇恨。第二组（位于中间）保持中立。任何攻击第三组的无人机将被第二组锁定并攻击。速刷：消灭第三个区域中第三组的所有舰船。跃迁离开。提示：消灭第三组所有舰船后任务标记为完成。

sections.heading: 注意
sections.text: 当首次发布时（在EVE-Survival上），有人质疑为什么在一个对抗艾玛的任务中加速轨道外会有天使企业联合体的吉斯图姆毁灭者。如果有其他人接到这个任务能确认一下会很有帮助。

sections.text: 来源：; MariaEpiconthe（2009-03-04）：我怀疑天使企业联合体会和艾玛帝国合作，所以如果有人接到这个任务，请告诉我们天使企业联合体的老鼠是否也在你那里，或者这是一个bug还是什么。谢谢 ; StraightChillen（2009-04-15）：我可以确认截至今天，星门处确实有吉斯图姆天使老鼠 ; HappyPants（2013-07-02）：再次确认2只吉斯图姆老鼠，不需要击杀它们就能使用星门，只杀了艾玛老鼠 ; Anonymous（2022-07-14）：确认艾玛老鼠中有2x天使企业联合体巡洋舰。无法确认是否存在电子战。不需要击杀它们中的任何一个，可以直接进入第一个任务房间。thumb|艾玛老鼠中的两艘吉斯图姆巡洋舰 类别：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Nightmare, Machariel, Sentry Dominix Blitz: * All warp gates are locked. Eliminate all groups from pocket 1 & 2. * Eliminate all ships from Group 3 in pocket 3. Warp out. Note: The majority hostile ships are frigate/destroyer/cruiser class with only a handful of battlecruisers and only two battleships. NPCs will aggro drones.

sections.heading: Warpin
sections.text: The warp gate into the pocket is guarded by a small group of ships. They will aggro immediately after you have warped in.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Group 2 has a proximity aggro of 25km. Deploying drones to attack Group 1 will aggro Group 2. No loot from structures. Group 1 does not always aggro. If it doesn't, engaging group 1 will aggro group 2, but group 2 can be safely engaged without aggroing group 1.

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: When you warp in only group 1 is present. The other two group spawns in few seconds. Destroy group 3 on the asteroid station to complete the mission. Auto aggro from Group 1. Group 3 will aggro after several seconds. Group 2 (located in the middle) remains neutral. Any drones attacking Group 3 will be targeted and attacked by Group 2.

sections.heading: Rewards

zh.title: 大规模进攻（萨沙共和国）（4级）

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：Nightmare，Machariel，Sentry Dominix 速刷：* 所有跃迁门锁定。消灭第一和第二个区域中的所有编队。* 消灭第三个区域中第三组的所有舰船。跃迁离开。注意：大多数敌对舰船为护卫舰/驱逐舰/巡洋舰级别，只有少量战列巡洋舰和两艘战列舰。NPC会仇恨无人机。

sections.heading: 跃迁进入
sections.text: 通往区域的跃迁门由一小群舰船守卫。它们会在你跃迁进入后立即仇恨。

sections.heading: 第一个区域
sections.text: 第二组有25公里的接近仇恨范围。部署无人机攻击第一组将仇恨第二组。结构体没有战利品。第一组不总是主动仇恨。如果不仇恨，攻击第一组将仇恨第二组，但第二组可以在不仇恨第一组的情况下安全交战。

sections.heading: 第三个区域
sections.text: 跃迁进入时只有第一组存在。其余两组在几秒后刷新。摧毁小行星空间站上的第三组以完成任务。第一组自动仇恨。第三组将在几秒后仇恨。第二组（位于中间）保持中立。任何攻击第三组的无人机将被第二组锁定并攻击。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: （2021年7月）赏金= 400万 战利品= 60万 打捞物= 250万

sections.heading: 采矿

guides.title: Matriarch
guides.objective: Retrieve Salvaged Electronics

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: For this storyline you are asked to retrieve a mission objective (Salvaged Electronics, 20 m³) which is inside a cloaked cache. After destroying the whole group present, a new spawn will appear. In total there are one initial group (Angels) and three waves (Sanshas) equals four groups. All groups will autoaggro after some seconds. Note: All NPC may aggro your drones, need to be verified. Blitz: Not possible as all the ships have to be killed in order for the cloaked cache to be revealed.

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: After destroying all ships, the sansha's waves start. This is indicated by a message about a cynosural field opening. The cynosural field opens about 25 km from the initial warp in point. After destroying all ships, the next group spawns. After destroying all ships, the final group appears. You'll find a now revealed Bunker labelled "Cloaked Cache" which contains scrap metal and the mission's objective (Salvaged Electronics). Structures: Destroyed Bunkers may drop T1 module(s) and scrap metals. The Watchtowers didn't drop anything. The two battlestations have a lot of hitpoints. Battlestations dropped no loot. Bounty and loot: Bounty: ≈8M Loot: ≈2-3M Salvage: ≈3-4M Category:Storyline missions Category:Security missions

groups.name: Decloaked cache after all enemies have been killed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 在这个故事线任务中，你需要取回一个位于隐形储藏箱内的任务目标物品（打捞电子元件，20 m³）。消灭在场的所有敌人群组后，会出现新的刷怪。总共有一组初始敌人（天使企业联合体）和三波增援（萨沙共和国），共计四组敌人。所有敌人群组会在数秒后自动仇恨。注意：所有NPC可能会攻击你的无人机，尚需验证。速刷：不可行，必须击杀所有舰船才能揭示隐形储藏箱。

sections.heading: 单房间
sections.text: 消灭所有舰船后，萨沙共和国的波次开始。这通过一条关于诱导力场开启的消息来提示。诱导力场在初始跃迁点约25 km处开启。消灭所有舰船后，下一组敌人刷新。消灭所有舰船后，最后一组敌人出现。你会发现一个已揭示的堡垒，标记为"隐形储藏箱"，内含废金属和任务目标物品（打捞电子元件）。建筑：被摧毁的堡垒可能掉落T1组件和废金属。瞭望塔没有掉落任何东西。两个战斗空间站有大量生命值。战斗空间站没有掉落战利品。赏金与战利品：赏金：≈8M 战利品：≈2-3M 打捞：≈3-4M 分类：故事线任务 分类：安全等级任务

guides.title: Mining Misappropriation
guides.objective: Destroy everything

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Sentry Dominix, Gila 2021-05-02] Single ungated pocket. You warp-in directly to beacon. You can´t warp to optimal range and also no bookmarks possible. Your mission is to set an example and destroy everything. No blitzing, everything must be destroyed. Since this miner has a defense fleet a Catalyst isn't the ship to use. In the pocket you will find a single Hulk called Illegal Miner. Destroying it triggers a series of spawns. The hulk has impressive shield tank but it will die. Destroying the hulk spawns three battleship. The ships spawn some distance away but they have short range weapons (20 km orbit). Second wave spawns even further away. These have longer range weapons and will orbit at 50 km. Again far spawn that will approach to 50 km orbit. Rewards: Bounty: ~13 Mio ISK Salvage: ~3 Mio ISK Loot: ~6.5 Mio ISK Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：Sentry Dominix, Gila 2021-05-02] 单个无门房间。你直接跃迁到信标处。你无法跃迁到最佳射程，也无法设置书签。你的任务是杀一儆百，消灭所有敌人。不能速刷，必须全部消灭。由于该矿工拥有一支防御舰队，Catalyst不是合适的选择。在房间内你会发现一艘名为Illegal Miner的Hulk。摧毁它会触发一系列刷怪。该Hulk拥有强大的护盾防御，但它最终会被击毁。摧毁Hulk会刷出三艘战列舰。这些舰船在较远处刷新，但它们装备的是短程武器（20 km环绕）。第二波在更远处刷新。这些装备更长程的武器，将在50 km距离环绕。同样是远距离刷新，会接近到50 km环绕。奖励：赏金：~13 Mio ISK 打捞：~3 Mio ISK 战利品：~6.5 Mio ISK 分类：安全等级任务

guides.title: Missing Persons Report
guides.objective: Kill the enemy ships

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: No spawn on entry, can warp at range. Spawn is triggered by approaching the Acceleration Gate (13km, inactive until approached) or the Damaged Gallente Passenger Liner (22km). The gate is unlocked.

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: The Damaged Gallente Passenger Liner is 34km from the warp in beacon but does NOT contain the mission objective. You must destroy all ships in this pocket and loot a Cargo Container that is dropped when the last ship is destroyed. Enemy types and numbers may vary, below is just one example. * Killing the last ship in Group 5 drops a Cargo Container at the Damaged Gallente Passenger Liner. This contains 1 x Survivors which is the mission objective. Tip: Triggering Groups 3 and 4 of Pocket 2 may cause an uncomfortable amount of DPS heading your way. If you had difficulty tanking the first 2 groups of that pocket you might want to call a friend. Something (waiting around or looting the objective?) causes a small amount of AoE damage near the passenger liner that can destroy drones.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Tags: Caldari Navy Admiral Insignia I x36 Caldari Navy Captain Insignia II x4 Caldari Navy Commodore Insignia I x12 Caldari Navy Commodore Insignia II x16 Caldari Navy Midshipman Insignia III x4 (Total value: 83,700,000 ISK). Loot and Salvage: 11,000,000 ISK. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 进入时无敌人，可以保持距离跃迁。接近加速轨道（13km，接近前处于非活跃状态）或受损的盖伦特客轮（22km）会触发刷怪。轨道已解锁。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 受损的盖伦特客轮距离跃迁信标34km，但不包含任务目标物品。你必须消灭该房间内所有舰船，并拾取最后一艘舰船被摧毁时掉落的货物集装箱。敌人类型和数量可能有所不同，以下仅为一个示例。* 击杀第5组最后一艘舰船会在受损的盖伦特客轮处掉落一个货物集装箱。内含1 x 幸存者，即任务目标物品。提示：触发第2房间的第3组和第4组可能会导致大量DPS向你涌来。如果你在前2组时就感到防御吃力，建议叫上一个朋友。某些操作（等待或拾取目标物品？）会在客轮附近造成少量AOE伤害，可能摧毁无人机。

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: No hostiles on the initial acceleration gate. The last Mordus ship drops the mission objective, it's recommended to leave one frigate until the end so picking up takes no time. Every new wave aggros you and your drones, so keep them safe. Mineable Asteroids: Mission contains a field of about 40 Veldspar asteroids with a diameter of around 40 km. Structures: Five Abandoned Containers with t1 loot (usually 1 item per container). Tractor beam doesn't work on them. * Tip: As of 23 Aug YC124 Abandoned Containers contained only Metal Scraps and ammo (hybrid and energy turrets). Bounty: 6.674.000 Loot: Est Price: 12 Mil

sections.heading: Mordu's Folly (Part 2 of 2)
sections.text: Video: Torpedo Golem 2022-06-05 Blitz: Destroy the Caldari Supply Depot. Tip: Even though the mission is against Caldari State, you can run it without standing loss if you only destroy the Caldari Supply Depot. But you have to deal with the ECM from some of the NPCs. Therefore either have good sensor strength or use drones to destroy the structure. As of 23 Aug YC124, Depot defenders do attack drones so watch them carefully. Supply Depot is very tough (above 180k HPs) but explodes when structure strength falls below 75% (armor and shield go to 0%).

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: No aggro on warp-in. If you destroy the depot early, the first battleship reinforcements wave (Bishamon/Shogun) will consist of 4 Bishamon.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: The following dog tags dropped in total. The current value is about 50 million isk. The exact amounts might vary with the exact spawn amounts. Just like the market value might also fluctuate. Supply Depot sometimes drops 10x Science Graduates that are used for building Research Lab module for Upwell structures. Other times, it drops 5x Civilians (with no use that I know of), or 5x Janitors (used in 3 blueprints).

sections.heading: Mordus的愚行（第2部分，共2部分）
sections.text: 视频：Torpedo Golem 2022-06-05 速刷：摧毁加达里补给站。提示：虽然任务是针对加达里合众国的，但如果你只摧毁加达里补给站，可以不掉声望。但你必须应对部分NPC的ECM。因此要么有良好的传感器强度，要么使用无人机摧毁建筑。截至YC124年8月23日，补给站防御者会攻击无人机，所以要小心看管。补给站非常坚硬（超过180k HP），但当结构强度降至75%以下时会爆炸（装甲和护盾归零）。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Raven Single ungated pocket. Auto-aggro on initial group and spawns. Watch out for continuous AoE damage to player ships and drones while in the pocket. Drone ships such as Dominix can not be used at all in this mission. Mission is complete when wave 3 and "Patient Zero" structure are destroyed. Mission is completed also when Patient Zero is destroyed and waves 2 and 3 have not yet been spawned - just leave some ships from spawn 1 alive. Triggers: * Attacking Patient Zero triggers wave 1. * One of the Domination Alvus battleships of wave 1 will trigger wave 2 when destroyed. * Destroying wave 2 will trigger wave 3 (Note: 2018/8/6 - wave 3 didn't arrive at all). * Destroying Patient Zero (and wave 3 if it has been triggered) completes the mission. Tip: Destruction of Patient ends the AoE damage, enabling e.g. salvaging with an alt in a fragile ship or deploying drones to destroy frigate NPCs. Blitz: Destroy Patient Zero without triggering wave 2 or 3. Note: "Patient Zero" structure has very strong resistances and Shield Tank + Armor Tank + Structure Tank (rare occasion) - very hard to destroy ! On 14-Nov-YC124 in Jatate 0.6 system Wave1 arrived after Initial defenders were destroyed (no harm to structure "Patient Zero") and consisted of Frigates + Cruisers + 4x Spearhead Alvus BS + 2x Domination Alvus BS (not as shown in table below). sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: [Dominix May 2020], [Vargur June 2012], [Rattlesnake October 2013], [Gila April 2021], [Manticore (Blitz) April 2024] Single gated pocket. You warp in to an empty pocket but soon find yourself surrounded by a swarm of Hostiles. Group spawn is slightly delayed and distances vary. The spawn order is group 4, 2, 1 and then 3 and 5 (numbered from closest to furthest). Group 1 will auto aggro after some time. Proximity aggro is a major factor in this mission. Please be aware that you can aggro a neutral group by just moving too close to it. The proximity distance for Group 4 is about 80km. It is recommended that you do not move your ship. All other groups remain neutral until attacked or approached. Tip: * Attacking group 1 does not aggro any other groups. * Attacking group 2 will aggro group 3 (and vice-versa). * Attacking group 4 will aggro group 5. * To throw off aggro from group 5, wait until an enemy ship from group 5 has locked your ship. Warp out, then warp back in. * If you have to move be careful not to approach the neutral groups, move up or down as you are surrounded from the sides. * Recommended order of elimination: Group 1, 5 (if you do not warp out to throw-off aggro), 4, 2 and 3. * All ships except Gist Saint and the Battlecruiser come in range of 5-8 km. Great for salvaging afterwards. Short range weapons recommended unless you can kill things before they get in knifefight range. Blitz: Warp in, destroy ships from Group 5 (MJD) and warp out.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Videos:Navy RavenVargurRattlesnakeCNRSentry Dominix Single gated pocket. At warp-in, you will see Group 4. Four other groups will spawn several seconds later. The spawn order is Group 2, Group 1, Group 3 and finally Group 5. It is recommended that you do not move your ship. The proximity aggro bubble for Group 4 is about 80km and you may get aggroed EITHER during warp-in or if you move towards it. Group 1 will auto-aggro immediately. Groups 2, 3, 4 & 5 will remain neutral until attacked or aggroed via proximity. Warning * The two Loyal elite frigates in Group 1 will frequently warp scramble you in under 20 secs. * Proximity aggro is a major factor in this mission. Please be aware that you can aggro a neutral group by just moving into its aggro bubble. Aggro Notes: * Attacking Group 1 does not aggro any other groups. You can safely deploy drones to attack this group. * Attacking Group 2 aggros Group 3 (and vice versa). You can safely deploy drones after the pair have been aggroed. * Attacking Group 4 aggros Group 5 (attacking Group 5 didn't aggro group 4). You can safely deploy drones after the pair have been aggroed. * Group 4 may aggro drones if they get too close to that group. Tips: * Be absolutely careful not to move towards the neutral groups. Move away from them to minimize setting off the proximity aggro * Recommended order of elimination: Group 1, Group 5 & Group 4, finally Group 2 & Group 3. * Mission is flagged completed when ALL ships in Group 5 are killed. Blitz:Destroy all ships from Group 5 and warp out. Kill warp disruptor if needed. Ships ordered by distance

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Pot and Kettle is a 5 part mission chain.

sections.heading: Part 1 of 5
sections.text: Space type: Deadspace Video: Cerberus Part 1, Cerberus Part 2 Kronos - Minimal Amarr Standing Loss Blitz: Kill the Prophecy, warp out.

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: Warp in at about 50km from the nearest group. When you fire on the Prophecy pretty much everything aggros except the Prophecy may not aggro. There are two timed spawn (only a few minutes after you warp in and quickly after each other). Tags (all spawns): * Imperial Navy Sergeant III x 7 * Imperial Navy Major I x 11 * Imperial Navy Colonel I x 34 Standing loss (all spawns): 0.018% with Amarr Empire (per standing tick - can be done in 15 minutes easily with a Paladin for example - did not destroy the towers)

sections.heading: Part 2 of 5 (Mine Sweeper)
sections.text: Space type: Deadspace with Gate Blitz: * For snipers: snipe all of the mines from as far away as you can. Keep shooting the mines until the "Amarrian drone mine 1" spawns. Blow that one up, and mission is completed. (Note: When I did the mission Drones didn't attack until blowing up the last 3 mines - NikalVaszol.) Using this blitz you can do the mission in less than 10 minutes, easily. * For ships with high alpha strike: if you can kill a mine in one volley (by grouping your turrets/launchers), it will not spawn any NPCs. Mines have 1200 hp each. Using this method you can complete the mission in two minutes in absolute safety. There are 6 mines at warp-in 22km - 70km away. After one mine explodes 4 new mines spawn. After shooting 4 more mines there's another spawn of 4 mines + the "Amarrian drone mine 1". After blowing up "Amarrian drone mine 1" the mission is over. Upon firing on the Mines, 4 Amarr Smart Drones (really Rogue Drone Cruisers and Battlecruisers) will appear around the mine, and your ship (and any in your fleet on the grid) will take 600-1000 damage. Destroy the drones after each mine to avoid being swamped. Loot: No loot, 1.4 m3 (3-4M isk worth) of salvage. Standing loss (all spawns): 2.4% with Amarr Empire (per standing tick) for destroying the mines (show as "Amarr Lookout")

sections.heading: Part 3 of 5
sections.text: Possible cargo: (1 Large EMP Smartbomb I, Volume 50m³) (10 Quafe Ultra, Volume 1m³) (1 Design Documents, Volume 0.5m³)

sections.heading: Part 4 of 5
sections.text: Note: If you decline this, you'll get an alternative part 5 of 5. Space type: Deadspace Group 1: These ships are present upon warp-in. They do not cause spawns. These ships are on a timed spawn. Mission is complete when all Amarr Recon Ships are destroyed. Tip: * Outpost Defender drones do 100 DPS each, orbit at 3 km, and will MWD towards you at 2000 m/s. EMP smartbombs can be quite useful here. Tags: * Imperial Navy Sergeant II x 8 * Imperial Navy Midshipman III x 4 * Imperial Navy Major I x 1 * Imperial Navy Colonel I x 19 * Imperial Navy General I x 1 Standing loss: 2.4% with Amarr Empire "for destroying Amarr Empire's Outpost Defender" !

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: You warp in the first pocket using an acceleration gate, no aggro on warp in. There are 3 groups, with increasingly larger size ships, all faction (so no bounty). The 2 groups closest to you (40km and 80km) can be pulled or sniped. If you need to get closer to the 3rd group to pull them (120km) they will aggro you when you are 80 to 90km away. The gate at about 45 km distance is locked, so you need to remove all ships anyway. The optimal range of the battleships is around 40 km usually. Spawns (might be slightly random): Tags (Room 1): * Imperial Navy Sergeant II x 9 * Imperial Navy Major I x 3 * Imperial Navy Colonel I x 11 * Imperial Navy General I x 12 * Imperial Navy General II x 1

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: First group will aggro on warp in (or a few seconds later), 2nd group seems to aggro after group 1 goes. You could pull them together with the other groups if you feel confident, otherwise don't get too close and they will not target you or your drones. Tags (Room 1 + Room 2): * Imperial Navy Colonel I x 23 * Imperial Navy General I x 21 * Imperial Navy General II x 1 * Imperial Navy Major I x 5 * Imperial Navy Sergeant I x 3 * Imperial Navy Sergeant II x 14 * Imperial Navy Sergeant III x 1

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 锅与壶是一个5部分任务链。

sections.heading: 第1部分（共5部分）
sections.text: 空间类型：死亡空间 视频：Cerberus 第1部分，Cerberus 第2部分 Kronos - 艾玛声望最低损失 速刷：击杀Prophecy，跃迁离开。

sections.heading: 单一房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入时距最近编组约50公里。向Prophecy开火后几乎所有船只都会仇恨，但Prophecy本身可能不会仇恨。有两波定时增援（跃迁进入后仅几分钟内且彼此间隔很短）。NPC（所有增援波次）：* Imperial Navy Sergeant III x 7 * Imperial Navy Major I x 11 * Imperial Navy Colonel I x 34 声望损失（所有增援波次）：与艾玛帝国0.018%（每次声望结算——例如用Paladin可轻松在15分钟内完成——未摧毁炮塔）

sections.heading: 第2部分（共5部分）（扫雷）
sections.text: 空间类型：有门死亡空间 速刷：* 狙击配置：从尽可能远的距离狙击所有水雷。持续射击水雷直到"Amarrian drone mine 1"出现。击毁该水雷，任务完成。（注意：我做任务时无人机在炸掉最后3颗水雷前不会攻击——NikalVaszol。）使用此速刷方法可轻松在10分钟内完成任务。* 高齐射伤害配置：如果你能一次齐射摧毁一颗水雷（通过分组炮台/发射器），则不会刷出任何NPC。水雷每颗1200血量。使用此方法可在两分钟内绝对安全地完成任务。跃迁进入时6颗水雷分布在22公里至70公里范围内。一颗水雷爆炸后刷出4颗新水雷。再射掉4颗水雷后又刷出4颗水雷 + "Amarrian drone mine 1"。击毁"Amarrian drone mine 1"后任务结束。向水雷开火时，4艘艾玛智能无人机（实际上是自由无人机巡洋舰和战列巡洋舰）会在水雷周围及你的舰船（以及同网格内舰队中的任何舰船）出现，造成600-1000伤害。每颗水雷击毁后清理无人机以避免被压制。战利品：无战利品，1.4立方米（价值300-400万伊斯基）残骸。声望损失（所有增援波次）：与艾玛帝国2.4%（每次声望结算），因摧毁水雷（显示为"艾玛哨兵"）

sections.heading: 第3部分（共5部分）
sections.text: 可能货物：（1 Large EMP Smartbomb I，体积50立方米）（10 Quafe Ultra，体积1立方米）（1 Design Documents，体积0.5立方米）

sections.heading: 第4部分（共5部分）
sections.text: 注意：如果拒绝此任务，你将获得替代的第5部分（共5部分）。空间类型：死亡空间 第一组：跃迁进入时即存在。不会触发增援。这些船只有定时增援机制。所有艾玛侦察船被摧毁后任务完成。提示：* 前哨防御无人机每艘100 DPS，3公里轨道环绕，并以2000米/秒速度使用微跃引擎靠近你。EMP智能炸弹在此非常有用。NPC：* Imperial Navy Sergeant II x 8 * Imperial Navy Midshipman III x 4 * Imperial Navy Major I x 1 * Imperial Navy Colonel I x 19 * Imperial Navy General I x 1 声望损失：与艾玛帝国2.4%，原因"摧毁艾玛帝国的前哨防御无人机"！

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 你通过加速轨道进入第一个房间，跃迁进入时无仇恨。有3组编队，船只型号逐渐增大，全部为派系船只（因此无赏金）。离你最近的2组（40公里和80公里）可以拉怪或狙击。如果需要靠近第3组来拉怪（120公里），它们在80至90公里时会仇恨你。约45公里距离处的轨道门被锁定，因此你无论如何需要清除所有船只。战列舰的最佳射程通常在40公里左右。增援波次（可能略有随机）：NPC（房间1）：* Imperial Navy Sergeant II x 9 * Imperial Navy Major I x 3 * Imperial Navy Colonel I x 11 * Imperial Navy General I x 12 * Imperial Navy General II x 1

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 第一组将在跃迁进入时仇恨（或几秒后），第二组似乎在第一组被消灭后仇恨。如果你有信心可以将它们与其他编组一起拉过来，否则不要靠太近，它们不会锁定你或你的无人机。NPC（房间1 + 房间2）：* Imperial Navy Colonel I x 23 * Imperial Navy General I x 21 * Imperial Navy General II x 1 * Imperial Navy Major I x 5 * Imperial Navy Sergeant I x 3 * Imperial Navy Sergeant II x 14 * Imperial Navy Sergeant III x 1

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Quota Season is a storyline mission involving combat against the Angel Cartel. There is a lot of DPS in this mission, so you may have to warp out. Leave one Throne from the first group active and take out the Malakims to reduce incoming DPS. Sniping is possible. Destroy the AI Storage Unit (not the Drone Production Lines) to get the cargo container needed for mission completion. The mission helper incorrectly states that you need to destroy Fuel Depot - ignore that. Blitz: Destroy Drone AI Storage Unit, collect can, warp off.

sections.text: 配额季节是一个涉及与天使企业联合体作战的故事线任务。此任务DPS很高，你可能需要跃迁离开。留第一个编组中一个Throne存活，先击杀Malakim以降低 incoming DPS。可以狙击。摧毁AI存储单元（不是无人机生产线）以获得任务完成所需的货柜。任务助手错误地提示你需要摧毁燃料库——忽略该提示。速刷：摧毁无人机AI存储单元，拾取货柜，跃迁离开。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blitz: Go to the Pirate Station and loot the Hostage.

sections.heading: Warp-In
sections.text: You are given the choice between two gates * Gate to Acidic Cloud (18km) * Gate to Patrol Area (18km) When approaching either of the acceleration gates a popup message explains what you have to expect in the area they lead into.

sections.heading: Pocket 1a (Acidic Cloud)
sections.text: Empty pocket, no spawn. * Ship receives damage of unknown type every second. * Gate to Pirate Base 40k away. * Gate to Entrance 6k away. Note: Area deals enough damage to reduce my Rattlesnake's almost perfect passive tank (I have T1 Defense Field Purgers instead of T2, and level 4 in the shield compensation skills) to 56% (stable) by the time I fly to the next gate. Note: Seamus Donohue calculates, based on his personal observations, that the acidic cloud deals 600 damage per second as perfect omnidamage (that is, 150 EM/second, 150 thermal/second, 150 kinetic/second, and 150 explosive/second).

sections.heading: Pocket 2 (Pirate Base)
sections.text: Will not aggro until attacked, no drone aggression.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * Maximum bounty when going through the Patrol Area = 4.41 mill * Loot: About 1200 m³ before cap booster charges and metal scraps. * Standing increase is excellent with this storyline mission. * This being a typical mercenary mission, all NPCs will close to a range of 15k or less, similar to Damsel in Distress L4. If you can handle the DPS, and deal good DPS, this is very easy and quick (10 minutes) to finish. Category:Storyline missions Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 速刷：前往海盗空间站并拾取人质。

sections.heading: 跃迁进入
sections.text: 你可以选择两道门 * 通往酸性云的门（18公里） * 通往巡逻区域的门（18公里） 接近任一加速轨道时，弹出消息会说明前方区域的情况。

sections.heading: 房间1a（酸性云）
sections.text: 空房间，无增援。 * 舰船每秒受到未知类型伤害。 * 通往海盗基地的门40公里远。 * 通往入口的门6公里远。 注意：该区域造成的伤害足以将我的Rattlesnake近乎完美的被动防御（我使用T1防御场净化器而非T2，护盾补偿技能4级）在我飞到下一个门时降至56%（稳定值）。注意：Seamus Donohue根据个人观察计算，酸性云每秒造成600点完美全向伤害（即每秒150电磁/150热能/150动能/150爆炸伤害）。

sections.heading: 房间2（海盗基地）
sections.text: 未受攻击前不会仇恨，无人机无仇恨。

sections.heading: 备注
sections.text: * 走巡逻区域路线的最高赏金 = 441万 * 战利品：约1200立方米（不含电容 booster 弹药和金属碎片）。 * 此故事线任务的声望提升非常好。 * 作为一个典型的雇佣兵任务，所有NPC会靠近至15公里以内，类似L4任务Damsel in Distress。如果你能扛住DPS并且输出良好，这非常轻松快捷（10分钟）即可完成。分类：故事线任务 分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Sentry Dominix Blitz * Clear first pocket * In second pocket destroy the battleships, destroyers and the cathedral.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: No aggro at warp-in. Proximity aggro range for the Blood Cruise Missile Batteries is about 30km. The warp gate is locked until all hostile ships have been eliminated. Notes: * Eliminate the battlecruisers, destroyers and cruise missile batteries first, to reduce incoming DPS. * If you do not move when you first warp-in, Cruise Batteries will not aggro you.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: At warp-in, you will get proximity aggroed from the sentry guns and missile batteries that sits within 30km range. No NPC ships will aggro UNTIL you start your attack. * The sentry guns/missile batteries, each have an aggro & shooting range of 30km. Before starting your attack, move away > 30km to remove them as a threat. * Eliminate the battlecruisers and destroyers first, to reduce incoming DPS. * Mission is flagged completed once you have destroyed the Blood Raiders Cathedral and eliminated all defending battleships and destroyers.

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入时无仇恨。血袭者巡航导弹炮台的接近仇恨范围约为30公里。跃迁门被锁定，直到所有敌对船只被消灭。备注：* 优先消灭战列巡洋舰、驱逐舰和巡航导弹炮台，以降低 incoming DPS。* 如果跃迁进入时不移动，巡航导弹炮台不会仇恨你。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入时，30公里范围内的哨兵炮和导弹炮台会产生接近仇恨。NPC船只不会仇恨，除非你发起攻击。* 哨兵炮/导弹炮台各有30公里仇恨和射击范围。发起攻击前，移动到>30公里以消除其威胁。* 优先消灭战列巡洋舰和驱逐舰，以降低 incoming DPS。* 摧毁血袭者大教堂并消灭所有防御战列舰和驱逐舰后，任务标记为完成。

guides.title: Rogue Drone Harassment (Level 4)
guides.objective: Destroy Rogue Drones

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Ishtar, Raven Navy Issue, Sentry Dominix, Machariel, Gila 2021-04-18] Deadspace complex with two gated rooms. No hostiles at initial gate. This mission contains large number of spawns from the Mother Drone. Stop shooting the Mother Drone and take out each spawn, this avoids getting swarmed and possibly overwhelmed by their combined DPS. If your ship is well tanked, you may opt to finish the Mother Drone first and take out the swarm as it approaches. The highest DPS in this Pocket comes from the Mother Drone. Blitz: Kill everything.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Upon warp in, you will find a single hostile, the Kayzum Mother Drone, which will call in reinforcements upon reaching a certain level of damage: * 80% Armor triggers the 1st Spawn. * 50% Armor triggers the 2nd Spawn. * 30% Armor triggers the 3rd Spawn. * Hull Damage triggers the 4th Spawn. The reinforcements spawn 6 ships in 20-60 km range at the Veldspar asteroids. The battlecruisers spawn closest to the Asteroid Mining Post, cruisers next closest, frigates farthest from the station which will be closest to the warp-in. Reinforcement Spawns will aggro your Drones. Acceleration gate to the next pocket is at 7km and is locked until all ships are destroyed. Kayzum Mother Drone has reversed weaknesses compared to all other rogue drones (Weakest Explosive 50%, Strongest EM 80%).

sections.heading: Loot & Salvage
sections.text: Loot: ± 1.25 Mil ISK Salvage: ± 1.13 Mil ISK

sections.heading: Mining
sections.text: None. CCP removed all minable asteroids from this mission sometime during or before 2023. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：Ishtar，Raven Navy Issue，哨兵Dominix，Machariel，Gila 2021-04-18] 死亡空间综合体，两个有门房间。初始门处无敌对目标。此任务包含母体无人机的大量增援波次。停止攻击母体无人机并逐一消灭每次增援，这可以避免被它们的联合DPS蜂拥压制。如果你的舰船防御足够好，你可以选择先击杀母体无人机，然后在蜂群靠近时消灭它们。此房间中最高的DPS来自母体无人机。速刷：全杀。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入后，你会发现一个敌对目标——Kayzum母体无人机，它在受到一定伤害后会召唤增援：* 80%装甲触发第1波增援。* 50%装甲触发第2波增援。* 30%装甲触发第3波增援。* 船体损伤触发第4波增援。增援在20-60公里范围内的凡晶石小行星处刷出6艘船只。战列巡洋舰在小行星采矿哨站最近处刷出，巡洋舰次之，护卫舰离空间站最远（即离跃迁进入点最近）。增援波次会仇恨你的无人机。通往下一个房间的加速轨道在7公里处，所有船只被消灭前处于锁定状态。Kayzum母体无人机的弱点与所有其他自由无人机相反（最弱爆炸50%，最强电磁80%）。

sections.heading: 战利品与残骸

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: The gate to next pocket will be locked until you have eliminated all hostile ships. All groups can be attacked independently

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: * No auto-aggro on warp-in, reinforcements do not auto-aggro * The 2nd Group can be attacked independently without drawing pocket aggro. * Attacking the 1st Group will aggro the 3rd Group and vice-versa. * The warp gate will be locked until you have eliminated all hostile ships.

sections.heading: 第1个房间

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Group 1 is the hardest hitting group. No webifiers, so turn around and move away from the blob while tanking the group. At a safe distance (100km from next rat) blow them up. Drones didn't aggro the rest of the pocket at 50km from the next group. While the mission does not have drone aggro or stage aggro, the second person to warp in will get aggro from the group with the webifiers, unless that group is already aggressed. * Effective Jan. 2009, there are two versions of this mission: ** Version A, Group 1 will auto-aggro but Group 2 will ignore you until it is attacked. ** Version B, there will be no auto-aggro, but Group 2 will aggro as soon as you fire on Group 1 --> HOWEVER, Group 2 can be attacked without causing aggro by Group 1. So, if you aren't attacked by Group 1 within 20 seconds or so of warping in, move out to sniping range and attack Group 2 first. After blowing group 1 up, take out the group with the webifiers (Group 2). No other group will be aggroed. The groups 3-5 are consisting of short range, low damage battleships. No webbing rats.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: No webifiers or points. Storage Silo drops an Amarr Nexus chip (type varies...view comments below) and 50x High tech data chips. The habitat modules can also drop trade commodities such as milk. *Mission Objective drops from last ship killed. Tip: If you have a short range setup and enough to tank them easily, go for the BS first as they like to move out to over 40k range. Everything else stays nice and close. Category:Storyline missions Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 第1组怪伤害最高。没有网子舰，所以转身远离怪堆边抗边打。在安全距离（距下一个怪100km）将其击毁。无人机在距下一组怪50km时不会触发整个房间的仇恨。虽然该任务没有无人机仇恨和阶段仇恨，但第二个跃迁进来的人会触发带网子舰那组怪的仇恨，除非该组怪已被开火。* 自2009年1月起，该任务有两个版本：** A版本：第1组怪会自动仇恨，但第2组怪在你开火前保持中立。** B版本：没有自动仇恨，但你对第1组怪开火后第2组怪会立刻仇恨 --> 但是，攻击第2组怪不会导致第1组怪仇恨。所以，如果你跃迁进来约20秒内没有被第1组怪攻击，就飞到狙击距离先打第2组怪。击毁第1组怪后，再打带网子舰的第2组怪。其他组怪都不会被仇恨。第3-5组怪都是短程低伤害的战列舰。没有网子怪。

sections.heading: 第2个房间

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Tengu, Raven, Raven Navy Issue, Sentry Dominix Blitz: You have to kill everything except the sentries. In third room snipe and kill the lone cruiser. Warp out. The mission is flagged complete once you've killed the named Ex-Elite Secret Agent. No Hostiles at Initial Gate.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Acceleration gate to next pocket is at 4km. The gate is locked until all ships are destroyed. Sentries do not need to be destroyed. Auto-aggro from the Sentry Towers, attacking them will aggro the entire pocket (use to draw 3rd group closer). Other groups can be agressed one by one. Battleships deal very high thermal and kinetic damage. It is recommended to take them out first. Unlike other drones, they don't have an omni-resist: it's best to deal EM damage to their shields, then switch to explosive for their armor. Aggressive drones may attack the sentries and cause unwanted aggro. Watch out for drone aggro.

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket (Mercenaries)
sections.text: Acceleration gate to next pocket is at 6km. The gate is locked until all ships are destroyed. No auto aggro but elite frigates will target drones. Groups can be agressed individually Some of the battleships will have unique names. The named battleships do not appear to drop anything special and seem to be just normal mercenary ships with new name.

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket (Ex-Elite Secret Agent)
sections.text: Auto aggro from the Sentries. Attacking any of the Sentries will aggro the lone cruiser. Blow up the cruiser and return to your agent. The target cruiser is 77 km from warp-in.

sections.text: 视频：Tengu、Raven、Raven Navy Issue、哨站Dominix速刷：你需要击杀除哨站外的所有目标。在第三个房间狙击并击杀那艘单独的巡洋舰。跃迁离开。击杀名为Ex-Elite Secret Agent的目标后任务即完成。初始星门处没有敌对目标。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 通往下一个房间的加速轨道在4km处。在所有舰船被击毁前轨道处于锁定状态。哨站不需要被击毁。哨站塔会自动仇恨，攻击它们会仇恨整个房间（可利用此机制把第3组怪拉过来）。其他组怪可以逐一仇恨。战列舰造成非常高的热能伤害和动能伤害。建议优先将其击毁。与其他无人机不同，它们没有全抗：最好对护盾使用电磁伤害，然后切换爆炸伤害打装甲。好战的无人机可能会攻击哨站并触发不必要的仇恨。注意无人机仇恨。

sections.heading: 第2个房间（雇佣兵）

sections.heading: 第3个房间（Ex-Elite Secret Agent）

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: * No aggro upon warp-in. One big group at around 60 km distance (perfect for sniping). * Ships begin to spawn after accepting the mission, so be quick to the encounter otherwise you may be faced with overwhelming fire. * No information regarding individual spawns at the moment, following a full list of ships that spawn: * Recommended generic setup for blitz: sniper (>100 km) with an afterburner * WARNING: Destroying the Control Tower without killing any ships still incurs a 2.4% standing penalty. Decline this mission if you care about your Amarr standings. Blitz: Blow up the Enemy Control Tower, and the mission is complete (Shipyards explode by themselves once Control Tower is killed). The Control Tower has zero resists, so hit it with your highest damage ammo. Tips: - Use a ship capable of speed-tanking if you can't survive sustained fire from the whole pocket. - The Control Tower has approximately 150,000hp. Fit for a good tank if you're going for the blitz. Dropped tags * Imperial Navy Captain Insignia I x6 * Imperial Navy Colonel Insignia I x5 * Imperial Navy General Insignia I x14 * Imperial Navy General Insignia II x10 * Imperial Navy Major Insignia I x5 * Imperial Navy Midshipman Insignia II x4 * Imperial Navy Midshipman Insignia III x5 * Imperial Navy Sergeant Insignia III x6 * Imperial Navy Sergeant Major Insignia I x6 Total value according to evepraisal.com as of 12/07/2021: Approximately 73 M ISK. sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: [Maelstrom April 2013], [Rattlesnake October 2013], [Sentry Dominix June 2018], [Gila April 2021] Blitz: Kill Group 3 (including the Blood Raider Personnel Transport) of pocket 2 and loot the Militants.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Acceleration gate 60 km from warp-in. Gate is locked until all enemies destroyed. No aggro on warp-in. Proximity aggro on groups 2 & 3 when within 6km of the gate. Tips: * Group 4 can be sniped without aggroing anything else. * Attacking Group 2 aggroes Group 3. The last group will remain neutral and can be aggroed separately. * Attacking Group 1 OR 3: Aggroes whole pocket. You can eliminate both groups 4 and 1 without drawing pocket aggro but it gets a bit complicated. You need to fly your ship off to the side putting the station ruins between your ship and groups 1 2 and 3. After your within range eliminate group 4 this will draw group 1 aggro. If you wait for a few minutes after destroying group 4 you will notice that group 1 will be stuck in the station ruins unable to get close to you. Additionally they will have drifted out of aggro range of the other 2 pockets. At this point it should be safe to eliminate group 1 without 2 and 3 aggroing you.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: NO aggro on warp in. The transport ships drop the mission objective. Destroying the group in which the transporters are (group 3) marks the mission completed. Tips: * Group 1 can be ignored. Though they will aggro your drones from far away if not destroyed. * Aggro for Group 2 & 3 are tied with each other. Attacking either will aggro the other. * Attacking Group 4 aggroes group 3 Groups here are not exactly defined.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Assault is a Level 4 combat mission. It has multiple faction variants. Videos: Gila 2021-05-01, Golem, Apocalypse Navy Issue, Dominix Blitz: In the first pocket, ignore all hostile targets and activate the acceleration gate. Clear the second pocket completely. Spawn triggers are the highest bounty battleships in a particular group. The exact battleship is randomly determined, so be sure to identify them correctly via their bounty. The incoming damage is almost entirely kinetic; only the elite cruisers deal noticeable thermal damage.

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: Fleet Aggro: The first pilot to enter the pocket will receive auto-aggro from Group 1 only. Any other fleet members who enter afterward will receive auto-aggro from Group 2 upon attacking Group 1. Group 2 and Reinforcements will aggro drones. The acceleration gate to next room is not locked, and can be activated at any time.

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: Attacking Group 2 will aggro Group 3. Reinforcement spawn and elite frigates will aggro drones. Destroying the prevents Reinforcements from spawning, but will also aggro Group 2. The incoming damage is quite high from Initial Defenders alone. The battleships will orbit at 50 km and attack with Scourge cruise missiles. It is recommended to destroy hostile targets in the following order: Group 1, Group 3, Group 2 (and Reinforcements waves when triggered). Mission is marked as completed after all ships are dead. The last ship destroyed from Reinforcements Wave 1 triggers Reinforcements Wave 2.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Videos: Baghest (blitzed), Gila (blitzed), Vargur, Golem, Apocalypse Imperial Issue (Sniper), Gila, Manticore (Blitz) The mission consists of three pockets and you only have to clear the NPCs in the third (last) pocket. You might have to clear some warp disrupting frigates in pocket 1 and 2 so you can take the acceleration gate. Blitz: In the first and second pockets, ignore all hostile targets and proceed through the acceleration gates. Note that the gates cannot be activated while warp disrupted, so it may be necessary to destroy any disrupting frigates before activating the gates. Destroy all the ships in the final pocket. Warning: It can be helpful to fit a or to help counteract sensor dampening.

sections.heading: 1st Pocket (Optional)
sections.text: Attacking group 1 has a chance to aggro group 2. Attacking group 3 will aggro group 2. Destroying any of the triggers will spawn reinforcements. Avoid triggering reinforcements too early as it includes more warp disruption and heavy dps. The acceleration gate is not locked, and can be activated at any time. However, note that the acceleration gate cannot be used while warp disrupted.

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket (Optional)
sections.text: Auto-aggro from groups 1 and 2 on warp-in. Destroying the trigger battleships will spawn reinforcements. The acceleration gate is not locked, and can be activated at any time. However, note that you cannot take the acceleration gate while warp disrupted.

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket
sections.text: Group 1 will aggro drones. Group 2 will aggro when approached within 40km. Mission is completed once both groups are destroyed.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：Baghest（速刷），Gila（速刷），Vargur，Golem，Apocalypse Imperial Issue（狙击），Gila，Manticore（速刷） 任务由三个死亡空间房间组成，你只需清除第三个（最后一个）房间中的NPC。你可能需要清除第1和第2房间中的一些反跳护卫舰，以便通过加速轨道。速刷：在第一个和第二个死亡空间房间中，忽略所有敌对目标，直接通过加速轨道。注意轨道在反跳状态下无法激活，因此可能需要先摧毁任何反跳护卫舰再激活轨道。摧毁最后一个房间中的所有舰船。警告：装备一个信号增强器或类似的装备可能有助于对抗传感器压制。

sections.heading: 第1个房间（可选）
sections.text: 攻击第1组有可能仇恨第2组。攻击第3组将仇恨第2组。摧毁任何触发目标都会刷出增援波次。避免过早触发增援，因为其中包含更多反跳和高DPS。加速轨道未锁定，可随时激活。但注意，加速轨道在反跳状态下无法使用。

sections.heading: 第2个房间（可选）
sections.text: 跃入时第1组和第2组自动仇恨。摧毁触发战列舰将刷出增援波次。加速轨道未锁定，可随时激活。但注意，你在反跳状态下无法通过加速轨道。

sections.text: Video: Gila, 10-04-2021] Blitz: Mission is completed when the Core Lord Admiral is killed. Fitting an (extra) Sensor Booster or Signal Amplifier is recommended to counteract the dampening. Avoid triggering additional spawns before previous elite cruisers are dealt with. Spawns and triggers vary, usually the odd-one-out Battleship is the trigger but not always (below are some examples). Auto and Drone aggro from initial group and all spawns. sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: [Sentry Dominix September 2018], [Gila March 2021], Manticore (Blitz) April 2024 Single ungated pocket. You can warp in at preferred distance. Reinforcements arrive when you attack Kruul (unless the Casino is destroyed first) and when the pleasure garden takes armor and hull damage. Important note: The Damsel will appear in the cargo hold of the ship that got the last hit of the Pleasure Garden. This should be noted if you are running this mission in fleets. : Note to important note: Endrulf Anbet Skor reported on 7 January 2023 that the Damsel did not appear in the cargo hold so this is most likely no longer true. : Note to note to important note: as of 2024-06-23, the Damsel *does* show up in the cargo hold. This may be inconsistent, pay particular attention when blitzing this mission. Notable loot: Kruul drops just some DNA. Zor drops Zbikoki's Hacker Card that allows you to skip the first room in Worlds Collide missions. Zor also drops an implant that is usually cheap but can be valuable if you are lucky. The gardens drop commodities such as tourists and tobacco. Tip: Don't let your drones shoot Kruul as that will trigger the Battleship reinforcements. Also, recall your drones before your last hit to the Pleasure Garden, it explosion can kill your light or salvage drones (from someone who lost 10 salvage drones because he forgot about this) Blitz: Destroy Kruul's Pleasure Garden (the one further away from warpin) and return to agent. The Damsel will appear in your cargo hold. The incoming DPS is very high if all waves are triggered.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Cerberus, Rattlesnake, Nightmare, Vargur, Kronos, Gila, 20-03-2021] The Mordus headhunters has some of the hardest combat among L4 missions. Each pocket of this mission involves drone aggro and proximity aggro groups. However, in each stage it's possible to position yourself so that you can happily take out at least the first group without aggro from the others. The battleships deal decent damage and have strong tank. Blitz: * 1st Pocket: Kill all the ships. * 2nd Pocket: Kill the group 3 (with the Mordus Mammoth). To avoid getting stage aggro, fly towards the right edge of the group and wait until the group aggro your ship. You can then attack the ships without aggro from the rest of the room. No hostiles at initial gate.

sections.text: 视频：Cerberus，Rattlesnake，Nightmare，Vargur，Kronos，Gila，2021年3月20日] 摩杜斯猎头者是4级任务中战斗最艰难的任务之一。此任务的每个死亡空间房间都涉及无人机仇恨和近距离仇恨组。然而，在每个阶段都可以定位自己，以便轻松消灭至少第一组而不被其他组仇恨。战列舰造成可观伤害并有强抗性。速刷：* 第1个房间：击杀所有舰船。* 第2个房间：击杀第3组（带有Mordus Mammoth的那组）。为避免获得阶段仇恨，向该组的右边缘飞行，等待该组仇恨你的舰船。然后你可以在不被房间其余部分仇恨的情况下攻击舰船。初始门处无敌对目标。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: [Ishtar (Blitz) July 2014], [Nightmare March 2013], [Apocalypse Navy Issue April 2013], [Dominix October 2013], [Raven Navy Issue April 2016], [Sentry Dominix July 2018], [Gila May 2021], [Manticore (Blitz) April 2024] Blitz: Kill Zor, destroy the Outpost Headquarters and warp out. Single ungated pocket. You can [Fleet] warp at preferred range. Mission is flagged completed after you have destroyed the Outpost Headquarters and Zor. Tips: * Incoming DPS will get intense at close range, make sure your ship is tanked properly or fitted with MJD to jump to sniper range if needed. * Zor drops Zbikoki's Hacker Card, which is used to blitz the Worlds Collide missions. * Zor occasionally drops Zor's Custom Navigation Hyper-Link - a 53 mil implant. But usually he just drops Zor's Custom Navigation Link, an almost worthless implant. * Zor deals long range damage, so some tank is needed even on sniper fitted ships. Optional Approach: Different approaches that works well: * Kill Zor first to reduce the incoming DPS. If he is out of range, kill the closest Cruisers and hit Zor once he is in optimal. * Start with the Frigates from group 2, then the Cruisers before they get into their optimal range (15km) and finally the two Battleships. * Take out several Cruisers to quickly manage aggro, shoot the Battleships and then the rest of the Cruisers and the Frigates.

sections.text:

你的任务是拦截一艘载有未授权武装人员的天使企业联合体运输舰。

guides.damageToResist: Ex / Kinetic main boss (Hoborak Moon) spews EM torpedoes, 1147.5 base damage each

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: The rats are in four groups, of which the closest sometimes aggros, but sometimes you land far enough that you can aggro one at a time. The furthest group is the hardest to tank both in this room and the whole mission.

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: There are four groups total and each aggro separately.

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: Hoborak Moon does a nasty amount of EM damage with Mjolnir Torpedoes. The Webifiers/Vipers should be a high priority target if you rely on speed tanking, since the webbing will allow Hoborak to apply his main damage to you much more easily. His resist profile is also modestly stronger than most Angel ships of his size (Weakest Explosive, 50%, Strongest EM 80%), and he repairs shield faster. 400+ sustained DPS in Explosive damage should be enough to crack his tank at a reasonable pace. Sentries have limited aggro range and do not need to be destroyed to complete the mission. Mission is complete once all ships are dead. Battlestation in the final room drops worthless loot, mostly ammo.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * Videos: Solo Tengu, Machariel (with fit) * The BS/C are tanked well, and moon is the hardest to take down. * This mission is somewhat easy, but it may take 30 minutes for the perfect ship. But consider it an hour and half to 2 hours. * With an 1100 DPS Tengu, I was able to complete the mission in ~25 minutes * You may get 20mil in bounties Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 敌人分为四组，最近的一组有时会仇恨，但有时你跃入距离足够远，可以逐个引仇恨。最远的一组在这个房间和整个任务中最难抗。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 共四组敌人，各自独立仇恨。

sections.heading: 房间 3
sections.text:
Hoborak Moon使用雷劫鱼雷造成大量电磁伤害。如果你依赖速度抗，网子舰/Vipers应是高优先级目标，因为网子效果会让Hoborak更容易将主要伤害投射到你身上。他的抗性分布也比同体型大多数天使舰船略强（最弱爆炸50%，最强电磁80%），且护盾回复更快。400+持续爆炸DPS应能在合理时间内破防。
哨兵炮塔仇恨范围有限，不需要摧毁即可完成任务。所有舰船被消灭后任务完成。最终房间的战斗基地掉落无价值战利品，主要是弹药。

* 这个任务相对简单，但最优舰船可能需要30分钟。但请预留1.5到2小时。
* 使用1100 DPS的Tengu，我能在约25分钟内完成任务
* 赏金可获得约2000万

guides.shipSuggestion: Battleship, Command Ship, HAC, Strategic Cruiser

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Golem, Sniper Maelstrom, Bastion Kronos, Sentry Dominix

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: All groups in this pocket have proximity aggro bubbles between 10-15km. You may get aggroed by Group 1 at warp-in as its proximity aggro triggers. DO NOT deploy drones to attack Group 1 as it will be targetted by Group 5. Group 3 & 4 forms an aggro pair. Both will aggro if either one is attacked. Drones can be safely deployed as long as both groups have been aggroed. Group 2 & 5 can be independently attacked in any order without drawing pocket aggro. You may deploy drones as per normal. Tip: - The warp gate is locked until all ships have been eliminated. - Recommended order of elimination: Group 1 & 5, Group 2 and Group 3 & 4. Mineable Asteroid: - Pocket 1 has a sizeable Veldspar deposits.

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: Auto aggro from Group 1 at warp-in. All other groups remain neutral. Each group can be taken out independently and drones can be deployed as per normal. Tip: - The warp gate is locked until all ships have been eliminated.

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: No aggro at warp-in. You warp in to approximately 65-75 KM from NPCs and sentry towers. Sentry towers proximity aggro will be triggered if your ship moves to within 50km. (This includes your drones, too!) - As of 20 June 2011 This room changed, there are 3-4 spawns and triggers. Fit hard tank. - As of Crucible, no new spawns. Tower sentries don't even aggro until you're within 50km. - There are new spawns, 2 waves 12/11/2016 Tip: - It is recommended that your ship carry at least 2-3 weapon upgrade modules (e.g. Ballistic Control System, Heat Sink, etc.) when attacking Draben Kuvakei. - If you stay slightly more than 50KM away from all sentry towers, do no use drones and your guns or missiles have a range slightly higher than 50 KM (i.e. 55KM Heavy Missiles), the NPCs can be killed without receiving fire from the sentry towers as they will not agro at greater than 50 KM. - Mission is flagged completed once you have eliminated ALL ships(tower sentries are not required) in Pocket 3. Blitz: - There is no quick way. Pocket 1 & 2 warp gates are locked until all ships have been eliminated. The last pocket must be cleared of ships to complete the mission. Mining: - You can mine 1.995.000 Veldspar, 180.000 Scordite and 150.000 in all 3 stages. - As of 12/2/2020 there is no ore to mine in this site. This is likely associated with EVE ore rebalancing. Bounty: - 14,694,118.05 ISK - 15,600,000.00 ISK Loot & Salvage Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：Golem、Sniper Maelstrom、Bastion Kronos、Sentry Dominix

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 这个房间中的所有编队之间存在10-15km的接近触发仇恨气泡。跃迁进入时，由于接近触发仇恨机制，你可能会被编队1攻击。切勿部署无人机攻击编队1，否则会被编队5锁定。编队3和编队4构成仇恨配对——攻击其中任一方，两方都会仇恨。只要两个编队都已仇恨，无人机可以安全部署。编队2和编队5可以按任意顺序独立攻击，不会引发房间仇恨。你可以正常部署无人机。提示：- 在所有舰船被消灭之前，跃迁门处于锁定状态。- 推荐消灭顺序：编队1和编队5、编队2、编队3和编队4。可开采小行星：- 房间1有大量凡晶石矿藏。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 跃迁进入时编队1自动仇恨。所有其他编队保持中立。每个编队可以独立消灭，无人机可以正常部署。提示：- 在所有舰船被消灭之前，跃迁门处于锁定状态。

sections.heading: 房间 3
sections.text: 跃迁进入时无仇恨。你跃迁至距离NPC和哨站塔约65-75 KM处。如果你的舰船移动到50km以内，哨站塔的接近触发仇恨将被激活。（这包括你的无人机！）- 截至 20 June 2011，此房间已更改，有3-4个刷新点和触发条件。配备硬抗装备。- 自 Crucible 起，无新增刷新。哨站塔哨兵在50km以内才会仇恨。- 有新刷新，2波 12/11/2016。提示：- 攻击Draben Kuvakei时，建议舰船至少携带2-3个武器升级模块（如弹道控制系统、散热槽等）。- 如果你与所有哨站塔保持略大于50KM的距离，不使用无人机，且你的火炮或导弹射程略高于50 KM（即55KM重型导弹），则可以在哨站塔不开火的情况下消灭NPC，因为超过50 KM它们不会仇恨。- 消灭房间3中所有舰船后任务即标记为完成（哨站塔哨兵无需消灭）。速刷：- 没有快速方法。房间1和房间2的跃迁门在所有舰船被消灭前处于锁定状态。最后一个房间必须消灭所有舰船才能完成任务。采矿：- 你可以开采1.995.000凡晶石、180.000斜长石，所有3个阶段共150.000。- 截至 12/2/2020，此站点无可开采矿石。这可能与EVE矿石平衡调整有关。赏金：- 14,694,118.05 ISK - 15,600,000.00 ISK 战利品与打捞 分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Video: Golem, Maelstrom, Kronos (Bastion) You will warp into a large swarm of Hostiles in the first 2 pockets, a MJD is highly recommended to snipe. Groups will aggro Drones, keep a close eye on them. Tip: * Xevni Jipon is weak against thermal damage but has high resistances against kinetic and is immune to EW. * Be careful not to get stuck on the gate and asteroids in the 1st pocket. Blitz: * 1st and 2nd pocket: destroy all ships to unlock the gates. * 3rd pocket: destroy the 3rd group (All ships by the station. Tagging these ships makes it easier). No other kills are needed to complete the mission. No Hostiles at initial gate.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 视频：Golem、Maelstrom、Kronos（Bastion） 在前2个房间中，你将跃迁进入大量敌对舰船群中，强烈建议使用MJD进行狙击。编队会仇恨无人机，请密切关注。提示：* Xevni Jipon对热能伤害较弱，但对动能伤害有高抗性，且免疫EW。* 注意不要在第1房间中被卡在跃迁门和小行星之间。速刷：* 第1和第2房间：消灭所有舰船以解锁跃迁门。* 第3房间：消灭第3编队（空间站附近的所有舰船。标记这些舰船会更容易）。无需其他击杀即可完成任务。初始跃迁门处无敌对舰船。

Version A consists solely of two courier missions and is suitable for a shuttle. Version B is laid out below. Declining the combat version might give you the courier version of this mission.

guides.objective: Rescue the stranded crew members from the damaged ship in the third room of this deadspace complex.

sections.heading: Mission Details
sections.text: Video: [Gila 2021-05-02] Note: Heavy drone aggro in Angel & Sansha Pocket 2. Setting drones to passive in order to avoid accidental aggro is recommended. This is not a drone friendly mission. However, one thing I notice since the AI update is a "glitch". If you do not shoot anyone, and you release more than one drone shooting at one target. Once they start shooting at one of your drones you can scoop that drone back into the bay. The foes should not shoot at your other drones. This "glitch" maybe fixed down the road. This is a time consuming mission if you do both the Angel & Sansha sides. Blitz: * Pocket 1: Unlock the Angel Base gate either using a Zbikoki's Hacker Card (or killing the Gist War General). The card will be consumed upon activation. * Pocket 2: (Angel Base): All ships in Pocket 2 have to be destroyed to unlock the gate. * Pocket 3: (Research Outpost): Destroy Group 1, grab the hostages from the heron, fly back to your agent. No need to destroy entire groups. - confirmed in July 16, 2014. * The Zbikoki's Hacker Card can be found in Zor's wreck in The Right Hand of Zazzmatazz or The Damsel In Distress Level 4 mission.

sections.heading: Pocket 1 (War Zone)
sections.text: The two gates are locked until you kill the trigger ship from each faction. The trigger ships are ALWAYS a Gist War General and Centus Savage Lord from the respective groups. NO aggro from the initial groups until you attack them. Each group can be aggroed independently. Drones can be safely deployed to attack any group with aggroing the entire pocket. thumb|upright= 2

sections.heading: Pocket 2 (Angel Base)
sections.text: On warp-in, Group 1 will auto aggro. The Angel Spy frigates do not scramble but they do web. DO watch for Thugs and Outlaws scrams. All ships in this pocket have to be destroyed to unlock the gate. Tip: * Once Group 1 has been eliminated, it is fairly safe to deploy your drones for the remaining groups. Keep a close watch on your drones’ target to ensure that they do not stray and mistakenly attack a neutral group. * Recommended order for elimination: Group 1, Group 2, Group 3 and finally Group 4. * An Angel Overseer battleship will have a random chance to spawn in this pocket. The chance to spawn seems to be based on triggering the Angel Base warp gate in Pocket 1 and then completing the warp into this pocket. Warning: * DO NOT deploy your drones to attack Group 1. (I'm going to say this is optional. I didn't move and I had my drones attack group 1 with no problem. However, everyone in the room did target my drones and not me. T1 hobgoblin) * Any attack on the Angel Spy frigates by fleet members will aggro the entire pocket. It is safe however, for them to kill the sentry guns in Group 1. * The FIRST ship that had warped into the pocket may kill the Angel Spy frigates without repercussions, as long as you stick to turret weapons/missiles. * NO aggro from the other groups until you attack them. Each group can be aggroed independently. thumb|upright= 2

sections.heading: Pocket 2 (Sansha Base)
sections.text: On warp-in, Group 1 will auto aggro. The Sansha Spy frigates do not scramble but they do web. Tip: * Once Group 1 has been eliminated, it is fairly safe to deploy your drones for the remaining groups. Keep a close watch on your drones’ target to ensure that they do not stray and mistakenly attack a neutral group. * Recommended order for elimination: Group 1, Group 2 and finally Group 3. * A Sansha's Overseer battleship will have a random chance to spawn in this pocket. The chance to spawn seems to be based on triggering the Sansha Base warp gate in Pocket 1 and then completing the warp into this pocket. Warning: * DO NOT deploy your drones to attack Group 1. * Any attack on the Sansha Spy frigates by fleet members will aggro the entire pocket. It is safe however, for them to kill the battleships in Group 1. * The FIRST ship that had warped into the pocket may kill the Sansha Spy frigates without repercussions, as long as you stick to turret weapons/missiles. * NO aggro from the other groups until you attack them. Each group can be aggroed independently. Sansha Base At Warp-In

sections.heading: Pocket 3 (Research Outpost)
sections.text: You will warp-in randomly around 5km from the Heron. In addition to the immediate aggro from Group 1, there is a small chance that one or more other groups will aggro due to proximity triggers. If this happens, start moving away from the remaining neutral groups and check if the webbing/scrambling Elite Frigates have you locked. Kill them first if they have you locked. If you are fleeted with friends, have them focus fire on Group 1 or any groups that have been aggroed by mistake. The FIRST ship needs to act as an Fleet Commander and assign the appropriate targets. A common mistake is to have everyone shoot random or their closest target, which leads to the whole pocket being aggroed. Sometimes fleet members that enter later will land differently and aggro groups that were unaggroed. If this includes the elite frigates and they scramble the new arrival, it can mean a quick death. All fleet members should have at least enough tank to survive until the scramblers are cleared. Having the lead ship tank the entire pocket is extremely difficult, as it can put down 1300-1500 DPS, in a wide variety of configurations. Here are some (extreme) examples: * 50% Exp, 31% Therm, 16% Kin, 2% EM * 63% Exp, 15% EM, 15% Kin, 6% Therm * 58% Exp, 23% Kin, 12% EM, 7% Therm Tip: * Warping-in from either Angel or Sansha Base does not change the ship combination for this pocket. It will always be Angel ships. Research Outpost At Warp-In Bounty: 25.63M ISK (2025-04-22) by Verum Peto Salvage: 10.6M ISK (2025-04-22) by Verum Peto Loot: 17.5M ISK (2025-04-22) by Verum Peto Category:Security missions

zh.title: 世界碰撞（天使企业联合体与萨沙共和国）（4级）

sections.heading: 任务详情
sections.text: 视频：[Gila 2021-05-02] 注意：天使与萨沙房间2中有严重的无人机仇恨问题。建议将无人机设置为被动模式以避免意外仇恨。这不是一个对无人机友好的任务。然而，自AI更新以来我注意到一个"漏洞"。如果你不攻击任何人，并且释放多架无人机攻击同一个目标。当敌人开始攻击你的一架无人机时，你可以将那架无人机收回无人机舱。敌人应该不会攻击你的其他无人机。这个"漏洞"可能会在将来被修复。如果你同时完成天使与萨沙两侧，这是一个耗时的任务。速刷：* 房间1：使用Zbikoki的黑客卡（或击杀Gist War General）解锁天使基地跃迁门。使用卡片后将被消耗。* 房间2：（天使基地）：房间2中的所有舰船必须被消灭才能解锁跃迁门。* 房间3：（研究前哨站）：消灭编队1，从Heron上营救俘虏，飞回你的代理人。无需消灭所有编队。- 于 July 16, 2014 确认。* Zbikoki的黑客卡可以在Zor的残骸中找到，来自Zazzmatazz的右手或落难少女4级任务。

sections.heading: 房间 1（战区）
sections.text: 两个跃迁门处于锁定状态，直到你击杀每个阵营的触发舰船。触发舰船始终是各编队中的Gist War General和Centus Savage Lord。初始编队不会仇恨，直到你主动攻击。每个编队可以独立仇恨。无人机可以安全部署攻击任何编队而不会仇恨整个房间。thumb|upright= 2

sections.heading: 房间 2（天使基地）
sections.text: 跃迁进入时，编队1将自动仇恨。Angel Spy护卫舰不会反跳但会网子。务必注意Thugs和Outlaws的反跳。此房间中所有舰船必须被消灭才能解锁跃迁门。提示：* 编队1被消灭后，部署无人机对付剩余编队较为安全。密切关注无人机的目标，确保它们不会偏离并误攻中立编队。* 推荐消灭顺序：编队1、编队2、编队3，最后是编队4。* Angel Overseer战列舰有随机几率在此房间刷新。刷新几率似乎基于在房间1触发天使基地跃迁门然后完成跃迁进入此房间。警告：* 切勿部署无人机攻击编队1。（我认为这是可选的。我没有移动，让无人机攻击编队1也没有问题。然而，房间中的所有人都锁定了我的无人机而不是我。T1 hobgoblin）* 舰队成员对Angel Spy护卫舰的任何攻击都会仇恨整个房间。但他们可以安全地消灭编队1中的哨兵炮。* 第一个跃迁进入房间的舰船可以消灭Angel Spy护卫舰而不会有后果，只要使用炮塔武器/导弹。* 其他编队不会仇恨，直到你主动攻击。每个编队可以独立仇恨。thumb|upright= 2

sections.heading: 房间 2（萨沙基地）
sections.text: 跃迁进入时，编队1将自动仇恨。Sansha Spy护卫舰不会反跳但会网子。提示：* 编队1被消灭后，部署无人机对付剩余编队较为安全。密切关注无人机的目标，确保它们不会偏离并误攻中立编队。* 推荐消灭顺序：编队1、编队2，最后是编队3。* Sansha's Overseer战列舰有随机几率在此房间刷新。刷新几率似乎基于在房间1触发萨沙基地跃迁门然后完成跃迁进入此房间。警告：* 切勿部署无人机攻击编队1。* 舰队成员对Sansha Spy护卫舰的任何攻击都会仇恨整个房间。但他们可以安全地消灭编队1中的战列舰。* 第一个跃迁进入房间的舰船可以消灭Sansha Spy护卫舰而不会有后果，只要使用炮塔武器/导弹。* 其他编队不会仇恨，直到你主动攻击。每个编队可以独立仇恨。萨沙基地 跃迁进入时

sections.heading: 房间 3（研究前哨站）
sections.text: 你将随机跃迁至距离Heron约5km处。除了编队1的即时仇恨外，由于接近触发机制，有一个小概率一个或多个其他编队会仇恨。如果发生这种情况，开始远离剩余的中立编队，并检查网子/反跳精英护卫舰是否锁定了你。如果它们锁定了你，优先击杀它们。如果你与朋友组队，让他们集中火力攻击编队1或任何被误仇恨的编队。第一艘舰船需要担任舰队指挥官并分配适当的目标。一个常见错误是让所有人射击随机目标或最近的目标，这会导致整个房间被仇恨。有时后进入的舰队成员着陆位置不同，会仇恨之前未仇恨的编队。如果这包括精英护卫舰并且它们反跳了新到达者，可能意味着快速死亡。所有舰队成员应至少具备足够的抗性以存活至反跳舰船被清除。让领头舰船硬抗整个房间极其困难，因为它可以输出1300-1500 DPS，配置种类多样。以下是一些（极端）示例：* 50% 爆炸，31% 热能，16% 动能，2% 电磁 * 63% 爆炸，15% 电磁，15% 动能，6% 热能 * 58% 爆炸，23% 动能，12% 电磁，7% 热能 提示：* 从天使基地或萨沙基地跃迁进入不会改变此房间的舰船组合。始终是天使舰船。研究前哨站 跃迁进入时 赏金：25.63M ISK（2025-04-22）由 Verum Peto 提供 打捞：10.6M ISK（2025-04-22）由 Verum Peto 提供 战利品：17.5M ISK（2025-04-22）由 Verum Peto 提供 分类：安全任务

guides.title: Worlds Collide (Blood Raiders & Angel Cartel) (Level 4)
guides.ewar: NOS (Priest/Dark Priest), Elite Frigates, Blood Spy

sections.heading: First Pocket (Warzone)
sections.text: You arrive in the middle of two large groups and two gates approximately 33km from the warp-in. One for your primary enemy, and one for the faction mentioned in the mission briefing (in this case, Blood Raiders and Angels). They start far away from you behind their own gate. The gates are locked until you kill the last ship of that faction. Blitz: You can blitz this by using Zbikoki's Hacker Card. (Obtained from Zor in other missions). It will be consumed upon unlocking the gate.

sections.heading: Blood Raider Pocket
sections.text: Warning: If you do it all wrong and aggro all of them the full-aggro is 1,100-1,200dps (EM 50%/TH 50%) with the occasional kinetic cruise missile from the battleships. Tips: * Shooting the Spies with your own guns/missiles will not aggro anything else. Drones and anyone else will. * Drones can be safely used to kill the auto-aggro group. Just make sure they don't shoot Spies. * One can slowboat to the next gate. No additional aggro. You will be at around 5 km to the gate when the gate group aggros you. * Wait for the 1st group to target you, and take them all out. Fire on another ship, it's group will target you, and take that group out. Feel free to take out the Blood Spies, once the 2nd group is gone, to trigger the last group. * You might find a collidable structure in your way (or even hit it) as you enter.

sections.heading: Angel Cartel Pocket
sections.text: Aggro at warp in: Yes (might web too) Tips: * Using drones on the Spies causes the whole room to aggro. * The Saints throw Bane torpedoes and can hit at 55km or more. * Arch Gistum Centurion is fast and will close the range to under 20km, so kill before the Saints. * Cherubim throw Havoc cruise missiles to at least 80km. Thrones are shorter range. * Chance of spawning a Gist Overlord [543k battleship] as well. Chance increases with every ship that enters the room. Overlord waits to be attacked, and attacking it caused the remainder of the room to aggro. * Original player leaving to get more ammo and returning does not cause remaining groups to aggro. //Untested: A second ship (gangmate) present may cause entire room to aggro immediately.//

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket (Blood Raiders)
sections.text: Killing all the ships in the 3rd pocket trips the "mission completed" flag even if you do NOT pick up the stranded crew. If you forget you will have to quit the mission with loss of standings from agent, corp, and faction. The pocket looks like a single group, but it's actually 3. Use the same technique suggested for the Blood Raider pocket. If you do everything wrong [use drones, etc.] full-aggro is 900-950dps (EM 51%/TH 49%) with the occasional kinetic cruise missile from the battleships. Tips: * Group 1 won't move very fast, so you can get some range on them if you can find a direction to go that doesn't come close to other groups. * Group 2 can be attacked separately. * You only need to blow up the auto-aggro group to get the ship crew. * Keep drones on Passive to prevent any unwanted aggro. * On occasion, you might - even without drones or partners - aggro all of the groups (some of which can warp scramble). I suggest you put some distance fast between you and the groups you haven't yet aggroed.

zh.title: 世界碰撞（血袭者与天使企业联合体）（4级）

sections.heading: 第1房间（战区）
sections.text: 你到达两个大型编队和两个跃迁门的中间，距离跃迁点约33km。一个通往你的主要敌人，另一个通往任务简报中提到的阵营（在本例中为血袭者和天使）。它们起始位置在各自跃迁门后方远离你的地方。跃迁门处于锁定状态，直到你消灭该阵营的最后一艘舰船。速刷：你可以使用Zbikoki的黑客卡速刷。（从其他任务中的Zor处获得）。使用卡片解锁跃迁门后将被消耗。

sections.heading: 血袭者房间
sections.text: 警告：如果你操作全部失误并仇恨所有敌人，完全仇恨的DPS为1,100-1,200dps（EM 50%/TH 50%），偶尔有战列舰发射动能巡航导弹。提示：* 用自己的火炮/导弹攻击Spies不会仇恨其他编队。无人机和其他人会。* 无人机可以安全用于消灭自动仇恨编队。只需确保它们不攻击Spies。* 可以慢速前往下一扇门。无额外仇恨。当门编队仇恨你时，你大约在距门5 km处。* 等待第1编队锁定你，然后消灭它们。攻击另一艘舰船，其编队会锁定你，然后消灭该编队。第2编队消灭后，可以自由消灭Blood Spies以触发最后的编队。* 进入时你可能会发现一个可碰撞建筑挡在路上（甚至撞到它）。

sections.heading: 天使企业联合体房间
sections.text: 跃迁进入时仇恨：是（可能也会网子）提示：* 对Spies使用无人机会导致整个房间仇恨。* Saints发射Bane鱼雷，射程可达55km或更远。* Arch Gistum Centurion速度很快，会拉近到20km以内，所以在Saints之前击杀。* Cherubim发射Havoc巡航导弹，射程至少80km。Thrones射程较短。* 有几率刷新Gist Overlord[543k战列舰]。每进入一艘舰船，几率增加。Overlord等待被攻击，攻击它会导致房间剩余编队仇恨。* 原始玩家离开补充弹药后返回不会导致剩余编队仇恨。//未测试：第二艘舰船（队友）在场可能导致整个房间立即仇恨。//

sections.heading: 第3房间（血袭者）
sections.text: 消灭第3房间中的所有舰船会触发"任务完成"标志，即使你没有拾取滞留船员。如果你忘记了，你将不得不退出任务并损失代理人、军团和阵营声望。该房间看起来像一个编队，但实际上是3个。使用血袭者房间建议的相同技巧。如果你一切操作失误[使用无人机等]，完全仇恨的DPS为900-950dps（EM 51%/TH 49%），偶尔有战列舰发射动能巡航导弹。提示：* 编队1移动速度不快，所以如果你能找到不接近其他编队的方向，可以对它们拉开距离。* 编队2可以单独攻击。* 你只需消灭自动仇恨编队即可获得船员。* 将无人机保持被动模式以防止不必要的仇恨。* 偶尔，即使没有无人机或队友，你也可能仇恨所有编队（其中一些可以反跳）。建议你快速与尚未仇恨的编队拉开距离。

guides.ewar: Centus Plague Lords tracking disrupt, Elite frigates point & web

sections.heading: Mission Details
sections.text: Blitz: * Pocket 1: Approach the Sansha gate kill the triggers or use Zbikoki's Hacker Card to jump in. (the card is consumed in process) * Pocket 2: Kill web frigates with your guns/missiles then approach the acceleration gate (be sure that you don't go near group 2 or group 3 in order to do that go to smaller end of acceleration gate) and use it. * Pocket 3: Kill all Ships. (sometimes the cargo is unlocked before you kill all ships)

sections.heading: Pocket 1 (War Zone)
sections.text: Each gate is locked until you kill a trigger from each group. Gates can, however, be activated, before killing the trigger, by using a Zbikoki's Hacker Card. Groups aggro individually and will not fly further than 30km from their control towers. Strongly recommend using Thermal missiles against the Federation Navy Orion, even if you're flying a Drake or Tengu, as they'll deal 2x the damage, even after the 25% damage bonus from the hull / offensive subsystem is taken into account.

sections.heading: Pocket 3 (Pirate Stash)
sections.text: Groups aggro when engaged or on proximity. Initial auto-aggro will vary, depending on which group you land closest to. Category:Security missions

zh.title: 世界碰撞（盖伦特联邦与萨沙共和国）

sections.heading: 任务详情
sections.text: 速刷：* 房间1：接近萨沙跃迁门，击杀触发舰船或使用Zbikoki的黑客卡跳入。（卡片在过程中被消耗）* 房间2：用火炮/导弹消灭网子护卫舰，然后接近加速轨道（确保不要靠近编队2或编队3，为此请前往加速轨道较小的一端）并使用它。* 房间3：消灭所有舰船。（有时货舱在你消灭所有舰船之前就会解锁）

sections.heading: 房间 1（战区）
sections.text: 每个跃迁门处于锁定状态，直到你击杀每个编队的触发舰船。然而，使用Zbikoki的黑客卡可以在击杀触发舰船之前激活跃迁门。各编队独立仇恨，且不会飞出距离其控制塔30km以外。强烈建议对Federation Navy Orion使用热能导弹，即使你驾驶的是Drake或Tengu，因为它们将造成2倍伤害，即使扣除船体/攻击子系统的25%伤害加成后仍然如此。

sections.heading: 房间 3（海盗藏匿点）
sections.text: 编队在被攻击或接近时仇恨。初始自动仇恨会有所不同，取决于你着陆时离哪个编队最近。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: 1st Pocket (Warzone)
sections.text: You can blitz this by using Zbikoki's Hacker Card. (Obtained from Zor in other missions). It will be consumed upon unlocking the gate.

sections.heading: Pocket 3 (The Research Outpost)
sections.text: Killing Group 1 will unlock the Heron cargohold.

sections.heading: Additional Info
sections.text: Notes: - Reports of a random BS spawn are now no longer true - the BS which used to spawn chance based before is now renamed to "Supervisor" and always there at start. It has about a 50% chance of physically being in the room in the beginning and another 50% chance of not coming in until a undetermined amount of time. Bounties, Loot, and Salvage reports below are approximations and may vary. Bounties: 27,888,626.61 ISK +/- Loot: 11,526,000 ISK (02.12.2015) Salvage: 11,400,000 ISK (05.03.2017) Videos: Torp Golem Arty Vargur Category:Security missions
