guides.title: Worlds Collide (Serpentis & Guristas Pirates)
guides.objective: Rescue ship's crew (40 m3)

sections.heading: Mission Details
sections.text: Video: Golem, Vargur, Gila, full clear, 17-03-2021] This mission consists of a deadspace complex with warpin area and three gated rooms. The warpin area has a gate to both Serpentis and Guristas bases. Both of these bases have a gate that leads to the same final room. Blitz: * Kill either Serpentis battleships or Guristas battleships in first room and take the corresponding gate. * Clear out the second room you chose ** Guristas room has higher DPS, ECM and elite cruisers. Serpentis room has more battleships to chew through. * In last room kill group 1, grab the crew and return to the agent.

sections.heading: Warp in - "Warzone stage"
sections.text: Choose one of two groups, kill them (you only need to kill the battleships) and go deeper using appropriate warpgate into second pocket (Serpentis base or Gurista base). From both second pockets route is directly to third pocket which is always same (Research outpost). * The ship groups are around 130 km from warpin * The gates are around 20 km from warpin. * You can skip killing the battleships by using Zbikoki's Hacker Card. (Obtained from Zor in other missions). It will be consumed upon unlocking the gate.

sections.heading: 1st room A - Serpentis Base
sections.text: Three groups of ships at around 20 km from warpin. Group 1 and the two lone ships auto aggro. Elite frigates will aggro drones. The may be able to be killed separately. The gate to next room is locked until all ships are destroyed. The Serpentis Overseer is not always present at the beginning and can appear after unknown time. War installation drops what looks like random junk T1 loot.

sections.heading: 1st room B - Gurista Base
sections.text: Three groups of ships. Group 1 auto aggress. Elite frigates attack drones. The may be able to be killed separately. Attacking the lone elite frigate will aggress the whole room. The incoming DPS is very high if you aggress all groups. The battleships like to orbit you at 30 km. Some of the ships also have ECM (all ECM not listed in table). The Guristas Overseer is not always present at the beginning and can appear after unknown time.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket - The Research Outpost
sections.text: Last room. When you warp in the group 1 is present. Groups 2 and 3 warp in shortly. To complete the mission you need to retrieve the crew from the damaged Heron. The Heron is locked until group 1 is destroyed. All the groups are in same area so the only way to identify group 1 is to tag it before the other ships warp in. Each group can be aggressed separately.

sections.heading: Bounties
sections.text: Bounties: ± 28 Mil ISK (including all the pockets)

sections.heading: Loot & Salvage
sections.text: Loot: ± 9.1 Mil ISK sometimes faction shadow module 200 millions ISK Salvage: ± 9.1 Mil ISK

sections.heading: Mining
sections.text: In the Research Outpost are 32 asteroids worth 703,056 units of Veldspar. Category:Security missions

zh.title: 碰撞世界（天蛇与古斯塔斯海盗）

sections.heading: 任务详情
sections.text: 视频：魔像级、瓦格尔级、吉拉级，全清，17-03-2021] 此任务由一个死亡空间综合体组成，包含跃迁入口区域和三个有门的房间。跃迁入口区域有通往天蛇和古斯塔斯基地的加速轨道。这两个基地各有一扇加速轨道通往同一个最终房间。速刷：* 在第1个房间击杀天蛇战列舰或古斯塔斯战列舰，然后走对应的加速轨道。* 清除你选择的第2个房间** 古斯塔斯房间有更高的DPS、ECM和精英巡洋舰。天蛇房间有更多的战列舰需要慢慢磨掉。* 在最后一个房间击杀第1编组，获取船员并返回代理人处。

sections.heading: 跃迁入口 - "战场阶段"
sections.text: 选择两组中的一组，击杀它们（你只需击杀战列舰），然后使用相应的跃迁门通过加速轨道进入第2个死亡空间房间（天蛇基地或古斯塔斯基地）。从两个第2个死亡空间房间都有直接通往第3个房间的路线，始终是同一个（研究前哨站）。* 舰船编组距离跃迁入口约130km* 加速轨道距离跃迁入口约20km* 你可以使用兹比科基的黑客卡跳过击杀战列舰。（从其他任务中的佐尔处获得）。解锁加速轨道时会被消耗。

sections.heading: 第1个房间A - 天蛇基地
sections.text: 三组舰船在跃迁入口约20km处。第1编组和两艘单独舰船自动仇恨。精英护卫舰会仇恨无人机。它们可能可以被单独击杀。通往下一房间的加速轨道在所有舰船被摧毁前处于锁定状态。天蛇监督者不一定在开始时出现，可能在未知时间后出现。战争设施掉落看似随机的垃圾T1战利品。

sections.heading: 第1个房间B - 古斯塔斯基地
sections.text: 三组舰船。第1编组自动仇恨。精英护卫舰攻击无人机。它们可能可以被单独击杀。攻击单独的精英护卫舰会引整个房间的仇恨。如果你引所有编组的仇恨，承受的DPS非常高。战列舰喜欢在30km距离环绕你。部分舰船还有ECM（表中未列出所有ECM）。古斯塔斯监督者不一定在开始时出现，可能在未知时间后出现。

sections.heading: 第2个死亡空间房间 - 研究前哨站
sections.text: 最后一个房间。跃迁进入时第1编组在场。第2和第3编组很快跃迁进入。完成任务你需要从受损的苍鹭级中获取船员。苍鹭级在第1编组被摧毁前处于锁定状态。所有编组在同一区域，所以识别第1编组的唯一方法是在其他舰船跃迁进入之前标记它。每个编组可以单独引怪。

sections.heading: 赏金
sections.text: 赏金：约28 Mil ISK（包含所有死亡空间房间）

sections.heading: 战利品与打捞
sections.text: 战利品：约9.1 Mil ISK，有时有势力影子模块价值200 Mil ISK打捞：约9.1 Mil ISK

sections.heading: 采矿
sections.text: 研究前哨站中有32颗小行星，价值703,056单位的凡晶石。分类：安全任务

guides.title: A Mote In The Eye
guides.ewar: Web, energy neutralizer, sensor dampener, Elite Federation Libertus
guides.objective: Destroy all enemy ships

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Fighters will respawn indefinitely until the three Fighter Bay structures are destroyed. With each structure, one fighter pops. Fourth structure, the Power Generator (250k ehp), does not take damage until Fighter Bays are destroyed. When the Generator is destroyed, the Neut that's attached to it is also destroyed. Mission is in deadspace, you will always be warping to the entry point(at range is allowed) and cannot warp to fleet members/bookmarks directly. Strategy: * Take out structures, missile & web towers, leave neuts until last. * Either take one neut and one spawn at a time, or shoot at all neuts and warp your rr out while the tank gains aggro. Takes 30-50 seconds before majority of dps is in place if you stay at warp-in.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: All enemies aggro on warp-in. Initial group will do around 800 dps with 42% Kinetic/58% Thermal. These spawns are approximations and there could be some variance. Can end up around 5,000 dps with 37% Kinetic/73% Thermal. The Elite Federation Libertus have web/scram, the Federation Praktor Dionia has energy neutralizer(20gj/s) and sensor damepener. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 战斗机会无限刷新，直到三个战斗机机库建筑被摧毁。每摧毁一个建筑，会刷出一批战斗机。第四个建筑，电力发生器（250k EHP），在战斗机机库被摧毁前不会受到伤害。当电力发生器被摧毁时，与之相连的毁电也会被摧毁。任务在死亡空间中，你总是跃迁到入口点（允许保持跃迁距离），不能直接跃迁到舰队成员/书签。策略：* 摧毁建筑、导弹塔和网子塔，毁电留到最后。* 要么一次处理一个毁电和一批刷新，要么攻击所有毁电并在坦克获得仇恨时将后勤维修舰跃迁出去。如果停留在跃迁入口，大部分DPS需要30-50秒才能到位。

sections.heading: 跃迁入口
sections.text: 所有敌人在跃迁入口仇恨。初始编组总DPS约800，伤害类型42%动能/58%热能。这些刷新是近似值，可能存在一些差异。最终可能达到约5,000 DPS，伤害类型37%动能/73%热能。精英联邦利伯图斯装备有网子/反跳，联邦普拉托·迪奥妮娅装备有毁电（20GJ/s）和传感器抑制器。分类：安全任务

guides.title: A Wolf by the Ears
guides.objective: Destroy enemy ships

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Mission is in normal space so bookmarks and fleet members can be warped too freely. The carrier has 150km energy neutralizer range for 40gj/s. Small drones are very good at speed tanking the fighters. The fighters will aggro drones if they are the closest thing when they spawn.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Carrier and fighters aggro immediately. The rest of ships aggro on engagement. Ships can be aggroed separately if you warp in far enough from the right group. Only the Imperial Templar Seer has tracking disrupter and energy neutralizer. Category:Security missions

rows.name: Imperial Templar Champion/Justicar/Phalanx/Seer
rows.note: Seer is only variant with EWAR

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 任务在普通空间中，可以自由跃迁至书签和舰队成员。航母的毁电范围为150km，每秒毁电40GJ。小型无人机非常适合用来速度抗战斗机。战斗机在刷新时如果无人机是最近的物体，会仇恨无人机。

sections.heading: 跃迁入口
sections.text: 航母和战斗机在跃迁入口立即仇恨。其余舰船在交战后仇恨。如果你跃迁进入时距离正确的编组足够远，可以单独引怪。只有帝国圣殿骑士·先知装备有跟踪扰断和毁电。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Alluring Emanations is a mission involving combat against Rogue Drones. There are multiple level variants.

sections.heading: Details
sections.text: No aggro on warp-in. Mission objective is marked complete when mission target is destroyed. The ambush group does not need to be destroyed, and because drones do not drop loot, it may be more time-efficient to blitz the mission by simply destroying the initial single drone and warping away. The maximum combined damage of the drone ambush group is 132 hp/s. Pilots who wish to engage the ambush group should ensure that they remain outside of the ambush group's optimal range, as getting too close can result in massive amounts of damage. Alternatively, a sufficiently-tanked ship can wait until the ambush group gets within range and use a smartbomb to destroy them all at once, though it can take some time (~2 minutes) for the ambush group to approach to smartbomb range. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 诱人辐射是一个涉及与自由无人机战斗的任务。有多个等级变体。

sections.heading: 详情
sections.text: 跃迁入口无仇恨。任务目标被摧毁时任务标记为完成。伏击编组无需被摧毁，而且无人机不掉落战利品，速刷此任务可能更省时间，只需摧毁初始的单架无人机然后跃迁离开。无人机伏击编组的最大总伤害为132 hp/s。想要与伏击编组交战的飞行员应确保保持在伏击编组的最佳射程之外，因为靠得太近会导致大量伤害。或者，一艘足够能抗的舰船可以等到伏击编组进入射程后使用智能炸弹一次性摧毁它们，不过伏击编组接近到智能炸弹射程可能需要一些时间（约2分钟）。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Breeding Facility
guides.objective: Destroy the Amarrian Breeding Facility

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Each energy neutralizer sentry does 40gj/s for a combined 160gj/s in this mission.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: There are many triggers to be aware of in the initial group. The Stasis tower each cause a Wave 2 to spawn. Each neutralizer tower also causes a Wave 3 to spawn. In addition there is also a timed spawn Wave 1. The Amarr Slave Transports do not always spawn, and will warp out after three minutes. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 每个毁电哨戒每秒毁电40GJ，本任务总计160GJ/s。

sections.heading: 跃迁入口
sections.text: 初始编组中有许多触发机制需要注意。每个停滞缠绕塔都会触发第2波次刷新。每个毁电塔也会触发第3波次刷新。此外还有定时刷新的第1波次。艾玛奴隶运输舰不一定刷新，三分钟后会跃迁离开。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Caldari Beacons
guides.objective: Destroy all enemy ships

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Each neut tower hits for 40gj/s for a combined 80gj/s. With the heavy jamming either a marauder or a drone boat is ideal. Even though the mission says the objective is to destroy the Subspace Beacons, it is flagged completed upon clearing Pocket 2 even if the beacons and their spawns are not triggered or killed. No hostiles at initial gate.

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: Ships are arrayed between 50km and 90km away and deal a combined 2,280dps (53%kin/47%therm).

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: Ships are arrayed between 30km and 75km away and deal a combined 2,480dps (48%kin/52%therm). An additional group is spawn for each Subspace Beacon destroyed. State Shukuro Nagashin's deal heavier then average thermal damage. Category:Security missions

rows.name: State Shukuro Nagashin/Turushima
rows.note: Turushima is the only variant with EWAR

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 每个毁电塔每秒毁电40GJ，总计80GJ/s。由于强力干扰，掠夺者级或无人机船是理想选择。虽然任务说明目标是摧毁子空间信标，但清除第2个死亡空间房间后任务即标记为完成，即使信标及其刷新未被触发或击杀。初始加速轨道处无敌对。

sections.heading: 第1个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 舰船分布在50km至90km之间，总DPS为2,280（53%动能/47%热能）。

sections.heading: 第2个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 舰船分布在30km至75km之间，总DPS为2,480（48%动能/52%热能）。每摧毁一个子空间信标会额外刷新一组舰船。合众国修克罗·纳加辛造成高于平均水平的热能伤害。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Aggro on warp-in. Waves 1 to 7 are triggered by random kills in the initial frigates. Wave 8 and 9 trigger on random kills among first 7 waves. Wave 10 spawns at 90% shield on the Sansha Outpost. Each neutralizer hits for 40gj/s. Category:Security missions

sections.text: 任务在死亡空间中，你总是跃迁到入口点（允许保持跃迁距离），不能直接跃迁到舰队成员/书签。速刷：* 炸毁萨沙哨站，击杀第10波次。

sections.heading: 跃迁入口

guides.title: Codename : Redress
guides.ewar: Web, target painter, Chief Republic Ivan
guides.objective: Retrieve items from Databank

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Notes: To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as a cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably one with a capacity of 6,000 m3).

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: There are 5 databanks in this room that will either spawn a Wave 1 or deal 400 damage.

sections.heading: 3rd Pocket
sections.text: There are 4 databanks in this room, the fourth one hacked will spawn Wave 1.

sections.heading: 4th Pocket
sections.text: 6 databanks that do not cause any waves to spawn. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 注意：要完成此任务，你需要一艘在线装配了黑客模块的舰船，以及至少2,000 m3容量的货舱（最好有6,000 m3的容量）。

sections.heading: 第2个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 这个房间有5个数据终端，每个会触发第1波次刷新或造成400伤害。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: No hostiles at initial gate. Freighters orbit at 70km, deal no damage, and have 142k hp. It is possible to throw off full-room aggro by leaving the room, returning and selectively aggressing certain groups that have approached quickly and separated from the others. Diviners and Dominators can be aggressed separately this way.

guides.title: Hidden Enemy Base (Amarr)
guides.ewar: Neuting, tracking disruption and heavy webbing, All Frigates 25-35% chance each

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Deadspace with multiple gated pockets. Two Remote Cloaking Array's must be destroyed before a hidden gate that leads to the Enemy Base will appear. Tips: * Use a Passive Tank and save time by not having to destroy Energy Neutralizer Sentries * When being Tracking Disrupted, your turrets can still be used effectively against stationary Sentries and Batteries (while your drones handle the frigates). * For Pockets 5 & 6, wait until all ships have spawned before bringing in a logistics ship

sections.heading: 1st pocket - Entry Point
sections.text: Empty pocket with 3 gates that lead to the pockets.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Warp disruption, neuting, tracking disruption and heavy webbing. All ships will orbit at close ~10km orbit. Destroy the Remote Cloaking Array (50,000 HP) and take the Gate to return to the Entry Point Pocket.

sections.heading: 3rd pocket
sections.text: Frigates will orbit at ~4 km while battleships stay at ~45 km. Destroy the Remote Cloaking Array (50,000 HP) and take the Gate to return to the Entry Point Pocket.

sections.heading: 4th pocket
sections.text: A gate to pocket 5 will be visible here if you destroyed the two Remote Cloaking Arrays in 2nd and 3rd pockets. Battlecruisers orbits at 10-20 km and battleships at 50 km.

sections.heading: 5th pocket
sections.text: Timed spawns. It takes 30 seconds for all 10 cruisers to spawn. Cruisers orbit at 10-22 km.

sections.heading: 6th pocket - Enemy Base
sections.text: Timed spawns. It takes 60 seconds for all ships to spawn. Destroy the Amarr Station (150,000 hp). Mission is flagged complete when the station is destroyed. Frigates and cruisers orbit at ~10 km, battlecruisers at 10-20 km and battleships 15-50 km. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 死亡空间，包含多个有门的房间。必须摧毁两个远程隐形阵列后，通往敌方基地的隐藏加速轨道才会出现。提示：* 使用被动抗可以节省时间，无需摧毁毁电哨戒* 被跟踪扰断时，你的炮台仍然可以有效攻击静止的哨戒和炮台（同时你的无人机处理护卫舰）。* 对于第5和第6个死亡空间房间，等所有舰船刷新完毕后再引入后勤舰

sections.heading: 第1个死亡空间房间 - 入口点
sections.text: 空房间，有3扇加速轨道通往其他房间。

sections.heading: 第2个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 反跳、毁电、跟踪扰断和强力网子。所有舰船将在约10km的近距环绕。摧毁远程隐形阵列（50,000 HP）后走加速轨道返回入口点房间。

sections.heading: 第3个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 护卫舰环绕约4km，战列舰保持在约45km。摧毁远程隐形阵列（50,000 HP）后走加速轨道返回入口点房间。

sections.heading: 第4个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 如果你摧毁了第2和第3个死亡空间房间中的两个远程隐形阵列，这里会显示通往第5个房间的加速轨道。战列巡洋舰环绕10-20km，战列舰在50km。

sections.heading: 第5个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 定时刷新。所有10艘巡洋舰需要30秒完成刷新。巡洋舰环绕10-22km。

sections.heading: 第6个死亡空间房间 - 敌方基地
sections.text: 定时刷新。所有舰船需要60秒完成刷新。摧毁艾玛空间站（150,000 HP）。空间站被摧毁后任务标记为完成。护卫舰和巡洋舰环绕约10km，战列巡洋舰10-20km，战列舰15-50km。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Hidden Enemy Base (Caldari)
guides.shipSuggestion: Ishtar with Osprey Shield Repping. Osprey was only needed for last room.
guides.ewar: Energy Neutralizer Sentry IIIs, Jamming, All Frigates 25-35% chance each

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Space type: Deadspace, multiple pockets with gates Two Remote Cloaking Array's must be destroyed before a hidden gate that leads to the Enemy Base will appear

sections.heading: Pocket 1 - Entry Point
sections.text: Empty pocket with 3 gates that lead to the combat pockets: * Top Gate - Gate to Remote Cloaking Array Pocket 2 * Bottom Gate - Gate to Remote Cloaking Array Pocket 3 * Middle Gate - Gate to Pocket 4 Entry Point - Pocket 1, 3 Gates lead to the action

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: via Top Gate (Heavy Web, Scramble) Destroy the Remote Cloaking Array (50,000 HP) and take the Gate to return to the Entry Point Pocket

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: via Bottom Gate Destroy the Remote Cloaking Array (50,000 HP) and take the Gate to return to the Entry Point Pocket

sections.heading: Pocket 4
sections.text: via Middle Gate A gate to pocket 5 will be visible here if you destroyed the two Remote Cloaking Arrays in pocket 2 and 3.

sections.heading: Pocket 5
sections.text: Takes 30 seconds for all 10 cruisers to spawn A gate will take you to the final pocket 6

sections.heading: Pocket 6 - Enemy Base
sections.text: Destroy the Caldari Station (150,000 hp). Mission is flagged complete when the station is destroyed. The station drops a T1 named turret or launcher.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text: * Use a Passive Tank and save time by not having to destroy Energy Neutralizer Sentries. * Set drones to aggressive for any jamming ships (especially Room 2). * For Pockets 5 & 6, wait until all ships have spawned before bringing in a logistics ship. * Suggest using a Drake instead of logistics if not needed. Really speeds up the process. Thanks to JohnnyMnemonic. I borrowed a good portion of his page and changed what I needed to for the Caldari version. Category:Security missions

rows.name: Taibu State Tachi
rows.note: 27.5 Jam for 20 seconds. This doesn't happen if the towers are all destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 空间类型：死亡空间，多个有门的房间。必须摧毁两个远程隐形阵列后，通往敌方基地的隐藏加速轨道才会出现。

sections.heading: 房间1 - 入口点
sections.text: 空房间，有3扇加速轨道通往战斗房间：* 上方加速轨道 - 通往远程隐形阵列房间2* 下方加速轨道 - 通往远程隐形阵列房间3* 中间加速轨道 - 通往房间4入口点 - 房间1，3扇加速轨道通往战斗区域

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 通过上方加速轨道（强力网子、反跳）摧毁远程隐形阵列（50,000 HP）后走加速轨道返回入口点房间

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 通过下方加速轨道摧毁远程隐形阵列（50,000 HP）后走加速轨道返回入口点房间

sections.heading: 房间4
sections.text: 通过中间加速轨道。如果你摧毁了房间2和3中的两个远程隐形阵列，这里会显示通往房间5的加速轨道。

sections.heading: 房间5
sections.text: 所有10艘巡洋舰需要30秒完成刷新。一扇加速轨道将你送往最终的房间6。

sections.heading: 房间6 - 敌方基地
sections.text: 摧毁加达里空间站（150,000 HP）。空间站被摧毁后任务标记为完成。空间站掉落一个T1命名炮台或发射器。

sections.heading: 提示
sections.text: * 使用被动抗可以节省时间，无需摧毁毁电哨戒。* 对任何干扰舰船将无人机设为主动攻击（尤其是房间2）。* 对于第5和第6个死亡空间房间，等所有舰船刷新完毕后再引入后勤舰。* 如果不需要后勤舰，建议使用龙骑兵级代替，能显著加快进度。感谢JohnnyMnemonic。我借鉴了他页面的大部分内容，并针对加达里版本进行了修改。分类：安全任务

guides.title: Hidden Enemy Base (Minmatar Republic)
guides.shipSuggestion: Passive shield tanked ships (eg: Drake, Nighthawk, etc)
guides.ewar: T2 Cruisers have a chance to web. Energy Neutralizer Towers neut. Stasis Towers web., T2 Frigates have a chance to web and/or scramble.

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: Upon warp-in you will find three gates stacked vertically. The top gate goes to pocket 2, the middle gate goes to pocket 4 and the lower gate goes to pocket 3. You need to destroy the Remote Cloaking Array in pockets 2 and 3 before you go to pocket 4.

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: Everything aggros on warp-in. Make sure to destroy the Remote Cloaking Array while you're here. This pocket contains an acceleration gate back to the first pocket.

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: Again, everything aggros on warp-in. Make sure to destroy the Remote Cloaking Array while you're here. This pocket also contains an acceleration gate back to the first pocket.

sections.heading: Pocket 4
sections.text: Everything aggros on warp-in. This pocket contains an acceleration gate back to the first pocket. If you destroyed the Remote Cloaking Arrays in pockets 2 and 3, then there will be another acceleration gate that will take you to pocket 5.

sections.heading: Pocket 5
sections.text: Everything aggros on warp-in. This pocket contains an acceleration gate back to the first pocket as well as an acceleration gate to pocket 6.

sections.heading: Pocket 6
sections.text: Everything aggros on warp-in. This pocket contains the Minmatar Station which you must destroy to complete the mission. Category:Security missions

zh.title: 隐秘敌人基地（米玛塔尔共和国）

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 跃迁入场后你会发现三个垂直排列的星门。上方的门通往房间2，中间的门通往房间4，下方的门通往房间3。你需要在进入房间4之前摧毁房间2和房间3中的远程隐形阵列。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 跃迁入场后所有敌人都会产生仇恨。确保你在这里摧毁远程隐形阵列。这个房间包含一个返回第一个房间的加速轨道。

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 同样，跃迁入场后所有敌人都会产生仇恨。确保你在这里摧毁远程隐形阵列。这个房间也包含一个返回第一个房间的加速轨道。

sections.heading: 房间4
sections.text: 跃迁入场后所有敌人都会产生仇恨。这个房间包含一个返回第一个房间的加速轨道。如果你摧毁了房间2和房间3中的远程隐形阵列，那么会出现另一个加速轨道将你送往房间5。

sections.heading: 房间5
sections.text: 跃迁入场后所有敌人都会产生仇恨。这个房间包含一个返回第一个房间的加速轨道以及一个通往房间6的加速轨道。

sections.heading: 房间6
sections.text: 跃迁入场后所有敌人都会产生仇恨。这个房间包含米玛塔尔空间站，你必须摧毁它以完成任务。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: Direct warp into ungated deadspace pocket. Full room aggro on first shot. There are 2 Ship groups and 2 Tower groups. In an attempt at simplicity, the total numbers of hostiles are combined. (I.e., there are only 12 ships per Ship group and 5 towers per Tower group.) Destroying the non-elite (not Guardian) frigates of that spawn causes a random Shadow Serpentis Battleship to appear which must be killed to complete the mission. After the frigate spawn, there will be another tower spawn. Blitz: Shoot the initial frigs and the Maulus frigs that spawn in order to spawn the Shadow Serpentis BS. Kill this BS to trigger completion.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - This mission is easy to solo and the lack of Neut towers makes it active tank friendly. - The Shadow Serpentis BS can drop Snake implants and several Shadow Serpentis modules. - Bounties from the rats are approximately 20 mil. - The Stronghold takes very long to destroy and does not drop good loot. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 单个房间
sections.text: 直接跃迁进入无门的死亡空间房间。第一枪触发全房间仇恨。有2个舰船编队和2个塔编队。为了简化，敌方总数合并计算。（即每个舰船编队只有12艘舰船，每个塔编队有5座塔。）摧毁该刷新的非精英（非Guardian）护卫舰会导致一艘随机暗影天蛇战列舰出现，必须将其杀死以完成任务。护卫舰刷新后，还会有一个塔刷新。速刷：射击初始护卫舰和刷新的Maulus护卫舰以触发暗影天蛇战列舰出现。杀死这艘战列舰触发任务完成。

sections.heading: 备注
sections.text: - 这个任务容易单刷，没有毁电塔使其适合主动抗。- 暗影天蛇战列舰可以掉落蛇脑插和多个暗影天蛇装备。- 怪的赏金约为20 mil。- 堡垒需要很长时间才能摧毁且不掉落好的战利品。分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Single Pocket
sections.text: When you warp in, there is a single mixed group. Aggro is automatic. Each Energy Neutralizer Tower III has 2 replacement spawns (e.g. Initial ENT --> Replacement Tower 1 --> Replacement Tower 2). Once these 6 towers have been destroyed, the next spawn appears. Tips: - It is recommend that you use Logistics support to help keep your passive tank alive to avoid warp outs - A CNR / Golem can do this mission with careful energy / tank management, but MUST have 2x Medium Energy Transfer Array II's going on it at all times and 4x Large Shield Reps. Your cap will drain, but the Neutralizer tower cycles allow you to turn your tank back on between cycles. - Shoot all but one of the initial BS's to reduce your tank damage taken Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 单个房间
sections.text: 跃迁入场后有一个混合编队。仇恨是自动的。每座毁电塔 III 有2个替换刷新（例如：初始毁电塔 --> 替换塔 1 --> 替换塔 2）。摧毁这6座塔后，下一个刷新出现。提示：- 建议使用后勤舰支援以保持你的被动抗存活，避免被迫撤离 - CNR / Golem 可以通过仔细的能量/抗管理完成这个任务，但必须始终有2个中型能量转移阵列 II 在传输并且使用4个大型护盾修复器。你的电容会耗尽，但毁电塔的循环间隔让你可以在循环之间重新开启抗性。- 攻击初始战列舰中除一艘外的所有以减轻你的抗承受的伤害 分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Part 1 of 2
sections.text: Space type: Deadspace, Allows direct warp to bookmarks or gang mates. First a few things to know about this mission: * It’s bugged, you can’t finish it properly yet. Yes I have bug reported this. And you can still finish it (you have to travel 10,000km in a ship, twice). * You can warp directly into any part of the mission despite it being a deadspace. * The rats don’t warp scramble (or at least they haven’t scrammed me) * Spawns vary in numbers a bit for the 3 main rooms, numbers below are just guidelines. * This fix worked for my mission, but CCP may change/fix this mission. I reported this fix and workaround at 17 June 2011 (confirmed still bugged and work around still works at 12 May 2012), see how out of date this is before trying the mission. The bug: There are 3 rooms in this mission that have a basic structure of 2 gates 1 active that leads to a guard room and 1 inactive that leads to the next room. Kill all the spawns in the room for a key to drop take that to the guard room and kill all the spawns there for the guard post to appear, drop the key in the guard post for the inactive gate to become active. This works for the first room but it does not work for the second or third room. The Fix: Since you can warp to anywhere in the mission grab a fast ship, align yourself with the gate and travel 10,000km to get to the room, bookmark and come back with a fleet. With a 5 km/s cepter it took roughly 30 minutes to travel to the next room. This won’t work for the second broken gate as the inactive gate is also facing the wrong direction (it’s instead facing the same way a

sections.text: 空间类型：死亡空间，允许直接跃迁到书签或小队成员。首先关于这个任务需要了解几件事：* 这个任务有bug，你还不能正常完成它。是的，我已经报告了这个bug。但你仍然可以完成它（你需要驾驶舰船飞行10,000km，两次）。* 尽管这是死亡空间，你可以直接跃迁到任务的任何部分。* 怪不会反跳（至少它们没有反跳过我）* 3个主要房间的刷新数量有些不同，以下数字仅供参考。* 这个修复方法对我的任务有效，但CCP可能会修改/修复这个任务。我在2011年6月17日报告了这个修复和变通方法（2012年5月12日确认仍然有bug且变通方法仍然有效），在尝试任务之前请看看这是多么过时。Bug描述：这个任务有3个房间，基本结构是2个星门，1个激活的通往守卫房间，1个未激活的通往下一个房间。杀死房间内所有刷新会掉落一把钥匙，带着它去守卫房间杀死那里所有刷新让守卫哨所出现，将钥匙放入守卫哨所使未激活的星门变为激活。这对第一个房间有效，但对第二个和第三个房间无效。修复方法：由于你可以跃迁到任务的任何地方，找一艘快速的船，对齐星门方向飞行10,000km到达那个房间，做书签然后带舰队回来。用一艘5 km/s的拦截舰大约需要30分钟飞到下一个房间。这对第二个坏掉的星门不起作用，因为未激活的星门朝向也是错的（它反而朝向同一方向a

sections.heading: Warp-In
sections.text: Ships at 20-75k unless you choose to warp to within a different distance Ships relative to Warp-in Beacon Tips: * Mission occurs in normal space, so you can always warp to distances and to bookmarks farther away from the NPCs. * Your first warp attempt will be a forced Warp to 0. Even if you select Warp to 100 you will arrive at the Warp-In Beacon. * Try selecting warp, canceling your warp, then warping to your desired distance. * Warping to within 100km leaves plenty of distance that spreads out the aggro. * Cruise Missile Batteries have a maximum range of 170km, and the Carrier’s NOS has a maximum range of 150km. * Fighters will immediately attack your drones when they spawn from the Carrier, but this can be used to your advantage. * Small Drones are invulnerable to the Fighters, as long as they are moving/attacking; and they are a great way to draw-off the Fighters aggro. Have your small drones attacking the carrier when the fighters spawn. * The Fighters are only be able to hit Large and Medium drones. * Mission is flagged complete when the Carrier and Fighters are destroyed. You do not need to destroy the Cap Ship Maint Array. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Against the Empire is a Level 3 mission involving combat against the Amarr Empire. Notes: You need to retrieve 3x Massive Sealed Cargo Containers (6000.0m3). To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as an available cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably 6,000 m3).

sections.heading: Warp-In
sections.text: Acceleration gate at 60km. Towers range 20km to 75km. Destroying Stasis Towera replaces them with an Amarr Heavy Neut Tower

sections.heading: Pocket 1
sections.text: Ships range 25-40km. Towers range 40-45km. You warp into the acceleration gate at 0km. Reinforcement spawns at 3 minutes from warp in, 20-25km from warp in point. Reinforcement spawns at 6 minutes from warp in, 15-25km from warp in point. Reinforcement spawns at 7 minutes from warp in, 15-25km from warp in point.

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: Ships range 20-30km. Towers range 25-30km. You warp into the acceleration gate at 0km. Destroying Neutralizer Towers replaces them with Sentry III Towers.

sections.heading: Pocket 3
sections.text: Ships range 30-40km. Towers range 20-60km. The objective (Datacenters) are 40k from the warp in.

sections.heading: Hacking
sections.text: There are 4 containers each in the 2nd and 3rd room and 5 in the last room. One among each of these groups has 1 of the 3 large containers you need to finish the mission. The rest only ever contain 1 unit of scrap metal. They are bunched together at 40km from the warp in in each of the rooms. Hacking 4 was enough for me to hack all of them. To find which of the cans you need to hack make sure you have 'type' column active and the objective can should have a different type than the rest. Hacking can in 2nd/3rd room will cause spawns to appear and attack 2nd room: 2 elite frigs, 2 spawns 3rd room: 5 elite frigs 6 elite cruisers, 1 spawn Hacking cans in any of the rooms will randomly cause a 500 aoe damage around the cans that hits your ship or any drones you have orbiting you.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: * The mission requires you to carry 6,000m3 which will require an Hauler/Transport ship to carry. * You need to equip an Analyser module to hack the datacenters. * You need more than Hacking level 3. * There are destructible structures in most of the rooms, none of them drop anything. Category:Security missions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 对抗帝国是一个涉及与艾玛帝国作战的3级任务。注意：你需要取回3个巨型密封货柜（6000.0m3）。完成此任务需要一艘装有黑入模块的舰船，以及至少2,000 m3的可用货舱容量（最好6,000 m3）。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 加速轨道在60km处。防御塔范围20km至75km。摧毁停滞之塔会将其替换为艾玛重型毁电塔。

sections.heading: 房间1
sections.text: 舰船范围25-40km。防御塔范围40-45km。你在0km处跃迁至加速轨道。增援波次在跃迁入场后3分钟刷新，距跃迁入场点20-25km。增援波次在跃迁入场后6分钟刷新，距跃迁入场点15-25km。增援波次在跃迁入场后7分钟刷新，距跃迁入场点15-25km。

sections.heading: 房间2
sections.text: 舰船范围20-30km。防御塔范围25-30km。你在0km处跃迁至加速轨道。摧毁中和塔会将其替换为哨兵III型炮塔。

sections.heading: 房间3
sections.text: 舰船范围30-40km。防御塔范围20-60km。目标（数据中心）距跃迁入场点40km。

sections.heading: 黑入
sections.text: 第2和第3房间各有4个容器，最后一个房间有5个。每组中有一个含有你完成任务所需的3个大型容器之一。其余的只装有1单位废金属。它们在每个房间中聚集在距跃迁入场点40km处。黑入技能4级足以让我黑入所有容器。要找到需要黑入哪个容器，确保'类型'列已激活，目标容器的类型应与其他不同。黑入第2/3房间的容器会导致增援出现并攻击 第2房间：2艘精英护卫，2个增援 第3房间：5艘精英护卫 6艘精英巡洋，1个增援 黑入任何房间的容器都会随机导致容器周围500 AOE伤害，击中你的舰船或任何环绕你的无人机。

sections.heading: 备注
sections.text: * 任务要求你携带6,000m3货物，需要一艘货舰/运输舰来运输。 * 你需要装备分析仪模块来黑入数据中心。 * 你的黑入技能需要高于3级。 * 大多数房间有可摧毁建筑，均不掉落任何物品。 分类：安全任务

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Ancient Ruins is a combat relic site only found in the Catch nullsec region, especially in the 9HXQ-G constellation. Up to T2 Battleships can enter this site. This site appears to probes as a combat site. The site is very rare and hard, and should only be attempted by skilled players. Sansha's Nation and Rogue Drone rats are present in this site. Omni tanks are highly preferable, especially EM and Thermal damage. Damage in the site can easily become excessive if care is not taken in managing triggers. Extra: *Bounties: approx. 60-70M isk + bounty adjustment payout *Loot: approx. 50M isk *Salvage: approx. 20M isk

sections.text: 远古遗迹是一个仅在Catch nullsec区域发现的战斗遗迹站点，尤其在9HXQ-G星座。最高允许T2战列舰进入此站点。此站点在探针上显示为战斗站点。此站点非常稀有且困难，只应由技术娴熟的玩家尝试。站点中存在萨沙共和国和自由无人机怪。高度推荐全抗配船，尤其是电磁和热能抗性。如果不谨慎管理触发机制，站点伤害很容易失控。额外信息： *赏金：约60-70M isk + 赏金调整收入 *战利品：约50M isk *打捞：约20M isk

sections.text: The Angel Military Complex is an unrated complex cosmic signature found in Angel infested regions. Kill first stasis tower (explode with 3k damage, be careful), recharge tank if needed, kill second stasis tower. Flee out from Angel Control Tower in 30-40 km range, shot it. Kill all tackling frigates, kill Domination boss, take loot, warp out.

sections.text: 天使军事综合体是一个在天使占领区域发现的未评级综合体宇宙信号。远程舰船速刷（需要锁定和武器射程 > 65-70 km）：跃迁至第1层房间，击杀4座停滞之塔，击杀Gist之门指挥官以解锁加速轨道。跃迁通过加速轨道进入第2层房间。击杀第一座停滞之塔（造成3k伤害会爆炸，小心），必要时重新充能抗性，击杀第二座停滞之塔。在30-40 km范围内逃离天使控制塔，射击它。击杀所有反跳护卫舰，击杀统御Boss，拿战利品，跃迁离开。

sections.text: The Angel Outpost is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of Low Sec space. Estimated payout 8.5 mil ISK, not counting faction drops. To complete this site you will need quite strong tank to survive the high dps present in the second pocket - a T2 tanked Drake should have no trouble.

sections.heading: First pocket
sections.text: Note: The separate groups of rats can be aggressed separately.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: about 4,500,000 ISK * Loot/salvage: about 4,000,000 ISK

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site may escalate to Salvation Angel's Shipment. If no Domination Defeater spawns, destroying the Angel Battlestation can lead to escalation. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使前哨是一个未评级宇宙信号战斗站点，可以在低安的天使占领区域使用核心探针扫描找到。预计收入8.5M ISK，不计势力掉落。完成此站点需要相当强的抗性来承受第2层房间的高dps——T2抗性的德拉戈级不会有困难。

sections.heading: 第1层房间
sections.text: 注意：分离的怪群可以分别拉仇恨。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此站点可能升级为天使救赎者的运输。如果没有统御毁灭者刷出，摧毁天使战斗空间站可能导致升级。 分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Provincial HQ is a null security unrated site found through exploration.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Upon warping to the site you will arrive at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: Attacking the four Gist Arena Guardian battleships will trigger an additional wave each. Killing the battleships that spawn in reinforcement waves does not trigger reinforcements. Killing the Gist Gate Guardian or having a Domination Crystal Tag in your cargo unlocks the gate. Do not try to blitz, it is really hard to tank.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Structures 2 x Battlestation (no worthwhile loot). Attacking either Triggers Commander Wave) drop may contain: * Domination stasis webifier, * Domination armor hardener, * Domination shield hardener, * Domination Heavy Stasis Grappler

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The site can escalate to Special Forces. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocked after Gist Gate Guardian is dead or if you have Domination Crystal Tag in your cargo.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使省级总部是一个通过探索发现的nullsec未评级站点。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 跃迁至站点时你会到达一个加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第1层房间
sections.text: 攻击四艘Gist竞技场守卫战列舰会各触发一个额外波次。击杀增援波次中刷出的战列舰不会触发增援。击杀Gist之门守卫或在货舱中拥有统御水晶标签可以解锁加速轨道。不要试图速刷，非常难扛。

sections.heading: 第2层房间
sections.text: 建筑 2 x 战斗空间站（无有价值战利品）。攻击任一触发指挥官波次）掉落可能包含： * 统御停滞网子 * 统御装甲硬化器 * 统御护盾硬化器 * 统御重型停滞抓钩

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此站点可升级为特种部队。 分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Angel Vigil is a unrated combat site that can be found via exploration by scanning down signatures with scanner probes in high-security systems. Its gate allows Battlecruisers or smaller to enter, and a (well equipped) Battlecruiser or HAC is suggested to bring into the site. (Addition: after completing in a Hurricane Dooobles notes that resists over 60% exp/kinetic, robust T2 tank with substantial buffer, exp/kinetic dmg dealing, web, and tracking gear are ESSENTIAL; the incoming damage is very high and the mobs kite.) The largest ship allowed to enter is a Command Ship (T2 Battlecruiser). == Walkthrough ==

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: The gate in the first room can be unlocked either by using an Angel Gold Tag or by killing the Gistatis Smuggler Commander in the Gate Spawn. It is possible to trigger the Gate Spawn preemptively by shooting the smuggler gate.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: Before shooting any tower, focus on lowering the number of enemies in the pocket. The incoming damage is quite substantial so something with a decent tank, or warp-outs are necessary. You will be webbed down to ~10% velocity or less (14.0 m/s in a BC), so speed tanking isn't possible. After the area is cleared of most of the enemies, shoot one of the stasis towers. This pocket can easily become tank-melting if you target the turrets before clearing the initial ships. After all the turrets are gone and everything's dead, shoot 'Pat's Shipyard' for the final spawn and kill him off. There are multiple cargo containers in the pocket (containing a small amount of ammo, one had faction ammo). A large number of Veldspar asteroids are in this pocket. Pat Wead dropped a Low-Grade Halo Beta when I ran this. (*Pat Wead drop for Dooobles Sept 22, 2010 - Domination 220mm autocannon, Domination Copper tag, 1000 Angel faction ammo) -Update 15 Feb 23 - Pat Wead dropped Mid-grade Halo Omega (valued at 329M isk, 220M isk Jita). Blitzing this pocket is possible but fairly impractical. Shoot Pat's Shipyard and kill Pat. You will probably want to kill all initial ships as you will be moving at the snail's pace of 14 m/s and the damage will be significant. Then kill stasis towers and Wave B. Ignoring missile turrets and Wave A will still allow you to complete the site and qualify for a potential escalation. Blitz info edit: As stated above you only need to shoot the smugglers gate in the first pocket once to spawn gate keeper (smuggler commander) and the gate is open once he is destroyed. Do it

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: For the initial exploration site (two pockets) *5M isk in bounties + loot, salvage, possible implant. *Asteroids for mining listed in each pocket. *Commander can drop Domination faction modules or implants.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to The Big Blue (expedition). Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使警戒是一个未评级战斗站点，可以通过在高安星系中使用扫描探针探索发现信号找到。其加速轨道允许战列巡洋舰或更小的舰船进入，建议携带一艘（装备良好的）战列巡洋舰或重型突击巡洋舰进入站点。（补充：Dooobles在使用飓风级完成后指出，超过60%爆炸/动能抗性、坚固的T2抗性配大量缓冲、爆炸/动能伤害输出、网子和追踪装备是必需的； incoming伤害非常高且怪物会风筝。）允许进入的最大舰船是指挥舰（T2战列巡洋舰）。 == 攻略 ==

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 第一房间的加速轨道可以通过使用天使金标签或击杀门刷中的Gistatis走私者指挥官来解锁。可以通过射击走私者之门提前触发门刷。

sections.heading: 策略
sections.text: 在射击任何塔之前，先集中减少房间中的敌人数量。incoming伤害相当可观，因此需要一艘有足够抗性的舰船，或者能够跃迁脱离。你会被网子减速至约10%速度或更低（战列巡洋舰中为14.0 m/s），因此速度抗性不可行。在清除大部分敌人后，射击其中一座停滞之塔。如果你在清除初始舰船之前攻击炮塔，这个房间很容易变成融化抗性的局面。在所有炮塔被摧毁且所有敌人被击杀后，射击'Pat的船坞'触发最终刷怪并击杀他。房间中有多个货柜（包含少量弹药，其中一个有势力弹药）。这个房间中有大量凡晶石小行星。Pat Wead在我跑此时掉落了Low-Grade Halo Beta。（*Pat Wead掉落信息来自Dooobles 2010年9月22日 - 统御220mm自动加农炮、统御铜标签、1000天使势力弹药） -2023年2月15日更新 - Pat Wead掉落了Mid-grade Halo Omega（价值329M isk，吉他220M isk）。速刷此房间可能但不太实际。射击Pat的船坞并击杀Pat。你可能需要击杀所有初始舰船，因为你将以14 m/s的蜗牛速度移动且伤害会很高。然后击杀停滞之塔和B波次。忽略导弹炮塔和A波次仍然可以让你完成站点并获得潜在升级资格。速刷信息补充：如上所述，你只需在第1层房间射击走私者之门一次即可刷出守门人（走私者指挥官），他被摧毁后加速轨道开放。执行它

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 对于初始探索站点（两层房间） *5M isk赏金 + 战利品、打捞、可能的植入体。 *每个房间中列出的可开采小行星。 *指挥官可能掉落统御势力装备或植入体。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此站点可升级为深蓝（远征）。 分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Angel Watch is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of High Sec space. Estimated payout 8.5 mil ISK, not counting faction drops. To complete this site you will need a battlecruiser or well fitted cruiser. Only a battlecruiser class ship or lower, and their Tech II equivalents, may enter this site.

sections.heading: First pocket
sections.text: All waves must be triggered to spawn the Gistum Militant Commander. Alternatively, an Angel Silver Tag can be used to bypass this room altogether. The tag is consumed on use. Note: ~60km off, aggressive on warp-in. The destroyers spawn 20-40 km away, while the cruiser spawns around 50-60 km away. This wave spawns around 60-80 km from the acceleration gate, in 3 groups which aggro together. The Militant Commander wave spawns 60-70 km from the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Second pocket
sections.text: Blitz: Ignore all NPCs (though you can shoot the nearby destroyer) and attack the Gist Drug Farm. Once the Farm wave spawns, approach the Militant Overseer until you get within optimal range of your weapons. When doing so, it is recommended to use manual piloting to avoid the structures, sentries and rats. Destroy only the Gistum Militant Overseer to trigger the commander wave, then destroy the commander, bookmark the wreck, and warp out of the site, wait for it to despawn, and warp back in to pick up the loot. Note: Waves 2 and 3 are triggered by approaching structures, and are additionally possibly on a timer. On triggering waves 2 and/or 3: Note: The Farm Wave is triggered by attacking the drug farm. It spawns 100 km away.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: about 1,700,000 ISK * Loot/salvage: about 3,300,000 ISK

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site may escalate to The Nuclear Small Arms Project. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Gistum Communications Officer
rows.trigger: Spawns wave 3 on being shot at.

rows.trigger: Spawns wave 4 on being shot at.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天使瞭望哨是一个未分级的宇宙信号战斗地点，可在高安区域中天使企业联合体活动的星域使用核心探针进行扫描。预计收益约850万ISK，不含势力掉落。完成此地点需要一艘战列巡洋舰或配置良好的巡洋舰。仅允许战列巡洋舰及以下级别的舰船及其T2对应型号进入。

sections.heading: 第一个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 必须触发所有波次才能刷新古斯塔姆好战指挥官。也可使用天使银牌直接跳过此房间，银牌使用后即消耗。注意：约60公里外，跃迁进入时主动攻击。驱逐舰在20-40公里处刷新，巡洋舰在50-60公里处刷新。此波次在距加速轨道60-80公里处刷新，分3组同时仇恨联动。好战指挥官波次在距加速轨道60-70公里处刷新。

sections.heading: 第二个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 速刷：忽略所有NPC（但可以射击附近的驱逐舰），直接攻击古斯塔毒品农场。农场波次刷新后，靠近好战监督官直到进入你的武器最佳射程。建议此时使用手动驾驶以避开建筑、哨卫和怪。仅击杀古斯塔姆好战监督官以触发指挥官波次，然后击杀指挥官，保存残骸书签，跃迁离开地点，等待其消失后再跃迁回来拾取战利品。注意：第二波和第三波通过靠近建筑触发，且可能同时受计时器影响。触发第二波和/或第三波时：注意：农场波次通过攻击毒品农场触发，在100公里外刷新。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此地点可能升级为The Nuclear Small Arms Project。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Blood Forlorn Den is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be freely warped to in Blood Raider owned territory of Low and Null Sec space. The site itself is a small area with no Acceleration Gate. Each wave spawns after the destruction of the previous wave.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: this anomaly may escalate to 7/10 DED complex Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Corpatis Exorcist/Phantom
rows.trigger: Attacking any of these ships seems to trigger wave 6

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者凄凉巢穴是一个未定级的宇宙信号战斗地点，可在低安和0.0安的血袭者控制领土中自由跃迁到达。该地点本身是一个没有加速轨道的小型区域。每一波敌人在前一波被消灭后刷新。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该异常点可能升级为 7/10 DED 综合体 分类：未定级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Blood Hidden Den is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be freely warped to in Blood Raiders owned territory of Low and Null Sec space. The site itself is a small area with no Acceleration Gate. Each wave spawns after the destruction of a specific trigger.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: ≈5.6 Mil * Loot/salvage: 10 Mil

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site may escalate into Crimson Hand Supply Depot. The trigger for this escalation is unknown. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者隐秘巢穴是一个未定级的宇宙信号战斗地点，可在血袭者控制的低安和0.0安领土中自由跃迁到达。该地点本身是一个没有加速轨道的小型区域。每一波敌人在特定触发条件满足后刷新。

sections.heading: 收益
sections.text: * 赏金：约560万 * 战利品/打捞物：1000万

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可能升级为绯红之手补给站。升级触发条件未知。分类：未定级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Hideout is an Unrated Complex type of combat site found in low and high security space. It is one of the easiest to attempt.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: After destruction of the Blood Raider Chapel, you may receive the escalation Frentex. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者藏身处是一种在高安和低安地区均可发现的未定级综合体战斗地点，是最容易尝试的地点之一。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁血袭者礼拜堂后，你可能会获得升级地点弗伦特克斯。分类：未定级综合体

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: ---- Destroying all the defenders will unlock the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: ---- All Group 1 - 3 are present on warp in. Destroying Group 2 (the group to the left at around 50 km) will trigger the commander spawn. If no commander spawns then the "Blood Raider Bunker" is the second escalation trigger. File:Blood_Lookout_Room_2.jpg‎

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: ---- Destroying the Dark Blood Frigate may trigger an escalation to Following the Blood. If the Dark Blood frigate does not spawn then the escalation trigger is the Blood Raider Bunker. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: ---- 消灭所有防御者将解锁加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ---- 跃迁入场时第1组至第3组全部在场。消灭第2组（约50公里处的左侧一组）将触发指挥官增援波次。若未出现指挥官，则"血袭者地堡"为第二个升级触发条件。File:Blood_Lookout_Room_2.jpg‎

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: ---- 消灭暗血护卫舰可能触发升级至追随鲜血。若暗血护卫舰未出现，则升级触发条件为血袭者地堡。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Blood Military Complex is an unrated complex cosmic signature .

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: thumb|Gate locked pop-up. The acceleration gate in this room is locked; a Blood Diamond Tag must be obtained from hostiles and used to unlock the gate. Shooting the Blood Control Unit Unlocks the gate and triggers another spawn.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Note that shooting the main structure in this room spawns additional waves. Elite frigate webbing and tackling Killing the Dark Blood Harbinger may lead to further escalation.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Loot is usually minimal 10M ISK but you may get a faction drop 50M ISK.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Chance of triggering escalation site Frontier in Flames Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked! Requires a Blood Diamond Tag to unlock.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者军事综合体是一个未评级的综合体宇宙信号。

sections.heading: 第一间
sections.text: thumb|大门锁定弹窗。此房间的加速轨道处于锁定状态；需要从敌方获取血袭者钻石标签来解锁大门。射击血袭者控制单元可以解锁大门并触发另一波刷新。

sections.heading: 第二间
sections.text: 注意，射击此房间的主建筑会刷新额外的波次。精英护卫舰的网子和反跳 击杀黑暗血袭者先驱者可能导致进一步升级。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 战利品通常最少 10M ISK，但你可能获得势力掉落 50M ISK。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 有几率触发升级站点烈焰前线 分类:未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Provincial HQ is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null security systems with Blood Raider presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The first room is largely straightforward; a well-tanked T3 Cruiser or Battleship can do it fairly easily. The second room is much harder to solo due to strong webbing, neuting and fairly high DPS. If your ship does not have the ~1000 DPS required to destroy the Arena Sentinel structure in the second room, recommend bringing a friend for this site. Warping to the site lands you on an acceleration gate that permits up to T2 Battleships.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: The acceleration gate deeper into the complex is locked until the Gate Security Outpost is destroyed. Alternatively, a Blood Crystal Tag can be used to skip the room (the tag is consumed on use).

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: The Siege Beam Laser Sentries deal a total of about 200 DPS of omni damage with a slant towards EM and Thermal damage. They fire every 15-16 seconds. The Arena Sentinel has a very strong -75% web that reaches out to 50 km. It fires Citadel EM torpedoes that deal approximately 1500 EM damage every 18 seconds. It also has a very strong active shield and armor tank that requires at least 1000 DPS to break.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Fountain of Youth. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Reinforcements (triggered by attacking the Gate Security Outpost)

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until Gate Security Outpost is destroyed

rows.name: Arena Sentinel
rows.trigger: Triggers reinforcements at different damage intervals

rows.name: Elder Corpum Priest/Sage/Revenant
rows.note: Elder Corpum Revenant neuts and tracking disrupts

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者行省总部是一个未评级综合体，可在有血袭者存在的零安星系中通过扫描发现。

sections.heading: 攻略流程
sections.text: 第一个房间基本比较直接；一艘防御充足的T3巡洋舰或战列舰可以轻松通过。第二个房间由于强力的网子、毁电和相当高的DPS，单人挑战要困难得多。如果你的舰船没有摧毁第二个房间中竞技场哨兵结构所需的约1000 DPS，建议带一个朋友一起打这个站点。跃迁到站点会落在一条加速轨道上，允许最大T2战列舰通过。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 深入综合体的加速轨道在门禁安全哨站被摧毁前处于锁定状态。或者，可以使用血袭者水晶标签跳过此房间（标签使用后即消耗）。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 攻城光束激光哨兵总共造成约200 DPS的全方位伤害，偏向电磁和热能伤害。它们每15-16秒开火一次。竞技场哨兵拥有一个非常强力的-75%网子，射程可达50公里。它每18秒发射一发堡垒电磁鱼雷，造成约1500电磁伤害。它还有一个非常强力的主动护盾和装甲防御，需要至少1000 DPS才能击穿。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此站点可升级为青春之泉。 分类:未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Base is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null Security regions with Blood Raider presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is very similar to Provisional Blood Outpost. Upon warping to the site you will land at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Acceleration gate is approx. 30 km away. Timed wave spawns in a few minutes after warpin.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Completely destroying the Blood Raider Chapel before subsequent waves have been aggressed can cause the Commander Battleship wave to not spawn.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Religious Fury. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Additional defenders on very short timer

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

rows.name: Blood Raider Chapel
rows.trigger: Escalation trigger. Triggers chapel wave when attacked

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者基地是一个未评级综合体，通过在有血袭者存在的零安区域扫描发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点与临时血袭者前哨站非常相似。跃迁到站点后，你会落在一条加速轨道旁。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 加速轨道距离约30公里。跃迁入场后数分钟内会刷新定时波次。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 在后续波次被触发之前彻底摧毁血袭者礼拜堂，可以导致指挥官战列舰波次不刷新。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可升级为宗教之怒。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Fortress is an Unrated Complex found in null security systems with Blood Raider presence. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site through the initial acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: All three groups of NPCs are initially passive until attacked. The acceleration gate to the next pocket is 25 km from warp-in. All defenders must be destroyed to use it.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Large number of ships. Close proximity of spawns means that incoming damage can be quite high. Destroy Dark Blood commander battleship to trigger escalation. Alternatively destroy the Blood Raider Battlestation to trigger escalation. Note that it has around 200k EHP and may take a long time to destroy.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying either the Dark Blood commander or the Blood Raider Battlestation can escalate the site to Dubious Assignment. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all defenders are destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者堡垒是一个未评级综合体，出现在有血袭者存在的零安星系。T2战列舰及以下的舰船可通过初始加速轨道进入该站点。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 所有三组NPC在未被攻击前均为被动状态。通往下一房间的加速轨道距跃迁入场点25公里。必须消灭所有防御者才能使用。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 舰船数量众多。刷新点距离很近，导致受到的伤害可能非常高。击杀暗血指挥官战列舰以触发升级。或者摧毁血袭者战斗空间站以触发升级。注意其有效生命值约为200k，可能需要较长时间才能摧毁。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 击杀暗血指挥官或摧毁血袭者战斗空间站均可将该站点升级为可疑任务。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: 400px The Blood Raider Outpost is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Blood Raider regions of Low Sec space. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate. A passive shield-tanked Drake can run this site. =Walkthrough=

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: *Last ship in nearest group triggers commander spawn This site may trigger the escalation Save The Slaves. Corpum cruisers can neut.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: about 4,000,000 ISK =Escalation= This site can escalate to Save The Slaves Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Blood Raider Bunker
rows.trigger: Destroying all Bunkers may result in getting the escalation.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 400px 血袭者前哨站是一个未评级宇宙信号战斗站点，可在低安血袭者区域使用核心探针扫描发现。该站点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁至侧面将落在加速轨道0米处。一艘被动盾抗龙蜥可以速刷此站点。=攻略=

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: *最近一组中最后一艘舰船触发指挥官增援波次 此站点可能触发升级 拯救奴隶。兵团巡洋舰会毁电。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: * 赏金：约4,000,000 ISK =升级= 此站点可升级至拯救奴隶 Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Blood Raider Temple Complex is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null Security systems with Blood Raider presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site is similar to Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point. It is much harder than its counterpart, though, and should only be attempted by skilled players in a ship with a very strong tank. Warping to the site you will land at an ancient acceleration gate, which permits T2 Battleships.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Wave 2 is triggered by killing all ships from initial defenders. None of the structures drop loot.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Do not underestimate the neuts in this room; recommend eliminating the elite cruisers and neuting towers first.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: The site does not contain any noteworthy loot.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: There is an almost 100% chance of the site escalating to the expedition Blood Raider Temple Complex (The Inner Sanctum). Category:Unrated_Complexes

rows.name: Corpus Cardinal/Monsignor/Patriarch/Pope
rows.trigger: Triggers battleship reinforcements upon attack and destruction

groups.name: Elite reinforcements (elite frigates from initial spawn destroyed)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 血袭者神殿综合体是一个未评级综合体，通过在存在血袭者的0.0安全等级星系中扫描发现。

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 该地点类似于暗血舰队集结点。但它比对应地点难得多，只有技术娴熟的玩家驾驶防御极强的舰船才应尝试。跃迁至该地点后，你会出现在一个古老的加速轨道旁，该轨道允许T2战列舰进入。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 击杀所有初始防御者舰船后会触发第二波。所有建筑均不掉落战利品。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 不要低估这个房间里的毁电威胁；建议优先消灭精英巡洋舰和毁电塔。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 该地点没有任何值得注意的战利品。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点有接近100%的几率升级为远征地点血袭者神殿综合体（内部圣坛）。Category:Unrated_Complexes

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This is a difficult site. Battlecruisers, or faction/pirate cruisers are recommended

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: The Powerful EM Forcefields will fully repair all hostile NPCs and sentries every couple of seconds while they are still present. Destroy them as quickly as you can before the NPCs get close to you, incoming DPS will build up quickly.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Killing the Corpus Station Manager may trigger the escalation The Rewards of Devotion. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: unlocks when Blood Raider Chapel is destroyed or if you have a Blood Raider Gold tag in your cargo

rows.name: Powerful EM Forcefield
rows.note: Until destroyed all complex receive insane reps

rows.name: Dark Blood Arch Templar (Corpus Station Manager)

sections.heading: 流程攻略
sections.text: 这是一个高难度地点。建议使用战列巡洋舰或势力/海盗巡洋舰。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 强力电磁力场会在存在期间每隔数秒完全修复所有敌对NPC和哨兵。在NPC接近你之前尽快摧毁力场，否则承受的DPS会迅速叠加。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 击杀血袭者空间站主管可能触发升级地点虔诚的回报。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This is a combat site that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in high security space in the Amarr regions. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Battlecruiser hulls and below can access it. A passive tanked battlecruiser or faction cruiser can run this site with little difficulty.

sections.heading: The Site Itself
sections.text: The site is gated. Warping to the site lands at 0 on the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Note: The Elder Corpii Spy Drones orbit with microwarpdrives at around 7,500m. As you may be Tracking Disrupted, you may need to use rockets or drones to kill it.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Medical Twilight.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocked by killing the Militant Commander or with a blood silver tag (consumed)

rows.name: Blood Raider Cathedral
rows.trigger: Attacking triggers Blood Raider Cathedral Engagement Wave

rows.name: Corpus Militant Supervisor
rows.trigger: Destroying may trigger Commander Wave, escalation trigger

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 这是一个可以通过探针扫描定位的战斗死亡空间，可在高安阿玛尔区域找到。站点位于加速轨道后方。只有战列巡洋舰及更小吨位的舰船能够进入。一艘被动防御的战列巡洋舰或势力巡洋舰可以轻松速刷此站点。

sections.heading: 站点本身
sections.text: 站点设有门禁。跃迁至站点会落在加速轨道的0米处。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 注意：长者在科尔皮侦察无人机搭载微型跃迁引擎在约7,500米处环绕运行。由于你可能遭到追踪干扰，你可能需要使用火箭或无人机来击杀它。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此站点可升级至医疗暮光。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Chemical Yard is an unrated combat site that can be found by Probe scanning in high and low security regions. The acceleration gates in site allow only T1 and pirate faction cruisers and below to enter.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Reinforcements arrive once all cruisers from initial defenders are destroyed.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: ---- The group nearest to warpin aggresses as you land. Destroying this group triggers commander wave. Destroying the reinforcement wave from group 3 is most likely second escalation trigger. Each group aggresses when approached or attacked. Groups 3 and 4 are far enough that they will not aggress unless specifically approached and can be ignored. Group 4 spawns differently sometimes, it may have 2 cruisers and 2 battlecruisers or 3 cruisers.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Hunting the Drudge Factory. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Drone Harvester
rows.trigger: Destroying this group triggers commander wave

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 化学工厂是一个未评级战斗死亡空间，可通过探针扫描在高安和低安区域找到。站点内的加速轨道仅允许T1和海盗势力巡洋舰及更小吨位的舰船进入。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 当初始防御部队中的所有巡洋舰被消灭后，增援波次到达。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ---- 入场点附近的第一组敌人在你降落时主动攻击。消灭该组敌人会触发指挥官波次。消灭第三组的增援波次很可能是第二个升级触发条件。每组敌人被靠近或攻击时变为敌对。第三组和第四组距离足够远，除非特意接近否则不会主动攻击，可以跳过。第四组的生成配置有时会变化，可能是2艘巡洋舰和2艘战列巡洋舰，或者3艘巡洋舰。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 此站点可升级至猎杀苦力工厂。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point is an unrated cosmic signature site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Blood Raider infested regions of Null Sec space. It may also be received as an escalation from Blood Forsaken Hub and Blood Forlorn Hub anomalies. The site itself escallates twice, involving travel. If both escallations go in the same direction, you could end up in hostile space for part 3. This can be run in a single Ishtar. The site appears to not aggro on Ishtar drones, so reset the aggro if that happens. The most critical part of running this is to deal with the neut batteries. Primary them but run away while you do because incoming damage will be heavy and you won't have cap. Fits with 100mn ABs and especially drone navigation modules, to get to the neut batteries faster may be best. Note that non-capital dark blood modules vary widely in price and so the site may not be worth running. It takes a long time. I destroyed all the batteries, but I recommend only destroying the neut batteries.

sections.heading: 2nd Pocket
sections.text: Killing the Corpus Pope will proceed the site to stage 2

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate, and I believe it may be guaranteed to do so, to Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point 2. Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 暗血舰队集结点是一个未评级的宇宙信号 site，可在血袭者控制的零安区域使用核心探针扫描发现。该 site 也可能由血弃枢纽（Blood Forsaken Hub）和血殇枢纽（Blood Forlorn Hub）异常升级而来。site 本身会升级两次，涉及跃迁转移。如果两次升级都指向同一方向，第三阶段你可能会身处敌对空间。该 site 可使用一艘伊什塔克级完成。site 似乎不会对伊什塔克级的无人机产生仇恨，如果发生仇恨请重新重置。运行此 site 最关键的是应对毁电电池组。优先锁定它们，但同时要保持距离，因为 incoming 伤害会很重，而且你会没有电容。装配 100MN 加力燃烧器，尤其是无人机导航模块，可以更快接近毁电电池组，可能是最优选择。注意非旗舰尺寸的暗血装备价格差异很大，因此该 site 可能不值得打。耗时很长。我摧毁了所有电池组，但建议只摧毁毁电电池组。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 击杀圣血教皇（Corpus Pope）后 site 进入第2阶段。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该 site 可以升级，我认为可能是必定升级为暗血舰队集结点2（Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point 2）。Category:Expeditions

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Desolate Site is an Unrated Complex found in high sec and low sec via exploration. You must be flying a T3 cruiser or smaller to enter the acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Initially there are only two groups on grid. Third group consisting of a frigate and a destroyer appears in few seconds. You can ignore the groups that have destroyers or drones. Destroying the group with frigates only will trigger additional waves. The first and second spawns appear by the Warning Sign structure. Finishing first spawn can trigger escalation.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: * Salvage: 814K-1.42M * Loot: (sentient drone) Drone Capillary Fluids + Drone Synaptic Relay Wiring (~5m). Possible Rogue Drone 46-X Nexus Chip (~50m). Sentient Modules (~100m) (very rare). * Bounties: about 50k (defenders) and 80k (reinforcement)

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the first spawn group or sentient drone can escalate the site to Mare Sargassum. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 荒芜站点是一个通过探索在高安和低安发现的未评级综合体。你必须驾驶 T3 巡洋舰或更小的舰船才能进入加速轨道。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 初始场上只有两组怪。第三组由一艘护卫舰和一艘驱逐舰组成，几秒后出现。你可以忽略包含驱逐舰或无人机的怪组。仅包含护卫舰的怪组被摧毁后会触发额外波次。第一波和第二波增援波次出现在警告标志（Warning Sign）建筑附近。完成第一波可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: * 打捞件：814K-1.42M * 战利品：（感知无人机）无人机毛细血管液 + 无人机突触中继线路（约500万）。可能的自由无人机 46-X 核心芯片（约5000万）。感知模块（约1亿）（非常稀有）。 * 赏金：约50K（防御怪）和80K（增援波次）

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁第一波增援波次或感知无人机可将 site 升级为马尾藻海（Mare Sargassum）。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Dirty Site is an Unrated Complex found in lowsec via exploration. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: Acceleration gate is 25 km from warp-in.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Additional spawns are mostly (only?) triggered by killing frigates. Shoot triggers with caution; it is very easy to trigger multiple waves at once and the large amount of elite cruisers and battlecruisers can do serious damage.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to Loose Ends. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Harvester/Infectious Drone
rows.trigger: killing all Infectious drones triggers commander wave. killing Harvester drones triggers other spawns

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 脏点是一个通过探索在低安发现的无评级综合体。该站点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁至站点会落在轨道0米处。

sections.heading: 房间 1
sections.text: 加速轨道距离跃入点 25 km。

sections.heading: 房间 2
sections.text: 额外刷新大多（仅？）由击杀护卫舰触发。射击触发器时要谨慎；非常容易同时触发多个波次，大量精英巡洋舰和战列巡洋舰能造成严重伤害。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可升级为未了之事。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null Security systems with Guristas presence. It can also be received as an escalation from a Guristas Forsaken Hub or Guristas Hidden Rally Point.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is fairly hard due to large number of ships and neuting towers. It can be done in a group of T2, T3 or Faction cruisers or a few battleships. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on an acceleration gate. === First pocket === The first pocket is fairly straightforward and easy. Destroy initial spawn, blow up the trigger last, destroy wave 2, take the gate.

sections.heading: Second pocket
sections.text: Get ready to blow up the energy neutralizing sentries when you warp in; they add a lot of difficulty to the room. The site does not contain any noteworthy loot.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The site has an almost 100% chance to escalate to Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point 2. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Initial defenders (45-55 km from acceleration gate)

zh.title: 恐惧古斯塔斯舰队集结点

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 恐惧古斯塔斯舰队集结点是一个通过在有古斯塔斯活动的0.0安全区扫描发现的无评级综合体。也可从古斯塔斯被遗弃的枢纽或古斯塔斯隐藏集结点升级获得。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点因大量舰船和毁电塔而难度较高。可使用T2、T3或舰队巡洋舰编队或数艘战列舰完成。跃迁至站点会落在加速轨道0米处。 === 第一个死亡空间房间 === 第一个死亡空间房间相当直接且简单。消灭初始刷怪，最后摧毁触发器，消灭第二波，通过加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第二个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 跃入时准备好摧毁毁电岗哨；它们会大幅增加该房间的难度。该站点没有任何值得注意的战利品。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点有近乎100%的概率升级为恐惧古斯塔斯舰队集结点 2。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Federation Detention Facility is an unrated combat site belonging to the Gallente Federation faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning signatures in high security systems in Black Rise within the Aokinen constellation. The site is level II scanning difficulty. This site appears to be the target for the Caldari epic arc mission The Breakout, and will only spawn when the respective mission has been accepted. One site will spawn in every system in the constellation and will respawn after completion.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: Acceleration Gate is 90 km from warp-in. Usually the pocket will be empty, but sometimes the following NPCs will spawn: The NPCs will aggro based on proximity and some of the frigates will web and point. Cruisers will use a significant amount of damping. The acceleration gate is not locked so a cloaky ship or well-tanked fast frigate can skip the pocket.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: The non-Warden frigates may not spawn. The Warden frigates are very weak (<100 HP) and can't stand a lot of damage. The Federation Detention Facility containers must be hacked with a Data Analyzer to retrieve the "Caldari Prisoners of War" item required to complete The Breakout. The containers are Easy difficulty (70 HP green System Core). After the first container is successfully hacked, an invisible 60-second timer starts, after which the containers will all explode and the site despawns. The containers are grouped relatively close together in a straight line, so if you have a fast ship and good hacking skills, you can hack multiple containers and pick up multiple mission items. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 联邦拘留设施是一个属于加里联邦势力的未评级战斗站点。可以通过在高安区黑升领域的奥基宁星座中扫描信号来发现。该站点的扫描难度为II级。该站点似乎是加里史诗任务'突破'的目标，只有在接受相应任务后才会生成。星座中每个星系都会生成一个站点，完成后会重新刷新。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 加速轨道距离跃迁点90公里。通常该区域是空的，但有时会生成以下NPC：NPC会根据距离主动攻击，部分护卫舰会使用网子和反跳。巡洋舰会施加大量阻尼效果。加速轨道没有锁定，因此隐身船或装甲充足的快速护卫舰可以跳过该区域。

sections.heading: 第一区域
sections.text: 非看守者护卫舰可能不会生成。看守者护卫舰非常脆弱（<100 HP），无法承受大量伤害。必须使用数据分析仪破解联邦拘留设施容器以获取完成'突破'任务所需的'加里战俘'物品。容器为简单难度（70 HP绿色系统核心）。成功破解第一个容器后，一个60秒的隐形计时器启动，之后所有容器将爆炸且站点消失。容器在一条直线上排列得比较紧密，因此如果船速快且破解技能好，可以破解多个容器并获取多个任务物品。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Festering Ruins is a combat relic site found in the Fountain nullsec region. Up to T2 Battleships can enter this site. This site appears to Probes as a combat site. The site is very rare and hard, and should only be attempted by skilled players. Rogue Drone, Serpentis, Angel Cartel and Guristas rats are present in this site. Omni tanks are highly recommended, especially against Kinetic and Thermal damage. Compared to other combat relic sites, this is noticeably harder due to higher DPS, especially in the fourth and last pocket.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: You land at an acceleration gate at warp-in. It is locked until the three battleships guarding it are destroyed.

sections.heading: First Pocket (Terrace)
sections.text: Expect high incoming damage in this room; recommend destroying the Stasis Towers first if you cannot tank the damage. The "Gate to Portal" will lead to second pocket while the "Gate to Hall" leads to third pocket. Both are locked until all ships are destroyed.

sections.heading: Second Pocket (Portal)
sections.text: This section is optional; only run it for extra bounties/salvage.

sections.heading: Fourth Pocket (Sanctum)
sections.text: Warning: DPS is considerably higher in this room. Highly recommend a strongly tanked T3 Cruiser or several Battleships. Use caution when destroying the Siege Sentries, as destroying each of them triggers a strong smartbomb wave. Category:Unrated_ComplexesCategory:Relic_sites

rows.name: Corelum Guardian Chief Defender/Chief Infantry/Chief Sentinel
Alvus Ruler/Supreme Alvus Parasite/Alvus Creator/Patriarch Alvus
Hive Mother
rows.note: Triggers next wave after structural damage

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 溃烂遗迹是一个位于喷泉无安区的战斗遗迹站点。最高允许T2战列舰进入该站点。在探针上该站点显示为战斗站点。该站点非常罕见且困难，只应由技术熟练的玩家尝试。站点中有自由无人机、天蛇、天使企业联合体和古斯塔斯的敌人。强烈建议全抗配置，特别是对动能和热能伤害的抗性。与其他战斗遗迹站点相比，由于更高的DPS，该站点明显更难，尤其是在第四和最后一个区域。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁入场时传送到加速轨道。轨道处于锁定状态，需要摧毁守卫的三艘战列舰才能解锁。

sections.heading: 第一区域（平台）
sections.text: 该房间伤害很高；如果无法抗住伤害，建议优先摧毁停滞塔。'通往传送门之门'将通往第二区域，而'通往大厅之门'通往第三区域。两扇门都需要消灭所有船只后才能解锁。

sections.heading: 第二区域（传送门）
sections.text: 此部分为可选内容；仅为了额外赏金/打捞物而进行。

sections.heading: 第四区域（圣坛）
sections.text: 警告：该房间的伤害明显更高。强烈建议使用装甲充足的T3巡洋舰或多艘战列舰。摧毁攻城哨兵时需谨慎，因为摧毁每一个都会触发一次强力的智能炸弹波次。Category:Unrated_ComplexesCategory:Relic_sites

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Forgotten Ruins is a very rare combat relic site found only in the Delve region, especially in the OK-FEM constellation. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site, and it often features large groups of Rogue Drone and Blood Raider rats. This combat site is harder than many lowsec and nullsec ones, and should only be attempted by skilled players.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site is similar to the Bloated Ruins and Wispy Ruins. Try to avoid triggering two waves at once, as the site can then become very difficult.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: The rats at warp-in are passive unless attacked, but have to be destroyed to unlock the gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket (Terrace)
sections.text: This room contains rats from the Blood Raider pirate faction.

sections.heading: Second Pocket (Portal)
sections.text: thumb|alt=|Forgotten Ruins - Portal This pocket is optional.

sections.heading: Third Pocket (Hall)
sections.text: thumb|alt=|Forgotten Ruins - Hall There are 6 Floating Debris containers that must be hacked with a Relic Analyzer before getting access to their contents.

sections.heading: Fourth Pocket (Sanctum)
sections.text: The Drone Creation Compound fires Citadel Explosive torpedoes that deal very high Explosive damage. Recommend at least 70% resists to Explosive damage. There are 2 Ancient Ruins containers that must be hacked with a Relic Analyzer before getting access to their contents. Hacking can trigger a spawn of Blood Raiders (4xBS,3xCruisers). Approaching a container can also trigger an explosion. Hive has an active tank that requires about 400-500 DPS to break. Rare chance Kasham Murdec arrives. No loot. Category:Unrated ComplexesCategory:Relic sites

rows.name: Drone Cruise Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Attacking any one triggers battery wave

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 遗忘遗迹是一个非常罕见的战斗遗迹站点，仅在Delve领域发现，特别是在OK-FEM星座。最高允许T2战列舰进入该站点，通常有大量自由无人机和血袭者的敌人。该战斗站点比许多低安和无安区站点更难，只应由技术熟练的玩家尝试。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点类似于膨胀遗迹和稀薄遗迹。尽量避免同时触发两波敌人，否则站点会变得非常困难。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 跃迁入场处的敌人是被动的，除非被攻击，但必须消灭它们才能解锁大门。

sections.heading: 第一区域（平台）
sections.text: 该房间包含血袭者海盗势力的敌人。

sections.heading: 第二区域（传送门）
sections.text: thumb|alt=|遗忘遗迹 - 传送门 该区域为可选内容。

sections.heading: 第三区域（大厅）
sections.text: thumb|alt=|遗忘遗迹 - 大厅 有6个漂浮碎片容器，必须使用遗迹分析仪破解后才能获取其中的物品。

sections.heading: 第四区域（圣坛）
sections.text: 无人机创造综合体发射城堡爆炸鱼雷，造成极高的爆炸伤害。建议至少70%的爆炸抗性。有2个远古遗迹容器，必须使用遗迹分析仪破解后才能获取其中的物品。破解可能触发血袭者增援（4艘战列舰，3艘巡洋舰）。靠近容器也可能触发爆炸。蜂巢有主动防御，需要约400-500 DPS才能击破。有极低概率出现Kasham Murdec。无战利品。Category:Unrated ComplexesCategory:Relic sites

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gurista Base is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null Security systems with Gurista presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site is very similar to Provisional Gurista Outpost. This site is doable in an Extender fit Drake. MWD or long-range weapons are recommended due to enemies spawning very far away. Warping to the site lands you at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: The acceleration gate to the second room is approximately 65 km away. It unlocks when all enemies are destroyed.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You will get faction ammo and Dread Guristas dog tags. The commander battleship can drop Dread Guristas battleship modules and even a rare Rattlesnake BPC.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Consequences Smonsequences. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all ships are destroyed

groups.name: Reinforcements (may not spawn; triggered by approaching the Control Tower)
Tower wave (triggered by destroying the Control Tower)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯基地是一个未评级综合体，通过扫描有古斯塔斯势力存在的无安区星系发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点与临时古斯塔斯前哨站非常相似。该站点可以在扩展装配幼龙中完成。由于敌人生成距离非常远，建议使用微曲推进或远程武器。跃迁到站点会传送到加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一区域
sections.text: 通往第二区域的加速轨道大约65公里远。消灭所有敌人后解锁。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你将获得势力弹药和恐惧古斯塔斯狗牌。指挥官战列舰可能掉落恐惧古斯塔斯战列舰装备，甚至有稀有的响尾蛇BPC。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级到后果。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gurista Fortress is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null Security systems with Guristas presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Warping to the site lands you at 0 on an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: The acceleration gate to the second room is approximately 30 km away. It unlocks when all enemies are destroyed.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: The Dread Guristas Dismantler may not spawn in until you reach ~10 km of the Guristas Bunker. It is unverified, but if you do not trigger an escalation after killing all NPCs you may destroy the bunker which is separate from the other three. Then destroy the middle one among the remaining three bunkers and destroy the last two bunkers. You will still have the chance of triggering escalation after doing these steps. *RigelKent, 2025-10-12: just got the escalation from following the aforementioned sequence: after killed all rats, then, I killed the bunker separated and following that, I killed the bunker in the middle; can't confirm if it's enough always or the order is random.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Hired Gun. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all ships are destroyed

rows.name: Guristas Bunker
rows.note: It is believed that destroying all bunker will increase the chance of triggering escalation. TBC.

rows.name: Pithum Eraser
rows.note: It is believed that leaving this NPC at the last one to kill will increase the chance of triggering escalation and commander spawn.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯堡垒是一个未评级综合体，通过扫描有古斯塔斯势力存在的无安区星系发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到站点会传送到加速轨道的0点。

sections.heading: 第一区域
sections.text: 通往第二区域的加速轨道大约30公里远。消灭所有敌人后解锁。

sections.heading: 第二区域
sections.text: 恐惧古斯塔斯拆卸者可能在你接近古斯塔斯地堡约10公里内才会生成。未经证实，但如果在杀死所有NPC后没有触发升级，你可以摧毁那个与其他三个分开的地堡。然后摧毁剩余三个中中间的地堡，再摧毁最后两个地堡。完成这些步骤后你仍有机会触发升级。*RigelKent，2025-10-12：按照上述顺序确实触发了升级：杀死所有敌人后，我先摧毁了分开的地堡，然后摧毁了中间的地堡；无法确认这是否总是足够或者顺序是随机的。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级到雇佣枪手。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Gurista Hideout is a Cosmic Signature of the Unrated Complex type, occupied by the Guristas pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec systems.

sections.heading: Walkthough
sections.text: The site consists of two deadspace pockets with acceleration gates, various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Delayed Wave 1 arrives after about 10 seconds. Delayed Wave 2 arrives after about 2 minutes. Tower Wave triggered by attacking the Experimental Weapon Tower. Wave 2 arives not always.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: After destruction of the Dread Guristas Imputor/Arrogator or Experimental Weapon Tower, you may receive the escalation Sooth Sayer. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all NPC`s are killed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯藏身处是一个未评级综合体类型的宇宙信号，由古斯塔斯海盗势力占据。可以通过在高安星系的探索中发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点由两个死亡空间区域组成，有加速轨道连接各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用轨道可以进入站点内的其他区域。列出的船只名称和数量可能略有不同。

sections.heading: 第二房间
sections.text: 延迟波次1在约10秒后到达。延迟波次2在约2分钟后到达。攻击实验武器塔触发塔楼波次。波次2不一定出现。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁恐惧古斯塔斯冲击者/傲慢者或实验武器塔后，你可能收到升级到预言者的通知。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gurista Lookout is an unrated combat site belonging to the Guristas Pirates faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning signatures in high security systems.

sections.heading: Warp In
sections.text: No NPCs at initial warp in. Initial gate will not allow cruisers or bigger to pass.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: To trigger commander spawn destroy the Guristas Control Center. Escalation can probably be triggered by destroying the Guristas Control Center.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The Gurista Lookout can escalate to Trap?.

sections.heading: Mining
sections.text: Unfortunately, the acceleration gate is limited to frigate or destroyer-sized ships, so only mining frigates or expedition frigates can enter the site to mine. The site will stay loaded provided the Guristas Control Center is not destroyed. If it is destroyed, staying inside the site will keep it loaded. You can use an alt for this purpose. You may also briefly leave the site to drop off ore, but if the site is too far away from your drop-off point, the site may despawn if nobody is inside. It is best to leave someone in the site if possible just in case. Moving too far toward the outside on grid can also cause the site to despawn. If you want to further restrict who can come into the site, purposefully destroying the Guristas Control Center will remove the site signature and restrict its access to bookmarks and combat probes. It is recommended to use an Endurance to mine the site, as its larger mining hold will minimize drop-offs to unload your cargo. It also lets you use light scout drones to defeat all rats in each pocket and reinforcements that include ECM rats. Prospect can be used but it has no good way to deal with ECM rats and will get jammed and its mining hold is smaller. Venture is a good option if you don't have the skills for expedition frigates. In order of profitability, it is best to prioritize the Hemorphite first, then the Omber and lastly the Jaspet. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Guristas Control Center
rows.trigger: Possible escalation trigger, commander wave trigger

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯瞭望站是一个属于古斯塔斯海盗势力的未评级战斗站点。可以通过在高安星系中扫描信号来发现。

sections.heading: 跃迁入场
sections.text: 初始跃迁入场处没有NPC。初始加速轨道不允许巡洋舰或更大的船只通过。

sections.heading: 第二房间
sections.text: 摧毁古斯塔斯控制中心以触发指挥官刷新。摧毁古斯塔斯控制中心可能也可以触发升级。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 古斯塔斯瞭望站可以升级到陷阱？

sections.heading: 采矿
sections.text: 不幸的是，加速轨道仅限于护卫舰或驱逐舰级别的船只，因此只有采矿护卫舰或勘探护卫舰可以进入该站点采矿。只要古斯塔斯控制中心未被摧毁，站点就会保持加载状态。如果被摧毁，留在站点内可以保持其加载状态。你可以用小号来做这件事。你也可以短暂离开站点去卸载矿石，但如果站点距离卸载点太远且站点内无人，站点可能会消失。如果可能的话，最好留一个人在站点内以防万一。在网格上向外移动太远也可能导致站点消失。如果你想进一步限制谁能进入站点，故意摧毁古斯塔斯控制中心将移除站点信号，并将其访问限制为仅限书签和战斗探针。建议使用耐力级采矿护卫舰开采该站点，因为其更大的采矿舱将减少卸载货物的次数。它还允许你使用轻型侦察无人机击败每个区域的敌人和包含ECM敌人的增援。勘探级可以使用，但没有好的方式对付ECM敌人，会被干扰，且采矿舱更小。如果没有勘探护卫舰技能，冒险级是一个好选择。按收益排序，最好优先开采赫莫弗里特矿石，然后是奥姆伯矿石，最后是杰斯佩特矿石。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Annex is an Unrated Complex that can be found in Low Security systems with Gurista presence through exploration. Battleships and their T2 counterparts can enter the site.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is similar to Guristas Vigil. Warping to the site will land you on an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Accel gate to room 3- taking it can trigger escalation to Guristas Powergrid. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.trigger: Unlocks when Port Authority Officer is destroyed

rows.name: Port Authority Officer (Pith Destroyer)
