rows.trigger: Destroy to unlock the acceleration gate

groups.name: Commander wave (battleship from last wave destroyed)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯附属建筑是一个未评级综合体，可以通过探索在有古斯塔斯势力存在的低安星系中发现。战列舰及其T2 counterpart可以进入该站点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点类似于古斯塔斯哨站。跃迁到站点将落在加速轨道上。

sections.heading: 第二区域
sections.text: 通往第三区域的加速轨道——通过可能触发升级到古斯塔斯电网。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 1st Pocket
sections.text: 3 NPC groups, with two more spawns upon attacking and killing the control tower. Without diamond tag, blitz is still possible, but not recommended, incoming damage becomes *very* high and the frigates point. It seems you can skip the room and activate the gate with a Guristas diamond tag in your cargo. Destroying the EM forcefield will destroy your drones.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: 4 NPC groups The sentry guns deal 53% kinetic, 40% thermal, 7% EM damage, high K and T resistance and the use of afterburner can lower sentry damage to the minimum. The deep space stronghold has about 500,000 EHP and triggers reinforcement at 30% hull: * If the faction battleship does not spawn, the stronghold is the escalation trigger. * Destroying the deep space stronghold (or the Dread Guristas Eliminator, if it spawns) finishes the site. Deep Space Stronghold drops nothing interesting.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Pirate's Path.

sections.heading: To be verified
sections.text: * Range of EM smartbomb * Does dread guristas spawns 100% (No it does not, and it not spawning does not automatically lead to an escalation the Pirate's Path site). Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Control Tower
rows.trigger: attacking triggers Tower Wave, destroying it unlocks the gate.

rows.name: Dread Guristas Eliminator
rows.note: moves surprisingly fast, almost 2km/sec - can give t2 salvage

sections.heading: 第一区域
sections.text: 3个NPC编队，攻击并杀死控制塔后刷新两波增援。没有钻石标签也可以速刷，但不推荐，受到的伤害变得*非常*高且护卫舰会反跳。似乎可以用货舱中的古斯塔斯钻石标签跳过房间并激活门。摧毁电磁力场将摧毁你的无人机。

sections.heading: 第二区域
sections.text: 4个NPC编队。哨兵炮造成53%动能、40%热能、7%电磁伤害，高动能和热能抗性并使用加力燃烧器可以将哨兵伤害降到最低。深空堡垒约有500,000 EHP，在30%船体时触发增援：* 如果势力战列舰未刷新，深空堡垒是升级触发条件。* 摧毁深空堡垒（或恐惧古斯塔斯歼灭者，如果刷新）完成站点。深空堡垒不掉落有价值的物品。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级到海盗之路。

sections.heading: 待验证
sections.text: * 电磁智能炸弹的范围 * 恐惧古斯塔斯是否100%刷新（不，不会，且它不刷新不会自动导致升级到海盗之路站点）。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This combat site is an unrated complex which can be found in Low-sec through exploration.

sections.heading: Difficulty & Ship Recommendation
sections.text: You can do first pocket in Assault Frigate with ~200DPS, orbiting at 10km. Second pocket is same except you need to manually control your range due to large asteroid in center of complex.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Destroy all hostiles, advance to the next pocket.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Destroy all battlecruisers, if spawned destroy commander and loot it. Also destroy Guristas Bunker for possible escalation.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site has a chance to escalate to Gurista Productions Shipment. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 该战斗站点是一个未评级综合体，可以通过探索在低安区发现。

sections.heading: 难度与舰船推荐
sections.text: 你可以用约200DPS的突击护卫舰完成第一区域，在10公里环绕。第二区域相同，但由于综合体中心有大块小行星，你需要手动控制距离。

sections.heading: 第一区域
sections.text: 消灭所有敌对目标，前进到下一区域。

sections.heading: 第二区域
sections.text: 消灭所有战列巡洋舰，如果刷新则消灭指挥官并拾取战利品。同时摧毁古斯塔斯地堡以可能触发升级。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点有机会升级到古斯塔斯生产运输线。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas provincial HQ - Can be found in Guristas Nullsec

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: * Mix of 15 or so Battleships/battlecruisers in first pocket * 2 stasis web towers 31km off. Both web immediately. Got Chased out before I could finish the site. Will update later when I can. - Kaboose 909 Killed control tower which unlocked the gate

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: WARNING! Second room contains 4 siege railguns (80km away) that can hit for 300-400 against a tengu with 62% thermal, 92% kinetic resists! They volley at the same time. 2023.9.17 update Siege railguns have a damage type of 10% EM, 10% Explosive, 30% Thermal, 50% Kinetic. A Proteus with a resistance of 87% Thermal, 95% Kinetic, 50% EM, 10% Explosive, would take 200~350 damage from one hit. 4 siege railguns DO fire at the same time, rate of fire around 15 seconds a shot. attacking the station will cause a Kinetic smartbomb activation, causing around 6000 Kinetic damage. The smartbomb does not repeat. When the station is brought down to 20% structure, it would spawn a wave of 20 battleships plus more scram web frigates and a dread guristas conquistador with a 10m isk bounty. It is recommended to use afterburner to avoid damage from battleship torpedos. If you kill the station and warp out but do not kill the faction spawn, the whole site including the faction commander will despawn. I recommended killing the scram / web frigates immediately and taking down a couple of the siege rail guns before attacking the station. The DPS from the railguns plus the second wave can quickly overwhelm even a blingy ship.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The site can escalate to No Quarter. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯省级总部 - 可在古斯塔斯无安区找到

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: * 第一区域混合约15艘战列舰/战列巡洋舰 * 2个静止网子塔在31公里处。两者立即使用网子。在完成站点前被 chased 出去。稍后能完成时会更新。- Kaboose 909 杀死了控制塔，解锁了门

sections.heading: 第二房间
sections.text: 警告！第二房间有4门攻城轨道炮（80公里外），对热抗62%、动抗92%的乌鸦级可造成300-400伤害！它们同时齐射。2023.9.17更新 攻城轨道炮的伤害类型为10%电磁、10%爆炸、30%热能、50%动能。一个热抗87%、动抗95%、电磁抗50%、爆炸抗10%的普罗透斯级，每次命中将受到200~350伤害。4门攻城轨道炮确实同时开火，射速约15秒一发。攻击空间站将触发动能智能炸弹激活，造成约6000动能伤害。智能炸弹不会重复。当空间站被降至20%结构时，将刷出一波20艘战列舰以及更多反跳和网子护卫舰，以及一艘赏金1000万ISK的恐惧古斯塔斯征服者。建议使用加力燃烧器以避免战列舰鱼雷的伤害。如果你杀死空间站后跃迁出去但没有杀死势力刷新，整个站点包括势力指挥官都会消失。建议立即击杀反跳/网子护卫舰，并在攻击空间站前摧毁几门攻城轨道炮。轨道炮加第二波的DPS可以快速压制即使是豪华装配的舰船。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级到绝无例外。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Guristas Vigil is a Cosmic Signature of the Unrated Complex type, occupied by the Guristas pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec systems. This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

sections.heading: Walkthough
sections.text: The site consists of three deadspace pockets with an acceleration gates, various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: Approach Smuggler Gate to trigger gate wave.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Wave 2 arrives after about 3 minutes. Wave 3 arrives after about 4 minutes. Wave 4 arrives after about 5 minutes.

sections.heading: Room 3
sections.text: The room is empty except for a warp beacon. This room is an alternate trigger for possible Expedition.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Kidnapped! Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until Port Authority Officer is killed or by consuming a Guristas Gold Tag

rows.name: Smuggler Gate
rows.trigger: Approach this to trigger Gate Wave

rows.name: Port Authority Officer (Pith Eradicator)
rows.trigger: Destroying this will unlock the acceleration gate
rows.note: Message on death in Local: "The port authorities ship must have somehow been connected with the acceleration gate below. Once it is destroyed, a strange sound is heard coming out of the gate."

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯哨站是一个未评级综合体类型的宇宙信号，由古斯塔斯海盗势力占据。可以通过在高安星系的探索中发现。该站点的加速轨道仅允许战列巡洋舰级别或更低的船只及其T2等价物进入。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点由三个死亡空间区域组成，有加速轨道连接各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用轨道可以进入站点内的其他区域。列出的船只名称和数量可能略有不同。

sections.heading: 第一房间
sections.text: 接近走私者之门以触发门波次。

sections.heading: 第二房间
sections.text: 波次2在约3分钟后到达。波次3在约4分钟后到达。波次4在约5分钟后到达。

sections.heading: 第三房间
sections.text: 该房间除跃迁信标外为空。该房间是可能远征的替代触发点。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级到绑架事件。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Guristas Watch is an Unrated Complex found in high security space through exploration.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: There are two pockets in this site. Due to the site having a lot of triggers monitor any drones closely so they do not shoot the trigger ship on accident.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: It is possible to skip this room by shooting the triggers and destroying the Pithum Militant Commander, but expect high incoming damage.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Terrorist Plot! Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when Pithum Militant Commander is destroyed

rows.name: Guristas Heavy Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Triggers wave 2 (wave 2 comes regardless based on a invisible timer)

groups.name: Supervisor wave (triggered by attacking the Weapons Manufacturing Plant)

rows.name: Pithatis Militant Supervisor (Pithatis Enforcer/Assaulter)
rows.trigger: Destroying triggers commander wave; can also trigger escalation

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 古斯塔斯哨所是一个通过探索在高安区发现的未评级综合体。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点有两个区域。由于站点有很多触发点，密切监控你的无人机，以免它们意外射击触发船只。

sections.heading: 第一区域
sections.text: 可以通过射击触发点并摧毁皮姆好战指挥官来跳过该房间，但预期会受到高额伤害。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级到恐怖袭击。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Haunted Yard is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. This site can escalate to Pulverize the Pioneers

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: To blitz: The leaking caskets are unlocked so head straight for them. The commander wave spawns near the warp in so boost back there.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.text: HiSec (0.6): Acceleration gate handles: Frigate, Cruiser, Shuttle, Corvette, Assault Frigate, Destroyer, Interdictor, Covert Ops, Interceptor, Stealth Bomber, Electronic Attack Ship, Expedition Frigate, Tactical Destroyer, Logistics Frigate, Command Destroyer

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Pulverize the Pioneers. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 闹鬼院子是一个属于自由无人机势力的未评级战斗站点。可以通过在高安和低安星系中扫描异常来发现。该站点可以升级到粉碎先驱

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 速刷路线：泄露的棺材已解锁，直接前往它们。指挥官波次在跃迁入场点附近刷新，所以加速回到那里。

sections.heading: 可达性
sections.text: 高安（0.6）：加速轨道允许：护卫舰、巡洋舰、穿梭机、护卫艇、突击护卫舰、驱逐舰、拦截舰、隐形侦察舰、截击舰、隐形轰炸舰、电子攻击舰、勘探护卫舰、战术驱逐舰、后勤护卫舰、指挥驱逐舰

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级到粉碎先驱。Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The following info is unconfirmed. It is modified from a similar site in a different region. Hidden Ruins is a very rare Relic site involving combat as well as hacking, found by scanning in Nullsec. It is found in the Cloud Ring region, and is probably found in the Syndicate and Outer Ring regions. Rats from several factions are present here. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site. Damage in the site can easily become excessive if care is not taken in managing triggers.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The warpin contains a few rats. The acceleration gate is locked until the defenders are dead.

sections.heading: First Pocket (Terrace)
sections.text: This room contains rats from the Serpentis pirate faction.

sections.heading: Second Pocket (Portal)
sections.text: This is an optional room, as the Gate to Hall leads deeper towards the central deadspace pocket.

sections.heading: Third Pocket (Hall)
sections.text: Rogue drones are present in this room. Floating Debris containers require a Relic Analyzer to access.

sections.heading: Fourth Pocket (Sanctum)
sections.text: The Hive Mother does not have very strong tank but triggers several waves of defenders that can possibly overwhelm an unprepared explorer. The smartbomb wave from the Ancient Ruins is strong enough to instantly destroy any frigate not prepared for it. Category:Relic sitesCategory:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Drone Cruise Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Attacking any one triggers battery wave

rows.name: Floating Debris
rows.trigger: Successfully hacking all containers triggers a smartbomb wave

rows.name: Gate to Sanctum
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

rows.name: Damaged Sentinel Chimera Strain Mother
rows.trigger: Triggers subsequent waves at armor damage, hull damage, 50% and 25% hull

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 以下信息未经证实。它是根据另一个星域的类似站点修改而来的。隐秘遗迹是一个非常罕见的遗迹站点，涉及战斗以及黑客入侵，通过扫描在00安全等级空间中发现。它位于云环星域，可能也出现在辛迪加和外环星域。多个势力的怪会出现在这里。最高T2战列舰可以进入该站点。如果不注意管理触发机制，站点内的伤害很容易变得过高。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁入口点有几个怪。加速轨道在防御者被消灭前处于锁定状态。

sections.heading: 第一个房间（露台）
sections.text: 这个房间包含天蛇海盗势力的怪。

sections.heading: 第二个房间（传送门）
sections.text: 这是一个可选房间，因为通往大厅的加速轨道深入通往中央死亡空间房间。

sections.heading: 第三个房间（大厅）
sections.text: 这个房间中有自由无人机。漂浮碎片容器需要遗迹分析仪才能访问。

sections.heading: 第四个房间（圣坛）
sections.text: Hive Mother没有很强的防御，但会触发多波防御者，可能会压垮毫无准备的探索者。远古遗迹的智能炸弹波次足以瞬间摧毁任何未做准备的护卫舰。分类：遗迹站点分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Hierarchy is an Unrated Complex found in nullsec via exploration. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate. All rats must be cleared to activate the acceleration gate to the second room.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: Blitz: The entire site has no warp disruptors or scrams so most rats can be ignored if you can tank them. Upon landing approach the Warning Sign near the Hierarchy structure. Getting close will trigger the first spawn. Each new wave is triggered by simply damaging a single rat so you can quickly spawn the battleship wave. Kill all the battleships, spawning the Sentient, kill it, bookmark the wreck and warp off. After the site has despawned grab your loot and possibly salvage the wreck (average 9-11m in Salvage).

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to Trouble in Paradise, a four part expedition. Category:Combat Anomalies

groups.name: Gate spawn after approaching acceleration gate
Spawn 5 after all battleships have been destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 层级是一个未评级综合体，通过探索在00安全等级空间中发现。该站点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到站点会降落在加速轨道的0米处。必须清除所有怪才能激活通往第二个房间的加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 速刷：整个站点没有反跳和扰频，所以如果你能抗住伤害，大部分怪可以忽略。降落后接近层级建筑附近的警告标志。靠近会触发第一波刷新。每一新波次只需伤害一个怪即可触发，所以你可以快速刷出战列舰波次。击杀所有战列舰，刷出Sentient，击杀它，对残骸做书签然后跃迁离开。站点消失后拾取战利品并可能打捞残骸（平均打捞收入9-11M）。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可以升级为天堂之乱，一个四部分远征任务。分类：战斗异常点

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Independence is an Unrated Complex found in nullsec via exploration. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate.

sections.heading: First room
sections.text: Acceleration gate is 50 km from warp-in. Gate is not locked. Burn towards the gate while destroying the scrammer frigates.

sections.heading: Second room
sections.text: BLITZ : burn towards the 3 closest battleships, destroy them, shoot just once one of the two battleships that spawn after the initial 3, Sentient will spawn. The initial defenders are arranged in three groups around the warp in (by ship size) and can be aggressed separately. Attacking any Battleships from Spawn 1 triggers Spawn 2. Attacking any ship from Spawn 3 triggers Spawn 4. Destroying all NPCs in this site will pay about 22 million ISK in bounties.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to The Drone Roulette with the message: Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.trigger: Approaching the Acceleration Gate triggers the Gate Wave

rows.name: Matriach Alvus
rows.trigger: Attacking any of these triggers Spawn 2

rows.name: Strain Infester/Decimator/Splinter/Render Alvi
rows.trigger: Attacking any of these ships triggers Spawn 4

rows.name: Alvus Ruler/Supreme Alvus Parasite
rows.trigger: Attacking any of these ships triggers Spawn 4

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 独立是一个未评级综合体，通过探索在00安全等级空间中发现。该站点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到站点会降落在加速轨道的0米处。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 加速轨道距离跃迁点50 km。轨道未锁定。在消灭扰频护卫舰的同时冲向加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 速刷：冲向最近的3艘战列舰，消灭它们，对初始3艘之后刷新的2艘战列舰中的任意一艘开火一次，Sentient就会刷新。初始防御者按舰船大小分为三组环绕跃迁点，可以分别触发。攻击第1波刷新的任何战列舰会触发第2波。攻击第3波刷新的任何舰船会触发第4波。消灭该站点中所有NPC大约可获得22M ISK赏金。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级为无人机轮盘，并显示消息：分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: ISHAEKA Tactical Response HQ is an Unrated Complex found only in the Monalaz constellation in the Genesis region. The site is ungated at warpin and is NOT deadspace in first pocket. It is very hard and should only be attempted by skilled players. CONCORD and Amarr Empire rats are present. You will likely receive hefty standing losses from them. AVOID using cap-dependent modules in this site, you will likely lose your ship.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The sentries have very short range but deal heavy EM damage.

sections.heading: Pocket 2
sections.text: The Justicar Archives gate continues forward in the complex, while the Justicar Haven gate leads back to the first pocket.

sections.heading: Pocket 3 (Justicar Archives)
sections.text: Blitz: Destroy ISHAEKA Monalaz Commander, bookmark his wreck, warp out and come back later to pick up the loot. Imperial Templar Diviner has VERY heavy neuts, as well as strong tracking disruption.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: Typical loot drop from the rats is just metal scraps, T1 ammo, drones, possible meta modules and insignias. The ISHAEKA Monalaz Commander can drop meta and Imperial Navy faction modules and possibly 3% and 5% skill hardwiring implants. Rarely it can contain a one-run Apocalypse Navy Issue BPC. Category: Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Justicar Haven
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

rows.name: ISHAEKA Response Team Gamma (DED Soldier 3rd Class)
ISHAEKA Response Team Alpha (DED Army Colonel)
Gate to ISHAEKA Fleet Staging Area
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: ISHAEKA战术响应总部是一个未评级综合体，仅位于起源星域的Monalaz星座中。该站点跃迁入口没有轨道限制，第一个房间不是死亡空间。该站点非常困难，只应由技术娴熟的玩家尝试。有CONCORD和艾玛帝国的怪。你很可能会遭受大量的声望损失。避免在该站点使用依赖电容的装备，否则你很可能会损失舰船。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 哨兵的射程很短，但造成大量电磁伤害。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 裁决者档案库加速轨道在综合体中向前延伸，而裁决者避难所加速轨道通回第一个房间。

sections.heading: 第3个房间（裁决者档案库）
sections.text: 速刷：消灭ISHAEKA Monalaz Commander，对残骸做书签，跃迁出去稍后回来拾取战利品。Imperial Templar Diviner有非常强的毁电，以及强烈的追踪干扰。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 怪的典型战利品掉落只有金属碎片、T1弹药、无人机、可能的meta装备和徽章。ISHAEKA Monalaz Commander可以掉落meta和帝国海军势力装备，以及可能的3%和5%技能硬连线植入体。稀有情况下可能包含一个一次使用的Apocalypse Navy Issue BPC。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Minor Angel Annex is an unrated Complex occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found by probing in Lowsec. Its signal strength is 10%, making it moderately easy to scan down. The site is accessed through an acceleration gate. While a well fit battlecruiser can solo the first part, it would be difficult if not impossible to do so for the second part. This complex is unrated and is of a difficulty similar to a 5 or 6/10 DED Rated Complexes

sections.heading: First room
sections.text: More defenders appear as the communications officers are agressed. The militant commander appears in last wave. The destruction of militant commander unlocks the acceleration gate. The wave information here is inaccurate and should be considered as a rough view of the site.

sections.heading: Second room
sections.text: The information of waves in second room is even worse than for first room. The second wave seems to be triggered by sentries. Supervisor is triggered by attacking the drug factory. Attacking the drug factory may trigger all other waves too if they have not been triggered before engaging the station. Commander is triggered by killing the supervisor. Other triggers are unknown. To engage next wawe hit the drug farm

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: *Bounty: Approx 7 M ISK in the first room, 10 M ISK in the second room *Loot and Salvage: Approx 6 - 8 M ISK in the first room, 6 - 8 M ISK in the second rooom *The Domination ship has a chance to drop faction or Gist mods.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site may escalate to Angel Owned Station. Category:Unrated Complexes

zh.title: 小型天使企业联合体附馆

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 小型天使企业联合体附馆是一个被天使企业联合体海盗势力占据的未评级综合体。可以通过在低安空间中使用探针扫描发现。其信号强度为10%，中等容易扫描到。该站点通过加速轨道进入。虽然一艘配置良好的战巡舰可以单刷第一部分，但第二部分即使不是不可能也会很困难。该综合体未评级，难度类似于5或6/10 DED评级综合体。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 随着通讯官被攻击，更多防御者会出现。好战指挥官出现在最后一波。消灭好战指挥官可以解锁加速轨道。此处的波次信息不准确，应视为对该站点的大致概述。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 第二个房间的波次信息比第一个房间更不准确。第二波似乎由哨兵触发。攻击毒品工厂会触发主管。如果在攻击站点之前尚未触发其他波次，攻击毒品工厂可能也会触发所有其他波次。击杀主管会触发指挥官。其他触发条件未知。要触发下一波次，攻击毒品农场。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: *赏金：第一个房间约7M ISK，第二个房间10M ISK *战利品和打捞：第一个房间约6-8M ISK，第二个房间6-8M ISK *统御舰船有几率掉落势力或吉斯特改装件。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可能升级为天使占领空间站。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Minor Blood Annex is a low security unrated site found through exploration. Excercise extreme caution due to multiple waves potentially having been spawned before you enter.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Upon warping to the site you will arrive at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: The webbing drone in each group will spawn the next group. On some occasions multiple groups will already be present when you warp in. In final wave the destruction of Corpus Militant Commander unlocks the gate. The gate can also be unlocked with a Blood Crystal Tag. The tag is consumed.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Destroying the webbing drones will again trigger additional waves. Attacking the cathedral triggers cathedral wave. Destroying Corpus Militant Supervisor in cathedral wave triggers commander wave.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The site can escalate to Blood Owned Station. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 小型血袭者附馆是一个通过探索在低安全等级空间发现的未评级站点。由于在你进入之前可能已经触发了多波怪，请极度小心。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到站点后你会到达一个加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 每组中的网子无人机会触发下一组。有时多组怪在你跃迁进入时已经存在。在最后一波中，消灭Corpus Militant Commander可以解锁加速轨道。加速轨道也可以使用血袭者水晶标签解锁。标签会被消耗。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 消灭网子无人机将再次触发额外波次。攻击大教堂会触发大教堂波次。在大教堂波次中消灭Corpus Militant Supervisor会触发指挥官波次。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级为血袭者占领空间站。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Minor Guristas Annex is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security regions with Guristas presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is very similar to Guristas Watch. Recommended high resists for kinetic and thermal damage. Video: [HAM Tengu February 2014] Upon warping to the signature you will land at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Either kill the Pith Militant Commander to unlock the acceleration gate or use a Guristas Crystal Tag to proceed into the second room.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to Guristas Owned Station Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Weapons Manufacturing Plant
rows.trigger: Attacking aggros all ships. Triggers Supervisor wave when attacked.

rows.name: Pith Militant Supervisor(Pith Massacrer)
rows.trigger: Destruction completes site, and triggers commander wave
rows.note: Higher active shield tank than other NPCs

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 小型古斯塔斯附馆是一个未评级综合体，通过在有古斯塔斯存在的低安全等级星域扫描发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点与古斯塔斯哨站非常相似。建议对动能和热能伤害准备高抗性。视频：[HAM Tengu 2014年2月] 跃迁到信号点后会降落在一个加速轨道处。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 要么击杀Pith Militant Commander解锁加速轨道，要么使用古斯塔斯水晶标签进入第二个房间。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可以升级为古斯塔斯占领空间站。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Minor Sansha Annex is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security systems in Sansha infested space.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is very similar to Sansha Watch. Upon warping to the site you will land at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Approach the acceleration gate to trigger the proximity wave.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Blitz: Destroy the True Sansha battlecruiser, bookmark his wreck, warp out and come back in a few minutes to pick up the loot. Full room aggro on warp-in. The fleet is spread out in several groups at significant distances across the pocket so immediate incoming damage will be low. Most of them will be ~50 km away; one battleship will spawn at a high angle above you 90 km away and can be ignored. True Sansha Battlecruiser will not be immediately present on warp-in. After roughly 30 seconds in the pocket a loud alarm will sound in local and (sometimes) spawn the commander. Shoot the Mind Control Tower and kill the Centus Militant Supervisor if no commander spawns to despawn the site.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the True Sansha commander may escalate the site to Sansha Owned Station. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Initial defenders (2 Groups, both ~30km from warp-in)

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until Slave Commander is destroyed

rows.name: Centus Militant Supervisor (Centus Dark Lord/Overlord)
rows.trigger: Destroying despawns site and may trigger escalation

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 小型萨沙共和国附馆是一个未评级综合体，通过在被萨沙侵扰的低安全等级星系扫描发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点与萨沙哨站非常相似。跃迁到站点后会降落在一个加速轨道处。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 接近加速轨道以触发接近波次。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 速刷：消灭纯正萨沙战巡舰，对残骸做书签，跃迁出去几分钟后回来拾取战利品。跃迁进入时全房间仇恨。舰队分散在房间中多个相距甚远的编队中，因此初始承受的伤害会很低。大部分在约50 km外；一艘战列舰会在你上方高角度90 km处刷新，可以忽略。纯正萨沙战巡舰在跃迁进入时不会立即出现。进入房间大约30秒后，本地频道会响起响亮的警报声，并（有时）刷出指挥官。射击精神控制塔，如果没有指挥官刷新则击杀Centus Militant Supervisor以使站点消失。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 消灭纯正萨沙指挥官可能将站点升级为萨沙占领空间站。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site is very similar to Serpentis Watch.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: ---- Kill points, approach the gate, use Serpentis Crystal Tag - voilà, you are in Second Pocket. Or kill Core Militiant Commander.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: ---- Shooting any of the Serpentis Towers triggers Tower wave. Shooting the Smuggler gate triggers gate wave. If you shoot at the gate before triggering tower wave then tower wave is also triggered (verify). Spawns can be grouped differently depending on what order they are triggered in. The following is from shooting one of the towers before shooting at the gate. Reinforcements to tower wave arrive few seconds later.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to Serpentis Owned Station Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点与天蛇哨站非常相似。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: ---- 击杀点，接近加速轨道，使用天蛇水晶标签 - 搞定，你进入了第二个房间。或者击杀Core Militant Commander。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ---- 射击任何天蛇塔会触发塔波次。射击走私者加速轨道会触发轨道波次。如果你在触发塔波次之前射击加速轨道，塔波次也会被触发（待验证）。刷新编组可能根据触发顺序不同而有所变化。以下信息来自在射击加速轨道之前先射击其中一座塔的情况。塔波次的增援几秒后到达。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可以升级为天蛇占领空间站。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Provisional Angel Outpost is a low security unrated site found through exploration.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site will require you to fly long +100 km distances. A fast ship is recommended. Gistum Defeater cruisers can rarely web.

sections.heading: 1st pocket
sections.text: The timed wave will appear after few minutes. Approaching the acceleration gate will trigger gate wave.

sections.heading: 2nd pocket
sections.text: Timed wave 1 appears after about a minute. Timed wave 2 appears few minutes later. Attacking the lab triggers lab wave. Lab wave can trigger commander wave.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Domination Surveillance Squad. Category:Unrated Complexes

zh.title: 临时天使企业联合体前哨

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 临时天使企业联合体前哨是一个通过探索在低安全等级空间发现的未评级站点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点需要你飞行超过100 km的长距离。建议使用快速的舰船。Gistum Defeater巡洋舰偶尔会使用网子。

sections.heading: 第1个房间
sections.text: 定时波次会在几分钟后出现。接近加速轨道会触发轨道波次。

sections.heading: 第2个房间
sections.text: 定时波次1在大约一分钟后出现。定时波次2在几分钟后出现。攻击实验室会触发实验室波次。实验室波次可以触发指挥官波次。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级为统御监视小队。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Provisional Blood Outpost is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Blood Raiders owned regions of Low Sec space. The site is located behind an acceleration gate. Battlecruisers (T1/T2) and below can access it. A passive shield-tanked Drake can run this site slowly. The rats are not difficult, but they are very spread out, so bring a MWD.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Each new wave spawns when the previous one is destroyed. All enemy waves spawn around the cluster of structures.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: about 1,000,000 ISK * Loot: unknown loot & salvage

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site may escalate into Blood Surveillance Squad after you destroy every ship and/or the Blood Raider Chapel. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Wave #2 - spawns upon approaching Blood Raider Bunker
Wave #3 - spawns upon approaching Abandoned Shipyard
Wave #2 - spawns upon damaging Blood Raider Chapel
Faction Ship - may not spawn, can spawn at any time

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 临时血袭者前哨是一个未评级宇宙信号战斗站点，可以在低安空间中血袭者控制区域使用核心探针扫描发现。该站点位于加速轨道后方。战巡舰（T1/T2）及以下舰船可以进入。一艘被动盾抗Drake可以缓慢运行该站点。怪不难，但分布非常分散，所以带上MWD。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 每一新波次在前一波被消灭时刷新。所有敌方波次在建筑群周围刷新。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: *赏金：约1,000,000 ISK *战利品：未知战利品和打捞

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 在你消灭所有舰船和/或血袭者教堂后，该站点可能升级为血袭者监视小队。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Provisional Gurista Outpost is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security systems with Gurista presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Warping to the signature will land you at 0 on an ancient acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site has a chance to escalate to Gurista Surveillance Squad. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

rows.name: Guristas Heavy Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Destroy any one to trigger reinforcement 2. Destroying both triggers reinforcement 3

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 临时古斯塔前哨是一个未评级综合体，通过在有古斯塔存在的低安全等级星系扫描发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到信号点会降落在一个古老加速轨道的0米处。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点有几率升级为古斯塔监视小队。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Provisional Sansha Outpost is a Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security systems with Sansha presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site rats are very far from each other, make sure to bring long range weapons and an MWD.

groups.name: Second Wave - Triggered by approaching the Acceleration Gate - located 70 km away from the gate

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 临时萨沙共和国前哨是一个未评级综合体，通过在有萨沙存在的低安全等级星系扫描发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点的怪彼此距离很远，确保带上远程武器和MWD。

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Provisional Serpentis Outpost is a low security unrated site found through exploration.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Upon warping to the site you will arrive at an ancient acceleration gate. The defenders in the pockets can be 50-160 km away.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: ---- (Update: March 5th, 2026 - No Commander spawn - But site did escalate to Guardian Angels Surveillance Squad upon destroying the armory structure which only contained Medium Hybrid Ammo.) (Update: April 13th, 2026 - Commander spawned but did not trigger escalation; nor did the armory structure destruction.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The site can escalate to Guardian Angels Surveillance Squad Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Gate Wave (triggered by approaching the gate)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 临时天蛇前哨是一个通过探索在低安全等级空间发现的未评级站点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 跃迁到站点后你会到达一个古老的加速轨道。房间中的防御者可能在50-160 km外。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ---- （更新：2026年3月5日 - 没有指挥官刷新 - 但在消灭军械库建筑后站点确实升级为守护天使监视小队，军械库中仅包含中型混合弹药。）（更新：2026年4月13日 - 指挥官刷新了但没有触发升级；军械库建筑被消灭也没有触发升级。）

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级为守护天使监视小队。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Radiance is an Unrated Complex found in nullsec via exploration. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: The acceleration gate in the first pocket is not locked, so you can fly to it and take the gate to the next room, and thereby skip this room altogether if you want. Be careful though, as proximity to the gate spawns additional reinforcement waves, so you need a strong tank if you chose to skip the room.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: To get the commander wave to spawn, you have to approach the Warning Sign in the corner of the station. Alternatively, it can be triggered by destroying the battlecruisers from initial defenders. There is also a second version, where the commander wave consists of around 15 cruisers and battlecruisers instead of the battleships. 15 cruisers wave was additional one for me, which spawned battleship wave with Sentient Supreme Alvus Parasite after.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This combat site can escalate into the Molting Season expedition. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Strain Decimator Alvi/Devilfish Alvi/Barracuda Alvi
rows.note: The Strain Decimator Alvi webs and points

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 光辉是一个未评级综合体，通过探索在00安全等级空间中发现。该站点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到站点会降落在加速轨道的0米处。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 第一个房间中的加速轨道未锁定，所以你可以飞向它并通过加速轨道进入下一个房间，从而完全跳过这个房间。不过要小心，因为接近加速轨道会刷出额外增援波次，所以如果你选择跳过这个房间就需要较强的防御。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 要触发指挥官波次刷新，你必须接近空间站角落的警告标志。或者，可以通过消灭初始防御者中的战巡舰来触发。还有第二个版本，指挥官波次由大约15艘巡洋舰和战巡舰组成，而不是战列舰。对我来说，15艘巡洋舰波次是额外的，之后刷出了包含Sentient Supreme Alvus Parasite的战列舰波次。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该战斗站点可以升级为蜕皮季节远征任务。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This combat site is a Unrated Complex which can be found in Low-sec via exploration. Its signal strength is high (20%), making it easy to scan down.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Spatial Rift is roughly 7-10km from warp-in. Depending on the angle that you land you may end up <5 km from the rift and immediately trigger the proximity spawn.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Frigates will be 25-30km away and will aggro very quickly. Destroyers are 50-60km away and will not aggro unless approached or attacked.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Total bounty about 1.8 M ISK. (recent 01/2017 run gave 2.69M ISK, plus ~11M ISK in Rogue Drone Component drops) May drop Sentient drone components: * Sentient Damage Control, 2017-08-26, 270 mill + * Sentient Drone Navigation Computer, 2018-04-29, ~135M * Rogue Drone 43-X Nexus Chip, 2020-10-19, ~119M ISK * Red box doesn't work: 4mil bounty and 5.6mil salvage/loot 2023-01-29

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Killing the Sentient Annihilator Alvum may start the escalation chain Moving Day. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Wave #2 - Wave #3 - Spatial Rift proximity spawn (~5000m)
Wave #3 (may triggered by accessing one of the container)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 该战斗站点是一个未评级综合体，可以通过探索在低安空间中找到。其信号强度较高（20%），容易扫描到。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 空间裂隙距离跃迁点大约7-10km。根据你跃迁进入的角度，你可能会落在距离裂隙<5 km的位置并立即触发接近波次刷新。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 护卫舰在25-30km外，会很快引到仇恨。驱逐舰在50-60km外，除非接近或攻击否则不会引到仇恨。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 总赏金约1.8M ISK。（最近2017年1月的一次运行获得2.69M ISK，加上约11M ISK的自由无人机组件掉落）可能掉落Sentient无人机组件：* Sentient损控，2017-08-26，270M + * Sentient无人机导航电脑，2018-04-29，约135M * 自由无人机43-X Nexus Chip，2020-10-19，约119M ISK * 红箱无效：4M赏金和5.6M打捞/战利品 2023-01-29

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 击杀Sentient Annihilator Alvum可能启动搬家日升级链。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: When you warp in only frigates are on site. Rest of the initial defenders spawn shortly. Only Strain Splinter/Render/Decimator/Infester Alvi frigate types will web and point.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to Menacing Mechanics. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 当你跃迁进入时，站点只有护卫舰。其余初始防御者很快会刷新。只有Strain Splinter/Render/Decimator/Infester Alvi护卫舰类型会使用网子和反跳。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可以升级为威胁机械师。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Annex is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security systems with Sansha presence.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site is very similar to Sansha Vigil. Upon warping to the site you will land at an acceleration gate. Video: HAM Tengu

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Kill tackling elite frigates (and the battlecruisers and battleships, if you can't tank the incoming damage) before attempting to shoot the sentries to avoid accidentally spawning the additional waves too early; the combined damage is extreme.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Sansha Powergrid. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Sansha Security Tower
rows.trigger: Triggers tower waves when attacked. Unlocks acceleration gate

groups.name: Tower wave 1 (when Security Tower is attacked)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙共和国附馆是一个未评级综合体，通过在有萨沙存在的低安全等级星系扫描发现。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该站点与萨沙警戒站非常相似。跃迁到站点后会降落在一个加速轨道处。视频：HAM Tengu

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 在尝试攻击哨兵之前，先击杀拦截精英护卫舰（以及战巡舰和战列舰，如果你无法抗住承受的伤害），以避免过早意外触发额外波次；组合伤害极其可怕。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该站点可以升级为萨沙电力网。分类：未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Base is a combat site that can be scanned down with probes in null security Sansha regions. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate. Bring a MWD or long-range weapons, as the enemies all spawn very far away. Completing the site chages your Sansha standing by -0.3

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: Acceleration gate is 56 km from warp-in. It unlocks when all enemies are killed.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Any last enemy in a wave can be a trigger for faction spawn. Goal in this room is to destroy Sansha Minor Refinery which spawns 160 km off warp-in. Sansha Minor Refinery drops tech 1 ammo. 01.08.2025: The last wave spawned when all of the battleships were killed, with some of the battlecruisers still alive

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: 01.08.2025: The Overseer Battleship did not spawn. The Overseer Battleship did spawn and dropped a True Sansha Crystal Tag, Sanshas Radio L and T2 salvage.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the Sansha Minor Refinery structure or the Overseer Battleship in Room 2 may cause the site to escalate to True Power HQ. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: 56km from warp-in. Unlocked by destroying all enemies.

rows.name: Centus Tyrant / Dread Lord / Dark Lord
Centii Loyal Manslayer / Butcher / Scavenger / Minion
Centii Loyal Manslayer / Butcher / Scavenger / Minion / Servant / Ravener
Centus Tyrant / Dread Lord / Savage Lord / Mutant Lord

groups.name: Wave 3 (triggered by killing all ships in previous waves)

rows.name: Centus Tyrant / Lord / Slave Lord / Dread Lord
True Sansha Lord / Tyrant / Mutant Lord

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙基地是一个战斗地点，可以通过探针在00安萨沙区域扫描定位。该地点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到侧面会落在轨道0公里处。请携带微曲引擎或远程武器，因为所有敌人都刷新在很远的地方。完成该地点会使你的萨沙声望变化-0.3

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 加速轨道距离跃入点56公里。击杀所有敌人后解锁。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 每波最后一个敌人可能是派系刷新的触发条件。此房间的目标是摧毁萨沙小型精炼厂，它刷新在跃入点160公里处。萨沙小型精炼厂掉落科技1弹药。2025年1月8日：最后一波在所有战列舰被击杀时触发，部分战列巡洋舰仍然存活

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 2025年1月8日：监视者战列舰未刷新。监视者战列舰确实刷新并掉落了真实萨沙水晶标签、萨沙无线电L和T2打捞物。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁萨沙小型精炼厂建筑或第二间房间的监视者战列舰可能导致地点升级至真实力量总部。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Fortress is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null security regions with Sansha presence. T2 Battleships and below can enter the site.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Upon warping to the site you land at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Gate wave is triggered by approaching the Acceleration Gate.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You will possibly get True Sansha modules, faction ammo/tags, or rarely a Nightmare BPC. Salvaging the True Sansha battleship wreck may produce T2 salvage.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the True Sansha commander and/or the Sansha Control Center may escalate the site to Shady Operation. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Gate wave (triggered by approaching the Acceleration Gate)

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙要塞是一个未评级建筑群，可在有萨沙存在的00安区域通过扫描发现。T2战列舰及以下级别舰船可进入该地点。

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 跃迁到地点后你会落在加速轨道上。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 门控波次通过接近加速轨道触发。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 你可能获得真实萨沙模块、派系弹药/标签，或罕见情况下获得Nightmare蓝图副本。打捞真实萨沙战列舰残骸可能产出T2打捞物。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁真实萨沙指挥官和/或萨沙控制中心可能将地点升级至秘密行动。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Sansha Hidden Hub is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Sansha owned territory of Null Sec space. The site itself is a small, open area with no Acceleration Gate. There are two variations of this site, the LCO Habitation and Dark Shipyard. It is unknown whether this site can spawn a True Sansha commander ship, but it is assumed that it is possible.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: unknown * Loot/salvage: unknown

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: It is unknown at this time if this site can trigger an Escalation. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙隐秘枢纽是一个未评级宇宙信号战斗地点，可在00安萨沙控制区域使用核心探针扫描发现。该地点本身是一个小型开放区域，没有加速轨道。该地点有两个变体：LCO居住区和暗黑船坞。目前未知该地点是否会刷新真实萨沙指挥官舰船，但推测有可能。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: * 赏金：未知 * 战利品/打捞物：未知

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 目前未知该地点是否能触发升级。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Hideout is an Unrated Complex that can be scanned down with scanner probes. It is found in both high security systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. Only Frigate class Sansha ships will be encountered within this site. The names and amount of ships may vary from what is listed here.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: Mineable Asteroids: * From 50km to 150km * 13x Veldspar (6 x 489m, 5x 1089m, 2x 3615m) * 1x Scordite (3615m) Minable asteroids confirmed to still exist as of 2024-12-15. (CCP removed minable asteroids from a lot of missions during or before 2023.)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Bounties: The bounties on the heads of the pirates in this anomaly add up to a total of roughly 200,000 ISK, payable by CONCORD. Loot: True Sansha Copper Tag, (True) Sansha Ammo, Faction Loot (True Sansha Modules) (very rare)

sections.heading: Escalations
sections.text: Destroying the Minor Refinery structure or the Commander Ship may trigger an expedition called Drop, with this message: "While fighting the last defenders of this hideout, you noticed three of their ships warp out and disappear from radar. Your navigational computer has had a few minutes now to mull over the data they left and has come up with a probable destination in case you want to chase them." Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when first room is cleared

rows.name: Centior Misshape
rows.trigger: Destroying 1 ship triggers Wave 2, estroying all ships triggers Wave 3

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙藏匿点是一个可通过扫描探针定位的未评级建筑群。它出现在萨沙共和国海盗派系占据的高安系统中。该地点内只会遇到护卫舰级别的萨沙舰船。舰船名称和数量可能与此处列出的有所不同。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 可开采小行星：* 从50公里到150公里 * 13x 凡晶石（6 x 489m，5x 1089m，2x 3615m）* 1x 奥米石（3615m）截至2024年12月15日确认可开采小行星仍然存在。（CCP在2023年期间或之前从许多任务中移除了可开采小行星。）

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 赏金：该异常中海盗的赏金总计约200,000 ISK，由统合部支付。战利品：真实萨沙铜标签、（真实）萨沙弹药、派系战利品（真实萨沙模块）（非常罕见）

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁小型精炼厂建筑或指挥官舰船可能触发名为Drop的远征，提示消息如下："在与该藏匿点的最后防御者战斗时，你注意到他们的三艘舰船跃迁离开并从雷达上消失。你的导航计算机已有几分钟时间分析他们留下的数据，并推算出一个可能的目的地，如果你想追踪他们的话。"Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Lookout is an Unrated Complex that can be scanned down with scanner probes. It is found in both high security systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: ---- The ships are scattered around second room

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Slave Breeding Plants. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when first room is cleared

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙哨站是一个可通过扫描探针定位的未评级建筑群。它出现在萨沙共和国海盗派系占据的高安系统中。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: ---- 舰船分散在第二间房间各处

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可升级至奴隶繁殖工厂。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Military Complex is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null security regions with Sansha presence. T2 Battleships and below are allowed to enter the site.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Upon warping to the site you will land at an acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: Attacking any battleship triggers wave 2.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: No defenders are initially present. Shooting the Sansha Military Barracks triggers several successive waves of defenders.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the True Sansha Beast/Plague Lord may trigger an escalation to David V Goliath. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Gate Scrambler
rows.trigger: Destroy to unlock the acceleration gate
rows.note: Triggers massive smartbomb wave upon destruction

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until Gate Scrambler is destroyed

rows.name: Sansha Military Barracks
rows.trigger: Triggers several reinforcement waves. May trigger escalation

rows.name: True Sansha's Beast Lord/Plague Lord
rows.note: May not always spawn, can spawn with delay 3-4 minutes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙军事综合体是一个未评级建筑群，可在有萨沙存在的00安区域通过扫描发现。T2战列舰及以下级别舰船允许进入该地点。

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 跃迁到地点后你会落在加速轨道上。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 攻击任意战列舰触发第二波。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 初始没有防御者。射击萨沙军事兵营会触发多波连续防御者。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁真实萨沙兽王/瘟疫领主可能触发升级至大卫对战歌利亚。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: Gate to next room is ~60 km away, locked until all ships are destroyed. No auto-aggro.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: Ships are spread out in 3 groups between 20-70 km from the warp-in. No auto-aggro and the groups can be fought separately. ---- Total bounties ~8M ISK

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Hidden Riches Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Commander wave (triggered by killing all frigates and destroyers from group 3)

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 通往下一房间的轨道约60公里远，在所有舰船被摧毁前锁定。无自动仇恨。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 舰船分为3组分布在跃入点20-70公里范围内。无自动仇恨，各组可分别击杀。---- 总赏金约800万ISK

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可升级至隐秘财富Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Sansha Provincial HQ is a null security Unrated Complex found by scanning in Sansha infested space.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This site is practically impossible to solo, and is often called 'the secret 10/10'. HIGHLY RECOMMEND BRINGING FRIENDS FOR THIS SITE. For running this site, bringing a friend or two is recommended to help tank the DPS in the first pocket or break the Provisional HQ in the second room. T3 Cruisers and T2 Battleships can enter the site. Like with all unrated complexes, you land on an acceleration gate when warping to the complex.

sections.heading: First Pocket (The Sansha Minefields)
sections.text: Destroying the Gate Scrambler will activate a smartbomb that deals heavy Explosive damage. The smartbomb damage is rated at around 10,000 points. Recommend high resists to Explosive damage to tank the explosion.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: The Provisional HQ has a strong 50+ km web and will target you upon warpin. It fires Citadel Mjolnir torpedoes that deal around 1500-2000 EM damage to an untanked ship. It repairs both shield and armor to the tune of about 1000 DPS. Multiple ships are recommended to take it down.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the True Sansha commander battleship or the Sansha Provisional HQ may trigger an escalation to the expedition The Ancient City. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.trigger: Unlocks when gate scrambler is destroyed

rows.name: Sansha Provisional HQ
rows.trigger: Triggers reinforcements and smartbomb wave. Destroying may trigger escalation

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙省级总部是一个00安未评级建筑群，可在萨沙肆虐区域通过扫描发现。

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 该地点几乎不可能单刷，常被称为'隐藏的10/10'。强烈建议带朋友一起打此地点。建议带一两个朋友帮助在第一间房间抗伤害或在第二间房间摧毁临时总部。T3巡洋舰和T2战列舰可以进入该地点。与所有未评级建筑群一样，跃迁到建筑群时会落在加速轨道上。

sections.heading: 第一间房间（萨沙雷区）
sections.text: 摧毁门扰频器会激活一个智能炸弹，造成大量爆炸伤害。智能炸弹伤害约为10,000点。建议堆高爆炸抗性来承受爆炸伤害。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 临时总部拥有超过50公里的网子效果，会在你跃入时锁定你。它发射堡垒级锤头鱼雷，对无防护舰船造成约1500-2000电磁伤害。它以约1000 DPS的速率同时修复护盾和装甲。建议多艘舰船协同将其击毁。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁真实萨沙指挥官战列舰或萨沙临时总部可能触发升级至远征古城。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: The gate is unlocked by destroying the security tower. No other thing needs to be destroyed to proceed. Use caution when attacking or destroying towers to reduce dps- it's easy to unleash the large swarm of defenders. The second gate drops you in to the middle of the initial defenders and towers. Destroying the webbing stasis tower releases the webbing spider drones and additional defenders. Tank on the order of strong T1 cruiser to survive the immediate initial dps in room 1.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to True Power Shipyards. Category:Unrated Complexes

groups.name: Reinforcements after attacking the security tower. 70 km away

rows.name: Sansha Security Tower
rows.trigger: Attacking spawns reinforcements, destroying unlocks gate

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until Security Tower is destroyed

rows.name: Sansha Light Missile Battery
rows.trigger: First one destroyed triggers battery wave

groups.name: Battery Wave. Triggers when first missile battery is destroyed
Tower Wave #1. Triggered when a tower (web?) is attacked
Tower Wave #2. Triggered when a web tower is destroyed

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 通过摧毁安全塔解锁轨道。无需摧毁其他设施即可继续。攻击或摧毁塔时需谨慎以减少伤害输出——很容易释放大群防御者。第二道轨道会将你投送到初始防御者和塔群中央。摧毁网子停滞塔会释放网子蜘蛛无人机和额外防御者。需要至少较强T1巡洋舰级别的防御力来承受第一间房间的初始伤害。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可升级至真实力量船坞。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: An Unrated Complex that can be scanned down with scanner probes. It is commonly found in highsec systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Cruiser class or smaller. There are two variations of the site. This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site. Flying too close (4 km) to the second gate will trigger a large spawn. Shoot the Sansha Mind Control Tower to get the Centum Militant Supervisor to spawn. He's got the good stuff. The first pocket can be skipped if you have a Sansha Silver Tag in your cargo hold. This will be consumed when the acceleration gate is activated.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: Sentries are split into two groups to the left and right, relative to the next acceleration gate. They are out of range of the warp-in point and can be ignored without any damage if one simply burns straight to the next gate. The reinforcement wave is timed and will spawn even if the left group of frigates is not attacked.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: Most of the spawn is split into several groups about 30-60 km away. 2 destroyers and a cruiser sit at 0 on the warp-in point. All ships autoaggro within a few seconds. The True Sansha frigate is separate from the rest of the ships, about 100 km away. He will approach you with microwarpdrive. == Escalations == Destroying the True Sansha's faction spawn or the Centum Militant Overseer may trigger an expedition Nation on the Rise, with this message:

groups.name: Reinforcement Wave (Triggered by attacking Facility Patroller left group, or after ~30 seconds)
Gate Proximity Wave (Triggered by attacking Facility Patroller right group or approaching the gate)

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks after Slave commander is dead

groups.name: Overseer wave (triggered by attacking the Mind Control Tower)

rows.name: Centum Militant Supervisor
rows.trigger: Escalation trigger, may trigger commander wave

groups.name: 90-100 km away, towards the top left

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 一个可通过扫描探针定位的未评级建筑群。常见于萨沙共和国海盗派系占据的高安星系。该地点由一片包含加速轨道的空间区域组成，内含各种建筑及其防御海盗。使用轨道可进入地点内的其他区域。被攻击时，防御者可能派出多波增援。每组的出现由前一组成员的摧毁触发。列出的舰船名称和数量可能略有不同，但始终为巡洋舰级别或更小。该地点有两个变体。该地点的加速轨道仅允许战列巡洋舰级别及以下舰船及其T2等效舰船进入。过于接近（4公里）第二道轨道会触发大量刷新。射击萨沙精神控制塔使百夫长军事主管刷新。他有好的战利品。如果你货舱中有萨沙银标签，可以跳过第一间房间。激活加速轨道时标签会被消耗。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 哨兵分为两组位于下一个加速轨道的左右两侧。它们超出跃入点射程范围，如果直接冲向下一个轨道可以不受任何伤害地忽略。增援波次是定时刷新的，即使不攻击左侧护卫舰组也会刷新。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 大部分刷新分为多组分布在约30-60公里外。2艘驱逐舰和1艘巡洋舰位于跃入点0公里处。所有舰船在几秒内自动进入仇恨状态。真实天蛇护卫舰与其他舰船分开，约100公里远。它会以微曲引擎向你接近。== 升级 == 摧毁真实天蛇的派系刷新或百夫长军事监工可能触发远征派系崛起，提示消息如下：

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Sansha Yard is an combat anomaly that can be found in Sansha infested territory of Low and Null Sec space. The site itself is a small, open area with no Acceleration Gate. There are two variations of this site, the LCO Habitation and Dark Shipyard.

sections.heading: Variation 1 (LCO Habitation)
sections.text: Destroying the Sansha Heavy Missile Battery spawns another sentry of the same type.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: * Bounty: 4 million ISK for LCO Habitation variant, 2.5 million ISK for Dark Shipyard variant * Loot/salvage: typical Sansha salvage materials

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site may escalate into the expedition Sansha War Supply Complex, a 6/10 rated DED complex. The escalation may be triggered by destroying all ships. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Sansha Heavy Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Destroying it spawns another sentry of the same type

groups.name: Battery wave (triggered by destroying the Heavy Missile Battery from the previous wave)

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 萨沙船坞是一个战斗异常点，可在低安和00安的萨沙肆虐区域找到。该地点本身是一个小型开放区域，没有加速轨道。该地点有两个变体：LCO居住区和暗黑船坞。

sections.heading: 变体1（LCO居住区）
sections.text: 摧毁天蛇重型导弹电池会刷新另一个同类型的哨兵。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: * 赏金：LCO居住区变体400万ISK，暗黑船坞变体250万ISK * 战利品/打捞物：典型天蛇打捞材料

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可能升级为远征天蛇战争补给群，一个6/10等级的DED建筑群。升级可能通过摧毁所有舰船触发。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This complex is similar to Serpentis Vigil. The complex is accessed by activating the acceleration gate on warp-in. A battleship or above is recommended for this site.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: Destroy 2 Serpentis Bunkers and Core Drug Dealer will probably spawn. Kill him, then clear the pocket.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: 400px|thumb|Screenshot of initial defenders.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Serpentis Powergrid. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Serpentis Gold Tag must be provided or unknown trigger should happen.

rows.name: Core Rear Admiral
rows.note: Core Port/Rear Admiral use 1 x Defender Rocket.

rows.name: Serpentis Stasis Tower
rows.note: Serpentis Stasis Tower webs on 42km, probably even to 250km.

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 该建筑群类似于天蛇哨戒所。通过激活跃入时的加速轨道进入建筑群。建议使用战列舰或更大舰船。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 摧毁2个天蛇地堡后核心毒贩可能会刷新。击杀他，然后清理房间。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 400px|thumb|初始防御者截图。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可升级至天蛇电力网。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Base is a combat site that can be scanned down with probes in null security Serpentis regions. The site is behind an acceleration gates. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate. An extender fit Drake can run this site. Bring a MWD or long-range weapons, as the enemies all spawn very far away.

sections.heading: Room #1
sections.text: The rats are few, but far away from each other. Acceleration gate is 56 km from warp-in. It unlocks when all enemies are killed.

sections.heading: Room #2
sections.text: ---- Faction spawn has a chance to appear after a few minutes of entering the site. The alternative completion trigger is the Serpentis Armory, which spawns 160 km off warp-in.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: You can get about 4 million isk in bounties from this site. If the faction battleship spawns, you can get an additional 4 million isk in bounties, plus the value of its faction loot.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: The site completes and de-spawns upon destruction of the faction battleship or the Serpentis Armory structure in Room #2 (if the faction battleship did not spawn). The site has a chance to escalate to Contract Killers. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.trigger: Getting within 10 km triggers the proximity wave

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇基地是一个战斗地点，可以通过探针在00安天蛇区域扫描定位。该地点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到侧面会落在轨道0公里处。一艘扩展配置的幼龙级可以跑该地点。请携带微曲引擎或远程武器，因为所有敌人都刷新在很远的地方。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 敌人数量不多，但彼此距离很远。加速轨道距离跃入点56公里。击杀所有敌人后解锁。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: ---- 进入地点几分钟后派系刷新有几率出现。另一个完成触发条件是萨沙军械库，它刷新在跃入点160公里处。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 你可以从该地点获得约400万isk赏金。如果派系战列舰刷新，你可以额外获得400万isk赏金，加上其派系战利品的价值。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁派系战列舰或第二间房间的萨沙军械库建筑（如果派系战列舰未刷新）后地点完成并消失。该地点有几率升级至合同杀手。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Fortress is a combat site that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in null security space in the Serpentis regions. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Warping to the site lands on an acceleration gate at 0.

sections.heading: Room 1
sections.text: The enemies spawn in three groups. The groups can be aggressed individually. The acceleration gate to Room 2 is 25 km from warp-in.

sections.heading: Room 2
sections.text: ---- The large Serpentis Station can be destroyed, but drops regular modules. There is a chance of getting the Suspicious Job escalation when you destroy the Shadow Serpentis battleship if it spawns, or the Station if it doesn't.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: You can get about 30 million ISK in bounties from fully clearing the site. The faction battleship may drop additional valuable loot.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying the Serpentis Stronghold structure in Room #2 may cause the site to escalate to Suspicious Job. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Core Lord Admiral/Grand Admiral
rows.note: Grand Admirals race away to orbit at 51 km

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all hostile ships are destroyed.

groups.name: Shadow Serpentis Rare - Might spawn after 3 min

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Rear Admiral/Port Admiral
rows.note: May trigger an escalation if spawned, if not destroy the station for a escalation chance

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇要塞是一个战斗地点，可以通过探针扫描定位，可在00安天蛇区域找到。该地点位于加速轨道后方。跃迁到地点会落在轨道0公里处。

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 跃迁到地点会落在0公里的加速轨道上。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 敌人分三组刷新。各组可分别拉仇恨。通往第二间房间的加速轨道距离跃入点25公里。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: ---- 大型天蛇空间站可以被摧毁，但掉落普通模块。摧毁暗影天蛇战列舰（如果刷新）或空间站（如果未刷新）时有几率获得可疑工作升级。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 完全清理该地点可获得约3000万ISK赏金。派系战列舰可能掉落额外贵重战利品。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁第二间房间的天蛇要塞建筑可能导致地点升级至可疑工作。Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Hideout is an Unrated Deadspace Complex that is found in High Security and Low Security Gallente Space, via Probe scanning. The site consists of an entrance pocket, and two main pockets, separated by acceleration gates. If running the site in a T1 frigate, or if using light drones, take care against the Elite Frigates (Coreli Guardian Agent/Defender/Guard/Protector) as they will do higher damage than the regular frigate enemies, and will target light drones.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: When you warp to the site you will land on an acceleration gate. There are no enemies on it, and nothing around other than the acceleration gate that leads to the first main room of the site.

sections.heading: Main Room 1
sections.text: This room contains just a couple of frigates when you warp in. Destroying them will spawn additional waves of frigates. class="wikitable complex collapsible" ! Structures ! L - 1 x Acceleration Gatex - 1 x Abandoned Ship Yardex damage - 4 x Serpentis Lookoutex damage These waves spawn when when the ships in the initial defender group are destroyed.

sections.heading: Main Room 2
sections.text: Upon warp in this room contains a couple of frigates and a structure called Serpentis Armory. After an amount of time more enemies will spawn. Additionally, damaging the armory will cause a wave of enemies to spawn. Destroying the initial defenders has a chance to spawn a Shadow Serpentis faction frigate. Shadow Serpentis frigate rarely drops valuable Snake implant. class="wikitable complex collapsible" ! Structures ! L - 1 x Serpentis Armoryxex damage small container - 2 x Serpentis Bunkerex damage - 1 x Abandoned Ship Yardex damage The armory wave spawns shortly after the Serpentis Armory has been damaged. This Shadow Serpentis Faction Frigate has a chance to spawn when the Initial Defender wave is destroyed.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Mindflood. Escalation chance ~25% (3 out of 13). class="wikitable complex collapsible" + Commander and other valuable loot - !Item Name !Est. Value !Note - Shadow Hybrid Ammo S x 1000 5k - 100k - Shadow Serpentis Copper Tag 5k Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.trigger: Destroying either of these ships will spawn another wave.

rows.name: Coreli Patroller

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Initiate/Scout
rows.trigger: Destroying this ship has a chance to give an escalation to the Mindflood expedition.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇藏匿点是一个未评级死亡空间建筑群，通过探针扫描在高安和低安加伦特空间找到。该地点由一个入口房间和两个通过加速轨道分隔的主房间组成。如果使用T1护卫舰刷该地点或使用轻型无人机，请注意精英护卫舰（核心护卫代理/防御者/守卫/保护者），因为它们伤害高于普通护卫舰敌人，并且会锁定轻型无人机。

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 跃迁到地点后你会落在加速轨道上。轨道上没有敌人，除了通往该地点第一个主房间的加速轨道外周围没有其他东西。

sections.heading: 主房间1
sections.text: 跃入时该房间只有几艘护卫舰。摧毁它们会刷新额外的护卫舰波次。class="wikitable complex collapsible" ! 建筑 ! L - 1 x 加速轨道x - 1 x 废弃船坞x 伤害 - 4 x 天蛇瞭望塔x 伤害 这些波次在初始防御者组的舰船被摧毁时刷新。

sections.heading: 主房间2
sections.text: 跃入时该房间有几艘护卫舰和一个名为天蛇军械库的建筑。一段时间后更多敌人会刷新。此外，损坏军械库会导致一波敌人刷新。摧毁初始防御者有几率刷出暗影天蛇派系护卫舰。暗影天蛇护卫舰罕见掉落贵重的蛇类植入体。class="wikitable complex collapsible" ! 建筑 ! L - 1 x 天蛇军械库xex 伤害 小容器 - 2 x 天蛇地堡ex 伤害 - 1 x 废弃船坞x 伤害 军械库波次在天蛇军械库被损坏后不久刷新。暗影天蛇派系护卫舰在初始防御者波次被摧毁时有几率刷新。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可升级至心灵洪流。升级几率约25%（13次中3次）。class="wikitable complex collapsible" + 指挥官和其他贵重战利品 - !物品名称 !估价 !备注 - 暗影混合弹药S x 1000 5k - 100k - 暗影天蛇铜标签 5kCategory:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: No NPCs at initial warp in. Initial gate will allow Tech 2 and 3 cruisers to pass.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: While mining after the site is complete, an additional frigate may occasionally spawn.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: The acceleration gate to next room is locked until all ships have been destroyed. The missile battery does not need to be destroyed to proceed. Shooting at each group once before deploying drones avoids drone aggro. The gate to the second room is 27km from warp in.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: To trigger commander spawn destroy the destroyers by the solar harvesters. These destroyers are on left side when looking at the enemies. Escalation can be triggered by killing the commander or by destroying the Serpentis control center.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site has a chance to escalate to Angel Kickbacks. Failure message: Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 初始跃入时没有NPC。初始轨道允许T2和T3巡洋舰通过。

sections.heading: 攻略
sections.text: 地点完成后采矿时，偶尔可能刷新额外的护卫舰。

sections.heading: 第一间房间
sections.text: 通往下一房间的加速轨道在所有舰船被摧毁前锁定。导弹电池无需摧毁即可继续。对每组各开火一次再部署无人机可避免无人机仇恨。通往第二间房间的轨道距离跃入点27公里。

sections.heading: 第二间房间
sections.text: 要触发指挥官刷新需摧毁太阳能收割机旁的驱逐舰。这些驱逐舰位于面向敌人时的左侧。升级可通过击杀指挥官或摧毁天蛇控制中心触发。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点有几率升级至天使回扣。失败消息：Category:未评级建筑群

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Military Complex is an unrated complex that can be found in null-sec. It contains two rooms.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: This combat site can be quite challenging solo without high skills and good modules. It can be done in a good drone boat, like the Gila or Ishtar. *In the first room you want to clear out all the NPCs before attacking the Gate Scrambler. *The second room can be quite challenging, since the waves arrive pretty fast on a timer. You want to kill of the frigates first because they scram you, so you can warp off if needed.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: It is possible to skip this entire room by flying to the gate, destroying the gate scrambler and using the gate to go to the next part. Doing so requires a good tank.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: This room can be very challenging, and unless you are experienced, might want to team up for.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Gives around 35.000.000 ISK in bounties. =Escalation= If you get the escalation from destroying Slick-Silver's Control Tower, you see this message: Can escalate to Colony Under Fire Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇军事综合体是一个未评级综合体，位于零安区域。它包含两个房间。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 这个战斗地点如果没有高技能和好装备，单人挑战可能相当困难。可以使用无人机舰船来完成，比如Gila或Ishtar。*在第一个房间，你需要在攻击门禁扰断器之前清除所有NPC。*第二个房间可能相当困难，因为增援波次按计时器到达得很快。你需要优先击杀护卫舰，因为它们会用反跳锁你，这样你可以在需要时跃走。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 你可以直接飞向加速轨道，摧毁门禁扰断器并使用轨道前往下一部分来跳过整个房间。这样做需要良好的防御。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 这个房间可能非常困难，除非你经验丰富，否则建议组队前往。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 赏金约35,000,000 ISK。=升级=如果你从摧毁Slick-Silver的控制塔获得升级，你会看到以下信息：可以升级为殖民地遇袭分类:未评级综合体

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: ---- There exists two variations of the second room. One with large asteroid and one with a station. Whether the difference is only cosmetic is not known. The shadow serpentis trigger is not completely clear and can be elite cruisers, certain destroyers or their combination. Note: Stronger than usual damps, at peak -84% targeting range. Some elite frigates have point/web.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Can escalate to Elite Playground, e.g. through popping the Bunkers. Category:Unrated Complexes

rows.name: Corelatis Cpatain/Platoon Leader/ Squad Leader/Wing Leader

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ----第二个房间存在两种变体。一种有大型小行星，另一种有空间站。两者之间的区别是否仅为外观差异尚不清楚。阴影天蛇的触发条件不完全明确，可能是精英巡洋舰、特定驱逐舰或两者的组合。注意：感应抑阻比通常更强，峰值时锁定范围-84%。部分精英护卫舰带有反跳/网子。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 可以升级为精英游乐场，例如通过摧毁地堡。分类:未评级综合体

sections.heading: Locating & Difficulty
sections.text: The Serpentis Provincial HQ is a Cosmic Signature of the Unrated Complex type, occupied by the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Null-sec systems. The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battleship class or smaller. This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: Warning: Initial damage upon entry to both rooms is high, so a high combination of speed tanking, and either armor or shield tanking is recommended.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: The Acceleration Gate "Gate to the Sarpati Luxury Lodge" remains locked after destroying the initial spawn. It may be unlocked if you have a Shadow Serpentis Crystal Tag in your cargo hold when you attempt to operate the gate, or alternatively it you may destroy the Core Defense Officer's Quarters to permanently unlock it. Be warned, doing so will cause heavy reinforcements to arrive. If you pre-align with the acceleration gate before destroying the Officer's Quarters, you can instantly activate the gate as soon as the Officer's Quarters are destroyed, avoiding the reinforcements.

sections.heading: Second Room
sections.text: The initial spawn consists of 5 Siege Blaster Sentries which constitute the main threat. They will deal significant damage (Explosive & Thermal) to any ship large and slow enough for them to hit. It is highly recommended to completely clear this initial spawn prior to assaulting the station. The two reinforcement waves may be triggered seperately by aggressing the Sarpati Luxury Lodge with a non-damaging hostile module such as a Target Painter. Otherwise, the second reinforcement wave can be triggered very quickly after the first, resulting in a combined spawn with high incoming damage.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: ~ 23 million in loot and salvage without shadow drop. About 58 million in bounty =Escalation= After killing Shadow Serpentis BS or Sarpati Luxury Lodge you might get the escalation Serpentis Secrets: Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 定位与难度
sections.text: 天蛇省级总部是一种未评级综合体类型的宇宙签名，由天蛇海盗派系占据。可以通过在零安星系中使用探针探索来找到。该地点由一个包含加速轨道的空间区域组成，内有各种建筑及其防守海盗。使用轨道可以进入地点内的其他区域。当受到攻击时，防守方可能派出多波增援。每组的出现由前一组成员的摧毁触发。列出的舰船名称和数量可能略有不同，但始终为战列舰级别或更小。该地点的加速轨道仅允许战列舰级别及以下的舰船及其T2等效舰船进入。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 警告：进入两个房间的初始伤害很高，因此建议结合速度抗性以及装甲或护盾抗性进行配置。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 加速轨道"通往萨帕提豪华旅馆的轨道"在摧毁初始刷怪后仍然锁定。如果你在尝试操作轨道时货舱中有阴影天蛇水晶标签，则可以解锁；或者你可以摧毁核心防御军官宿舍来永久解锁它。注意，这样做会导致大量增援到达。如果你在摧毁军官宿舍之前提前对准加速轨道方向，你可以在军官宿舍被摧毁后立即激活轨道，从而避开增援。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: 初始刷怪由5个攻城爆破者哨兵组成，它们是主要威胁。它们会对任何足够大且速度较慢的舰船造成显著伤害（爆炸和热能）。强烈建议在进攻旅馆之前完全清除这些初始敌人。两波增援可以通过使用非伤害性敌对模块（如目标标记器）攻击萨帕提豪华旅馆来分别触发。否则，第二波增援可能在第一波之后很快触发，导致合并刷怪且incoming伤害很高。

sections.heading: 奖励
sections.text: 无阴影掉落时约2300万战利品和打捞物。约5800万赏金=升级=击杀阴影天蛇战列舰或萨帕提豪华旅馆后，你可能获得升级天蛇秘密：分类:未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Vigil is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. It is presumed that Battlecruisers (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as Tech 2 implants. This combat site consists of two deadspace complexes, the second of which hosts Tago Uriken, the site's overseer. Access to the second complex is given by destroying all remaining hostile ships at the first complex. Defeating Tago Uriken may escalate into the Booster R&D expedition.

sections.heading: First Room
sections.text: The gate in first room can be unlocked by killing all ships. Note that even though the message after Drug Trader is killed suggests that the gate unlocks you still need to kill all remaining ships. There are three spawns that appear to be timed. Video: [Astero February 2021] First group immediately aggresses on warpin.

sections.heading: Second room
sections.text: ---- Overseer Spawn appears after destroying one of the sentry towers.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: This site can escalate to Booster R&D. Category:Unrated Complexes

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇哨戒是一个属于天蛇集团海盗派系的未评级战斗地点。可以通过在高安和低安星系中扫描异常来找到。据推测，战列巡洋舰（及其T2等效舰船）是允许进入该地点的最大舰船级别。完成该综合体可能奖励玩家珍贵的阴影天蛇派系模块以及T2植入体。该战斗地点由两个死亡空间综合体组成，第二个有该地点的监管者Tago Uriken。进入第二个综合体需要摧毁第一个综合体的所有剩余敌对舰船。击败Tago Uriken可能升级为Booster R&D探险。

sections.heading: 第一个房间
sections.text: 第一个房间的轨道可以通过击杀所有舰船来解锁。注意，尽管击杀毒品商人后的提示信息表明轨道已解锁，你仍然需要击杀所有剩余舰船。共有三波刷怪，似乎是按时间触发的。视频：[Astero 2021年2月]第一组在跃入时立即进入攻击状态。

sections.heading: 第二个房间
sections.text: ----监管者刷怪在摧毁一座哨塔后出现。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点可以升级为Booster R&D。分类:未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Serpentis Watch is an Unrated Complex which can be found in Hi-sec through exploration. The biggest ships in this site are two battlecruisers, one in each pocket. Serpentis rats weakest resistance is against thermal damage and they on average deal 55% thermal damage and 45% kinetic damage. If using a drone boat, set drones to passive and focus fire so they won't accidentally shoot the trigger ship and spawn the next wave, overwhelming you.

sections.heading: Difficulty & Ship Recommendation
sections.text: This site is possible to complete in a T1 Cruiser, however the damage can easily become excessive if care is not taken in managing the triggers. It is recommended to bring a well-tanked T2 Heavy Assault Cruiser or Battlecruiser.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: You will arrive at an ancient acceleration gate.

sections.heading: First Pocket
sections.text: There are three options for unlocking the Acceleration gate to the next room. * Destroy each wave until the fourth wave, and destroy the Corelum Militant Commander * Approach the Acceleration gate, which sets off the alarm and spawns the fourth wave, skipping waves 2 and 3, and destroy the Corelum Militant Commander. If you cannot tank the rats, destroy all of them EXCEPT FOR THE CORELUM SCOUT. * Unlock the Acceleration gate by having a Serpentis Silver Tag in your inventory (the tag is consumed). Attack the Corelum Scout to trigger the next wave. Attack the Corelum Scout to trigger the next wave. Attack the Corelum Scout to trigger the next wave. Destroy the Corelum Militant Commander to unlock the Acceleration Gate. 16 x Scordite (~1.1 million units) 26 x Veldspar (~1.25 million units)

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Tower wave is triggered by attacking the Starbase Control Tower. It will not spawn if the Gate Wave is already destroyed. Gate wave is triggered by attacking the Smuggler's Gate. Simply using an EWAR module(preferably Target Painter) works. Shooting at the gate will also trigger tower wave if it has not been triggered already. The gate wave consists of one large group by the gate and three smaller groups scattered around the site. Once all groups are in range the incoming dps can be too much for t1 cruiser or even a battlecruiser. The commander wave is triggered by destroying Supervisor's Guardians (in the Gate Wave). The Shadow Serpentis frigate will approach you very quickly, at 1700 m/s. He can be separated from the others, therefore avoiding a lot of DPS. Supervisor's Henchmen tend to keep behind the supervisor and regularly retarget drones.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 天蛇哨望是一个未评级综合体，可以通过在高安区域的探索中找到。该地点最大的舰船是两艘战列巡洋舰，每个死亡空间房间各一艘。天蛇海盗对热能伤害的抗性最弱，他们平均造成55%热能伤害和45%动能伤害。如果使用无人机舰船，将无人机设置为被动模式并集火，以免误射触发舰船导致下一波刷怪，从而压垮你。

sections.heading: 难度与舰船推荐
sections.text: 该地点可以在T1巡洋舰中完成，但如果不注意管理触发机制，伤害很容易过高。建议驾驶配置良好的T2重型突击巡洋舰或战列巡洋舰。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 你将到达一个古老的加速轨道。

sections.heading: 第一个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 解锁通往下一房间的加速轨道有三种选择。*逐波消灭直到第四波，然后摧毁天蛇好战指挥官*接近加速轨道，触发警报并刷出第四波，跳过第二和第三波，然后摧毁天蛇好战指挥官。如果你扛不住敌人，摧毁除天蛇侦察兵外的所有舰船。*通过在背包中携带天蛇银标签来解锁加速轨道（标签被消耗）。攻击天蛇侦察兵触发下一波。攻击天蛇侦察兵触发下一波。攻击天蛇侦察兵触发下一波。摧毁天蛇好战指挥官以解锁加速轨道。16 x 斜长石（约110万单位）26 x 凡晶矿（约125万单位）

sections.heading: 第二个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 塔楼波次通过攻击星际基地控制塔触发。如果门波次已被摧毁则不会刷出。门波次通过攻击走私者之门触发。仅使用电子战模块（最好是目标标记器）即可。如果塔楼波次尚未触发，射击门也会触发。门波次由门边的一个大编队和分散在地点周围的三个小编队组成。一旦所有编队进入射程，incoming DPS对T1巡洋舰甚至战列巡洋舰来说可能过高。指挥官波次通过摧毁监护者守卫（在门波次中）触发。阴影天蛇护卫舰会以1700 m/s的速度快速接近你。他可以与其他敌人分离，从而避免大量DPS。监护者的随从倾向于躲在监护者身后并经常重新锁定无人机。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 该地点有机会升级为Jet-Set Hooligans。之前的升级提示信息更加有趣，内容为

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: | 2025年4月9日 - Lord Peche Run | 中级蛇Alpha | 估值4500万ISK | 完成方式：1x Vexor 半T2装配：纯无人机配置。注意无人机仇恨，否则召回并重新释放即可。注意射程，微曲推进器是关键，我直线向下/向上/向侧飞行（随你偏好）|-|2026年8月|垃圾|100万ISK|守卫铁质弹药S 1,000, 阴影天蛇铜标签, 制式轻型离子相位炮, 紧凑型扰断器|分类:未评级综合体

sections.text: The Shadow Serpentis Fleet Staging Point is a unrated complex that can be found via exploration and scanned down with probes. The second and third part are considered expeditions.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 阴影天蛇舰队集结点是一个未评级综合体，可以通过探索并用探针扫描找到。第二部分和第三部分被视为探险。

sections.heading: 第二个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 你需要优先快速击杀毁电哨兵。

sections.heading: 奖励
