sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in null security systems with Sansha presence. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: The site can be difficult due to energy neutralizer sentries in the second room. Advise fitting for a strong tank against EM and Thermal damage. Warping to the site lands you on an ancient acceleration gate.

sections.heading: Second Pocket
sections.text: Energy Meutralizer Sentries have a decent amount of armor, so it takes a while to destroy them, even with a high DPS battleship. Their range is exactly 115km. If you are in range of both Energy Neutralizer Sentries and don't have a cap booster fitted, you will run out of capacitor before you destroy even one of them. Some good approaches are either using cap boosters or a Micro Jump Drive to get out of the range of the sentries. It is not mandatory to destroy them for the site to be completed and/or to get an escalation. This site does not drop any special loot.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: Destroying all enemy ships may trigger an escalation to True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 2. Category:Unrated_Complexes

zh.title: 真萨沙共和国舰队集结点

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 真萨沙共和国舰队集结点是一个未评级综合体，在有萨沙存在的零安星系中通过扫描找到。最高允许T2战列舰进入该地点。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 由于第二个房间的毁电哨兵，该地点可能很困难。建议配置针对电磁和热能伤害的强力防御。跃入该地点会降落在一个古老的加速轨道上。

sections.heading: 第二个死亡空间房间
sections.text: 毁电哨兵有相当多的装甲值，因此即使使用高DPS战列舰也需要一段时间才能摧毁。它们的射程恰好为115km。如果你同时处于两个毁电哨兵的射程内且没有装备电容增效剂，你在摧毁其中一个之前电容就会耗尽。一些好的方法是使用电容增效剂或微型跳跃驱动装置来脱离哨兵的射程。该地点不要求摧毁它们即可完成和/或获得升级。该地点不掉落任何特殊战利品。

sections.heading: 升级
sections.text: 摧毁所有敌方舰船可能触发升级为真萨沙共和国舰队集结点2。分类:未评级综合体

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Wispy Ruins is a combat relic site involving both combat and hacking. It appears to Probes as a scannable combat site. Unlike most combat sites, it is only found in the Feythabolis nullsec region, specifically in the I-3ODK constellation. A dedicated combat ship like the Vargur is highly recommended for this site. Avoid taking frigates into the site, as the smartbombs in the third and fourth pockets can easily destroy any frigate. The smartbomb damage can even be high enough to destroy a cruiser. Pirates from the Rogue Drones and Angel Cartel are featured.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text: There are four rooms in this complex but only three need to be completed. The second stage(Portal) can be skipped since the central deadspace pocket can be accessed more quickly by taking the other gate in the first pocket.

sections.heading: Warp-in
sections.text: 3 "Pirate Grave Robber" Angel Battleships are present on warp-in. You will land at a locked acceleration gate to the Terrace.

sections.heading: First Pocket - Terrace
sections.text: The acceleration gates deeper into the complex are guarded by three groups of rats. They can be aggressed separately. The named battleship(Angel Raid Commander) triggers reinforcements. The acceleration gates are not locked, and the room can be skipped.

sections.heading: Second Pocket - Portal
sections.text: This room is optional. Gate to next room(Hall) is not locked.

sections.heading: Third Pocket - Hall
sections.text: This room has Rogue Drone rats as well as hacking containers.

sections.heading: Fourth Pocket - Sanctum
sections.text: The Sentinel Chimera Strain Mother has a strong active armor tank and many structure hitpoints, as well as a strong web that reaches out to 50 km. It fires Mjolnir XL Torpedoes that hit rather hard. It is recommended that you bring a friend or two to take it down.

sections.heading: Loot
sections.text: If you are lucky enough to get this site the rewards are very profitable.

sections.heading: 概述
sections.text: 朦胧遗迹是一个涉及战斗和黑入的战斗遗迹地点。在探针上显示为可扫描的战斗地点。与大多数战斗地点不同，它仅出现在Feythabolis零安区域，具体在I-3ODK星座。强烈建议使用专用战斗舰船如Vargur来完成该地点。避免带护卫舰进入，因为第三和第四个死亡空间房间的智能炸弹可以轻松摧毁任何护卫舰。智能炸弹的伤害甚至可能高到摧毁巡洋舰。涉及自由无人机和天使企业联合体的海盗。

sections.heading: 流程
sections.text: 该综合体有四个房间，但只需完成三个。第二阶段（传送门）可以跳过，因为从第一个死亡空间房间走另一扇门可以更快地到达中央死亡空间房间。

sections.heading: 跃入
sections.text: 跃入时有3艘"海盗盗墓者"天使战列舰。你将降落在一个通往露台的锁定加速轨道处。

sections.heading: 第一个死亡空间房间 - 露台
sections.text: 通往综合体更深层的加速轨道由三组敌人守卫。它们可以分别触发。命名的战列舰（天使突袭指挥官）触发增援。加速轨道未锁定，该房间可以跳过。

sections.heading: 第二个死亡空间房间 - 传送门
sections.text: 该房间为可选。通往下一房间（大厅）的轨道未锁定。

sections.heading: 第三个死亡空间房间 - 大厅
sections.text: 该房间有自由无人机敌人以及黑入容器。

sections.heading: 第四个死亡空间房间 - 圣坛
sections.text: 哨兵奇美拉菌株母体拥有强大的主动装甲防御和大量结构生命值，以及一个射程可达50公里的强力网子。它发射姆乔尔尼尔XL鱼雷，伤害相当可观。建议带一两个朋友来击杀它。

sections.heading: 战利品
sections.text: 如果你足够幸运获得该地点，奖励非常丰厚。
